114 public static bool IsBaseAvoidanceVisualEntity(Entity? ent)
115 {
116 if (ent == null) return false;
117 if (string.Equals(ent.LayerName, BaseAvoidanceVisualLayerName, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)) return true;
118 if (ent.EntityData is string strData)
119 {
120 return strData.StartsWith(BaseAvoidancePlaneEntityDataPrefix, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
121 strData.StartsWith(BaseAvoidanceLabelEntityDataPrefix, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
122 }
123 return false;
124 }

155 private static string GetBaseAvoidanceSourceKey(string? sourcePath)
156 {
157 return string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(sourcePath) ? string.Empty : sourcePath;
158 }
159
166 private static string BuildBaseAvoidanceTag(string prefix, string? sourcePath)
167 {
168 return string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(sourcePath) ? prefix : $"{prefix}:{sourcePath}";
169 }
170
176 private static string? TryGetBaseAvoidanceVisualSource(Entity? entity)
177 {
178 if (entity?.EntityData is not string data)
179 return null;
180
181 string prefix;
182 if (data.StartsWith(BaseAvoidancePlaneEntityDataPrefix, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
183 prefix = BaseAvoidancePlaneEntityDataPrefix;
184 else if (data.StartsWith(BaseAvoidanceLabelEntityDataPrefix, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
185 prefix = BaseAvoidanceLabelEntityDataPrefix;
186 else
187 return null;
188
189 if (string.Equals(data, prefix, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
190 return string.Empty;
191
192 string separator = prefix + ":";
193 return data.StartsWith(separator, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
194 ? data.Substring(separator.Length)
195 : null;
196 }
197
204 private static bool IsBaseAvoidanceVisualEntityForSource(Entity? entity, string? sourcePath)
205 {
206 string? entitySource = TryGetBaseAvoidanceVisualSource(entity);
207 if (entitySource == null)
208 return false;
209
210 return string.Equals(
211 GetBaseAvoidanceSourceKey(entitySource),
212 GetBaseAvoidanceSourceKey(sourcePath),
213 StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
214 }

274 "mile" or "miles" or "mi" => linearUnitsType.Miles,
275 "mm" or "millimeter" or "millimeters" => linearUnitsType.Millimeters,

278 "km" or "kilometer" or "kilometers" => linearUnitsType.Kilometers,

280 "mil" or "mils" => linearUnitsType.Mils,

282 "angstrom" or "angstroms" => linearUnitsType.Angstroms,
283 "nm" or "nanometer" or "nanometers" => linearUnitsType.Nanometers,
284 "micron" or "microns" => linearUnitsType.Microns,
285 "dm" or "decimeter" or "decimeters" => linearUnitsType.Decimeters,

699 public void UpdateContextMenuVisibilities()
700 {
701 bool isProbeCollisionRunning = _pathManager != null && _pathManager.IsProbeCollisionValidationRunning;
702 if (isSimulationActive && _pathManager != null && _pathManager.CmmType == Models.CMMType.Probe && !isProbeCollisionRunning)
703 {
704 ShowStandardContextMenuItemsVisibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
705 ShowSimulationContextMenuItemsVisibility = Visibility.Visible;
706 }
707 else
708 {
709 ShowStandardContextMenuItemsVisibility = Visibility.Visible;
710 ShowSimulationContextMenuItemsVisibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
711 }
712
713 UpdateProbeCollisionCheckMenuVisibility();
714 }
715
716 private void UpdateProbeCollisionCheckMenuVisibility()
717 {
718 bool isRunning = _pathManager != null && _pathManager.IsProbeCollisionValidationRunning;
719 bool canRunProbeCollisionCheck = !IsSimulationActive &&
720 _pathManager != null &&
721 _pathManager.HasGeneratedProbePaths() &&
722 !isRunning;
723 bool canRunSegmentCollisionCheck = !IsSimulationActive &&
724 _pathManager != null &&
725 _pathManager.CanRunGeneratedPathSegmentCollisionValidation &&
726 !isRunning;
727 ProbeCollisionCheckMenuVisibility = canRunProbeCollisionCheck ? Visibility.Visible : Visibility.Collapsed;
728 SegmentCollisionCheckMenuVisibility = canRunSegmentCollisionCheck ? Visibility.Visible : Visibility.Collapsed;
729 CancelProbeCollisionCheckMenuVisibility = isRunning ? Visibility.Visible : Visibility.Collapsed;
730 OnPropertyChanged(nameof(ShowFollowProbeMenuItem));
731 OnPropertyChanged(nameof(ShowStopFollowingMenuItem));
732 }

746 private void HandlePathManagerFacesAutoIgnored(IReadOnlyList<CADFace> faces)
747 {
748 if (faces == null || faces.Count == 0)
749 return;
750
751 var dispatcher = _designControl?.Dispatcher ?? Application.Current?.Dispatcher;
752 if (dispatcher != null && !dispatcher.CheckAccess())
753 {
754 dispatcher.Invoke(() => HandlePathManagerFacesAutoIgnored(faces));
755 return;
756 }
757
758 foreach (var face in faces)
759 {
760 if (face == null)
761 continue;
762
763 face.IsIgnored = true;
764 IgnoredFaces.Add(face);
765 }
766
767 if (_holesByColor != null)
768 {
769 var newlyIgnoredFaceIndices = new HashSet<int>(faces.Where(f => f != null).Select(f => f.FaceGlobalIndex));
770 foreach (var holeList in _holesByColor.Values)
771 {
772 foreach (var hole in holeList)
773 {
774 bool holeFacesIgnored = hole.FaceGlobalIndices != null && hole.FaceGlobalIndices.Any(idx => newlyIgnoredFaceIndices.Contains(idx));
775 if (hole.IsIgnored || holeFacesIgnored)
776 {
777 if (!hole.IsIgnored)
778 {
779 hole.IsIgnored = true;
780 }
781 if (!IgnoredHoles.Contains(hole))
782 {
783 IgnoredHoles.Add(hole);
784 }
785 }
786 }
787 }
788 }
789
790 _ignoredItemManager?.ApplyIgnoredStyle(faces.Where(f => f != null));
791 _ignoredItemManager?.SyncVisibility();
792 _visualsManager?.DrawAllMarkers(_allFacesByColor, _holesByColor!, IgnoredFaces, IgnoredHoles, _flippedFaceNormals);
793 PopulateTreeViewBasedOnFilter();
794 }

977 private async System.Threading.Tasks.Task RestoreSessionFromConfig(HirEV_SmartFitSystemsApp.Models.Configuration.SessionConfig config)
978 {
979 if (config == null) return;
980 CancelActiveObjectManipulatorForModelChange();
981 UndoManager.Clear();
982
983 EyeshotStatus_Text = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Eyeshot_RestoringSession") ?? "Restoring session...";
984 Mouse.OverrideCursor = Cursors.Wait;
985
986 try
987 {
988 // 1. Clear current state
989 CancelActiveObjectManipulatorForModelChange();
990 _designControl.Clear();
991 ClearOriginGrids();
992
993 Entities.Clear();
994 _selectionUtils.ClearDesignControlSelection();
995 _visualsManager.ClearAllMarkers();
996 _allFacesByColor.Clear();
997 _facesByColor.Clear();
998 _holesByColor.Clear();
999 _faceIndexToHoleMap = null;
1000 IgnoredFaces.Clear();
1001 IgnoredHoles.Clear();
1002 _flippedFaceNormals.Clear();
1003 _treeViewHelper.ClearTreeViewSelection();
1004 _pathManager.ClearAllPaths();
1005 UpdateProbeCollisionCheckMenuVisibility();
1006 _pathManager.InvalidateShellCache();
1007 _cachedShellMeshDTOs.Clear();
1008 _cachedEyeshotFaceRefDTOs.Clear();
1009
1010 // Re-initialize manager since _designControl.Clear() removed its block/reference
1011 _ignoredItemManager = new IgnoredItemManager(_designControl) { DocLanguage = DocLanguage };
1012
1013 // 2. Load Models
1014 if (config.Models.Any())
1015 {
1016 CurrentlyLoadedFilePath = config.Models.First().FilePath;
1017 }
1018
1019 foreach (var model in config.Models)
1020 {
1021 if (File.Exists(model.FilePath))
1022 {
1023 await ImportModelQuietlyAsync(model.FilePath, LoadMatrixFromArray(model.CurrentTransform), LoadMatrixFromArray(model.OriginalTransform));
1024 }
1025 }
1026
1027 // Build file-path-to-entity-index map from newly loaded entities
1028 // This is needed because ImportModelQuietlyAsync creates entities at new indices
1029 var fileToEntityIndex = new Dictionary<string, int>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
1030 for (int i = 0; i < _designControl.Entities.Count; i++)
1031 {
1032 var ent = _designControl.Entities[i];
1033 if (IsSessionModelEntity(ent))
1034 {
1035 string? filePath = ent.EntityData as string;
1036 if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(filePath) && !fileToEntityIndex.ContainsKey(filePath))
1037 fileToEntityIndex[filePath] = i;
1038 }
1039 }
1040
1041 var oldToNewEntityIndex = new Dictionary<int, int>();
1042
1043 // Run all UI/restoration operations synchronously on the UI thread dispatcher
1044 await _designControl.Dispatcher.InvokeAsync(() =>
1045 {
1046 // 3. Restore Metadata (Faces/Holes) directly from configuration
1047 // We DO NOT re-extract faces here to save time and ensure exact match with saved state
1048 if (config.FullCADData != null && config.FullCADData.Any())
1049 {
1050 foreach (var groupDTO in config.FullCADData)
1051 {
1052 string colorKey = groupDTO.ColorName ?? "Default";
1053
1054 if (!_allFacesByColor.ContainsKey(colorKey)) _allFacesByColor[colorKey] = new List<CADFace>();
1055 if (!_facesByColor.ContainsKey(colorKey)) _facesByColor[colorKey] = new List<CADFace>();
1056 if (!_holesByColor.ContainsKey(colorKey)) _holesByColor[colorKey] = new List<CADHole>();
1057
1058 _allFacesByColor[colorKey].AddRange(groupDTO.Faces);
1059
1060 foreach (var holeDto in groupDTO.Holes)
1061 {
1062 _holesByColor[colorKey].Add(CADHole.FromDTO(holeDto));
1063 }
1064
1065 // Split _allFacesByColor into _facesByColor (non-hole faces only for tree view)
1066 var holeFaceIndices = _holesByColor[colorKey].SelectMany(h => h.FaceGlobalIndices).ToHashSet();
1067 _facesByColor[colorKey].AddRange(groupDTO.Faces.Where(f => !holeFaceIndices.Contains(f.FaceGlobalIndex)));
1068 }
1069
1070 // Remap EntityIndex for all restored faces to match newly loaded entity indices
1071 // We map each face's Original EntityIndex (which is face.EntityIndex right now)
1072 // to the new EntityIndex in the loaded session.
1073 // First, let's build a map of ModelFilePath -> List of new entity indices
1074 var fileToEntityIndices = new Dictionary<string, List<int>>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
1075 for (int i = 0; i < _designControl.Entities.Count; i++)
1076 {
1077 var ent = _designControl.Entities[i];
1078 if (IsSessionModelEntity(ent))
1079 {
1080 string? filePath = ent.EntityData as string;
1081 if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(filePath))
1082 {
1083 if (!fileToEntityIndices.ContainsKey(filePath))
1084 fileToEntityIndices[filePath] = new List<int>();
1085 fileToEntityIndices[filePath].Add(i);
1086 }
1087 }
1088 }
1089
1090 // We also need to group the faces by their original EntityIndex so we can map them in order.
1091 // Assuming that the order of original EntityIndex for a given file matches the order of new EntityIndex.
1092 var originalIndicesByFile = new Dictionary<string, SortedSet<int>>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
1093 foreach (var faceList in _allFacesByColor.Values)
1094 {
1095 foreach (var face in faceList)
1096 {
1097 if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(face.ModelFilePath))
1098 {
1099 if (!originalIndicesByFile.ContainsKey(face.ModelFilePath))
1100 originalIndicesByFile[face.ModelFilePath] = new SortedSet<int>();
1101 originalIndicesByFile[face.ModelFilePath].Add(face.EntityIndex);
1102 }
1103 }
1104 }
1105
1106 // Create the explicit mapping from old EntityIndex to new EntityIndex
1107 foreach (var kvp in originalIndicesByFile)
1108 {
1109 string filePath = kvp.Key;
1110 var oldIndices = kvp.Value.ToList();
1111 if (fileToEntityIndices.TryGetValue(filePath, out var newIndices))
1112 {
1113 // Map in order. If there are mismatches, map up to the available count.
1114 int count = Math.Min(oldIndices.Count, newIndices.Count);
1115 for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
1116 {
1117 oldToNewEntityIndex[oldIndices[i]] = newIndices[i];
1118 }
1119 }
1120 }
1121
1122 foreach (var faceList in _allFacesByColor.Values)
1123 {
1124 foreach (var face in faceList)
1125 {
1126 if (oldToNewEntityIndex.TryGetValue(face.EntityIndex, out int newIdx))
1127 {
1128 face.EntityIndex = newIdx;
1129 }
1130 else
1131 {
1132 // Fallback: try to find an entity that can hold this face if the exact mapping failed
1133 if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(face.ModelFilePath) && fileToEntityIndices.TryGetValue(face.ModelFilePath, out var newIndices))
1134 {
1135 foreach (int possibleIdx in newIndices)
1136 {
1137 if (possibleIdx < _designControl.Entities.Count && _designControl.Entities[possibleIdx] is Brep brep)
1138 {
1139 if (face.FaceIndex < brep.Faces.Length)
1140 {
1141 face.EntityIndex = possibleIdx;
1142 break;
1143 }
1144 }
1145 }
1146 }
1147 }
1148 }
1149 }
1150
1151 UpdateFaceIndexToHoleMap();
1152 FacesUpToDate = true;
1153 }
1154
1155 // 4. Restore Statuses (Ignored / Flipped)
1156 _flippedFaceNormals = new HashSet<int>(config.FlippedNormals);
1157 ApplyFlippedFaceTextures();
1158
1159 IgnoredFaces.Clear();
1160 foreach (var faceIdx in config.IgnoredFacesIndices)
1161 {
1162 var face = _allFacesByColor.Values.SelectMany(f => f).FirstOrDefault(f => f.FaceGlobalIndex == faceIdx);
1163 if (face != null)
1164 {
1165 face.IsIgnored = true;
1166 IgnoredFaces.Add(face);
1167 }
1168 }
1169
1170 IgnoredHoles.Clear();
1171 foreach (var holeId in config.IgnoredHolesIndices)
1172 {
1173 var hole = _holesByColor.Values.SelectMany(h => h).FirstOrDefault(h => h.HoleId == holeId);
1174 if (hole != null)
1175 {
1176 hole.IsIgnored = true;
1177 IgnoredHoles.Add(hole);
1178 }
1179 }
1180
1181 // 5. Restore Paths
1182 var pathPlanningInfo = config.ProbePathPlanningInfo;
1183 if (pathPlanningInfo == null || pathPlanningInfo.ColorPaths == null || !pathPlanningInfo.ColorPaths.Any())
1184 {
1185 pathPlanningInfo = config.ScannerPathPlanningInfo;
1186 }
1187
1188 if (pathPlanningInfo != null)
1189 {
1190 _pathManager.LoadPathFromDTO(pathPlanningInfo);
1191 UpdateProbeCollisionCheckMenuVisibility();
1192 RemapLoadedPathPointEntityIndices(oldToNewEntityIndex);
1193 RepairMissingPathPointOwnershipFromModelGeometry();
1194 measuring_sp?.RefreshColorToolList();
1195 if (measuring_sp != null)
1196 {
1197 // Only collapse if there are actual paths
1198 if (pathPlanningInfo.ColorPaths != null && pathPlanningInfo.ColorPaths.Any())
1199 measuring_sp.GeneratePaths_Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
1200 else
1201 measuring_sp.GeneratePaths_Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
1202 }
1203 _lastSavedPathHash = _pathManager.GetPathStateHash();
1204 }
1205 else
1206 {
1207 if (measuring_sp != null)
1208 {
1209 measuring_sp.GeneratePaths_Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
1210 }
1211 _lastSavedPathHash = string.Empty;
1212 UpdateProbeCollisionCheckMenuVisibility();
1213 }
1214
1215 // 6. Restore Meshes (Shells only, Ignored mesh is reconstructed dynamically below)
1216 void EnsureLayerExistsLocal(string layerName)
1217 {
1218 if (!_designControl.Layers.Contains(layerName))
1219 {
1220 bool isShell = layerName != null && layerName.StartsWith("SHELL_", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
1221 var layer = new devDept.Eyeshot.Layer(layerName) { Color = System.Drawing.Color.White, Visible = !isShell };
1222 _designControl.Layers.Add(layer);
1223 }
1224 }
1225
1226 if (config.ShellMeshes != null)
1227 {
1228 foreach (var shellDto in config.ShellMeshes)
1229 {
1230 var mesh = shellDto.ToMesh();
1231 if (mesh != null)
1232 {
1233 EnsureLayerExistsLocal(mesh.LayerName);
1234 if (mesh.LayerName != null && mesh.LayerName.StartsWith("SHELL_", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
1235 {
1236 mesh.Visible = false;
1237 }
1238 _designControl.Entities.Add(mesh);
1239 }
1240 }
1241 }
1242
1243 // Cache the shell mesh DTOs so they survive Entities.Regen() calls
1244 _cachedShellMeshDTOs = config.ShellMeshes != null
1245 ? new List<ShellMeshDTO>(config.ShellMeshes)
1246 : new List<ShellMeshDTO>();
1247 _cachedEyeshotFaceRefDTOs = config.EyeshotFaceReferences != null
1248 ? new List<ShellMeshDTO>(config.EyeshotFaceReferences)
1249 : new List<ShellMeshDTO>();
1250
1251 var sdfValidationInput = BuildSdfShellCacheValidationInput(config.Models, recomputeHashes: true);
1252 _pathManager.TryAttachSdfShellCache(config.SdfShellCache, sdfValidationInput);
1253
1254 // 7. Restore entity processing order
1255 if (config.ModelFileOrder != null && config.ModelFileOrder.Any())
1256 {
1257 var cadEntities = _designControl.Entities.Where(IsSessionModelEntity).ToList();
1258 var ordered = new List<Entity>();
1259 var usedEntities = new HashSet<Entity>();
1260
1261 foreach (var filePath in config.ModelFileOrder)
1262 {
1263 // Find the first entity matching the file path that hasn't been used yet
1264 var match = cadEntities.FirstOrDefault(e =>
1265 string.Equals(e.EntityData as string, filePath, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) &&
1266 !usedEntities.Contains(e));
1267
1268 if (match != null)
1269 {
1270 ordered.Add(match);
1271 usedEntities.Add(match);
1272 }
1273 }
1274 // Add any remaining entities that weren't explicitly ordered
1275 ordered.AddRange(cadEntities.Except(ordered));
1276 OrderedPartEntities = ordered;
1277 }
1278
1279 // 8. Reconstruct Ignored Mesh dynamically from stored indices
1280 if (IgnoredFaces.Any())
1281 {
1282 _ignoredItemManager.ApplyIgnoredStyle(IgnoredFaces);
1283 }
1284
1285 // 9. UI Update - Enable commands before populating TreeView
1286 CanExtractFaces = true;
1287 CanExport = true;
1288
1289 bool hasExtractedFaces = config.FullCADData != null && config.FullCADData.Any();
1290 bool hasProbePlanning = config.ProbePathPlanningInfo != null && config.ProbePathPlanningInfo.ColorPaths != null && config.ProbePathPlanningInfo.ColorPaths.Any();
1291 bool hasScannerPlanning = config.ScannerPathPlanningInfo != null && config.ScannerPathPlanningInfo.ColorPaths != null && config.ScannerPathPlanningInfo.ColorPaths.Any();
1292 bool hasPlanning = hasProbePlanning || hasScannerPlanning;
1293
1294 PlanningTab_Enabled = hasExtractedFaces;
1295 MeasuringTab_Enabled = hasExtractedFaces && hasPlanning;
1296
1297 _lastExtractedEntityCount = _designControl.Entities.Count;
1298 ExtractUpdateFacesButton_Text = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "UpdateFaces") ?? "Update Faces";
1299
1300 // 10. Final Visual & UI Update
1301 _ignoredItemManager.SyncVisibility();
1302 _visualsManager.DrawAllMarkers(_allFacesByColor, _holesByColor, IgnoredFaces, IgnoredHoles, _flippedFaceNormals);
1303
1304 _designControl.Entities.Regen();
1305 _designControl.Invalidate();
1306
1307 _treeViewHelper.InvalidateCache();
1308 PopulateTreeViewBasedOnFilter();
1309
1310 if (TreeViewItems == null || TreeViewItems.Count == 0)
1311 {
1312 PlanningTab_Enabled = false;
1313 }
1314
1315 planning_sp?.InitializeToleranceSliders();
1316 measuring_sp?.UpdateMeasurementCounts();
1317
1318 SaveCurrentSession();
1319
1320 // 11. Reconstruct Undo History from EditHistory
1321 if (_pathManager != null && _pathManager.EditHistory.Any())
1322 {
1323 UndoManager.Clear();
1324 var persistedEditGroups = _pathManager.EditHistory
1325 .Select((edit, order) => new { Edit = edit, Order = order })
1326 .GroupBy(item => string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(item.Edit.EditGroupId)
1327 ? $"LEGACY:{item.Order}"
1328 : $"GROUP:{item.Edit.EditGroupId}")
1329 .OrderBy(group => group.Min(item => item.Order));
1330
1331 foreach (var persistedGroup in persistedEditGroups)
1332 {
1333 var commands = new List<IUndoCommand>();
1334 foreach (var item in persistedGroup.OrderBy(entry => entry.Order))
1335 {
1336 var edit = item.Edit;
1337 var color = Color.FromArgb(edit.ColorR, edit.ColorG, edit.ColorB);
1338 if (!_pathManager.ColorPaths.TryGetValue(color, out var path))
1339 continue;
1340
1341 var oldPos = new Point3D(edit.OldX, edit.OldY, edit.OldZ);
1342 var newPos = new Point3D(edit.NewX, edit.NewY, edit.NewZ);
1343
1344 // Reconstruct the command using the target marker entity created during DrawAllPaths
1345 var marker = FindMarker(color, edit.PointIndex);
1346 if (marker != null)
1347 {
1348 // Use MoveWaypointCommand to support cross-session undo
1349 commands.Add(new MoveWaypointCommand(_pathManager, _designControl, path, edit.PointIndex, oldPos, newPos, Vector3D.AxisZ, Vector3D.AxisZ, marker));
1350 }
1351 }
1352
1353 if (commands.Count == 1)
1354 UndoManager.PushCommand(commands[0]);
1355 else if (commands.Count > 1)
1356 UndoManager.PushCommand(new CompositeCommand(commands));
1357 }
1358 UndoManager.MarkSaved();
1359 }
1360
1361 EyeshotStatus_Text = string.Format(GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Eyeshot_SessionRestored") ?? "Session restored from {0}", config.Timestamp);
1362 DesignerVisibility = Visibility.Visible;
1363
1364 // 12. Restore CMM Bounding Box and Grids
1365 UpdateCmmBoundingBoxAndGrid();
1366 }, DispatcherPriority.Normal);
1367
1368 await Task.Delay(200);
1369 await Application.Current.Dispatcher.InvokeAsync(() =>
1370 {
1371 _designControl.Entities.UpdateBoundingBox();
1372 _designControl.ZoomFit();
1373 _designControl.Invalidate();
1374 }, DispatcherPriority.ContextIdle);
1375 }
1376 catch (Exception ex)
1377 {
1378 System.Windows.MessageBox.Show($"Error restoring session: {ex.Message}", GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "MessageBox_InternalError") ?? "Error restoring session", System.Windows.MessageBoxButton.OK, System.Windows.MessageBoxImage.Error);
1379 }
1380 finally
1381 {
1382 Mouse.OverrideCursor = null;
1383 }
1384 }

1389 private sealed class PathOwnershipRepairPartBounds
1390 {
1394 public int EntityIndex { get; set; }
1398 public Point3D BoxMin { get; set; } = Point3D.Origin;
1402 public Point3D BoxMax { get; set; } = Point3D.Origin;
1403 }
1404
1409 private void RemapLoadedPathPointEntityIndices(IReadOnlyDictionary<int, int> oldToNewEntityIndex)
1410 {
1411 if (_pathManager?.ColorPaths == null)
1412 return;
1413
1414 foreach (var path in _pathManager.ColorPaths.Values)
1415 {
1416 if (path?.Points == null)
1417 continue;
1418
1419 EnsurePathPointEntityIndexCount(path);
1420
1421 for (int i = 0; i < path.PointEntityIndices.Count; i++)
1422 {
1423 int oldIndex = path.PointEntityIndices[i];
1424 if (oldIndex < 0)
1425 continue;
1426
1427 if (oldToNewEntityIndex != null && oldToNewEntityIndex.TryGetValue(oldIndex, out int newIndex))
1428 {
1429 path.PointEntityIndices[i] = newIndex;
1430 }
1431 else if (!IsCurrentSessionModelEntityIndex(oldIndex))
1432 {
1433 path.PointEntityIndices[i] = -1;
1434 }
1435 }
1436 }
1437 }
1438
1442 private void RepairMissingPathPointOwnershipFromModelGeometry()
1443 {
1444 if (_pathManager?.ColorPaths == null || _designControl?.Entities == null)
1445 return;
1446
1447 var partBounds = BuildPathOwnershipRepairPartBounds();
1448 if (partBounds.Count == 0)
1449 return;
1450
1451 var exclusiveColorOwnersByArgb = BuildExclusiveFaceColorOwnersByArgb();
1452
1453 foreach (var path in _pathManager.ColorPaths.Values)
1454 {
1455 if (path?.Points == null || path.Points.Count == 0)
1456 continue;
1457
1458 EnsurePathPointEntityIndexCount(path);
1459
1460 bool hasMissingOwnership = path.PointEntityIndices.Any(index => !IsCurrentSessionModelEntityIndex(index));
1461 if (!hasMissingOwnership)
1462 continue;
1463
1464 int colorArgb = path.Color.ToArgb();
1465 for (int i = 0; i < path.Points.Count; i++)
1466 {
1467 if (IsCurrentSessionModelEntityIndex(path.PointEntityIndices[i]))
1468 continue;
1469
1470 int inferredEntityIndex = -1;
1471 if (!IsBridgeIntermediaryPathPoint(path, i))
1472 {
1473 if (exclusiveColorOwnersByArgb.TryGetValue(colorArgb, out int colorOwner) &&
1474 IsCurrentSessionModelEntityIndex(colorOwner))
1475 {
1476 inferredEntityIndex = colorOwner;
1477 }
1478 else
1479 {
1480 inferredEntityIndex = FindNearestPartEntityIndex(path.Points[i], partBounds);
1481 }
1482 }
1483
1484 path.PointEntityIndices[i] = inferredEntityIndex;
1485 }
1486 }
1487 }
1488
1493 private List<PathOwnershipRepairPartBounds> BuildPathOwnershipRepairPartBounds()
1494 {
1495 var bounds = new List<PathOwnershipRepairPartBounds>();
1496 if (_designControl?.Entities == null)
1497 return bounds;
1498
1499 for (int i = 0; i < _designControl.Entities.Count; i++)
1500 {
1501 var entity = _designControl.Entities[i];
1502 if (!IsSessionModelEntity(entity))
1503 continue;
1504
1505 if (!TryGetFiniteEntityBounds(entity, out var boxMin, out var boxMax))
1506 continue;
1507
1508 bounds.Add(new PathOwnershipRepairPartBounds
1509 {
1510 EntityIndex = i,
1511 BoxMin = boxMin,
1512 BoxMax = boxMax
1513 });
1514 }
1515
1516 return bounds;
1517 }
1518
1523 private Dictionary<int, int> BuildExclusiveFaceColorOwnersByArgb()
1524 {
1525 var ownersByColor = new Dictionary<int, HashSet<int>>();
1526 if (_allFacesByColor == null)
1527 return new Dictionary<int, int>();
1528
1529 foreach (var face in _allFacesByColor.Values.SelectMany(faces => faces))
1530 {
1531 if (face == null || !IsCurrentSessionModelEntityIndex(face.EntityIndex))
1532 continue;
1533
1534 int argb = face.FaceColor.ToArgb();
1535 if (!ownersByColor.TryGetValue(argb, out var owners))
1536 {
1537 owners = new HashSet<int>();
1538 ownersByColor[argb] = owners;
1539 }
1540
1541 owners.Add(face.EntityIndex);
1542 }
1543
1544 return ownersByColor
1545 .Where(kvp => kvp.Value.Count == 1)
1546 .ToDictionary(kvp => kvp.Key, kvp => kvp.Value.First());
1547 }
1548
1554 private bool IsCurrentSessionModelEntityIndex(int entityIndex)
1555 {
1556 return _designControl?.Entities != null &&
1557 entityIndex >= 0 &&
1558 entityIndex < _designControl.Entities.Count &&
1559 IsSessionModelEntity(_designControl.Entities[entityIndex]);
1560 }
1561
1566 private static void EnsurePathPointEntityIndexCount(ColorPath path)
1567 {
1568 path.PointEntityIndices ??= new List<int>();
1569
1570 if (path.Points == null)
1571 {
1572 path.PointEntityIndices.Clear();
1573 return;
1574 }
1575
1576 while (path.PointEntityIndices.Count < path.Points.Count)
1577 path.PointEntityIndices.Add(-1);
1578
1579 if (path.PointEntityIndices.Count > path.Points.Count)
1580 path.PointEntityIndices.RemoveRange(path.Points.Count, path.PointEntityIndices.Count - path.Points.Count);
1581 }
1582
1589 private static bool IsBridgeIntermediaryPathPoint(ColorPath path, int pointIndex)
1590 {
1591 string? pointType = path.PointTypes != null &&
1592 pointIndex >= 0 &&
1593 pointIndex < path.PointTypes.Count
1594 ? path.PointTypes[pointIndex]
1595 : null;
1596
1597 return string.Equals(pointType, "BridgeIntermediary", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
1598 }
1599
1606 private static int FindNearestPartEntityIndex(Point3D point, IReadOnlyList<PathOwnershipRepairPartBounds> partBounds)
1607 {
1608 if (!IsFiniteGeometryPoint(point) || partBounds == null || partBounds.Count == 0)
1609 return -1;
1610
1611 int bestEntityIndex = -1;
1612 double bestDistanceSquared = double.MaxValue;
1613
1614 foreach (var bounds in partBounds)
1615 {
1616 double distanceSquared = DistanceSquaredToBox(point, bounds.BoxMin, bounds.BoxMax);
1617 if (distanceSquared < bestDistanceSquared)
1618 {
1619 bestDistanceSquared = distanceSquared;
1620 bestEntityIndex = bounds.EntityIndex;
1621 }
1622 }
1623
1624 return bestEntityIndex;
1625 }
1626
1634 private static bool TryGetFiniteEntityBounds(Entity entity, out Point3D boxMin, out Point3D boxMax)
1635 {
1636 boxMin = Point3D.Origin;
1637 boxMax = Point3D.Origin;
1638
1639 if (entity == null)
1640 return false;
1641
1642 try
1643 {
1644 entity.UpdateBoundingBox(new devDept.Eyeshot.TraversalParams());
1645 var min = entity.BoxMin;
1646 var max = entity.BoxMax;
1647 if (!IsFiniteGeometryPoint(min) || !IsFiniteGeometryPoint(max))
1648 return false;
1649
1650 boxMin = new Point3D(
1651 Math.Min(min.X, max.X),
1652 Math.Min(min.Y, max.Y),
1653 Math.Min(min.Z, max.Z));
1654 boxMax = new Point3D(
1655 Math.Max(min.X, max.X),
1656 Math.Max(min.Y, max.Y),
1657 Math.Max(min.Z, max.Z));
1658 return true;
1659 }
1660 catch
1661 {
1662 return false;
1663 }
1664 }
1665
1673 private static double DistanceSquaredToBox(Point3D point, Point3D boxMin, Point3D boxMax)
1674 {
1675 double dx = point.X < boxMin.X ? boxMin.X - point.X : point.X > boxMax.X ? point.X - boxMax.X : 0.0;
1676 double dy = point.Y < boxMin.Y ? boxMin.Y - point.Y : point.Y > boxMax.Y ? point.Y - boxMax.Y : 0.0;
1677 double dz = point.Z < boxMin.Z ? boxMin.Z - point.Z : point.Z > boxMax.Z ? point.Z - boxMax.Z : 0.0;
1678
1679 return dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz;
1680 }
1681
1687 private static bool IsFiniteGeometryPoint(Point3D point)
1688 {
1689 return point != null &&
1690 !double.IsNaN(point.X) &&
1691 !double.IsNaN(point.Y) &&
1692 !double.IsNaN(point.Z) &&
1693 !double.IsInfinity(point.X) &&
1694 !double.IsInfinity(point.Y) &&
1695 !double.IsInfinity(point.Z);
1696 }

1704 private async System.Threading.Tasks.Task ImportModelQuietlyAsync(string path, devDept.Geometry.Transformation currentTrans, devDept.Geometry.Transformation originalResetTrans)
1705 {
1706 // Similar to LoadModelAsync but without clearing and with specific transforms
1707 try
1708 {
1709 var tempDesign = new Design();
1710 ReadSTEP reader = null!;
1711
1712 await Task.Run(() =>
1713 {
1714 reader = new ReadSTEP(path);
1715 reader.DoWork();
1716 }).ConfigureAwait(false);
1717
1718 await Application.Current.Dispatcher.InvokeAsync(() =>
1719 {
1720 reader.AddTo(tempDesign);
1721
1722 // IMPORTANT: Copy Blocks from tempDesign to _designControl
1723 // BlockReferences in Entities need their Blocks to be present in the same Document
1724 foreach (Block b in tempDesign.Blocks)
1725 {
1726 if (!_designControl.Blocks.Contains(b.Name))
1727 _designControl.Blocks.Add(b);
1728 }
1729
1730 // IMPORTANT: Copy Layers from tempDesign to _designControl
1731 foreach (Layer l in tempDesign.Layers)
1732 {
1733 if (!_designControl.Layers.Contains(l.Name))
1734 _designControl.Layers.Add(l);
1735 }
1736
1737 foreach (var ent in tempDesign.Entities)
1738 {
1739 ent.EntityData = path; // Important for saving later
1740
1741 // Apply current transform
1742 ent.TransformBy(currentTrans);
1743
1744 _designControl.Entities.Add(ent);
1745
1746 // Store in _originalPositions for Reset capability
1747 StoreOriginalPosition(ent, new List<Entity> { ent }, currentTrans);
1748 }
1749 _designControl.Units = _units;
1750 });
1751 }
1752 catch (Exception ex)
1753 {
1754 Debug.WriteLine($"Error importing model quietly: {ex.Message}");
1755 }
1756 }

1761 public void SaveCurrentSession()
1762 {
1763 try
1764 {
1765 var config = new HirEV_SmartFitSystemsApp.Models.Configuration.SessionConfig
1766 {
1767 Timestamp = DateTime.Now,
1768 SessionName = string.IsNullOrEmpty(CurrentlyLoadedFilePath)
1769 ? $"Session_{DateTime.Now:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm}"
1770 : $"{Path.GetFileNameWithoutExtension(CurrentlyLoadedFilePath)} — {DateTime.Now:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm}"
1771 };
1772
1773 // 1. Models and their transforms
1774 config.Models = BuildCurrentSessionModelInfos();
1775 // 2. Metadata
1776 config.IgnoredFacesIndices = _ignoredItemManager?.GetIgnoredFaceIndices() ?? new List<int>();
1777 config.IgnoredHolesIndices = IgnoredHoles.Select(h => h.HoleId).ToList();
1778 config.FlippedNormals = _flippedFaceNormals.ToList();
1779
1780 // 3. Full CAD Data (Faces, Holes, Metadata)
1781 // Use _allFacesByColor so that faces belonging to holes are also persisted.
1782 config.FullCADData = HirEV_SmartFitSystemsApp.Utilities.JsonExportUtils.GetColorGroupedExportDTOs(_allFacesByColor, _holesByColor, false);
1783
1784 // 3b. Color Tolerances — save for ALL colours (faces + holes)
1785 var allColorKeys = new HashSet<string>(_facesByColor.Keys, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
1786 foreach (var k in _holesByColor.Keys) allColorKeys.Add(k);
1787 foreach (var colorHex in allColorKeys)
1788 {
1789 var tol = ToleranceConfigManager.GetValue(colorHex);
1790 if (tol != null)
1791 config.ColorTolerances[colorHex] = tol;
1792 }
1793
1794 // 3c. Entity processing order (from Entity Filter dialog)
1795 config.ModelFileOrder = OrderedPartEntities
1796 .Select(e => e.EntityData as string ?? string.Empty)
1797 .Where(p => !string.IsNullOrEmpty(p))
1798 .ToList();
1799 // Fallback: if no explicit ordering, save the natural order of loaded models
1800 if (!config.ModelFileOrder.Any() && config.Models.Any())
1801 config.ModelFileOrder = config.Models.Select(m => m.FilePath).ToList();
1802
1803 // 4. Path Planning
1804 if (_pathManager != null)
1805 {
1806 var pathExport = _pathManager.GetPathExportDTO(CurrentlyLoadedFilePath ?? "Session");
1807 if (IsScannerPathExport(pathExport))
1808 config.ScannerPathPlanningInfo = pathExport;
1809 else
1810 config.ProbePathPlanningInfo = pathExport;
1811 }
1812
1813 // 5. Meshes - Find robustly including inside blocks
1814 var allMeshes = new List<Mesh>();
1815 allMeshes.AddRange(_designControl.Entities.OfType<Mesh>());
1816 foreach (var br in _designControl.Entities.OfType<BlockReference>())
1817 {
1818 if (_designControl.Blocks.Contains(br.BlockName))
1819 {
1820 allMeshes.AddRange(_designControl.Blocks[br.BlockName].Entities.OfType<Mesh>());
1821 }
1822 }
1823
1824 var liveShellDTOs = allMeshes
1825 .Where(m => m.LayerName != null && m.LayerName.StartsWith("SHELL_"))
1826 .Select(m => ShellMeshDTO.FromMesh(m)).ToList();
1827
1828 // Guard: Entities.Regen() can destroy standalone Mesh vertex data.
1829 // If live meshes have empty vertices, fall back to the cached DTOs.
1830 bool liveShellsValid = liveShellDTOs.Count > 0
1831 && liveShellDTOs.All(dto => dto.Vertices != null && dto.Vertices.Count > 0);
1832
1833 if (liveShellsValid)
1834 {
1835 config.ShellMeshes = liveShellDTOs;
1836 _cachedShellMeshDTOs = new List<ShellMeshDTO>(liveShellDTOs);
1837 }
1838 else if (_cachedShellMeshDTOs.Count > 0)
1839 {
1840 config.ShellMeshes = new List<ShellMeshDTO>(_cachedShellMeshDTOs);
1841 }
1842 else
1843 {
1844 config.ShellMeshes = liveShellDTOs;
1845 }
1846
1847 if (_pathManager != null)
1848 {
1849 var sdfValidationInput = BuildSdfShellCacheValidationInput(config.Models, recomputeHashes: false);
1850 _pathManager.UpdateShellCacheValidationModels(sdfValidationInput.Models);
1851 config.SdfShellCache = _pathManager.ExportSdfShellCache(sdfValidationInput);
1852 }
1853
1854 var liveFaceRefDTOs = allMeshes
1855 .Where(m => m.LayerName != null && m.LayerName.Contains("FaceReference"))
1856 .Select(m => ShellMeshDTO.FromMesh(m)).ToList();
1857
1858 bool liveFaceRefsValid = liveFaceRefDTOs.Count > 0
1859 && liveFaceRefDTOs.All(dto => dto.Vertices != null && dto.Vertices.Count > 0);
1860
1861 if (liveFaceRefsValid)
1862 {
1863 config.EyeshotFaceReferences = liveFaceRefDTOs;
1864 _cachedEyeshotFaceRefDTOs = new List<ShellMeshDTO>(liveFaceRefDTOs);
1865 }
1866 else if (_cachedEyeshotFaceRefDTOs.Count > 0)
1867 {
1868 config.EyeshotFaceReferences = new List<ShellMeshDTO>(_cachedEyeshotFaceRefDTOs);
1869 }
1870 else
1871 {
1872 config.EyeshotFaceReferences = liveFaceRefDTOs;
1873 }
1874
1875 config.IgnoredFacesMesh = null; // No longer saving the mesh, will reconstruct from indices
1876
1877 config.UndoHistory = UndoManager.ExportTimeline();
1878
1879 HirEV_SmartFitSystemsApp.Utilities.Configuration.SessionConfigurationManager.SaveSession(config);
1880 if (_pathManager != null) _lastSavedPathHash = _pathManager.GetPathStateHash();
1881 UndoManager.MarkSaved();
1882 }
1883 catch (Exception ex)
1884 {
1885 Debug.WriteLine($"Error saving session: {ex.Message}");
1886 }
1887 }

1893 private List<ModelFileInfo> BuildCurrentSessionModelInfos()
1894 {
1895 var models = new List<ModelFileInfo>();
1896 var savedPaths = new HashSet<string>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
1897 var mainParts = _designControl.Entities.Where(IsSessionModelEntity).ToList();
1898
1899 foreach (var part in mainParts)
1900 {
1901 if (part.LayerName != null && IsSessionSystemLayer(part.LayerName))
1902 continue;
1903
1904 string? path = part.EntityData as string;
1905 if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(path))
1906 path = CurrentlyLoadedFilePath;
1907
1908 if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(path) || !File.Exists(path) || !savedPaths.Add(path))
1909 continue;
1910
1911 var currentTransform = GetCurrentTransformForSessionEntity(part);
1912 models.Add(new ModelFileInfo
1913 {
1914 FilePath = path,
1915 Hash = HirEV_SmartFitSystemsApp.Utilities.Configuration.SessionConfigurationManager.CalculateFileHash(path),
1916 CurrentTransform = GetMatrixAsArray(currentTransform),
1917 OriginalTransform = GetMatrixAsArray(devDept.Geometry.Transformation.CreateIdentity())
1918 });
1919 }
1920
1921 return models;
1922 }
1923
1929 private devDept.Geometry.Transformation GetCurrentTransformForSessionEntity(Entity part)
1930 {
1931 foreach (var stored in _originalPositions.Values)
1932 {
1933 var entityTransform = stored.Entities.FirstOrDefault(item => ReferenceEquals(item.ent, part));
1934 if (entityTransform.ent != null && entityTransform.trans != null)
1935 {
1936 var currentTrans = (devDept.Geometry.Transformation)entityTransform.trans.Clone();
1937 currentTrans.Invert();
1938 return currentTrans;
1939 }
1940 }
1941
1942 return devDept.Geometry.Transformation.CreateIdentity();
1943 }
1944
1950 private double[] GetMatrixAsArray(devDept.Geometry.Transformation trans)
1951 {
1952 var arr = new double[16];
1953 for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++)
1954 {
1955 for (int j = 0; j < 4; j++)
1956 {
1957 arr[i * 4 + j] = trans[i, j];
1958 }
1959 }
1960 return arr;
1961 }
1962
1968 private devDept.Geometry.Transformation LoadMatrixFromArray(double[] arr)
1969 {
1970 if (arr == null || arr.Length != 16) return devDept.Geometry.Transformation.CreateIdentity();
1971 var trans = new devDept.Geometry.Transformation();
1972 for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++)
1973 {
1974 for (int j = 0; j < 4; j++)
1975 {
1976 trans[i, j] = arr[i * 4 + j];
1977 }
1978 }
1979 return trans;
1980 }
1981
1990 private void TransformCachedShellMeshDTOs(devDept.Geometry.Transformation transform)
1991 {
1992 if (transform == null) return;
1993
1994 static void ApplyTransform(List<ShellMeshDTO> dtos, devDept.Geometry.Transformation t)
1995 {
1996 foreach (var dto in dtos)
1997 {
1998 if (dto.Vertices == null) continue;
1999 for (int i = 0; i < dto.Vertices.Count; i++)
2000 {
2001 var v = dto.Vertices[i];
2002 var pt = new Point3D(v.X, v.Y, v.Z);
2003 pt.TransformBy(t);
2004 dto.Vertices[i] = new PointExportDTO(pt);
2005 }
2006 }
2007 }
2008
2009 ApplyTransform(_cachedShellMeshDTOs, transform);
2010 ApplyTransform(_cachedEyeshotFaceRefDTOs, transform);
2011 }

2019 private SdfShellCacheValidationInput BuildSdfShellCacheValidationInput(IEnumerable<ModelFileInfo>? models, bool recomputeHashes)
2020 {
2021 var input = new SdfShellCacheValidationInput
2022 {
2023 OffsetDistance = double.Parse(ConfigurationManager.AppSettings["ApproachOffsetDistance"] ?? "3.0"),
2024 VoxelSize = PathManager.SdfShellVoxelSize,
2025 HoleFaceIndices = GetCurrentShellHoleFaceIndices().OrderBy(i => i).ToList(),
2026 FlippedNormals = _flippedFaceNormals.OrderBy(i => i).ToList()
2027 };
2028
2029 if (models != null)
2030 {
2031 foreach (var model in models)
2032 {
2033 if (model == null)
2034 continue;
2035
2036 input.Models.Add(new SdfShellModelFingerprintDTO
2037 {
2038 FilePath = model.FilePath,
2039 Hash = recomputeHashes
2040 ? HirEV_SmartFitSystemsApp.Utilities.Configuration.SessionConfigurationManager.CalculateFileHash(model.FilePath)
2041 : model.Hash,
2042 CurrentTransform = NormalizeTransformArray(model.CurrentTransform)
2043 });
2044 }
2045 }
2046
2047 return input;
2048 }

2054 private HashSet<int> GetCurrentShellHoleFaceIndices()
2055 {
2056 var indices = new HashSet<int>();
2057 if (_holesByColor == null)
2058 return indices;
2059
2060 foreach (var holeList in _holesByColor.Values)
2061 {
2062 foreach (var hole in holeList)
2063 {
2064 if (hole?.FaceGlobalIndices == null)
2065 continue;
2066
2067 foreach (var faceIndex in hole.FaceGlobalIndices)
2068 {
2069 indices.Add(faceIndex);
2070 }
2071 }
2072 }
2073
2074 return indices;
2075 }

2082 private static double[] NormalizeTransformArray(double[]? transform)
2083 {
2084 if (transform == null || transform.Length != 16)
2085 {
2086 var identity = devDept.Geometry.Transformation.CreateIdentity();
2087 var values = new double[16];
2088 for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++)
2089 {
2090 for (int j = 0; j < 4; j++)
2091 {
2092 values[i * 4 + j] = identity[i, j];
2093 }
2094 }
2095
2096 return values;
2097 }
2098
2099 return transform.ToArray();
2100 }

2107 private static bool IsSessionModelEntity(Entity? entity)
2108 {
2109 if (entity == null)
2110 return false;
2111
2112 if (entity.EntityData as string == "UI_MARKER" || entity.EntityData as string == "PART_ORIGIN")
2113 return false;
2114
2115 string? layerName = entity.LayerName;
2116 if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(layerName) && IsSessionSystemLayer(layerName))
2117 return false;
2118
2119 string? sourcePath = entity.EntityData as string;
2120 if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(sourcePath) && File.Exists(sourcePath))
2121 return true;
2122
2123 if (entity is Brep || entity is Mesh || entity is Solid)
2124 return true;
2125
2126 return HirEV_SmartFitSystemsApp.Utilities.EyeshotGeometryUtils.TryConvertToBrep(entity) != null;
2127 }
2128
2134 private static bool IsSessionSystemLayer(string layerName)
2135 {
2136 return layerName.StartsWith("SHELL_", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
2137 layerName.Contains("IGNORED", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
2138 layerName.StartsWith("PATH_", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
2139 layerName.StartsWith("SCANNER_", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
2140 layerName.StartsWith("PROBE_", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
2141 layerName.StartsWith("TRACKING_", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
2142 layerName.StartsWith("MEASUREMENT_", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
2143 layerName.Contains("SIMULATION", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
2144 layerName.Equals("MARKERS", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
2145 layerName.Equals("COLLISION_MARKERS", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
2146 layerName.Equals("RAYCAST_HITS", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
2147 layerName.Equals("PROBE_TRACKING", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
2148 layerName.Equals("SCANNER_FOV_VISUALIZATION", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
2149 layerName.StartsWith("BASE_AVOIDANCE", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
2150 }

2689 public string ShellVisibilityMenuText
2690 {
2691 get
2692 {
2693 try
2694 {
2695 if (_designControl == null || _designControl.Entities == null)
2696 return GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "ContextMenu_ShowShellMesh") ?? "Show Exterior Shell";
2697
2698 // Prefer layer visibility because shell toggle works at layer level
2699 var shellLayerNames = _designControl.Layers
2700 .Where(l => l != null && l.Name != null &&
2701 l.Name.StartsWith("SHELL_", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
2702 .Select(l => l.Name)
2703 .ToList();
2704
2705 if (shellLayerNames.Count > 0)
2706 {
2707 bool anyLayerVisible = shellLayerNames.Any(layerName => _designControl.Layers.Contains(layerName) && _designControl.Layers[layerName].Visible);
2708 return anyLayerVisible
2709 ? GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "ContextMenu_HideShellMesh") ?? "Hide Exterior Shell"
2710 : GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "ContextMenu_ShowShellMesh") ?? "Show Exterior Shell";
2711 }
2712
2713 // Fallback for cases where shell entities exist without dedicated layers
2714 var shellEntities = _designControl.Entities
2715 .Where(e => e != null && e.LayerName != null &&
2716 e.LayerName.StartsWith("SHELL_", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
2717 .ToList();
2718
2719 if (shellEntities.Count == 0)
2720 return GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "ContextMenu_ShowShellMesh") ?? "Show Exterior Shell";
2721
2722 bool anyVisible = shellEntities.Any(e => e != null && e.Visible);
2723 return anyVisible
2724 ? GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "ContextMenu_HideShellMesh") ?? "Hide Exterior Shell"
2725 : GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "ContextMenu_ShowShellMesh") ?? "Show Exterior Shell";
2726 }
2727 catch
2728 {
2729 return GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "ContextMenu_ShowShellMesh") ?? "Show Exterior Shell";
2730 }
2731 }
2732 }
2733
2737 public bool ShellMeshesExist

2748 // Count shell entities safely
2749 var shellEntities = _designControl.Entities

2751 e.LayerName.StartsWith("SHELL_", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
2752 .ToList();
2753
2754 return shellEntities.Count > 0;
2755 }

2757 {
2758 return false;
2759 }
2760 }

2933 #region Constructor
2938 public MainViewModel(MainWindow parent)
2939 {
2940 // Sync configurations dynamically from 3DModels files
2941 DynamicToolScanner.SyncConfigurations();
2942
2943 //Ensure creation of ProtectedConfig and the ExampleProfileDataXML files
2944 ProtectedConfigManager.EnsureConfigFileExists();
2945 //Ensure the PasswordFile exists
2946 SecurePasswordManager.InitializeOnFirstRun();
2947 //Set Default ProtectedValues
2948 Machine_IPAddress = ProtectedConfigManager.ReadConfig("Machine_IPAddress");
2949
2950 // Load Language
2951 var asm = Assembly.GetExecutingAssembly();
2952 XmlDocument newDocLanguage = new XmlDocument();
2953 string languageCode = ConfigurationManager.AppSettings["Language"] ?? "EN"; // Default to "EN" if not set
2954 string doclanguage_filetype = ConfigurationManager.AppSettings["DocLanguage_FileType"] ?? ".xml";
2955 var stream = asm.GetManifestResourceStream($"{asm.GetName().Name}.Language.{languageCode + doclanguage_filetype}");
2956 if (stream != null) { newDocLanguage.Load(stream); }
2957 DocLanguage = newDocLanguage;
2958 // Propagate language document to utility classes for localized logging
2959 JsonExportUtils.DocLanguage = newDocLanguage;
2960 XmlExportUtils.DocLanguage = newDocLanguage;
2961 HirEV_SmartFitSystemsApp.Utilities.Configuration.SessionConfigurationManager.DocLanguage = newDocLanguage;
2962 // Set Language
2963 XmlDataProvider languageData = (XmlDataProvider)parent.Resources["Language"];
2964 languageData.Document = DocLanguage;
2965 parent.Resources["Language"] = languageData;
2966
2967 //Set UI Language Defaults
2968 ConnectButton_Text = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Connect") ?? connectButton_Text;
2969 ExtractUpdateFacesButton_Text = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "ExtractFaces") ?? extractUpdateFacesButton_Text;
2970 Status_Text = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "NotConnected") ?? status_Text;
2971 Machine_Status_ProgressText = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Idle") ?? machine_Status_ProgressText;
2972 WindowMaximizeReduce = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Maximize") ?? "Maximize";
2973
2974 // Get ParentWindow
2975 MainParent = parent;
2976
2977 //Initialization of SidePanels
2978 about_sp = new About_SidePanel(this);
2979 measuring_sp = new Measuring_SidePanel(this);
2980 planning_sp = new Planning_SidePanel(this);
2981 settings_sp = new Settings_SidePanel(this);
2982 InitializePanelTimers();
2983
2984 //App Clock
2985 ClockTimer.Interval = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(1);
2986 ClockTimer.Tick += ClockTimer_Tick;
2987 ClockTimer.Start();
2988
2989 // Events
2990 parent.Closing += parent_Closing;
2991 parent.KeyDown += parent_KeyDown;
2992 parent.PreviewKeyDown += parent_KeyDown;
2993 parent.FacesTreeView.SelectedItemChanged += FaceTreeView_SelectedItemChanged;
2994
2995 //Part Manager Initialization
2996 _designControl = parent.designControl ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(parent.designControl));
2997
2998 // Hook up ContextMenuOpening event to prevent default context menu during manual marking
2999 _designControl.ContextMenuOpening += DesignControl_ContextMenuOpening;
3000 _designControl.PreviewKeyDown += parent_KeyDown;
3001
3002 // Initialize configuration values
3003 _units = ParseUnits(ConfigurationManager.AppSettings["Units"] ?? "mm");
3004 _blueSphereSize = double.TryParse(ConfigurationManager.AppSettings["ControlPointBlueSphereSize"], out var blue) ? blue : 2.0;
3005 _pinkSphereSize = double.TryParse(ConfigurationManager.AppSettings["ControlPointPinkSphereSize"], out var pink) ? pink : 1.0;
3006 _yellowCubeSize = double.TryParse(ConfigurationManager.AppSettings["VertexPointYellowCubeSize"], out var yellow) ? yellow : 0.5;
3007 _holeSphereSize = double.TryParse(ConfigurationManager.AppSettings["HoleSphereSize"], out var size) ? size : 2.0;
3008 _holeDepthLineWidth = int.TryParse(ConfigurationManager.AppSettings["HoleDepthLineWidth"], out var width) ? width : 3;
3009 _manualMarkingSphereSize = double.TryParse(ConfigurationManager.AppSettings["ManualMarkingSphereSize"], out var manualSize) ? manualSize : 3.0;
3010
3011 // Initialize utility classes
3012 _selectionUtils = new EyeshotSelectionUtils(_designControl);
3013 _visualsManager = new EyeshotVisualsManager(_designControl, _blueSphereSize, _pinkSphereSize, _yellowCubeSize, _holeSphereSize, _holeDepthLineWidth);
3014 _visualsManager.ControlPointsVisualsCleared += ResetShowAllControlPointsState;
3015 _treeViewHelper = new EyeshotTreeViewHelper(this);
3016 _cameraUtils = new EyeshotCameraUtils(_designControl, this);
3017 _cameraUtils.SetCameraOrbitalOffset(SimulationCameraOffset);
3018 _ignoredItemManager = new IgnoredItemManager(_designControl) { DocLanguage = DocLanguage };
3019 _measuringToolConfig = new MeasuringToolConfigManager();
3020 MeasuringToolConfigManager.ConfigurationChanged += MeasuringToolConfigManager_ConfigurationChanged;
3021 _recentPartsManager = new RecentPartsManager();
3022
3023 // Initialize recent parts visibility
3024 UpdateRecentPartsVisibility();
3025
3026 // Configure Eyeshot control
3027 try
3028 {
3029 _designControl.Units = _units;
3030 _designControl.ActiveViewport.DisplayMode = displayType.Rendered;
3031 _designControl.SelectionFilterMode = selectionFilterType.Face | selectionFilterType.Vertex;
3032 _designControl.ActionMode = actionType.SelectVisibleByPickDynamic;
3033 _designControl.ToolBar.Visible = true;
3034 _designControl.ForceHardwareAcceleration = false;
3035 _designControl.ShowFps = true;
3036 _designControl.ShowNormals = bool.TryParse(ConfigurationManager.AppSettings["Eyeshot_ShowNormals"], out var snrm) ? snrm : false; // Show face normals
3040 QualitySetting = Enum.TryParse(ConfigurationManager.AppSettings["RenderQualitySetting"], out QualitySettingEnum savedEnum) ? savedEnum : QualitySettingEnum.Quality; //Default to quality if invalid
3041 EyeshotVisualsManager.SetEyeshotQualitySetting(QualitySetting, _designControl); //Set quality level
3042 UpdateCmmBoundingBoxAndGrid();
3043 }
3044 catch (Exception ex)
3045 {
3046 Debug.WriteLine($"WARNING: Eyeshot Graphics Initialization Failed: {ex.Message}");
3047 // Fallback to safe mode
3048 try
3049 {
3050 _designControl.ForceHardwareAcceleration = false;
3051 _designControl.ActiveViewport.DisplayMode = displayType.Wireframe;
3052 _designControl.Invalidate();
3053 }
3054 catch { /* Final fallback failure */ }
3055 }
3056
3057 // Setup Section View (Clipping Plane) button helper
3058 Action addBtnToToolBars = () =>
3059 {
3060 if (_designControl.Viewports == null) return;
3061 bool added = false;
3062 foreach (var vp in _designControl.Viewports)
3063 {
3064 if (vp.ToolBars != null && vp.ToolBars.Count > 0)
3065 {
3066 var tb = vp.ToolBars[0];
3067 if (tb.Buttons.Any(b => b.Name == "SectionViewMain")) continue;
3068
3069 var vpBtn = new ToolBarButton(new BitmapImage(new Uri("pack://application:,,,/Images/App_Resources/sectionview.png")), "SectionViewMain", GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "ContextMenu_SectionView") ?? "Toggle Section View Plane", ToolBarButton.styleType.ToggleButton, true);
3070
3071 vpBtn.Click += SectionViewMain_Click;
3072
3073 tb.Buttons.Insert(0, vpBtn); // Insert at beginning
3074 added = true;
3075 }
3076 }
3077
3078 if (added) Debug.WriteLine($" > SUCCESS: Section View button added to ToolBar(s).");
3079 };
3080
3081 // Retry strategy to catch late-initialized toolbars
3082 _designControl.Loaded += (s, e) =>
3083 {
3084 var timer = new System.Windows.Threading.DispatcherTimer { Interval = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(0.5) };
3085 int retries = 0;
3086 timer.Tick += (st, et) =>
3087 {
3088 addBtnToToolBars();
3089 if (_designControl.Viewports != null && _designControl.Viewports.Any(vp => vp.ToolBars != null && vp.ToolBars.Any(tb => tb.Buttons.Any(b => b.Name == "SectionViewMain"))))
3090 {
3091 timer.Stop();
3092 }
3093 if (retries++ > 20) timer.Stop();
3094 };
3095 timer.Start();
3096 };
3097 //Initialize PathManager
3098 _pathManager = new PathManager(_designControl, DocLanguage, _measuringToolConfig);
3099 _pathManager.CadVisibilityRestored = HandlePathManagerCadVisibilityRestored;
3100 _pathManager.FacesAutoIgnored = HandlePathManagerFacesAutoIgnored;
3101 _scanPathManager = new ScanPathManager();
3102
3103 // Subscribe to simulation events
3104 _pathManager.SimulationStarted += OnSimulationStarted!;
3105 _pathManager.SimulationStopped += OnSimulationStopped!;
3106 _pathManager.SimulationPointReached += OnSimulationPointReached!;
3107 _pathManager.SimulationPathCompleted += OnSimulationPathCompleted!;
3108 _pathManager.ProbeCameraPoseUpdated += OnProbeCameraPoseUpdated!;
3109 _pathManager.ScannerVerificationStarted += OnScannerVerificationStarted!;
3110 _pathManager.ScannerVerificationProgress += OnScannerVerificationProgress!;
3111 _pathManager.ScannerVerificationStopped += OnScannerVerificationStopped!;
3112 _pathManager.ProbeCollisionValidationStarted += OnProbeCollisionValidationStarted!;
3113 _pathManager.ProbeCollisionValidationProgress += OnProbeCollisionValidationProgress!;
3114 _pathManager.ProbeCollisionValidationStopped += OnProbeCollisionValidationStopped!;
3115 _pathManager.ProbeCollisionValidationCleanupCompleted += OnProbeCollisionValidationCleanupCompleted!;
3116 _pathManager.ColorGroupProcessing += OnColorGroupProcessing!;
3117 _pathManager.CollisionMarkersChanged += (s, e) => UpdateCollisionMarkersVisibility();
3118
3119 // Set initial state
3120 CanExtractFaces = false;
3121 CanExport = false;
3122 IsExteriorOnlyChecked = bool.TryParse(ConfigurationManager.AppSettings["ExportExteriorOnlyDefault"], out var isext) ? isext : true; // Initialize exterior points export flag
3123 ExportOnlyControlPoints = bool.TryParse(ConfigurationManager.AppSettings["ExportOnlyControlPointsDefault"], out var ocp) ? ocp : true; // Initialize control points export flag
3124 ExportOnlyMeasurementPoints = bool.TryParse(ConfigurationManager.AppSettings["ExportOnlyMeasurementPointsDefault"], out var omp) ? omp : false; // Initialize measurement points export flag
3125
3126 // Create a new timestamped session file immediately so every launch
3127 // has its own persistent record — even before any model is loaded.
3128 HirEV_SmartFitSystemsApp.Utilities.Configuration.SessionConfigurationManager.CreateNewSessionFile();
3129
3130 // Subscribe to UndoManager events for status bar notification
3131 UndoManager.UndoPerformed += (s, e) =>
3132 {
3133 EyeshotStatus_Text = $"Undo: {e.Description}";
3134 _designControl?.Entities?.Regen();
3135 _designControl?.Invalidate();
3136 UpdateHasPathChangesVisibility();
3137 };
3138 UndoManager.RedoPerformed += (s, e) =>
3139 {
3140 EyeshotStatus_Text = $"Redo: {e.Description}";
3141 _designControl?.Entities?.Regen();
3142 _designControl?.Invalidate();
3143 UpdateHasPathChangesVisibility();
3144 };
3145 UndoManager.CommandPushed += (s, e) =>
3146 {
3147 _designControl?.Entities?.Regen();
3148 _designControl?.Invalidate();
3149 UpdateHasPathChangesVisibility();
3150 };
3151 UndoManager.Cleared += (s, e) => UpdateHasPathChangesVisibility();
3152 }

3156 private void MeasuringToolConfigManager_ConfigurationChanged()
3157 {
3158 if (_measuringToolConfig != null)
3159 {
3160 // Reload config into memory from disk
3161 _measuringToolConfig.ReloadConfiguration();
3162
3163 // Only actively overwrite the Simulation paths if we are in Simulation mode
3164 // Do NOT touch ProbeCollisionValidation because we only want that to update on next restart.
3165 if (_pathManager != null && _pathManager.IsSimulating)
3166 {
3167 if (_pathManager.ColorPaths != null)
3168 {
3169 foreach (var colorPath in _pathManager.ColorPaths.Values)
3170 {
3171 if (colorPath.PathCmmType == Models.CMMType.Probe || colorPath.PathCmmType == Models.CMMType.Scanner)
3172 {
3173 string currentToolName = _measuringToolConfig.GetToolForColor(colorPath.Color);
3174 if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(currentToolName) && colorPath.ToolName != currentToolName)
3175 {
3176 colorPath.ToolName = currentToolName;
3177 }
3178 }
3179 }
3180 }
3181 _pathManager.RefreshCurrentSimulationTool();
3182 }
3183 }
3184 }

3209 private void parent_KeyDown(object? sender, System.Windows.Input.KeyEventArgs e)
3210 {
3211 if (_designControl == null) return;
3212
3213 if (e.Key == Key.Z && Keyboard.Modifiers == ModifierKeys.Control)
3214 {
3215 UndoManager.Undo();
3216 e.Handled = true;
3217 return;
3218 }
3219 if (e.Key == Key.Y && Keyboard.Modifiers == ModifierKeys.Control)
3220 {
3221 UndoManager.Redo();
3222 e.Handled = true;
3223 return;
3224 }
3225
3226 // Handle ObjectManipulator Enter/Esc or Custom Dragging Enter/Esc
3227 if (_designControl.ObjectManipulator.Visible || _isCustomDragging)
3228 {
3229 var waypointEntity = (!_isPartManipulating && (_manipulatingEntity != null && _manipulatingEntity.EntityData is WaypointData))
3230 ? _manipulatingEntity
3231 : (!_isPartManipulating ? _designControl.Entities.FirstOrDefault(ent => ent.Selected && ent.EntityData is WaypointData) : null);
3232
3233 if (e.Key == Key.Enter || e.Key == Key.Return)
3234 {
3235 StopManipulating(null!);
3236 e.Handled = true;
3237 return;
3238 }
3239 else if (e.Key == Key.Escape)
3240 {
3241 if (waypointEntity != null)
3242 {
3243 CancelWaypointManipulation(waypointEntity);
3244 }
3245 else
3246 {
3247 ResetObjectPosition(null!);
3248 }
3249 e.Handled = true;
3250 return;
3251 }
3252 }
3253
3254 if (e.Key == Key.Return)
3255 {
3256 MainParent.MoveFocus(new TraversalRequest(FocusNavigationDirection.Next));
3257 }
3258 else if (e.Key == Key.Tab)
3259 {
3260 MainParent.MoveFocus(new TraversalRequest(FocusNavigationDirection.Next));
3261 }
3262 }

3816 private void ResetObjectPosition(object parameter)
3817 {
3818 _isPartManipulating = false;
3819 if (_isCreatingIntermediaryPoint)
3820 {
3821 CleanupPendingIntermediaryCreation();
3822 return;
3823 }
3824
3825 if (_designControl == null) return;
3826 Entity? partEntity = ResolvePartEntity(parameter);
3827 if (partEntity == null) return;
3828
3829 bool wasManipulating = _designControl.ObjectManipulator.Visible;
3830 if (_designControl.ObjectManipulator.Visible)
3831 {
3832 _designControl.ObjectManipulator.Cancel();
3833 _manipulatingEntity = null;
3834 }
3835 else if (_originalPositions != null && _originalPositions.TryGetValue(partEntity, out var originalData))
3836 {
3837 int partIndex = _designControl.Entities.IndexOf(partEntity);
3838 var exclusiveFallbackColors = partIndex >= 0
3839 ? GetExclusiveFallbackColorsForPart(partIndex)
3840 : new HashSet<Color>();
3841 var resetPathColors = partIndex >= 0
3842 ? GetPathColorsForPart(partIndex, exclusiveFallbackColors)
3843 : new HashSet<Color>();
3844 bool resetPathsWithObject = ShouldResetStoredObjectPaths(originalData, resetPathColors);
3845
3846 foreach (var item in originalData.Entities)
3847 {
3848 item.ent.TransformBy(item.trans);
3849 }
3850
3851 if (partIndex >= 0 && originalData.Entities.Count > 0)
3852 {
3853 var trans = originalData.Entities[0].trans;
3854 _ignoredItemManager?.ApplyTransformation(partIndex, trans);
3855 }
3856
3857 if (originalData.Grid != null)
3858 {
3859 var plane = originalData.Grid.Plane;
3860 plane.TransformBy(originalData.GridTransform);
3861 originalData.Grid.Plane = plane;
3862 }
3863
3864 if (resetPathsWithObject)
3865 {
3866 var resetEntityIndices = partIndex >= 0
3867 ? new HashSet<int> { partIndex }
3868 : null;
3869 RestoreStoredObjectPathStates(originalData, resetPathColors, resetEntityIndices);
3870 }
3871
3872 _originalPositions.Remove(partEntity);
3873
3874 if (_selectionUtils != null)
3875 _selectionUtils.ClearDesignControlSelection();
3876
3877 _designControl.Entities.Regen();
3878 _designControl.ZoomFit();
3879 _designControl.Invalidate();
3880 _pathManager?.InvalidateShellCache();
3881 }
3882 else if (wasManipulating)
3883 {
3884 _selectionUtils?.ClearDesignControlSelection();
3885 _designControl.Invalidate();
3886 }
3887 if (!wasManipulating)
3888 {
3889 _pathManager?.RegeneratePathVisuals();
3890 }
3891 }
3892
3896 private void CleanupPendingIntermediaryCreation()
3897 {
3898 _isCreatingIntermediaryPoint = false;
3899 _isCustomDragging = false;
3900 _prevDragPosition = null;
3901 _tempInsertPath = null;
3902 _tempInsertPosition = null;
3903 _oldPathStateForWaypointMove = null;
3904 _otherOverlappingBridgePoints = null;
3905 _otherOverlappingBridgePathsUndoInfo = null;
3906 _manipulatingEntity = null;
3907
3908 if (_designControl != null)
3909 {
3910 if (_designControl.ObjectManipulator != null && _designControl.ObjectManipulator.Visible)
3911 {
3912 _designControl.ObjectManipulator.Cancel();
3913 _designControl.ObjectManipulator.Visible = false;
3914 }
3915
3916 if (_draggingSphere != null)
3917 {
3918 _designControl.Entities.Remove(_draggingSphere);
3919 _draggingSphere = null;
3920 }
3921
3922 _designControl.Entities.ClearSelection();
3923 _designControl.Invalidate();
3924 }
3925 }
3926
3930 private void CancelActiveObjectManipulatorForModelChange()
3931 {
3932 _isPartManipulating = false;
3933 _isCustomDragging = false;
3934 _isCreatingIntermediaryPoint = false;
3935 _prevDragPosition = null;
3936 _initialTriadTrans = null;
3937 _tempInsertPath = null;
3938 _tempInsertPosition = null;
3939 _oldPathStateForWaypointMove = null;
3940 _otherOverlappingBridgePoints = null;
3941 _otherOverlappingBridgePathsUndoInfo = null;
3942 _manipulatingEntity = null;
3943 _draggingSpherePosition = null;
3944
3945 if (_designControl == null)
3946 return;
3947
3948 try
3949 {
3950 if (_designControl.ObjectManipulator != null)
3951 {
3952 _designControl.ObjectManipulator.Cancel();
3953 _designControl.ObjectManipulator.Visible = false;
3954 }
3955 }
3956 catch (Exception ex)
3957 {
3958 Debug.WriteLine($"Failed to cancel active ObjectManipulator before model change: {ex.Message}");
3959 }
3960
3961 if (_draggingSphere != null)
3962 {
3963 try
3964 {
3965 if (_designControl.Entities.Contains(_draggingSphere))
3966 _designControl.Entities.Remove(_draggingSphere);
3967 }
3968 catch (Exception ex)
3969 {
3970 Debug.WriteLine($"Failed to remove temporary dragging sphere before model change: {ex.Message}");
3971 }
3972 finally
3973 {
3974 _draggingSphere = null;
3975 }
3976 }
3977
3978 _designControl.Entities.ClearSelection();
3979 _selectionUtils?.ClearDesignControlSelection();
3980 _designControl.Invalidate();
3981 }
3982
3987 private void CancelWaypointManipulation(Entity? waypointEntity)
3988 {
3989 _isPartManipulating = false;
3990 _isCustomDragging = false;
3991 _prevDragPosition = null;
3992 _manipulatingEntity = null;
3993
3994 bool wasCreatingIntermediary = _isCreatingIntermediaryPoint;
3995
3996 if (_isCreatingIntermediaryPoint)
3997 {
3998 CleanupPendingIntermediaryCreation();
3999 return;
4000 }
4001
4002 // Fast path: check immediately if the point actually moved.
4003 // If no movement occurred, just deselect and clean up state — skip ALL heavy work.
4004 if (waypointEntity != null && waypointEntity.EntityData is WaypointData wpFast && !wpFast.IsNew)
4005 {
4006 bool moved = false;
4007 if (_oldPathStateForWaypointMove != null && wpFast.PointIndex >= 0 && wpFast.PointIndex < wpFast.Path.Points.Count && _oldPathStateForWaypointMove.Points.Count > wpFast.PointIndex)
4008 {
4009 moved = wpFast.Path.Points[wpFast.PointIndex].DistanceTo(_oldPathStateForWaypointMove.Points[wpFast.PointIndex]) > 1e-4;
4010 }
4011 else if (wpFast.PointIndex >= 0 && wpFast.PointIndex < wpFast.Path.Points.Count)
4012 {
4013 moved = wpFast.Path.Points[wpFast.PointIndex].DistanceTo(wpFast.OriginalPosition) > 1e-4;
4014 }
4015
4016 if (!moved)
4017 {
4018 // No movement — instant cleanup
4019 if (_designControl != null && _designControl.ObjectManipulator != null && _designControl.ObjectManipulator.Visible)
4020 {
4021 _designControl.ObjectManipulator.Cancel();
4022 _designControl.ObjectManipulator.Visible = false;
4023 }
4024 if (_designControl != null && _draggingSphere != null)
4025 {
4026 _designControl.Entities.Remove(_draggingSphere);
4027 _draggingSphere = null;
4028 }
4029 waypointEntity.Visible = true;
4030 waypointEntity.Selected = false;
4031 _oldPathStateForWaypointMove = null;
4032 _otherOverlappingBridgePoints = null;
4033 _otherOverlappingBridgePathsUndoInfo = null;
4034 _indirectlyMovedSharedPoints = null;
4035 _designControl?.Entities.ClearSelection();
4036 _designControl?.Entities.Regen();
4037 _designControl?.Invalidate();
4038 return;
4039 }
4040 }
4041
4042 if (_designControl != null && _designControl.ObjectManipulator != null && _designControl.ObjectManipulator.Visible)
4043 {
4044 _designControl.ObjectManipulator.Cancel();
4045 _designControl.ObjectManipulator.Visible = false;
4046 }
4047
4048 if (_designControl != null && _draggingSphere != null)
4049 {
4050 _designControl.Entities.Remove(_draggingSphere);
4051 _draggingSphere = null;
4052 }
4053
4054 if (waypointEntity != null)
4055 {
4056 waypointEntity.Visible = true;
4057 waypointEntity.Selected = false;
4058 }
4059
4060 if (_designControl == null) return;
4061
4062 if (waypointEntity != null && waypointEntity.EntityData is WaypointData wp)
4063 {
4064 bool actuallyMoved = false;
4065 if (_oldPathStateForWaypointMove != null && wp.PointIndex >= 0 && wp.PointIndex < wp.Path.Points.Count && _oldPathStateForWaypointMove.Points.Count > wp.PointIndex)
4066 {
4067 actuallyMoved = wp.Path.Points[wp.PointIndex].DistanceTo(_oldPathStateForWaypointMove.Points[wp.PointIndex]) > 1e-4;
4068 }
4069 else if (wp.PointIndex >= 0 && wp.PointIndex < wp.Path.Points.Count)
4070 {
4071 actuallyMoved = wp.Path.Points[wp.PointIndex].DistanceTo(wp.OriginalPosition) > 1e-4;
4072 }
4073
4074 if (_oldPathStateForWaypointMove != null)
4075 {
4076 if (actuallyMoved)
4077 {
4078 // Live dragging updates every reused path occurrence. Restore the
4079 // captured states as one operation when the user cancels.
4080 wp.Path.RestoreState(_oldPathStateForWaypointMove);
4081 if (_otherOverlappingBridgePathsUndoInfo != null)
4082 {
4083 foreach (var info in _otherOverlappingBridgePathsUndoInfo)
4084 info.Path.RestoreState(info.OldState);
4085 }
4086 _pathManager?.RegeneratePathVisuals();
4087 }
4088 _oldPathStateForWaypointMove = null;
4089 _otherOverlappingBridgePoints = null;
4090 _otherOverlappingBridgePathsUndoInfo = null;
4091 _indirectlyMovedSharedPoints = null;
4092 }
4093 else if (wp.IsNew)
4094 {
4095 // Just remove the newly created point
4096 if (wp.PointIndex >= 0 && wp.PointIndex < wp.Path.Points.Count)
4097 {
4098 wp.Path.Points.RemoveAt(wp.PointIndex);
4099 if (wp.Path.Normals != null && wp.Path.Normals.Count > wp.PointIndex) wp.Path.Normals.RemoveAt(wp.PointIndex);
4100 if (wp.Path.IsMeasure != null && wp.Path.IsMeasure.Count > wp.PointIndex) wp.Path.IsMeasure.RemoveAt(wp.PointIndex);
4101 if (wp.Path.PointTypes != null && wp.Path.PointTypes.Count > wp.PointIndex) wp.Path.PointTypes.RemoveAt(wp.PointIndex);
4102 if (wp.Path.OriginalPoints != null && wp.Path.OriginalPoints.Count > wp.PointIndex) wp.Path.OriginalPoints.RemoveAt(wp.PointIndex);
4103 if (wp.Path.PointEntityIndices != null && wp.Path.PointEntityIndices.Count > wp.PointIndex) wp.Path.PointEntityIndices.RemoveAt(wp.PointIndex);
4104 if (wp.Path.UpVectors != null && wp.Path.UpVectors.Count > wp.PointIndex) wp.Path.UpVectors.RemoveAt(wp.PointIndex);
4105
4106 foreach (var ent in _designControl.Entities)
4107 {
4108 if (ent.EntityData is WaypointData otherWp && otherWp.Path == wp.Path && otherWp.PointIndex > wp.PointIndex)
4109 {
4110 otherWp.PointIndex--;
4111 }
4112 }
4113 }
4114 _designControl.Entities.Remove(waypointEntity);
4115 }
4116 else
4117 {
4118 if (actuallyMoved && wp.PointIndex >= 0 && wp.PointIndex < wp.Path.Points.Count)
4119 {
4120 wp.Path.Points[wp.PointIndex] = (Point3D)wp.OriginalPosition.Clone();
4121 }
4122 }
4123
4124 if (wp.IsNew)
4125 {
4126 _pathManager?.ClearSinglePathVisuals(wp.Path.Color);
4127 _pathManager?.DrawSinglePath(wp.Path);
4128 }
4129 }
4130
4131 _indirectlyMovedSharedPoints = null;
4132 _designControl.Entities.ClearSelection();
4133 _designControl.Invalidate();
4134 }
4135
4139 private Entity? FindApproachEntityForMeasure(WaypointData wpData)
4140 {
4141 if (_designControl == null || wpData.Path?.IsMeasure == null) return null;
4142
4143 int approachIdx = -1;
4144 if (wpData.PointIndex > 0 && wpData.PointIndex - 1 < wpData.Path.IsMeasure.Count && !wpData.Path.IsMeasure[wpData.PointIndex - 1])
4145 {
4146 approachIdx = wpData.PointIndex - 1;
4147 }
4148 else if (wpData.PointIndex + 1 < wpData.Path.Points.Count && wpData.PointIndex + 1 < wpData.Path.IsMeasure.Count && !wpData.Path.IsMeasure[wpData.PointIndex + 1])
4149 {
4150 approachIdx = wpData.PointIndex + 1;
4151 }
4152
4153 if (approachIdx < 0) return null;
4154
4155 return _designControl.Entities.FirstOrDefault(e =>
4156 e.EntityData is WaypointData wd && wd.GetReferences().Any(reference =>
4157 ReferenceEquals(reference.Path, wpData.Path) && reference.PointIndex == approachIdx));
4158 }

4475 public void CloseAllSlidePanels(SidePanelTab currSidePanel)
4476 {
4477 currentActiveSidePanel = currSidePanel;
4478
4479 // Get Main Panels
4480 SidePanelTab settingsSidePanel = MainParent.SettingsSidePanel;
4481 SidePanelTab aboutSidePanel = MainParent.AboutSidePanel;
4482 SidePanelTab planningSidePanel = MainParent.PlanningSidePanel;
4483 SidePanelTab measuringSidePanel = MainParent.MeasuringSidePanel;
4484
4485 if (currSidePanel != settingsSidePanel && settingsSidePanel.IsExpanded)
4486 {
4487 settingsSidePanel.Collapse();
4488 // Delay detachment until after collapse animation
4489 _ = DelayedDetachContentFromPanel(settingsSidePanel, 850);
4490 }
4491 if (currSidePanel != aboutSidePanel && aboutSidePanel.IsExpanded)
4492 {
4493 aboutSidePanel.Collapse();
4494 _ = DelayedDetachContentFromPanel(aboutSidePanel, 850);
4495 }
4496 if (currSidePanel != planningSidePanel && planningSidePanel.IsExpanded)
4497 {
4498 planningSidePanel.Collapse();
4499 _ = DelayedDetachContentFromPanel(planningSidePanel, 850);
4500 }
4501 if (currSidePanel != measuringSidePanel && measuringSidePanel.IsExpanded)
4502 {
4503 measuringSidePanel.Collapse();
4504 _ = DelayedDetachContentFromPanel(measuringSidePanel, 850);
4505 }
4506 }

4514 private async Task DelayedDetachContentFromPanel(SidePanelTab panel, int delayMilliseconds)
4515 {
4516 await Task.Delay(delayMilliseconds);
4517
4518 // Only detach if the panel is actually collapsed
4519 DetachContentFromPanel(panel);
4520 }

4531 panel.AdditionalContent = null!;
4532 }

4538 public void Settings()
4539 {
4540 if (IsSimulationActive)
4541 return;
4542
4543 if (IsPanelTimerActive(settingsPanelTimer) || IsPanelTimerActive(planningPanelTimer) || IsPanelTimerActive(measuringPanelTimer) || IsPanelTimerActive(aboutPanelTimer))
4544 return;
4545
4546 SidePanelTab settingsSidePanel = MainParent.SettingsSidePanel;
4547 int PanelSize = 400;
4548
4549 // Check if we're closing the currently open panel
4550 bool isClosing = settingsSidePanel.IsExpanded;
4551
4552 CloseAllSlidePanels(settingsSidePanel);
4553
4554 settingsSidePanel.MoveSize = PanelSize;
4555
4556 if (!isClosing)
4557 {
4558 // Create instance once and reuse
4559 if (settings_sp == null)
4560 {
4561 settings_sp = new Settings_SidePanel(this);
4562 }
4563
4564 // Always set it (reattach to visual tree)
4565 settingsSidePanel.AdditionalContent = settings_sp;
4566 settingsSidePanel.Expand();
4567 }
4568 else
4569 {
4570 // Just collapse, delayed detachment will happen automatically
4571 settingsSidePanel.Collapse();
4572 _ = DelayedDetachContentFromPanel(settingsSidePanel, 850);
4573 }
4574
4575 StartPanelTimer(settingsPanelTimer);
4576 }

4946 private void ShowContextMenuForWaypoint(Entity entity, WaypointData wpData)
4947 {
4948 var contextMenu = new ContextMenu();
4949
4950 bool isPointManipulating = _isCustomDragging || (_designControl.ObjectManipulator.Visible && !_isPartManipulating);
4951 bool isMeasure = false;
4952 bool isScanPoint = false;
4953 bool nextIsMeasure = false;
4954 bool prevIsMeasure = false;
4955 bool isApproach = false;
4956
4957 void RefreshWaypointClassification()
4958 {
4959 isMeasure = wpData.Path.IsMeasure != null &&
4960 wpData.PointIndex < wpData.Path.IsMeasure.Count &&
4961 wpData.Path.IsMeasure[wpData.PointIndex];
4962 isScanPoint = wpData.Path.PointTypes != null &&
4963 wpData.PointIndex < wpData.Path.PointTypes.Count &&
4964 string.Equals(
4965 wpData.Path.PointTypes[wpData.PointIndex],
4966 "scanpoints",
4967 StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
4968 nextIsMeasure = wpData.Path.IsMeasure != null &&
4969 wpData.PointIndex + 1 < wpData.Path.Points.Count &&
4970 wpData.PointIndex + 1 < wpData.Path.IsMeasure.Count &&
4971 wpData.Path.IsMeasure[wpData.PointIndex + 1];
4972 prevIsMeasure = wpData.Path.IsMeasure != null &&
4973 wpData.PointIndex > 0 &&
4974 wpData.PointIndex - 1 < wpData.Path.IsMeasure.Count &&
4975 wpData.Path.IsMeasure[wpData.PointIndex - 1];
4976 isApproach = !isMeasure && (nextIsMeasure || prevIsMeasure);
4977 if (isApproach &&
4978 wpData.Path.PointTypes != null &&
4979 wpData.PointIndex < wpData.Path.PointTypes.Count)
4980 {
4981 wpData.Path.PointTypes[wpData.PointIndex] = "Approach";
4982 }
4983 }
4984
4985 RefreshWaypointClassification();
4986 bool hasSharedAxisConstraint = TryGetSharedWaypointMovementAxis(
4987 wpData,
4988 out Vector3D sharedMovementAxis,
4989 out bool hasIncompatibleSharedConstraint);
4990 bool hasSharedSurfaceConstraint = HasSurfaceMeasurementReference(wpData);
4991
4992 if (isPointManipulating)
4993 {

4995 {

5000 };

5006 Icon = new TextBlock { Text = "❌", FontSize = 12 }
5007 };

5011 };

5020 IsEnabled = true,
5021 ToolTip = hasIncompatibleSharedConstraint
5022 ? "Choose which compatible point group to detach and move."
5023 : (hasSharedAxisConstraint

5025 : (hasSharedSurfaceConstraint

5027 : "All reused occurrences move together."))
