5029
5030 void BeginWaypointMove(IReadOnlyCollection<WaypointReference>? selectedReferences)
5031 {
5032 if (selectedReferences != null)
5033 {
5034 if (_pathManager?.SplitSharedWaypointForManipulation(entity, selectedReferences) != true)
5035 return;
5036
5037 RefreshWaypointClassification();
5038 }
5039
5040 hasSharedAxisConstraint = TryGetSharedWaypointMovementAxis(
5041 wpData,
5042 out sharedMovementAxis,
5043 out hasIncompatibleSharedConstraint);
5044 hasSharedSurfaceConstraint = HasSurfaceMeasurementReference(wpData);
5045 if (hasIncompatibleSharedConstraint)
5046 return;
5047
5048 foreach (var ent in _designControl.Entities)
5049 {
5050 if (ent.EntityData is WaypointData)
5051 {
5052 ent.Selected = false;
5053 }
5054 }
5055 entity.Selected = true;
5056
5057 Point3D pt = wpData.Path.Points[wpData.PointIndex];
5058 _oldPathStateForWaypointMove = wpData.Path.CloneState();
5059 _prevDragPosition = (Point3D)pt.Clone();
5060
5061 _otherOverlappingBridgePoints = new List<(ColorPath Path, int PointIndex)>();
5062 _otherOverlappingBridgePathsUndoInfo = new List<(ColorPath Path, ColorPath OldState)>();
5063
5064 // Determine if the selected point is an approach point
5065 bool selectedIsApproach = isApproach;
5066
5067 foreach (var reference in GetValidWaypointReferences(wpData))
5068 {
5069 if (ReferenceEquals(reference.Path, wpData.Path) && reference.PointIndex == wpData.PointIndex)
5070 continue;
5071
5072 // Classify the overlapping reference point
5073 string refPointType = reference.Path.PointTypes != null && reference.PointIndex < reference.Path.PointTypes.Count
5074 ? reference.Path.PointTypes[reference.PointIndex] : "";
5075 bool refIsApproach = string.Equals(refPointType, "Approach", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
5076
5077 // If the selected point is NOT an approach point, exclude overlapping approach points
5078 // from the drag group — they have normal-direction constraints and should be moved separately.
5079 if (!selectedIsApproach && refIsApproach)
5080 continue;
5081
5082 // If the selected point IS an approach point, only include other approach points
5083 // that share a compatible normal direction (within ~5°).
5084 if (selectedIsApproach && refIsApproach)
5085 {
5086 if (reference.Path.Normals != null && reference.PointIndex < reference.Path.Normals.Count &&
5087 wpData.Path.Normals != null && wpData.PointIndex < wpData.Path.Normals.Count)
5088 {
5089 double dot = Vector3D.Dot(wpData.Path.Normals[wpData.PointIndex], reference.Path.Normals[reference.PointIndex]);
5090 if (dot < 0.996) // ~5° tolerance
5091 continue;
5092 }
5093 }
5094
5095 if (!_otherOverlappingBridgePoints.Any(item =>
5096 ReferenceEquals(item.Path, reference.Path) && item.PointIndex == reference.PointIndex))
5097 {
5098 _otherOverlappingBridgePoints.Add((reference.Path, reference.PointIndex));
5099 }
5100
5101 if (!ReferenceEquals(reference.Path, wpData.Path) &&
5102 !_otherOverlappingBridgePathsUndoInfo.Any(item => ReferenceEquals(item.Path, reference.Path)))
5103 {
5104 _otherOverlappingBridgePathsUndoInfo.Add((reference.Path, reference.Path.CloneState()));
5105 }
5106 }
5107
5108 _indirectlyMovedSharedPoints = new List<(ColorPath Path, int PointIndex, Point3D OldPosition)>();
5109 if (hasSharedSurfaceConstraint)
5110 CaptureSharedSurfaceDependentPoints(wpData);
5111
5112 string ptType = wpData.Path.PointTypes != null && wpData.PointIndex < wpData.Path.PointTypes.Count ? wpData.Path.PointTypes[wpData.PointIndex] : "";
5113 if (ptType == "Bridge" || ptType == "BridgeIntermediary")
5114 {
5115 if (_pathManager != null)
5116 {
5117 foreach (var otherPath in _pathManager.ColorPaths.Values)
5118 {
5119 if (otherPath == wpData.Path) continue;
5120 for (int k = 0; k < otherPath.Points.Count; k++)
5121 {
5122 string otherPtType = otherPath.PointTypes != null && k < otherPath.PointTypes.Count ? otherPath.PointTypes[k] : "";
5123 if (otherPtType == "Bridge" || otherPtType == "BridgeIntermediary")
5124 {
5125 if (otherPath.Points[k].DistanceTo(wpData.OriginalPosition) < 0.01)
5126 {
5127 if (!_otherOverlappingBridgePoints.Any(item =>
5128 ReferenceEquals(item.Path, otherPath) && item.PointIndex == k))
5129 {
5130 _otherOverlappingBridgePoints.Add((otherPath, k));
5131 }
5132 if (!_otherOverlappingBridgePathsUndoInfo.Any(item => ReferenceEquals(item.Path, otherPath)))
5133 {
5134 _otherOverlappingBridgePathsUndoInfo.Add((otherPath, otherPath.CloneState()));
5135 }
5136 }
5137 }
5138 }
5139 }
5140 }
5141 }
5142
5143 if (hasSharedSurfaceConstraint)
5144 {
5145 var closest = FindClosestFace(pt);
5146 _draggingMeasurePointFace = closest.Face;
5147 _draggingMeasurePointBrep = closest.Brep;
5148
5149 if (_draggingMeasurePointBrep != null && _draggingMeasurePointFace != null)
5150 {
5151 try
5152 {
5153 _draggingFaceMesh = _draggingMeasurePointBrep.Faces[_draggingMeasurePointFace.FaceIndex].ConvertToMesh();
5154 }
5155 catch
5156 {
5157 _draggingFaceMesh = null;
5158 }
5159 }
5160 }
5161
5162 Vector3D zAxis = hasSharedAxisConstraint
5163 ? (Vector3D)sharedMovementAxis.Clone()
5164 : wpData.Path.Normals![wpData.PointIndex];
5165 if (!hasSharedAxisConstraint && isApproach)
5166 {
5167 int mIdx = -1;
5168 if (wpData.Path.IsMeasure != null && wpData.PointIndex + 1 < wpData.Path.Points.Count && wpData.Path.IsMeasure[wpData.PointIndex + 1])
5169 {
5170 mIdx = wpData.PointIndex + 1;
5171 }
5172 else if (wpData.Path.IsMeasure != null && wpData.PointIndex > 0 && wpData.Path.IsMeasure[wpData.PointIndex - 1])
5173 {
5174 mIdx = wpData.PointIndex - 1;
5175 }
5176
5177 if (mIdx != -1)
5178 {
5179 zAxis = wpData.Path.Normals![mIdx];
5180 }
5181 }
5182
5183 if (zAxis.LengthSquared < 1e-6) zAxis = Vector3D.AxisZ;
5184 zAxis.Normalize();
5185
5186 Vector3D xAxis = Vector3D.Cross(Vector3D.AxisZ, zAxis);
5187 if (xAxis.LengthSquared < 1e-6) xAxis = Vector3D.Cross(Vector3D.AxisY, zAxis);
5188 xAxis.Normalize();
5189
5190 Vector3D yAxis = Vector3D.Cross(zAxis, xAxis);
5191 yAxis.Normalize();
5192
5193 var trans = new devDept.Geometry.Transformation();
5194 trans[0, 0] = xAxis.X; trans[0, 1] = yAxis.X; trans[0, 2] = zAxis.X; trans[0, 3] = pt.X;
5195 trans[1, 0] = xAxis.Y; trans[1, 1] = yAxis.Y; trans[1, 2] = zAxis.Y; trans[1, 3] = pt.Y;
5196 trans[2, 0] = xAxis.Z; trans[2, 1] = yAxis.Z; trans[2, 2] = zAxis.Z; trans[2, 3] = pt.Z;
5197
5198 // If it's a measure point, also select the associated approach point entity and orient camera
5199 if (isMeasure)
5200 {
5201 var approachEntity = FindApproachEntityForMeasure(wpData);
5202 if (approachEntity != null) approachEntity.Selected = true;
5203
5204 // Put camera normal to the surface for a top-down drag view
5205 /*
5206 if (_draggingMeasurePointFace != null)
5207 {
5208 _cameraUtils.OrientCameraToFacePerpendicularly(_draggingMeasurePointFace);
5209 }
5210 else
5211 {
5212 _cameraUtils.OrientCameraToNormal(pt, zAxis);
5213 }
5214 */
5215 }
5216
5217 _initialTriadTrans = trans;
5218 _manipulatingEntity = entity;
5219
5220 if (hasSharedSurfaceConstraint && !hasSharedAxisConstraint)
5221 {
5222 _isCustomDragging = true;
5223 _designControl.ObjectManipulator.Cancel();
5224
5225 // Keep the real measurepoint sphere visible
5226 entity.Selected = false;
5227
5228 // Create dragging sphere
5229 _draggingSphere = devDept.Eyeshot.Entities.Mesh.CreateSphere(0.45, 8, 8);
5230 _draggingSphere.Color = System.Drawing.Color.LimeGreen;
5231 _draggingSphere.ColorMethod = colorMethodType.byEntity;
5232 _draggingSphere.Translate(pt.X, pt.Y, pt.Z);
5233 _draggingSphere.Selected = true;
5234 _designControl.Entities.Add(_draggingSphere);
5235 _draggingSpherePosition = (Point3D)pt.Clone();
5236 }
5237 else
5238 {
5239 _isCustomDragging = false;
5240 _draggingMeasurePointFace = null;
5241 _draggingMeasurePointBrep = null;
5242 _draggingFaceMesh = null;
5243
5244 ConfigureWaypointManipulator(hasSharedAxisConstraint || isApproach);
5245 _designControl.Invalidate();
5246 _designControl.ObjectManipulator.Enable(_initialTriadTrans, false);
5247 _designControl.Invalidate();
5248 ConfigureWaypointManipulator(hasSharedAxisConstraint || isApproach);
5249
5250 }
5251
5252 _designControl.Invalidate();
5253 }
5254
5255 if (hasIncompatibleSharedConstraint)
5256 {
5257 var movementChoices = BuildSharedWaypointMovementChoices(wpData);
5258 if (movementChoices.Count == 0)
5259 {
5260 moveItem.IsEnabled = false;
5261 moveItem.ToolTip = "No valid path occurrence is available for movement.";
5262 }
5263 else
5264 {
5265 foreach (var choice in movementChoices)
5266 {
5267 var choiceItem = new MenuItem
5268 {
5269 Header = choice.Label,
5270 ToolTip = choice.ToolTip,
5271 Icon = new TextBlock { Text = "↕️", FontSize = 12 }
5272 };
5273 choiceItem.Click += (s, e) => BeginWaypointMove(choice.References);
5274 moveItem.Items.Add(choiceItem);
5275 }
5276 }
5277 }
5278 else
5279 {
5280 moveItem.Click += (s, e) => BeginWaypointMove(null);
5281 }
5282
5283 contextMenu.Items.Add(moveItem);
5284 }
5285
5286 // Show Tool and Rotate Point are available for all waypoint types
5287 {
5288 var showToolItem = new MenuItem
5289 {
5290 Header = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "ContextMenu_ShowToolOnPoint") ?? "Show Tool on this Point",
5291 Icon = new TextBlock { Text = "🔧", FontSize = 12 }
5292 };
5293 showToolItem.Click += (s, e) =>
5294 {
5295 ShowToolPreviewOnPoint(entity, wpData);
5296 };
5297 contextMenu.Items.Add(showToolItem);
5298
5299 var checkCollisionItem = new MenuItem
5300 {
5301 Header = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "ContextMenu_CheckToolCollisionOnPoint") ?? "Check tool collisions on this point",
5302 Icon = new TextBlock { Text = "🛡️", FontSize = 12 }
5303 };
5304 checkCollisionItem.Click += (s, e) =>
5305 {
5306 CheckToolCollisionOnPoint(entity, wpData);
5307 };
5308 contextMenu.Items.Add(checkCollisionItem);
5309
5310 var changeRotItem = new MenuItem
5311 {
5312 Header = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "ContextMenu_ChangePointRotation") ?? "Change Point Rotation",
5313 Icon = new TextBlock { Text = "🔄", FontSize = 12 }
5314 };
5315 changeRotItem.Click += async (s, e) =>
5316 {
5317 if (IsPointRotationPanelOpen)
5318 {
5319 IsPointRotationPanelOpen = false;
5320 await System.Threading.Tasks.Task.Delay(260);
5321 }
5322
5323 _pointRotationEditingWaypoint = wpData;
5324 _pointRotationBaseNormal = (Vector3D)wpData.Path.Normals[wpData.PointIndex].Clone();
5325 _pointRotationBaseUp = wpData.Path.UpVectors != null && wpData.PointIndex < wpData.Path.UpVectors.Count
5326 ? (Vector3D)wpData.Path.UpVectors[wpData.PointIndex].Clone()
5327 : new Vector3D(0, 1, 0);
5328 _pointRotationOldState = wpData.Path.CloneState();
5329
5330 ShowToolPreviewOnPoint(entity, wpData);
5331
5332 PointRotationX = 0;
5333 PointRotationY = 0;
5334 PointRotationZ = 0;
5335
5336 IsPointRotationPanelOpen = true;
5337 };
5338 contextMenu.Items.Add(changeRotItem);
5339 }
5340
5341 // Always show the "Delete Point" option
5342 var deleteItem = new MenuItem
5343 {
5344 Header = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "ContextMenu_DeletePoint") ?? "Delete Point",
5345 Icon = new TextBlock { Text = "🗑️", FontSize = 12 }
5346 };
5347 deleteItem.Click += (s, e) =>
5348 {
5349 bool isManipulating = _designControl.ObjectManipulator.Visible;
5350 if (isManipulating)
5351 {
5352 _designControl.ObjectManipulator.Cancel();
5353 }
5354
5355 string pointType = "";
5356 if (wpData.Path.PointTypes != null && wpData.PointIndex < wpData.Path.PointTypes.Count)
5357 {
5358 pointType = wpData.Path.PointTypes[wpData.PointIndex];
5359 }
5360
5361 if (pointType == "Start" || pointType == "End")
5362 {
5363 // Do not delete normal path points like Start or End. Just cancel manipulation.
5364 if (isManipulating)
5365 {
5366 CancelWaypointManipulation(entity);
5367 }
5368 return;
5369 }
5370
5371 // Capture path state before deletion
5372 var oldState = wpData.Path.CloneState();
5373
5374 // Remove from Path
5375 if (wpData.PointIndex >= 0 && wpData.PointIndex < wpData.Path.Points.Count)
5376 {
5377 int indexToRemove = wpData.PointIndex;
5378 wpData.Path.Points.RemoveAt(indexToRemove);
5379 wpData.Path.Normals.RemoveAt(indexToRemove);
5380 if (wpData.Path.IsMeasure != null && indexToRemove < wpData.Path.IsMeasure.Count)
5381 wpData.Path.IsMeasure.RemoveAt(indexToRemove);
5382 if (wpData.Path.PointTypes != null && indexToRemove < wpData.Path.PointTypes.Count)
5383 wpData.Path.PointTypes.RemoveAt(indexToRemove);
5384 if (wpData.Path.OriginalPoints != null && indexToRemove < wpData.Path.OriginalPoints.Count)
5385 wpData.Path.OriginalPoints.RemoveAt(indexToRemove);
5386
5387 // Update Path visuals (clears single path visuals and redraws spheres + segment lines correctly!)
5388 if (_pathManager != null)
5389 {
5390 _pathManager.DrawSinglePath(wpData.Path);
5391 }
5392
5393 // Register command in Undo history
5394 if (_pathManager != null)
5395 {
5396 UndoManager.PushCommand(new UpdateColorPathCommand(_pathManager, _designControl, wpData.Path.Color, oldState, wpData.Path.CloneState()));
5397 }
5398
5399 _designControl.Entities.Regen();
5400 _designControl.Invalidate();
5401 }
5402 };
5403 contextMenu.Items.Add(deleteItem);
5404
5405 // Only add the "Revert Position" context menu item if the point has actually been moved after generation
5406 bool canRevert = wpData.GeneratedPosition != null && wpData.Path.Points[wpData.PointIndex].DistanceTo(wpData.GeneratedPosition) > 0.001;
5407 if (canRevert)
5408 {
5409 var revertItem = new MenuItem
5410 {
5411 Header = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "ContextMenu_RevertPosition") ?? "Revert Position",
5412 Icon = new TextBlock { Text = "↩️", FontSize = 12, Padding = new Thickness(4, 0, 0, 0) }
5413 };
5414 revertItem.Click += (s, e) =>
5415 {
5416 bool isManipulating = _designControl.ObjectManipulator.Visible;
5417 if (isManipulating)
5418 {
5419 _designControl.ObjectManipulator.Cancel();
5420 }
5421
5422 var oldState = wpData.Path.CloneState();
5423
5424 // Revert the point's position to its GeneratedPosition
5425 Point3D genPos = wpData.GeneratedPosition!;
5426 if (genPos != null)
5427 {
5428 wpData.Path.Points[wpData.PointIndex] = (Point3D)genPos.Clone();
5429
5430 // If it is a measure point, update adjacent approach points back to their generated positions too!
5431 if (isMeasure && !isScanPoint)
5432 {
5433 Vector3D newNormal = wpData.Path.Normals[wpData.PointIndex];
5434 var closest = FindClosestFace(genPos);
5435 if (closest.Brep != null && closest.Face != null)
5436 {
5437 try
5438 {
5439 var fn = closest.Brep.Faces[closest.Face.FaceIndex].Normal(genPos);
5440 if (fn != null && fn.Length > 1e-6)
5441 {
5442 newNormal = fn;
5443 newNormal.Normalize();
5444 }
5445 }
5446 catch { }
5447 }
5448 wpData.Path.Normals[wpData.PointIndex] = newNormal;
5449
5450 if (wpData.PointIndex > 0 && wpData.Path.IsMeasure != null && !wpData.Path.IsMeasure[wpData.PointIndex - 1])
5451 {
5452 var entryWd = FindWaypointData(wpData.Path, wpData.PointIndex - 1);
5453 if (entryWd?.GeneratedPosition != null)
5454 {
5455 wpData.Path.Points[wpData.PointIndex - 1] = (Point3D)entryWd.GeneratedPosition.Clone();
5456 wpData.Path.Normals[wpData.PointIndex - 1] = (Vector3D)newNormal.Clone();
5457 }
5458 }
5459 if (wpData.PointIndex + 1 < wpData.Path.Points.Count && wpData.Path.IsMeasure != null && wpData.PointIndex + 1 < wpData.Path.IsMeasure.Count && !wpData.Path.IsMeasure[wpData.PointIndex + 1])
5460 {
5461 var exitWd = FindWaypointData(wpData.Path, wpData.PointIndex + 1);
5462 if (exitWd?.GeneratedPosition != null)
5463 {
5464 wpData.Path.Points[wpData.PointIndex + 1] = (Point3D)exitWd.GeneratedPosition.Clone();
5465 wpData.Path.Normals[wpData.PointIndex + 1] = (Vector3D)newNormal.Clone();
5466 }
5467 }
5468 }
5469
5470 if (_pathManager != null)
5471 {
5472 _pathManager.DrawSinglePath(wpData.Path);
5473 UndoManager.PushCommand(new UpdateColorPathCommand(_pathManager, _designControl, wpData.Path.Color, oldState, wpData.Path.CloneState()));
5474 }
5475
5476 _designControl.Entities.Regen();
5477 _designControl.Invalidate();
5478 }
5479 };
5480 contextMenu.Items.Add(revertItem);
5481 }
5482
5483 double tolerance = 2.0;
5484 if (double.TryParse(System.Configuration.ConfigurationManager.AppSettings["PointSelectionTolerance"], System.Globalization.NumberStyles.Any, System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, out double parsedTolerance))
5485 {
5486 tolerance = parsedTolerance;
5487 }
5488
5489 if (wpData.PointIndex >= 0 && wpData.PointIndex < wpData.Path.Points.Count)
5490 {
5491 Point3D currentPt = wpData.Path.Points[wpData.PointIndex];
5492 var overlappingPoints = new List<(Entity ent, WaypointData data)>();
5493
5494 foreach (var otherEnt in _designControl.Entities)
5495 {
5496 if (otherEnt != entity && otherEnt.EntityData is WaypointData otherWpData && otherEnt.Visible)
5497 {
5498 if (otherWpData.PointIndex >= 0 && otherWpData.PointIndex < otherWpData.Path.Points.Count)
5499 {
5500 Point3D otherPt = otherWpData.Path.Points[otherWpData.PointIndex];
5501 if (currentPt.DistanceTo(otherPt) <= tolerance)
5502 {
5503 overlappingPoints.Add((otherEnt, otherWpData));
5504 }
5505 }
5506 }
5507 }
5508
5509 if (overlappingPoints.Count > 0)
5510 {
5511 contextMenu.Items.Add(new Separator());
5512 foreach (var overlap in overlappingPoints)
5513 {
5514 string colorName = overlap.data.Path != null ? ColorNamer.FormatColorWithRgb(overlap.data.Path.Color) : "";
5515 var selectItem = new MenuItem
5516 {
5517 Header = $"Select point {overlap.data.PointIndex}" + (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(colorName) ? $" ({colorName})" : ""),
5518 Icon = new TextBlock { Text = "📍", FontSize = 12 }
5519 };
5520 var capturedEnt = overlap.ent;
5521 var capturedWpData = overlap.data;
5522 selectItem.Click += (s, e) =>
5523 {
5524 _designControl.Entities.ClearSelection();
5525 capturedEnt.Selected = true;
5526 _designControl.Invalidate();
5527 ShowContextMenuForWaypoint(capturedEnt, capturedWpData);
5528 };
5529 contextMenu.Items.Add(selectItem);
5530 }
5531 }
5532 }
5533
5534 contextMenu.PlacementTarget = _designControl;
5535 RegisterAndOpenContextMenu(contextMenu);
5536 }

5543 public void HighlightGeometryItem(object? item, bool selectInTree = false)
5544 {
5545 if (item == null || _visualsManager == null) return;
5546
5547 try
5548 {
5549 isUpdatingSelection = true;
5550 _visualsManager.ClearAllMarkers();
5551 _selectionUtils.ClearDesignControlSelection();
5552
5553 if (item is CADFace face)
5554 {
5555 HighlightFace(face);
5556 if (selectInTree)
5557 _treeViewHelper.SelectFaceInTree(face);
5558 }
5559 else if (item is CADHole hole)
5560 {
5561 _visualsManager.ShowHoleCenterAndDepth(hole);
5562
5563 var topFace = GetHoleFaces(hole)
5564 .OrderBy(f => hole.TopCenterPoint == null
5565 ? 0.0
5566 : EyeshotGeometryUtils.GetFaceCenter(f).DistanceTo(hole.TopCenterPoint))
5567 .FirstOrDefault();
5568 if (topFace != null)
5569 HighlightFace(topFace, includeParentHole: false);
5570
5571 if (selectInTree)
5572 _treeViewHelper.SelectHoleInTree(hole);
5573
5574 EyeshotStatus_Text = string.Format(GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Eyeshot_HighlightingHole") ?? "Highlighting hole {0}", hole.HoleId);
5575 }
5576 else if (item is FacePoint vertex)
5577 {
5578 var parentFace = FindParentFaceForVertexPoint(vertex);
5579 if (parentFace != null)
5580 {
5581 if (selectInTree)
5582 _treeViewHelper.SelectVertexInTree(parentFace, vertex.VertexIndex);
5583
5584 TrySelectBrepVertex(parentFace, vertex.VertexIndex);
5585 _visualsManager.ShowCornerMarkersForFace(parentFace, highlightVertexIndex: vertex.VertexIndex);
5586 _visualsManager.ShowControlPointsForFace(parentFace);
5587 _visualsManager.ShowZoomVertexHighlight(new devDept.Geometry.Point3D(vertex.X, vertex.Y, vertex.Z), cubeSize: EyeshotVisualsManager.PreviewVertexCubeSize);
5588 _visualsManager.CurrentSelectedFace = parentFace;
5589
5590 var parentHole = FindParentHoleForFace(parentFace);
5591 if (parentHole != null)
5592 _visualsManager.ShowHoleCenterAndDepth(parentHole);
5593 }
5594 else
5595 {
5596 _visualsManager.ShowZoomVertexHighlight(new devDept.Geometry.Point3D(vertex.X, vertex.Y, vertex.Z), cubeSize: EyeshotVisualsManager.PreviewVertexCubeSize);
5597 }
5598 }
5599 else if (item is Point4D controlPoint)
5600 {
5601 _visualsManager.ShowTemporaryControlPointSphere(controlPoint);
5602 }
5603
5604 _selectionUtils.TryRefreshDesignControlSelection();
5605 _designControl.Invalidate();
5606 }
5607 catch (Exception ex)
5608 {
5609 Debug.WriteLine($"Error highlighting geometry item: {ex.Message}");
5610 }
5611 finally
5612 {
5613 isUpdatingSelection = false;
5614 }

5616 void HighlightFace(CADFace cadFace, bool includeParentHole = true)
5617 {
5618 if (cadFace.EntityIndex >= 0 && cadFace.EntityIndex < _designControl.Entities.Count)
5619 _visualsManager.HighlightFaceVisualFallback(_designControl.Entities[cadFace.EntityIndex] as Brep, cadFace.FaceIndex);
5620
5621 _visualsManager.ShowControlPointsForFace(cadFace);
5622 _visualsManager.ShowCornerMarkersForFace(cadFace);
5623 _visualsManager.CurrentSelectedFace = cadFace;
5624
5625 if (!includeParentHole) return;
5626
5627 var parentHole = FindParentHoleForFace(cadFace);
5628 if (parentHole != null)
5629 _visualsManager.ShowHoleCenterAndDepth(parentHole);
5630 }
5631
5632 List<CADFace> GetHoleFaces(CADHole hole)
5633 {
5634 if (_allFacesByColor == null || hole.FaceGlobalIndices == null || !hole.FaceGlobalIndices.Any())
5635 return new List<CADFace>();
5636
5637 return _allFacesByColor.Values
5638 .SelectMany(list => list)
5639 .Where(face => hole.FaceGlobalIndices.Contains(face.FaceGlobalIndex))
5640 .ToList();
5641 }
5642
5643 void TrySelectBrepVertex(CADFace parentFace, int vertexIndex)
5644 {
5645 if (parentFace.EntityIndex < 0 || parentFace.EntityIndex >= _designControl.Entities.Count)
5646 return;
5647
5648 if (_designControl.Entities[parentFace.EntityIndex] is not Brep brep)
5649 return;
5650
5651 try
5652 {
5653 var brepType = brep.GetType();
5654 var setVertex = brepType.GetMethod("SetVertexSelection", new Type[] { typeof(int), typeof(bool) })
5655 ?? brepType.GetMethod("SetVertexSelection", new Type[] { typeof(int) });
5656
5657 if (setVertex == null)
5658 return;
5659
5660 try
5661 {
5662 setVertex.Invoke(brep, new object[] { vertexIndex, true });
5663 }
5664 catch
5665 {
5666 setVertex.Invoke(brep, new object[] { vertexIndex });
5667 }
5668 }
5669 catch { }
5670 }
5671 }
5672
5673 private CADFace? FindParentFaceForVertexPoint(FacePoint vertexPoint)
5674 {
5675 if (_allFacesByColor == null)
5676 return null;
5677
5678 var allFaces = _allFacesByColor.Values.SelectMany(list => list);
5679 return allFaces.FirstOrDefault(face => face.KeyPoints != null && face.KeyPoints.Any(point => ReferenceEquals(point, vertexPoint)))
5680 ?? allFaces.FirstOrDefault(face => face.KeyPoints != null && face.KeyPoints.Any(point =>
5681 point.VertexIndex == vertexPoint.VertexIndex &&
5682 Math.Abs(point.X - vertexPoint.X) < 1e-6 &&
5683 Math.Abs(point.Y - vertexPoint.Y) < 1e-6 &&
5684 Math.Abs(point.Z - vertexPoint.Z) < 1e-6))
5685 ?? allFaces.FirstOrDefault(face => face.KeyPoints != null && face.KeyPoints.Any(point => point.VertexIndex == vertexPoint.VertexIndex));
5686 }

6341 private void ShowBaseAvoidancePlanesForLoadedParts()

6347 .Where(IsValidPartEntity)
6348 .Select(e => GetPartSourceKey(e))
6349 .Where(source => !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(source))
6350 .Select(source => source!)
6351 .Distinct(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
6352 .ToList();
6353
6354 if (!sourceKeys.Any())
6355 {
6356 if (TryGetPartBoundsForSource(null, out Point3D min, out _, out double maxDim))
6357 AddBaseAvoidancePlaneVisuals(min, maxDim, null);
6358 }
6359 else
6360 {
6361 foreach (string sourcePath in sourceKeys)
6362 {
6363 if (TryGetPartBoundsForSource(sourcePath, out Point3D min, out _, out double maxDim))
6364 AddBaseAvoidancePlaneVisuals(min, maxDim, sourcePath);
6365 }

6369 _designControl.Invalidate();

6390 private List<string?> GetVisibleBaseAvoidancePlaneSources()
6391 {
6392 var sourcesByKey = new Dictionary<string, string?>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
6393 if (_designControl == null)
6394 return new List<string?>();
6395
6396 foreach (var entity in _designControl.Entities)
6397 {
6398 if (!entity.Visible || !IsBaseAvoidanceVisualEntity(entity))
6399 continue;
6400
6401 string? sourcePath = TryGetBaseAvoidanceVisualSource(entity);
6402 if (sourcePath == null)
6403 continue;
6404
6405 string sourceKey = GetBaseAvoidanceSourceKey(sourcePath);
6406 if (!sourcesByKey.ContainsKey(sourceKey))
6407 sourcesByKey.Add(sourceKey, string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(sourcePath) ? null : sourcePath);
6408 }
6409
6410 var sources = sourcesByKey.Values.ToList();
6411 if (sources.Count > 1)
6412 sources = sources.Where(source => !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(source)).ToList();
6413
6414 return sources;
6415 }

6422 private void IgnoreItem(object item)
6423 {
6424 SetItemIgnoredState(item, true);
6425 string desc = item is CADFace cFace
6426 ? $"Ignored Face ({ColorNamer.FormatColorWithRgb(cFace.FaceColor)})"
6427 : item is CADHole cHole
6428 ? $"Ignored Hole {cHole.HoleId} ({ColorNamer.FormatColorWithRgb(cHole.HoleColor)})"
6429 : "Ignored Item";
6430
6431 UndoManager.PushCommand(new ActionUndoCommand(
6432 () => SetItemIgnoredState(item, false, true),
6433 () => SetItemIgnoredState(item, true, true),
6434 desc,
6435 "Geometry"
6436 ));
6437 }
6438
6445 private void SetItemIgnoredState(object item, bool isIgnored, bool isUndoRedo = false)
6446 {
6447 if (item is CADFace face)
6448 {
6449 if (isIgnored)
6450 {
6451 if (!IgnoredFaces.Contains(face)) IgnoredFaces.Add(face);
6452 face.IsIgnored = true;
6453 if (ShowIgnoredAsTransparent)
6454 {
6455 _ignoredItemManager.ApplyIgnoredStyle(new List<CADFace> { face });
6456 }
6457
6458 // A manually ignored bridge face is an independent operator
6459 // choice. Do not cascade that action into its adjacent holes;
6460 // automatic bridge ignoring remains handled during extraction.
6461 if (!face.IsBridgeBetweenHoles &&
6462 face.FaceType == FaceTypeEnum.Planar &&
6463 face.ControlPoints != null &&
6464 face.ControlPoints.Any() &&
6465 _holesByColor != null)
6466 {
6467 double faceZ = face.ControlPoints.Average(cp => cp.Z);
6468 double minX = face.ControlPoints.Min(cp => cp.X) - 1.0;
6469 double maxX = face.ControlPoints.Max(cp => cp.X) + 1.0;
6470 double minY = face.ControlPoints.Min(cp => cp.Y) - 1.0;
6471 double maxY = face.ControlPoints.Max(cp => cp.Y) + 1.0;
6472
6473 var holesOnFace = _holesByColor.Values.SelectMany(h => h).Where(h =>
6474 (h.TopCenterPoint != null && Math.Abs(h.TopCenterPoint.Z - faceZ) < 1.0 && h.TopCenterPoint.X >= minX && h.TopCenterPoint.X <= maxX && h.TopCenterPoint.Y >= minY && h.TopCenterPoint.Y <= maxY) ||
6475 (h.BottomCenterPoint != null && Math.Abs(h.BottomCenterPoint.Z - faceZ) < 1.0 && h.BottomCenterPoint.X >= minX && h.BottomCenterPoint.X <= maxX && h.BottomCenterPoint.Y >= minY && h.BottomCenterPoint.Y <= maxY)
6476 ).ToList();
6477
6478 var allFaces = _allFacesByColor.Values.SelectMany(f => f).ToList();
6479 foreach (var hole in holesOnFace)
6480 {
6481 if (!IgnoredHoles.Contains(hole)) IgnoredHoles.Add(hole);
6482 hole.IsIgnored = true;
6483 var facesInHole = allFaces.Where(f => hole.FaceGlobalIndices.Contains(f.FaceGlobalIndex)).ToList();
6484 foreach (var f in facesInHole)
6485 {
6486 if (!IgnoredFaces.Contains(f)) IgnoredFaces.Add(f);
6487 f.IsIgnored = true;
6488 }
6489 if (ShowIgnoredAsTransparent)
6490 {
6491 _ignoredItemManager.ApplyIgnoredStyle(facesInHole);
6492 }
6493 }
6494 }
6495 }
6496 else
6497 {
6498 IgnoredFaces.Remove(face);
6499 face.IsIgnored = false;
6500 _ignoredItemManager.RestoreOriginalStyle(new List<CADFace> { face });
6501
6502 var parentHole = face.IsBridgeBetweenHoles
6503 ? null
6504 : IgnoredHoles.FirstOrDefault(h => h.FaceGlobalIndices.Contains(face.FaceGlobalIndex));
6505 if (parentHole != null)
6506 {
6507 IgnoredHoles.Remove(parentHole);
6508 parentHole.IsIgnored = false;
6509 }
6510
6511 // Restoring a bridge face is likewise isolated from its holes.
6512 if (!face.IsBridgeBetweenHoles &&
6513 face.FaceType == FaceTypeEnum.Planar &&
6514 face.ControlPoints != null &&
6515 face.ControlPoints.Any() &&
6516 _holesByColor != null)
6517 {
6518 double faceZ = face.ControlPoints.Average(cp => cp.Z);
6519 double minX = face.ControlPoints.Min(cp => cp.X) - 1.0;
6520 double maxX = face.ControlPoints.Max(cp => cp.X) + 1.0;
6521 double minY = face.ControlPoints.Min(cp => cp.Y) - 1.0;
6522 double maxY = face.ControlPoints.Max(cp => cp.Y) + 1.0;
6523
6524 var holesOnFace = _holesByColor.Values.SelectMany(h => h).Where(h =>
6525 (h.TopCenterPoint != null && Math.Abs(h.TopCenterPoint.Z - faceZ) < 1.0 && h.TopCenterPoint.X >= minX && h.TopCenterPoint.X <= maxX && h.TopCenterPoint.Y >= minY && h.TopCenterPoint.Y <= maxY) ||
6526 (h.BottomCenterPoint != null && Math.Abs(h.BottomCenterPoint.Z - faceZ) < 1.0 && h.BottomCenterPoint.X >= minX && h.BottomCenterPoint.X <= maxX && h.BottomCenterPoint.Y >= minY && h.BottomCenterPoint.Y <= maxY)
6527 ).ToList();
6528
6529 var allFaces = _allFacesByColor.Values.SelectMany(f => f).ToList();
6530 foreach (var hole in holesOnFace)
6531 {
6532 IgnoredHoles.Remove(hole);
6533 hole.IsIgnored = false;
6534 var facesInHole = allFaces.Where(f => hole.FaceGlobalIndices.Contains(f.FaceGlobalIndex)).ToList();
6535 foreach (var f in facesInHole)
6536 {
6537 IgnoredFaces.Remove(f);
6538 f.IsIgnored = false;
6539 }
6540 _ignoredItemManager.RestoreOriginalStyle(facesInHole);
6541 }
6542 }
6543 }
6544 }
6545 else if (item is CADHole hole)
6546 {
6547 var facesInHole = _allFacesByColor.Values.SelectMany(list => list)
6548 .Where(f => hole.FaceGlobalIndices.Contains(f.FaceGlobalIndex)).ToList();
6549 if (isIgnored)
6550 {
6551 if (!IgnoredHoles.Contains(hole)) IgnoredHoles.Add(hole);
6552 hole.IsIgnored = true;
6553 foreach (var f in facesInHole)
6554 {
6555 if (!IgnoredFaces.Contains(f)) IgnoredFaces.Add(f);
6556 f.IsIgnored = true;
6557 }
6558 if (ShowIgnoredAsTransparent)
6559 {
6560 _ignoredItemManager.ApplyIgnoredStyle(facesInHole);
6561 }
6562 }
6563 else
6564 {
6565 IgnoredHoles.Remove(hole);
6566 hole.IsIgnored = false;
6567 foreach (var f in facesInHole)
6568 {
6569 IgnoredFaces.Remove(f);
6570 f.IsIgnored = false;
6571 }
6572 _ignoredItemManager.RestoreOriginalStyle(facesInHole);
6573 }
6574 }
6575
6576 if (!isUndoRedo)
6577 {
6578 PopulateTreeViewBasedOnFilter();
6579 }
6580 else
6581 {
6582 _treeViewHelper?.InvalidateCache();
6583 }
6584
6585 if (measuring_sp != null)
6586 {
6587 measuring_sp.UpdateMeasurementCounts();
6588 measuring_sp.GeneratePaths_Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
6589 }
6590 _designControl?.Invalidate();
6591
6592 if (!isUndoRedo)
6593 {
6594 SaveCurrentSession();
6595 }
6596 }

6707 private void FlipSelectedFaceNormal(object? parameter)
6708 {
6709 if (parameter is not CADFace face)
6710 {
6711 System.Windows.MessageBox.Show(
6712 $"{GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "FlipNormal_NoFaceSelected") ?? "No face selected."}\n\n{GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "FlipNormal_SelectFaceFirst") ?? "Please select a face first to flip its normal."}",
6713 GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "FlipNormal_Title") ?? "Flip Normal",
6714 System.Windows.MessageBoxButton.OK,
6715 System.Windows.MessageBoxImage.Warning);
6716 return;
6717 }
6718
6719 // Toggle the flipped state for this face
6720 // CRITICAL: Use FaceGlobalIndex (entity-level) for IgnoredItemManager, FaceIndex (BREP-level) for ShellGenerator
6721 bool wasFlipped = _flippedFaceNormals.Contains(face.FaceIndex);
6722 if (!wasFlipped)
6723 {
6724 _flippedFaceNormals.Add(face.FaceIndex);
6725 Debug.WriteLine($"SUCCESS: Flipped normal for face - FaceGlobalIndex: {face.FaceGlobalIndex}, BREP FaceIndex: {face.FaceIndex}");
6726 }
6727 else
6728 {
6729 _flippedFaceNormals.Remove(face.FaceIndex);
6730 Debug.WriteLine($"SUCCESS: Restored normal for face {face.FaceGlobalIndex} (BREP face index: {face.FaceIndex})");
6731 }
6732
6733 // Refresh normals display if currently visible
6734 if (_designControl != null)
6735 {
6736 bool normalsVisible = bool.Parse(ConfigurationManager.AppSettings["ShowNormals"] ?? "false");
6737 if (normalsVisible)
6738 {
6739 // Force refresh by toggling off and on
6740 _designControl.ShowNormals = false;
6741 _designControl.Invalidate();
6742 _designControl.ShowNormals = true;
6743 _designControl.Invalidate();
6744 }
6745 }
6746
6747 // Notify user
6748 string message = wasFlipped
6749 ? string.Format(GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "FlipNormal_Restored") ?? "Normal for face {0} restored to original direction.", face.FaceGlobalIndex)
6750 : string.Format(GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "FlipNormal_Success") ?? "Normal for face {0} flipped successfully.", face.FaceGlobalIndex);
6751
6752 System.Windows.MessageBox.Show(
6753 message,
6754 GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "FlipNormal_Title") ?? "Flip Normal",
6755 System.Windows.MessageBoxButton.OK,
6756 System.Windows.MessageBoxImage.Information);
6757
6758 //UI Updates
6759 if (measuring_sp != null) { measuring_sp.GeneratePaths_Visibility = Visibility.Visible; }

6785 private async void RegenerateOffsetShell()
6786 {
6787 if (_designControl == null)
6788 {
6789 System.Windows.MessageBox.Show(
6790 "No design loaded.",
6791 "Regenerate Offset Shell",
6792 System.Windows.MessageBoxButton.OK,
6793 System.Windows.MessageBoxImage.Warning);
6794 return;
6795 }
6796
6797 try
6798 {
6799 // Save current shell visibility state
6800 bool shellWasVisible = false;
6801 if (_designControl.Layers.Contains("SHELL_UNIFIED"))
6802 {
6803 shellWasVisible = _designControl.Layers["SHELL_UNIFIED"].Visible;
6804 }
6805
6806 // Clear red overlays before regenerating
6807 if (_ignoredItemManager != null && _flippedFaceNormals.Count > 0)
6808 {
6809 _ignoredItemManager.ClearFlippedFaceOverlays(_flippedFaceNormals.ToList());
6810 }
6811
6812 // Show progress
6813 Machine_Status_ProgressText = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Progress_RegeneratingOffsetShell") ?? "Regenerating offset shell...";
6814 Machine_Status_Progress = 0;
6815
6816 Debug.WriteLine("INFO: Regenerating offset shell...");
6817 // Call the async method to regenerate shell
6818 await _pathManager.GenerateOversizedShellFromDesignAsync(_designControl, default, forceRegenerate: true);
6819
6820 Machine_Status_Progress = 100;
6821 Machine_Status_ProgressText = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Progress_ShellRegeneratedSuccessfully") ?? "Shell regenerated successfully!";
6822
6823 Debug.WriteLine($"SUCCESS: Shell regeneration complete");
6824
6825 // Restore shell visibility state if it was visible before
6826 if (shellWasVisible && _designControl.Layers.Contains("SHELL_UNIFIED"))
6827 {
6828 _designControl.Layers["SHELL_UNIFIED"].Visible = true;
6829 Debug.WriteLine(" 👁️ Shell layer visibility restored");
6830 }
6831
6832 // Refresh the viewport to show updated shell
6833 _designControl.Invalidate();
6834 await System.Threading.Tasks.Task.Delay(50); // Small delay for render
6835
6836 // Clear the flipped faces list since they've been applied
6837 _flippedFaceNormals.Clear();
6838
6839 // Brief success message
6840 await System.Threading.Tasks.Task.Delay(2000);
6841 Machine_Status_Progress = 0;
6842 Machine_Status_ProgressText = string.Empty;
6843 }
6844 catch (Exception ex)
6845 {
6846 Debug.WriteLine($"ERROR: Error regenerating shell: {ex.Message}");
6847 Debug.WriteLine($" Stack trace: {ex.StackTrace}");
6848 System.Windows.MessageBox.Show(
6849 $"Failed to regenerate shell:\n{ex.Message}",
6850 GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "MessageBox_InternalError") ?? "Failed to regenerate shell",
6851 System.Windows.MessageBoxButton.OK,
6852 System.Windows.MessageBoxImage.Error);
6853 }
6854 }

6986 private void ConvertHoleToFaces(CADHole holeToConvert)
6987 {
6988 if (holeToConvert == null) return;
6989 PerformConvertHoleToFaces(holeToConvert);
6990
6991 UndoManager.PushCommand(new ActionUndoCommand(
6992 () =>
6993 {
6994 AddNewHole(holeToConvert);
6995 _treeViewHelper?.InvalidateCache();
6996 PopulateTreeViewBasedOnFilter();
6997 },
6998 () => PerformConvertHoleToFaces(holeToConvert),
6999 description: $"Convert Hole {holeToConvert.HoleId} ({ColorNamer.FormatColorWithRgb(holeToConvert.HoleColor)}) to Faces",
7000 category: "Hole Management"
7001 ));
7002 }
7003
7008 private void PerformConvertHoleToFaces(CADHole holeToConvert)
7009 {
7010 if (holeToConvert == null) return;
7011
7012 string colorKey = _holesByColor.FirstOrDefault(kvp => kvp.Value.Contains(holeToConvert)).Key;
7013 if (colorKey == null) return;
7014
7015 // 1. Remove hole from the main holes dictionary
7016 _holesByColor[colorKey].Remove(holeToConvert);
7017 if (_holesByColor[colorKey].Count == 0)
7018 {
7019 _holesByColor.Remove(colorKey);
7020 }
7021
7022 // 2. Find the constituent faces from the master list
7023 var facesToAdd = _allFacesByColor.Values.SelectMany(list => list)
7024 .Where(f => holeToConvert.FaceGlobalIndices.Contains(f.FaceGlobalIndex)).ToList();
7025
7026 // 3. Add these faces to the non-hole faces dictionary
7027 if (!_facesByColor.ContainsKey(colorKey))
7028 {
7029 _facesByColor[colorKey] = new List<CADFace>();
7030 }
7031 _facesByColor[colorKey].AddRange(facesToAdd);
7032
7033 // 4. Update the lookup map
7034 foreach (var faceIdx in holeToConvert.FaceGlobalIndices)
7035 {
7036 if (_faceIndexToHoleMap != null)
7037 _faceIndexToHoleMap.Remove(faceIdx);
7038 }
7039
7040 // 5. Rebuild the cache and repopulate the tree
7041 _treeViewHelper.InvalidateCache();
7042 PopulateTreeViewBasedOnFilter();
7043
7044 EyeshotStatus_Text = $"Hole {holeToConvert.HoleId} converted to {facesToAdd.Count} faces.";
7045 }

7101 private async Task<bool> CancelActiveProcessesAndWaitAsync(int timeoutMs = 5000)
7102 {
7103 bool waitNeeded = false;
7104
7105 if (IsExtractingFaces)
7106 {
7107 CancelFaceExtraction();
7108 waitNeeded = true;
7109 }
7110 if (_pathGenerationCancellationTokenSource != null)
7111 {
7112 CancelPathGeneration();
7113 waitNeeded = true;
7114 }
7115
7116 if (!waitNeeded) return true;
7117
7118 int delay = 100;
7119 int elapsed = 0;
7120 while ((IsExtractingFaces || _pathGenerationCancellationTokenSource != null) && elapsed < timeoutMs)
7121 {
7122 await Task.Delay(delay);
7123 elapsed += delay;
7124 }
7125
7126 return !IsExtractingFaces && _pathGenerationCancellationTokenSource == null;
7127 }

7188 _designControl.Clear();

7206 }
7207 else if (extension == ".igs" || extension == ".iges")
7208 {
7209 igesReader.AddTo(_designControl);
7210 }
7211 else if (extension == ".obj")
7212 {
7213 objReader.AddTo(_designControl);
7214 }
7215 else
7216 {
7217 stepReader.AddTo(_designControl);
7218 }
7219 _designControl.Units = _units;
7220 foreach (var ent in _designControl.Entities)
7221 {
7222 if (ent != null && ent.EntityData == null)
7223 {
7224 ent.EntityData = path;
7225 }
7226 }
7227 FacesUpToDate = false;
7228
7229 _ignoredItemManager = new IgnoredItemManager(_designControl) { DocLanguage = DocLanguage };
7230
7231 AddPartOrigins(null, path); // Add single origin for the whole model
7232 UpdateCmmBoundingBoxAndGrid();
7233
7234 var val = System.Configuration.ConfigurationManager.AppSettings["MovePartToOriginByDefault"];
7235 if (bool.TryParse(val, out bool autoMove) && autoMove)
7236 {

7238 if (firstPartEntity != null)

7247 EyeshotStatus_Text = string.Format(GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Eyeshot_ModelLoaded")!, Path.GetFileName(path), CountLoadedPartEntities(path));
7248 DesignerVisibility = Visibility.Visible;
7249 }, DispatcherPriority.Normal);

7255 _designControl.ZoomFit();

7264
7265 SaveCurrentSession();

7267 catch (Exception ex)

"An error occurred while loading the CAD model:") + $" {ex.Message}", GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "MessageBox_ImportError") ?? "HirEV SmartFitSystems - Import Error", MessageBoxButton.OK, MessageBoxImage.Error);
7270 EyeshotStatus_Text = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Eyeshot_ImportFailed");

7501 var dlg = new OpenFileDialog
7502 {
7503 Filter = "STEP files (*.stp;*.step)|*.stp;*.step|IGES files (*.igs;*.iges)|*.igs;*.iges|OBJ files (*.obj)|*.obj|STL files (*.stl)|*.stl|All files (*.*)|*.*",
7504 FilterIndex = 1,
7505 Title = "Select CAD file"
7506 };
7507
7508 if (dlg.ShowDialog() != true)
7509 return;
7510
7511 string path = dlg.FileName;
7512 EyeshotStatus_Text = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Eyeshot_LoadingAdditionalModel");
7513 Mouse.OverrideCursor = Cursors.Wait;
7514
7515 try
7516 {
7517 string extension = Path.GetExtension(path).ToLowerInvariant();
7518 ReadSTL stlReader = null!;
7519 ReadSTEP stepReader = null!;
7520 ReadIGES igesReader = null!;
7521 ReadOBJ objReader = null!;
7522
7523 // Run the heavy parsing part off the UI thread
7524 await Task.Run(() =>
7525 {
7526 if (extension == ".stl")
7527 {
7528 stlReader = new ReadSTL(path);
7529 stlReader.DoWork();
7530 }
7531 else if (extension == ".igs" || extension == ".iges")
7532 {
7533 igesReader = new ReadIGES(path);
7534 igesReader.DoWork();
7535 }
7536 else if (extension == ".obj")
7537 {
7538 objReader = new ReadOBJ(path);
7539 objReader.DoWork();
7540 }
7541 else
7542 {
7543 stepReader = new ReadSTEP(path);
7544 stepReader.DoWork();
7545 }
7546 });
7547
7548 // 2️⃣ Everything that creates UI objects must run on the UI thread
7549 await Application.Current.Dispatcher.InvokeAsync(() =>
7550 {
7551 var tempDesign = new Design();
7552 if (extension == ".stl")
7553 {
7554 stlReader.AddTo(tempDesign);
7555 }
7556 else if (extension == ".igs" || extension == ".iges")
7557 {
7558 igesReader.AddTo(tempDesign);
7559 }
7560 else if (extension == ".obj")
7561 {
7562 objReader.AddTo(tempDesign);
7563 }
7564 else
7565 {
7566 stepReader.AddTo(tempDesign);
7567 }
7568
7569 var importedEntities = tempDesign.Entities.ToList();
7570 if (importedEntities.Count == 0)
7571 {
7572 EyeshotStatus_Text = string.Format(
7573 GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Eyeshot_NoEntitiesFound")!,
7574 Path.GetFileName(path));
7575 return;
7576 }
7577
7578 // Duplicate filtering
7579 var existingBoxes = _designControl.Entities
7580 .Select(e => (e.BoxMin, e.BoxMax))
7581 .ToHashSet();
7582
7583 var uniqueEntities = importedEntities
7584 .Where(e => !existingBoxes.Contains((e.BoxMin, e.BoxMax)))
7585 .ToList();
7586
7587 if (uniqueEntities.Count == 0)
7588 {
7589 EyeshotStatus_Text = string.Format(
7590 GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Eyeshot_AllEntitiesAlreadyExist") ?? "All entities from {0} already exist",
7591 Path.GetFileName(path));
7592 return;
7593 }
7594
7595 int entityCountBeforeImport = _designControl.Entities.Count;
7596 int gridCountBeforeImport = _designControl.Viewports.Count > 0 ? _designControl.Viewports[0].Grids.Count : 0;
7597
7598 foreach (var ent in uniqueEntities)
7599 {
7600 // Store original filename in EntityData for tooltip
7601 ent.EntityData = path;
7602 _designControl.Entities.Add(ent);
7603 }
7604 _designControl.Units = _units;
7605
7606 AddPartOrigins(uniqueEntities, path); // Add origin symbol for the new model group
7607
7608 var val = System.Configuration.ConfigurationManager.AppSettings["MovePartToOriginByDefault"];
7609 if (bool.TryParse(val, out bool autoMove) && autoMove)
7610 {
7611 var newPartEntity = uniqueEntities.FirstOrDefault(IsValidPartEntity);
7612 if (newPartEntity != null)
7613 {
7614 MoveObjectToOrigin(newPartEntity);
7615 }
7616 }
7617
7618 var newEntities = _designControl.Entities.Skip(entityCountBeforeImport).ToList();
7619 var newGrids = _designControl.Viewports.Count > 0
7620 ? _designControl.Viewports[0].Grids.Skip(gridCountBeforeImport).ToList()
7621 : new List<devDept.Eyeshot.Control.Grid>();
7622 var relatedGeneratedEntities = new List<Entity>();
7623
7624 UndoManager.PushCommand(new ActionUndoCommand(
7625 () =>
7626 {
7627 if (relatedGeneratedEntities.Count == 0)
7628 {
7629 relatedGeneratedEntities.AddRange(_designControl.Entities.Where(ent =>
7630 ent?.LayerName != null &&
7631 (ent.LayerName.StartsWith("SHELL_", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
7632 ent.LayerName.Contains("IGNORED", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))));
7633 }
7634
7635 foreach (var ent in relatedGeneratedEntities)
7636 {
7637 _designControl.Entities.Remove(ent);
7638 }
7639
7640 foreach (var ent in newEntities)
7641 {
7642 _designControl.Entities.Remove(ent);
7643 if (OrderedPartEntities.Contains(ent))
7644 {
7645 OrderedPartEntities.Remove(ent);
7646 }
7647 }
7648 if (_designControl.Viewports.Count > 0)
7649 {
7650 foreach (var g in newGrids)
7651 {
7652 _designControl.Viewports[0].Grids.Remove(g);
7653 }
7654 }
7655 FacesUpToDate = false;
7656 _treeViewHelper?.InvalidateCache();
7657 PopulateTreeViewBasedOnFilter();
7658 _designControl.Invalidate();
7659 },
7660 () =>
7661 {
7662 foreach (var ent in newEntities)
7663 {
7664 if (!_designControl.Entities.Contains(ent))
7665 {
7666 _designControl.Entities.Add(ent);
7667 }
7668 }
7669 if (_designControl.Viewports.Count > 0)
7670 {
7671 foreach (var g in newGrids)
7672 {
7673 if (!_designControl.Viewports[0].Grids.Contains(g))
7674 {
7675 _designControl.Viewports[0].Grids.Add(g);
7676 }
7677 }
7678 }
7679 foreach (var ent in relatedGeneratedEntities)
7680 {
7681 if (!_designControl.Entities.Contains(ent))
7682 {
7683 _designControl.Entities.Add(ent);
7684 }
7685 }
7686 FacesUpToDate = false;
7687 _treeViewHelper?.InvalidateCache();
7688 PopulateTreeViewBasedOnFilter();
7689 _designControl.Invalidate();
7690 },
7691 description: $"Import Model {Path.GetFileName(path)}",
7692 category: "Model Import"
7693 ));
7694
7695 EyeshotStatus_Text = string.Format(
7696 GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Eyeshot_AddedEntitiesFromModel") ?? "Added {0} entities from {1}",
7697 uniqueEntities.Count(), Path.GetFileName(path));
7698
7699 DesignerVisibility = Visibility.Visible;
7700 FacesUpToDate = false;
7701 });
7702
7703 CanExtractFaces = true;
7704 await Task.Delay(200);
7705 await Application.Current.Dispatcher.InvokeAsync(() =>
7706 {
7707 _designControl.Entities.UpdateBoundingBox();
7708 _designControl.ZoomFit();
7709 _designControl.Invalidate();
7710 ExtractUpdateFacesButton_Text = (_allFacesByColor == null || _allFacesByColor.Count == 0) ? GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "ExtractFaces") : GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "UpdateFaces");
7711 }, DispatcherPriority.ContextIdle);
7712
7713 SaveCurrentSession();
7714 }
7715 catch (Exception ex)
7716 {
7717 MessageBox.Show((GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "ErrorMessageBox_StepModelLoadError") ?? "An error occurred while loading the STEP model:") + $" {ex.Message}", GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "MessageBox_ImportError") ?? "HirEV SmartFitSystems - Import Error", MessageBoxButton.OK, MessageBoxImage.Error);
7718 EyeshotStatus_Text = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Eyeshot_ImportFailed");
7719 }
7720 finally
7721 {
7722 Mouse.OverrideCursor = null;
7723 }
7724 }

7730 public void RemoveModelEntity(Entity? entity)
7731 {
7732 if (entity == null) return;
7733
7734 Application.Current.Dispatcher.Invoke(() =>
7735 {
7736 if (_designControl.Entities.Contains(entity))
7737 {
7738 string? sourcePath = entity.EntityData as string;
7739 int orderedPartIndex = OrderedPartEntities.IndexOf(entity);
7740
7741 var removedGrids = new List<devDept.Eyeshot.Control.Grid>();
7742 var originSymbols = new List<BlockReference>();
7743
7744 // Check if any other entities from the same model remain (same source path) excluding this one
7745 bool anyRemaining = _designControl.Entities
7746 .Any(e => e != null && e != entity && e.EntityData as string == sourcePath && (e is Brep || e is Mesh));
7747
7748 if (!anyRemaining)
7749 {
7750 // Remove associated PART_ORIGIN BlockReference
7751 originSymbols = _designControl.Entities
7752 .OfType<BlockReference>()
7753 .Where(br => br.EntityData is string tag && tag.StartsWith("PART_ORIGIN", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) &&
7754 (string.IsNullOrEmpty(sourcePath) || tag.EndsWith(sourcePath, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) || tag == "PART_ORIGIN"))
7755 .ToList();
7756
7757 foreach (var os in originSymbols)
7758 {
7759 // Remove associated Viewport Grids matching the origin position
7760 if (_designControl.Viewports.Count > 0)
7761 {
7762 var gridsToRemove = _designControl.Viewports[0].Grids
7763 .Skip(1) // Skip main grid
7764 .Where(g => g != null && (g.Plane.Origin.Equals(os.InsertionPoint) || g.Plane.Origin.DistanceTo(os.InsertionPoint) < 1.0))
7765 .ToList();
7766 removedGrids.AddRange(gridsToRemove);
7767 }
7768 }
7769 }
7770
7771 Action doRemove = () =>
7772 {
7773 _designControl.Entities.Remove(entity);
7774
7775 if (orderedPartIndex >= 0 && OrderedPartEntities.Contains(entity))
7776 {
7777 OrderedPartEntities.Remove(entity);
7778 }
7779
7780 foreach (var os in originSymbols)
7781 {
7782 _designControl.Entities.Remove(os);
7783 }
7784
7785 if (_designControl.Viewports.Count > 0)
7786 {
7787 foreach (var g in removedGrids)
7788 {
7789 _designControl.Viewports[0].Grids.Remove(g);
7790 }
7791 }
7792
7793 // Mark state as dirty so user knows they need to update faces
7794 FacesUpToDate = false;
7795 ExtractUpdateFacesButton_Text = (_allFacesByColor == null || _allFacesByColor.Count == 0)
7796 ? GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "ExtractFaces")
7797 : GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "UpdateFaces");
7798
7799 _treeViewHelper?.InvalidateCache();
7800 PopulateTreeViewBasedOnFilter();
7801 _designControl.Invalidate();
7802 };
7803
7804 Action undoRemove = () =>
7805 {
7806 if (!_designControl.Entities.Contains(entity))
7807 {
7808 _designControl.Entities.Add(entity);
7809 }
7810
7811 if (orderedPartIndex >= 0 && !OrderedPartEntities.Contains(entity))
7812 {
7813 if (orderedPartIndex <= OrderedPartEntities.Count)
7814 {
7815 OrderedPartEntities.Insert(orderedPartIndex, entity);
7816 }
7817 else
7818 {
7819 OrderedPartEntities.Add(entity);
7820 }
7821 }
7822
7823 foreach (var os in originSymbols)
7824 {
7825 if (!_designControl.Entities.Contains(os))
7826 {
7827 _designControl.Entities.Add(os);
7828 }
7829 }
7830
7831 if (_designControl.Viewports.Count > 0)
7832 {
7833 foreach (var g in removedGrids)
7834 {
7835 if (!_designControl.Viewports[0].Grids.Contains(g))
7836 {
7837 _designControl.Viewports[0].Grids.Add(g);
7838 }
7839 }
7840 }
7841
7842 FacesUpToDate = false;
7843 ExtractUpdateFacesButton_Text = (_allFacesByColor == null || _allFacesByColor.Count == 0)
7844 ? GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "ExtractFaces")
7845 : GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "UpdateFaces");
7846
7847 _treeViewHelper?.InvalidateCache();
7848 PopulateTreeViewBasedOnFilter();
7849 _designControl.Invalidate();
7850 };
7851
7852 // Execute the removal
7853 doRemove();
7854
7855 // Push the undo/redo action command to the UndoManager
7856 UndoManager.PushCommand(new ActionUndoCommand(
7857 undoAction: undoRemove,
7858 redoAction: doRemove,
7859 description: $"Remove Model Entity {entity.GetType().Name}",
7860 category: "Model Import"
7861 ));
7862 }
7863 });
7864 }

7878 private async Task ReExtractFacesPreservingIgnoredStateAsync(
7879 int entityCountBeforeImport,
7880 HashSet<(int EntityIndex, int FaceIndex)> preservedIgnoredFaceIndices,
7881 HashSet<int> preservedIgnoredHoleIds)
7882 {
7883 try
7884 {
7885 EyeshotStatus_Text = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Eyeshot_UpdatingFaces");
7886
7887 // Run extraction-heavy work in background thread
7888 var token = _faceExtractionCancellationTokenSource?.Token ?? default;
7892 var extractionResult = await Task.Run(async () =>
7893 {
7894 await UpdateProgressAsync(0, $"{GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Progress_PreparingExtraction") ?? "A iniciar extração de faces..."} (0%)", delay: 0);
7895 var extractor = new FaceExtractor(_designControl.Entities);
7896 var extractedFaces = extractor.ExtractFaces((percentage, faceCount) =>
7897 {
7898 // Map 0-100% of extraction to 0-68% of overall progress
7899 int overallProgress = (int)(percentage * 0.68);
7900 Application.Current.Dispatcher.Invoke(() =>
7901 {
7902 Machine_Status_Progress = overallProgress;
7903 string extractingText = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Progress_ExtractingFaces") ?? "A extrair faces";
7904 Machine_Status_ProgressText = $"{extractingText} ({percentage}%)";
7905 }, System.Windows.Threading.DispatcherPriority.Normal);
7906 }, token);
7907
7908 token.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
7909 await UpdateProgressAsync(69, $"{GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Progress_ProcessingFaceData") ?? "A processar dados das faces..."} (69%)");
7910
7911 await UpdateProgressAsync(70, $"{GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Progress_StartingHoleDetection") ?? "A iniciar deteção de furos..."} (70%)");
7912
7913 List<CADHole> detectedHoles;
7914 List<CADFace> nonHoleFaces;
7915 (detectedHoles, nonHoleFaces) = HoleDetector.DetectHoles(extractedFaces, (percentage, holeCount) =>
7916 {
7917 // Map 0-100% of hole detection to 70-88% of overall progress
7918 int overallProgress = 70 + (int)(percentage * 0.18);
7919 Application.Current.Dispatcher.Invoke(() =>
7920 {
7921 Machine_Status_Progress = overallProgress;
7922 string detectingText = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Progress_DetectingHoles") ?? "A detetar furos";
7923 Machine_Status_ProgressText = $"{detectingText} ({overallProgress}%)";
7924 }, System.Windows.Threading.DispatcherPriority.Normal);
7925 }, token);
7926
7927 // await UpdateProgressAsync(89, $"{GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Progress_HoleDetectionComplete") ?? "Deteção de furos completa..."} (89%)");
7928
7929 return (extractedFaces, detectedHoles, nonHoleFaces);
7930 }, token).ConfigureAwait(false);
7931
7932 // Now we’re back on the UI thread
7933 var (faces, holes, nonHoleFaces) = extractionResult;
7934
7935 // Update main data structures
7936 _allFacesByColor = GroupFacesByColor(faces);
7937 _facesByColor = GroupFacesByColor(nonHoleFaces);
7938 _holesByColor = GroupHolesByColor(holes);
7939
7940 // Rebuild face-to-hole mapping
7941 _faceIndexToHoleMap = new Dictionary<int, CADHole>();
7942 foreach (var holeList in _holesByColor.Values)
7943 {
7944 foreach (var hole in holeList)
7945 {
7946 foreach (var faceGlobalIndex in hole.FaceGlobalIndices)
7947 {
7948 if (!_faceIndexToHoleMap.ContainsKey(faceGlobalIndex))
7949 _faceIndexToHoleMap.Add(faceGlobalIndex, hole);
7950 }
7951 }
7952 }
7953
7954 // Reapply ignored state to faces
7955 IgnoredFaces.Clear();
7956 foreach (var face in faces)
7957 {
7958 if (preservedIgnoredFaceIndices.Contains((face.EntityIndex, face.FaceIndex)))
7959 {
7960 IgnoredFaces.Add(face);
7961 face.IsIgnored = true;
7962 }
7963 }
7964
7965 // Reapply ignored state to holes
7966 IgnoredHoles.Clear();
7967 foreach (var holeList in _holesByColor.Values)
7968 {
7969 foreach (var hole in holeList)
7970 {
7971 if (preservedIgnoredHoleIds.Contains(hole.HoleId) || hole.IsIgnored)
7972 {
7973 if (!IgnoredHoles.Contains(hole))
7974 IgnoredHoles.Add(hole);
7975 hole.IsIgnored = true;
7976
7977 // Also mark constituent faces as ignored
7978 var facesInHole = faces
7979 .Where(f => hole.FaceGlobalIndices.Contains(f.FaceGlobalIndex))
7980 .ToList();
7981
7982 foreach (var f in facesInHole)
7983 {
7984 if (!IgnoredFaces.Contains(f))
7985 IgnoredFaces.Add(f);
7986 f.IsIgnored = true;
7987 }
7988 }
7989 }
7990 }
7991
7992 // Update visual representation
7993 if (ShowIgnoredAsTransparent)
7994 {
7995 var ignoredFacesList = IgnoredFaces.ToList();
7996 if (ignoredFacesList.Any())
7997 _ignoredItemManager.ApplyIgnoredStyle(ignoredFacesList);
7998 }
7999
8000 // Refresh tree view and UI
8001 _treeViewHelper.InvalidateCache();
8002 _treeViewHelper.PopulateTreeView(
8003 _facesByColor,
8004 _holesByColor,
8005 _allFacesByColor,
8006 showExteriorOnly: IsExteriorOnlyChecked,
8007 showVisibleOnly: IsVisibleOnlyChecked
8008 );
8009
8010 CanExport = true;
8011 planning_sp?.InitializeToleranceSliders();
8012
8013 int restoredFaceCount = IgnoredFaces.Count;
8014 int restoredHoleCount = IgnoredHoles.Count;
8015
8016 EyeshotStatus_Text = string.Format(
8017 GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Eyeshot_FacesExtracted")!,
8018 faces.Count,
8019 _facesByColor.Count
8020 ) + (holes.Count > 0 ? $" | {holes.Count} holes detected" : "")
8021 + (restoredFaceCount > 0 || restoredHoleCount > 0
8022 ? $" | Restored {restoredFaceCount} ignored faces, {restoredHoleCount} ignored holes"
8023 : "");
8024
8025 SaveCurrentSession();
8026 }
8027 catch (Exception ex)
8028 {
8029 MessageBox.Show(
8030 (GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "ErrorMessageBox_ExtractFacesError") ?? "Error updating faces:") + $" {ex.Message}",
8031 GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "MessageBox_InternalError") ?? "Internal Error",
8032 MessageBoxButton.OK,
8033 MessageBoxImage.Error
8034 );
8035 EyeshotStatus_Text = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Eyeshot_ExtractionFailed");
8036 }
8037 }

8165 _designControl.Entities.Add(sphere);
8166 }
8167 }
8168 }
8169 }

8171
8172 // Regenerate and invalidate to ensure the viewport updates
8173 _designControl.Entities.Regen();
8174 _designControl.Invalidate();
8175 });

8265 private async Task ExtractOrUpdateFacesAsync()
8266 {
8267 try
8268 {
8269 if (IsExtractingFaces)
8270 {
8271 CancelFaceExtraction();
8272 return;
8273 }
8274
8275 // SUCCESS: Check if path generation is in progress and prompt user
8276 if (_pathGenerationCancellationTokenSource != null && !_pathGenerationCancellationTokenSource.IsCancellationRequested)
8277 {
8278 var result = MessageBox.Show(
8279 GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "MessageBoxQuestion_CancelGenerationAndUpdateFaces") ?? "Quer cancelar a geração de trajetórias e atualizar as faces?",
8280 GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "MessageBox_CancelGenerationTitle") ?? "Cancelar Geração de Trajetórias",
8281 MessageBoxButton.YesNo,
8282 MessageBoxImage.Question);
8283
8284 if (result == MessageBoxResult.Yes)
8285 {
8286 CancelPathGeneration();
8287 // Wait a short moment to allow the background task to respond to cancellation
8288 await Task.Delay(200);
8289 }
8290 else
8291 {
8292 return; // User chose not to cancel, so abort extraction
8293 }
8294 }
8295
8296 int previousEntityCount = 0;
8297 if (_allFacesByColor != null && _allFacesByColor.Count > 0)
8298 {
8299 previousEntityCount = _allFacesByColor.Values
8300 .SelectMany(f => f)
8301 .Select(f => f.EntityIndex)
8302 .DefaultIfEmpty(-1)
8303 .Max() + 1;
8304 }
8305
8306 // No previous extraction or user forces update when faces are up to date -> full extraction
8307 if (_allFacesByColor == null || _allFacesByColor.Count == 0 || previousEntityCount >= _designControl.Entities.Count)
8308 {
8309 await PerformFaceExtractionAsync(false);
8310 _lastExtractedEntityCount = _designControl.Entities.Count;
8311 }
8312 else
8313 {
8314 // Incremental extraction (new entities added)
8315 await PerformFaceExtractionAsync(true, previousEntityCount);
8316 _lastExtractedEntityCount = _designControl.Entities.Count;
8317 }
8318
8319 FacesUpToDate = true; // Mark faces as up-to-date after extraction
8320 ExtractUpdateFacesButton_Text = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "UpdateFaces") ?? "Update Faces";
8321 }
8322 catch (Exception ex)
8323 {
8324 MessageBox.Show(
8325 (GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "ErrorMessageBox_ExtractFacesError") ??
8326 "Error extracting faces:") + $" {ex.Message}",
8327 GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "MessageBox_InternalError") ?? "Internal Error",
8328 MessageBoxButton.OK,
8329 MessageBoxImage.Error
8330 );
8331 EyeshotStatus_Text = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Eyeshot_ExtractionFailed") ?? "Extraction failed";
8332 }
8333 }

8341 private async Task PerformFaceExtractionAsync(bool isIncremental, int entityCountBeforeImport = 0)
8342 {
8343 try
8344 {
8345 if (IsExtractingFaces) return;
8346 IsExtractingFaces = true;
8347 _faceExtractionCancellationTokenSource?.Dispose();
8348 _faceExtractionCancellationTokenSource = new System.Threading.CancellationTokenSource();
8349
8350 Mouse.OverrideCursor = Cursors.Wait;
8351
8352 await Application.Current.Dispatcher.InvokeAsync(() =>
8353 {
8354 StatusProgressBarColor = new SolidColorBrush(System.Windows.Media.Color.FromRgb(16, 207, 200));
8355 EyeshotStatus_Text = isIncremental ?
8356 (GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Eyeshot_ExtractingNewFaces") ?? "Extracting faces from the new entities") :
8357 (GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Eyeshot_ExtractingFaces") ?? "Extracting faces...");
8358
8359 // Update text to "Cancel Extraction"
8360 ExtractUpdateFacesButton_Text = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "CancelExtraction") ?? "Cancelar Extração";
8361 });
8362 await UpdateProgressAsync(0, $"{GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Progress_StartingExtraction") ?? "A iniciar extração..."} (0%)");
8363
8364 var entitiesToExtract = new EntityList();
8365 var originalIndices = new List<int>();
8366
8367 if (!isIncremental)
8368 {
8369 await UpdateProgressAsync(1, $"{GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Progress_ClearingMarkers") ?? "A limpar marcadores..."} (1%)");
8370 _visualsManager.ClearAllMarkers();
8371
8372 // await UpdateProgressAsync(2, $"{GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Progress_ClearingSelection") ?? "A limpar seleção..."} (2%)");
8373 // _treeViewHelper.ClearTreeViewSelection();
8374
8375 await UpdateProgressAsync(3, $"{GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Progress_ClearingTreeView") ?? "A limpar árvore..."} (3%)");
8376 await Application.Current.Dispatcher.InvokeAsync(() => {
8377 TreeViewItems = new ObservableCollection<TreeViewItem>();
8378 });
8379
8380 await UpdateProgressAsync(4, $"{GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Progress_ClearingIgnored") ?? "A limpar ignorados..."} (4%)");
8381 _ignoredItemManager.ClearAll();
8382 IgnoredFaces.Clear();
8383 IgnoredHoles.Clear();
8384
8385 for (int i = 0; i < _designControl.Entities.Count; i++)
8386 {
8387 var ent = _designControl.Entities[i];
8388 if (IsModelEntity(ent))
8389 {
8390 entitiesToExtract.Add(ent);
8391 originalIndices.Add(i);
8392 }
8393 }
8394 }
8395 else
8396 {
8397 for (int i = entityCountBeforeImport; i < _designControl.Entities.Count; i++)
8398 {
8399 var ent = _designControl.Entities[i];
8400 if (IsModelEntity(ent))
8401 {
8402 entitiesToExtract.Add(ent);
8403 originalIndices.Add(i);
8404 }
8405 }
8406
8407 if (entitiesToExtract.Count == 0)
8408 {
8409 bool reExtract = false;
8410 await Application.Current.Dispatcher.InvokeAsync(() =>
8411 {
8412 EyeshotStatus_Text = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Eyeshot_NoNewEntitiesToExtract") ?? "No new entities to extract faces from.";
8413 StatusProgressBarColor = new SolidColorBrush(Colors.Gray);
8414 Machine_Status_Progress = 0;
8415 Machine_Status_ProgressText = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Idle") ?? "Idle";
8416
8417 string title = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "MessageBox_NoNewEntities_Title") ?? "Warning";
8418 string message = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "MessageBox_NoNewEntities_Message") ?? "There are no new entities to extract faces. Do you want to re-extract faces for the current parts configuration?";
8419
8420 var result = System.Windows.MessageBox.Show(message, title, System.Windows.MessageBoxButton.OKCancel, System.Windows.MessageBoxImage.Question);
8421 if (result == System.Windows.MessageBoxResult.OK)
8422 {
8423 reExtract = true;
8424 }
8425 });
8426
8427 if (reExtract)
8428 {
8429 IsExtractingFaces = false;
8430 await PerformFaceExtractionAsync(false);
8431 }
8432 return;
8433 }
8434 }
8435
8436 await UpdateProgressAsync(5, $"{GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Progress_PreparingExtraction") ?? "A iniciar extração de faces..."} (5%)", delay: 0);
8437
8438 int nextFaceGlobalIndex = 0;
8439 int nextHoleId = 1;
8440
8441 if (isIncremental && _allFacesByColor != null)
8442 {
8443 nextFaceGlobalIndex = _allFacesByColor.Values
8444 .SelectMany(f => f)
8445 .DefaultIfEmpty()
8446 .Max(f => f?.FaceGlobalIndex ?? 0) + 1;
8447
8448 nextHoleId = _holesByColor.Values
8449 .SelectMany(h => h)
8450 .DefaultIfEmpty()
8451 .Max(h => h?.HoleId ?? 0) + 1;
8452 }
8453
8454 List<CADFace>? extractedFaces = null;
8455 List<CADFace>? nonHoleFaces = null;
8456 List<CADHole>? detectedHoles = null;
8457
8458 await Task.Run(() =>
8459 {
8460 var extractor = new FaceExtractor(entitiesToExtract);
8461 extractedFaces = extractor.ExtractFaces((percentage, faceCount) =>
8462 {
8463 int overallProgress = 5 + (int)(percentage * 0.63);
8464 var dispatcher = Application.Current?.Dispatcher;
8465 if (dispatcher != null && !dispatcher.HasShutdownStarted)
8466 {
8467 try
8468 {
8469 dispatcher.Invoke(() =>
8470 {
8471 Machine_Status_Progress = overallProgress;
8472 string extractingText = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Progress_ExtractingFaces") ?? "A extrair faces";
8473 Machine_Status_ProgressText = $"{extractingText}... ({overallProgress}%)";
8474 }, System.Windows.Threading.DispatcherPriority.Normal);
8475 }
8476 catch (TaskCanceledException) { /* Ignored during shutdown */ }
8477 }
8478 }, _faceExtractionCancellationTokenSource?.Token ?? default);
8479
8480 if (extractedFaces != null)
8481 {
8482 foreach (var face in extractedFaces)
8483 {
8484 if (isIncremental)
8485 {
8486 face.FaceGlobalIndex += nextFaceGlobalIndex;
8487 }
8488
8489 if (originalIndices.Count > 0)
8490 {
8491 if (face.EntityIndex >= 0 && face.EntityIndex < originalIndices.Count)
8492 face.EntityIndex = originalIndices[face.EntityIndex];
8493 else if (isIncremental)
8494 face.EntityIndex += entityCountBeforeImport;
8495 }
8496
8497 // Ensure ModelFilePath is populated
8498 if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(face.ModelFilePath))
8499 {
8500 face.ModelFilePath = CurrentlyLoadedFilePath;
8501 }
8502 }
8503 }
8504 });
8505
8506 await UpdateProgressAsync(69, $"{GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Progress_ProcessingFaceData") ?? "A processar dados das faces..."} (69%)");
8507 await UpdateProgressAsync(70, $"{GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Progress_StartingHoleDetection") ?? "A iniciar deteção de furos..."} (70%)");
8508
8509 await Task.Run(() =>
8510 {
8511 if (extractedFaces != null)
8512 {
8513 (detectedHoles, nonHoleFaces) = HoleDetector.DetectHoles(extractedFaces, (percentage, holeCount) =>
8514 {
8515 int overallProgress = 70 + (int)(percentage * 0.18);
8516 var dispatcher = Application.Current?.Dispatcher;
8517 if (dispatcher != null && !dispatcher.HasShutdownStarted)
8518 {
8519 try
8520 {
8521 dispatcher.Invoke(() =>
8522 {
8523 Machine_Status_Progress = overallProgress;
8524 string detectingText = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Progress_DetectingHoles") ?? "A detetar furos";
8525 Machine_Status_ProgressText = $"{detectingText}... ({overallProgress}%)";
8526 }, System.Windows.Threading.DispatcherPriority.Normal);
8527 }
8528 catch (TaskCanceledException) { /* Ignored during shutdown */ }
8529 }
8530 }, _faceExtractionCancellationTokenSource?.Token ?? default);
8531
8532 if (isIncremental && detectedHoles != null)
8533 {
8534 foreach (var hole in detectedHoles)
8535 {
8536 hole.HoleId = nextHoleId++;
8537 }
8538 }
8539 }
8540 });
8541
8542 await UpdateProgressAsync(90, $"{GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Progress_GroupingByColor") ?? "A agrupar por cor..."} (90%)");
8543
8544 var newFacesByColor = GroupFacesByColor(extractedFaces!);
8545 var newNonHoleFacesByColor = GroupFacesByColor(nonHoleFaces!);
8546 var newHolesByColor = GroupHolesByColor(detectedHoles!);
8547
8548 if (!isIncremental)
8549 {
8550 _allFacesByColor = newFacesByColor;
8551 _facesByColor = newNonHoleFacesByColor;
8552 _holesByColor = newHolesByColor;
8553 _faceIndexToHoleMap = new Dictionary<int, CADHole>();
8554 }
8555 else
8556 {
8557 foreach (var kvp in newFacesByColor)
8558 {
8559 if (!_allFacesByColor!.ContainsKey(kvp.Key))
8560 _allFacesByColor[kvp.Key] = new List<CADFace>();
8561 _allFacesByColor[kvp.Key].AddRange(kvp.Value);
8562 }
8563
8564 foreach (var kvp in newNonHoleFacesByColor)
8565 {
8566 if (!_facesByColor.ContainsKey(kvp.Key))
8567 _facesByColor[kvp.Key] = new List<CADFace>();
8568 _facesByColor[kvp.Key].AddRange(kvp.Value);
8569 }
8570
8571 foreach (var kvp in newHolesByColor)
8572 {
8573 if (!_holesByColor.ContainsKey(kvp.Key))
8574 _holesByColor[kvp.Key] = new List<CADHole>();
8575 _holesByColor[kvp.Key].AddRange(kvp.Value);
8576 }
8577
8578 _faceIndexToHoleMap ??= new Dictionary<int, CADHole>();
8579 }
8580
8581 await UpdateProgressAsync(93, $"{GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Progress_BuildingHoleMap") ?? "A construir mapa de furos..."} (93%)");
8582 foreach (var holeList in newHolesByColor.Values)
8583 {
8584 foreach (var hole in holeList)
8585 {
8586 foreach (var faceGlobalIndex in hole.FaceGlobalIndices)
8587 {
8588 if (!_faceIndexToHoleMap.ContainsKey(faceGlobalIndex))
8589 _faceIndexToHoleMap.Add(faceGlobalIndex, hole);
8590 }
8591 }
8592 }
8593
8594 // AUTO-IGNORE ONLY PLANAR FACES ALREADY CONFIRMED AS BRIDGES BY HoleDetector
8595 //
8596 // Do not run a second geometric bridge classifier here. HoleDetector already
8597 // performs bridge detection before the optional concave isolated single-face
8598 // fallback and preserves those bridge flags exactly. Reclassifying faces here
8599 // allowed a newly detected open U-shaped hole to make unrelated upper planar
8600 // faces look "sandwiched" between holes.
8601 string filteringFacesMsg = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Progress_FilteringSpecialFaces") ?? "A filtrar faces entre furos...";
8602 await UpdateProgressAsync(93, $"{filteringFacesMsg} (93%)");
8603
8604 var token = _faceExtractionCancellationTokenSource?.Token ?? default;
8605
8606 if (extractedFaces != null)
8607 {
8608 var confirmedBridgeFaces = extractedFaces
8609 .Where(face => face.FaceType == FaceTypeEnum.Planar && face.IsBridgeBetweenHoles)
8610 .Distinct()
8611 .ToList();
8612
8613 foreach (var face in confirmedBridgeFaces)
8614 {
8615 token.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
8616 face.IsIgnored = true;
8617 IgnoredFaces.Add(face);
8618 }
8619
8620 if (confirmedBridgeFaces.Count > 0)
8621 {
8622 _ignoredItemManager.ApplyIgnoredStyle(confirmedBridgeFaces);
8623 }
8624 }
8625
8626 // AUTO-IGNORE BASE AVOIDANCE FACES
8627 string ignoringBottomFaceMsg = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Progress_IgnoringBottomFace") ?? "A ignorar face inferior...";
8628 await UpdateProgressAsync(93, $"{ignoringBottomFaceMsg} (93%)");
8629
8630 if (_allFacesByColor != null)
8631 {
8632 var allFaces = _allFacesByColor.Values.SelectMany(f => f).ToList();
8633 var allDetectedHoles = _holesByColor?.Values.SelectMany(h => h).ToList() ?? new List<CADHole>();
8634 var facesToIgnore = BaseAvoidanceFaceClassifier.FindFacesToIgnore(
8635 allFaces,
8636 allDetectedHoles,
8637 face =>
8638 {
8639 if (_designControl == null ||
8640 face.EntityIndex < 0 ||
8641 face.EntityIndex >= _designControl.Entities.Count)
8642 {
8643 return null;
8644 }
8645
8646 var entity = _designControl.Entities[face.EntityIndex];
8647 return entity as Brep ?? EyeshotGeometryUtils.TryConvertToBrep(entity);
8648 }).ToList();
8649
8650 foreach (var face in facesToIgnore)
8651 {
8652 face.IsIgnored = true;
8653 face.AutoIgnoredByBaseAvoidance = true;
8654 face.MeasurementPoints = new List<Point4D>();
8655 IgnoredFaces.Add(face);
8656 }
8657
8658 if (facesToIgnore.Count > 0)
8659 {
8660 _ignoredItemManager?.ApplyIgnoredStyle(facesToIgnore);
8661 }
8662 }
8663
8664 // AUTO-IGNORE OBSTRUCTED HOLES (not reachable from top due to a smaller bore above on the same axis)
8665 // Mirrors the same call already present in PathManager during path planning.
8666 // Running here ensures obstructed hole faces get the stripe texture immediately
8667 // after Extract Faces, without requiring a full path-planning pass first.
8668 // Activates when HoleDetection_AutoIgnoreObstructedByLarger = True AND any bottom-face avoidance is enabled.
8669 bool autoIgnoreObstructed = false;
8670 bool.TryParse(ConfigurationManager.AppSettings["HoleDetection_AutoIgnoreObstructedByLarger"], out autoIgnoreObstructed);
8671
8672 if (autoIgnoreObstructed && _holesByColor != null && _allFacesByColor != null)
8673 {
8674 var allFacesForObstruction = _allFacesByColor.Values.SelectMany(f => f).ToList();
8675 var allHolesForObstruction = _holesByColor.Values.SelectMany(h => h).ToList();
8676 var baseAvoidance = Utilities.Algorithms.BaseAvoidanceClearance.EnableForIgnoredBottomFace(
8677 Utilities.Algorithms.BaseAvoidanceClearance.LoadConfig(),
8678 Utilities.Algorithms.BaseAvoidanceFaceClassifier.HasIgnoredBottomFace(allFacesForObstruction));
8679 bool avoidBottom =
8680 baseAvoidance.Enabled ||
8681 (bool.TryParse(ConfigurationManager.AppSettings["Scanner_AvoidBottomFace"], out bool sbAv) && sbAv);
8682
8683 // Mutates hole.IsIgnored and face.IsIgnored in-place for any obstructed hole.
8684 Modules.HoleDetector.AutoIgnoreTopUnreachableHoles(allHolesForObstruction, allFacesForObstruction, avoidBottom);
8685
8686 // Collect faces that were just newly marked ignored by the obstruction check
8687 // and have not already been styled (avoids double-styling bridge/base faces).
8688 var newlyObstructedFaces = allFacesForObstruction
8689 .Where(f => f.IsIgnored && !IgnoredFaces.Contains(f))
8690 .ToList();
8691
8692 foreach (var face in newlyObstructedFaces)
8693 {
8694 face.MeasurementPoints = new List<Point4D>();
8695 IgnoredFaces.Add(face);
8696 }
8697
8698 var newlyObstructedHoles = allHolesForObstruction
8699 .Where(h => h.IsIgnored && !IgnoredHoles.Contains(h))
8700 .ToList();
8701
8702 foreach (var hole in newlyObstructedHoles)
8703 {
8704 IgnoredHoles.Add(hole);
8705 }
8706
8707 if (newlyObstructedFaces.Count > 0)
8708 {
8709 _ignoredItemManager?.ApplyIgnoredStyle(newlyObstructedFaces);
8710 }
8711 }
8712
8713 await UpdateProgressAsync(93, $"{GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Progress_GeneratingMeasurementPoints") ?? "A gerar pontos de medição..."} (93%)");
8714 token.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
8715 await Task.Run(() =>
8716 {
8717 _pathManager.PopulateMeasurementPointsForFaces(_designControl, isIncremental ? newFacesByColor : _allFacesByColor!, token);
8718 });
8719
8720 bool autoGenerateShellScannerMode = false;
8721 bool.TryParse(ConfigurationManager.AppSettings["AutoGenerateShellMeshOnScannerMode"], out autoGenerateShellScannerMode);
8722
8723 if (_pathManager != null)
8724 {
8725 bool meshOnExtraction = bool.Parse(ConfigurationManager.AppSettings["MeshCreationOnFaceExtraction"] ?? "True");
8726 bool isScanner = _pathManager.CmmType == Models.CMMType.Scanner;
8727
8728 if (meshOnExtraction && (!isScanner || autoGenerateShellScannerMode))
8729 {
8730 token.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
8731 await UpdateProgressAsync(94, $"{GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Progress_GeneratingShell") ?? "A gerar malha exterior de navegação..."} (94%)");
8732
8733 // Clear visuals so they don't get included as parts in shell mesh generation
8734 Application.Current.Dispatcher.Invoke(() =>
8735 {
8736 _visualsManager?.ClearAllMarkers();
8737 _designControl.Entities.Regen();
8738 _designControl?.Invalidate();
8739 });
8740
8741 await _pathManager.GenerateOversizedShellFromDesignAsync(_designControl, token).ConfigureAwait(false);
8742 }
8743 else
8744 {
8745 Debug.WriteLine(" ℹ️ Shell mesh auto-generation is DISABLED via settings or Scanner Mode. Shell mesh will not be created.");
8746 }
8747 }
8748
8749 await UpdateProgressAsync(95, $"{GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Progress_InvalidatingCache") ?? "A invalidar cache..."} (95%)");
8750 _treeViewHelper.InvalidateCache();
8751
8752 await UpdateProgressAsync(95, $"{GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Progress_UpdatingTreeView") ?? "A atualizar árvore..."} (95%)");
8753 _treeViewHelper.PopulateTreeView(
8754 _facesByColor,
8755 _holesByColor!,
8756 _allFacesByColor!,
8757 showExteriorOnly: IsExteriorOnlyChecked,
8758 showVisibleOnly: IsVisibleOnlyChecked
8759 );
8760
8761 await UpdateProgressAsync(97, $"{GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Progress_InitializingControls") ?? "A inicializar controlos..."} (97%)");
8762 await Application.Current.Dispatcher.InvokeAsync(() =>
8763 {
8764 CanExport = true;
8765 planning_sp?.InitializeToleranceSliders();
8766 FacesUpToDate = true;
8767
8768 if (ReadBoolAppSetting(BaseAvoidanceShowAfterExtractionSettingKey, true))
8769 {
8770 ShowBaseAvoidancePlanesForLoadedParts();
8771 }
8772 });
8773 await UpdateProgressAsync(100, $"{GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Progress_ExtractionComplete") ?? "Extração completa!"} (100%)", 1000);
8774
8775 await Application.Current.Dispatcher.InvokeAsync(() =>
8776 {
8777 if (isIncremental)
8778 {
8779 EyeshotStatus_Text = string.Format(
8780 GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Eyeshot_NewFacesAdded") ?? "Added {0} new faces, {1} new holes",
8781 extractedFaces?.Count ?? 0,
8782 detectedHoles?.Count ?? 0
8783 );
8784 }
8785 else
8786 {
8787 EyeshotStatus_Text = string.Format(
8788 GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Eyeshot_FacesExtracted") ??
8789 "Extracted {0} faces, in {1} color groups.",
8790 extractedFaces?.Count ?? 0, _facesByColor.Count
8791 );
8792 }
8793
8794 measuring_sp?.UpdateMeasurementCounts();
8795
8796 ExtractUpdateFacesButton_Text = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "UpdateFaces");
8797
8798 if (_designControl != null)
8799 {
8800 _designControl.SelectionFilterMode = selectionFilterType.Face | selectionFilterType.Vertex;
8801 _designControl.ActionMode = actionType.SelectVisibleByPickDynamic;
8802 }
8803 });
8804
8805 await Task.Delay(1000);
8806 await Application.Current.Dispatcher.InvokeAsync(() =>
8807 {
8808 StatusProgressBarColor = new SolidColorBrush(Colors.Gray);
8809 Machine_Status_Progress = 0;
8810 Machine_Status_ProgressText = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Idle") ?? "Idle";
8811 });
8812
8813 SaveCurrentSession();
8814 }
8815 catch (OperationCanceledException)
8816 {
8817 Debug.WriteLine("Face extraction was cancelled by user.");
8818 await Application.Current.Dispatcher.InvokeAsync(() =>
8819 {
8820 EyeshotStatus_Text = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Progress_ExtractionCancelled") ?? "Face Extraction Cancelled";
8821 Machine_Status_ProgressText = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Progress_ExtractionCancelled") ?? "Face Extraction Cancelled";
8822 Machine_Status_Progress = 0;
8823 StatusProgressBarColor = new SolidColorBrush(Colors.Orange);
8824 });
8825 }
8826 catch (Exception ex)
8827 {
8828 MessageBox.Show(
8829 (GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "ErrorMessageBox_ExtractFacesError") ??
8830 "Error extracting faces:") + $" {ex.Message}",
8831 GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "MessageBox_InternalError") ?? "Internal Error",
8832 MessageBoxButton.OK,
8833 MessageBoxImage.Error
8834 );
8835 EyeshotStatus_Text = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Eyeshot_ExtractionFailed");
8836
8837 await Application.Current.Dispatcher.InvokeAsync(() =>
8838 {
8839 StatusProgressBarColor = new SolidColorBrush(Colors.Red);
8840 Machine_Status_Progress = 0;
8841 Machine_Status_ProgressText = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Progress_Error") ?? "Error";
8842 });
8843 }
8844 finally
8845 {
8846 IsExtractingFaces = false;
8847 await Application.Current.Dispatcher.InvokeAsync(() =>
8848 {
8849 Mouse.OverrideCursor = null;
8850 // Reset button text appropriately based on whether we have faces or not
8851 ExtractUpdateFacesButton_Text = (_allFacesByColor == null || _allFacesByColor.Count == 0)
8852 ? GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "ExtractFaces")
8853 : GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "UpdateFaces");
8854 });
8855 }
8856 }

8891 private void ConvertSingleFaceToHole(CADFace face)
8892 {
8893 if (face == null) return;
8894 try
8895 {
8896 var allFaces = _allFacesByColor?.Values.SelectMany(f => f).ToList() ?? new List<CADFace>();
8897 int holeId = GetNextHoleId();
8898 var newHole = HoleDetector.CreateHoleFromSingleFace(face, holeId, allFaces);
8899 if (newHole != null)
8900 {
8901 AddNewHole(newHole);
8902 _treeViewHelper?.InvalidateCache();
8903 PopulateTreeViewBasedOnFilter();
8904 EyeshotStatus_Text = $"Hole {newHole.HoleId} converted from single face.";
8905
8906 UndoManager.PushCommand(new ActionUndoCommand(
8907 () =>
8908 {
8909 PerformConvertHoleToFaces(newHole);
8910 },
8911 () =>
8912 {
8913 AddNewHole(newHole);
8914 _treeViewHelper?.InvalidateCache();
8915 PopulateTreeViewBasedOnFilter();
8916 },
8917 description: $"Convert single face ({ColorNamer.FormatColorWithRgb(face.FaceColor)}) to Hole {newHole.HoleId}",
8918 category: "Hole Management"
8919 ));
8920 }
8921 }
8922 catch (Exception ex)
8923 {
8924 Debug.WriteLine($"Error converting single face to hole: {ex.Message}");
8925 }
8926 }

8931 private void StartFaceToHoleConversion(CADFace face)

8934 {
