8936 ?? "Invalid face for conversion. Face must be cylindrical.";
8937 return;

8942 ?? "Select another cylindrical face with the same radius to complete hole conversion.";

8944
8948 private void CompleteFaceToHoleConversion(CADFace secondFace)
8949 {
8950 if (_pendingHoleConversionFace == null || secondFace == null)
8951 {
8952 CancelFaceToHoleConversion();
8953 return;
8954 }
8955
8956 // Validate compatibility using HoleDetector
8957 if (!HoleDetector.CanConvertToHole(_pendingHoleConversionFace, secondFace))
8958 {
8959 EyeshotStatus_Text = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Eyeshot_IncompatibleFaces")
8960 ?? "Selected faces are not compatible. Both faces must be cylindrical with the same radius.";
8961 return;
8962 }
8963
8964 try
8965 {
8966 // Get all faces for context (needed for hole validation)
8967 var allFaces = _allFacesByColor?.Values.SelectMany(f => f).ToList() ?? new List<CADFace>();
8968
8969 // Get next hole ID
8970 int holeId = GetNextHoleId();
8971
8972 // Create hole using HoleDetector's public method
8973 var newHole = HoleDetector.CreateHoleFromTwoFaces(
8974 _pendingHoleConversionFace,
8975 secondFace,
8976 holeId,
8977 allFaces
8978 );
8979
8980 if (newHole != null)
8981 {
8982 // Add the new hole to the appropriate collection
8983 AddNewHole(newHole);
8984
8985 // Refresh the tree view
8986 _treeViewHelper?.InvalidateCache();
8987 PopulateTreeViewBasedOnFilter();
8988
8989 EyeshotStatus_Text = string.Format(
8990 GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Eyeshot_HoleConversionComplete")
8991 ?? "Hole conversion complete. Created Hole {0}.",
8992 newHole.HoleId
8993 );
8994
8995 UndoManager.PushCommand(new ActionUndoCommand(
8996 () =>
8997 {
8998 PerformConvertHoleToFaces(newHole);
8999 },
9000 () =>
9001 {
9002 AddNewHole(newHole);
9003 _treeViewHelper?.InvalidateCache();
9004 PopulateTreeViewBasedOnFilter();
9005 },
9006 description: $"Convert faces ({ColorNamer.FormatColorWithRgb(newHole.HoleColor)}) to Hole {newHole.HoleId}",
9007 category: "Hole Management"
9008 ));
9009 }
9010 else
9011 {
9012 EyeshotStatus_Text = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Eyeshot_HoleConversionFailed")
9013 ?? "Failed to create hole from selected faces.";
9014 }
9015 }
9016 catch (Exception ex)
9017 {
9018 EyeshotStatus_Text = string.Format(
9019 GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Eyeshot_HoleConversionError")
9020 ?? "Error during hole conversion: {0}",
9021 ex.Message
9022 );
9023 }
9024 finally
9025 {
9026 _pendingHoleConversionFace = null;
9027 }
9028 }

9043 private void StartManualMarking(object item)
9044 {
9045 if (item is CADFace face)
9046 {
9047 _faceBeingMarkedManually = face;
9048 _holeBeingMarkedManually = null;
9049 }
9050 else if (item is CADHole hole)
9051 {
9052 _holeBeingMarkedManually = hole;
9053 _faceBeingMarkedManually = null;
9054 }
9055 else
9056 {
9057 return;
9058 }
9059
9060 _isManualMarkingActive = true;
9061 _manuallyMarkedPoints.Clear();
9062 ClearManualMarkingSpheres();
9063
9064 EyeshotStatus_Text = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Eyeshot_ManualMarkingStarted")
9065 ?? "Manual marking mode active. Click on the surface to add measurement points. Right-click to finish.";
9066 }
9067
9071 private void CompleteManualMarking()
9072 {
9073 if (!_isManualMarkingActive)
9074 return;
9075
9076 try
9077 {
9078 if (_faceBeingMarkedManually != null && _manuallyMarkedPoints.Any())
9079 {
9080 var face = _faceBeingMarkedManually;
9081 var oldPoints = face.MeasurementPoints?.Select(p => new Point4D(p.X, p.Y, p.Z, p.W)).ToList() ?? new List<Point4D>();
9082 var oldHasManual = face.HasManualMeasurementPoints;
9083
9084 var newPoints = _manuallyMarkedPoints.Select(p => new Point4D(p.X, p.Y, p.Z, 1.0)).ToList();
9085
9086 Action<List<Point4D>, bool> setPointsAction = (pts, hasManual) =>
9087 {
9088 face.MeasurementPoints = pts.Select(p => new Point4D(p.X, p.Y, p.Z, p.W)).ToList();
9089 face.HasManualMeasurementPoints = hasManual;
9090 if (ShowAllMeasurementPoints)
9091 {
9092 ToggleAllMeasurementPointsVisibility(false);
9093 ToggleAllMeasurementPointsVisibility(true);
9094 }
9095 };
9096
9097 setPointsAction(newPoints, true);
9098
9099 UndoManager.PushCommand(new ActionUndoCommand(
9100 () => setPointsAction(oldPoints, oldHasManual),
9101 () => setPointsAction(newPoints, true),
9102 description: $"Manual marking on face ({ColorNamer.FormatColorWithRgb(face.FaceColor)})",
9103 category: "Measurement Points"
9104 ));
9105
9106 string message = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Eyeshot_ManualMarkingComplete")
9107 ?? "Manual marking complete. {0} measurement points marked.";
9108 EyeshotStatus_Text = string.Format(message, _manuallyMarkedPoints.Count);
9109 }
9110 else if (_holeBeingMarkedManually != null && _manuallyMarkedPoints.Any())
9111 {
9112 var hole = _holeBeingMarkedManually;
9113 var allFaces = _allFacesByColor?.Values.SelectMany(f => f).ToList() ?? new List<CADFace>();
9114 var holeFaces = allFaces.Where(f => hole.FaceGlobalIndices.Contains(f.FaceGlobalIndex)).ToList();
9115
9116 var oldStates = holeFaces.ToDictionary(f => f, f => new
9117 {
9118 Points = f.MeasurementPoints?.Select(p => new Point4D(p.X, p.Y, p.Z, p.W)).ToList() ?? new List<Point4D>(),
9119 HasManual = f.HasManualMeasurementPoints
9120 });
9121
9122 var newPoints = _manuallyMarkedPoints.Select(p => new Point4D(p.X, p.Y, p.Z, 1.0)).ToList();
9123
9124 Action<bool> setPointsAction = (isRedo) =>
9125 {
9126 foreach (var face in holeFaces)
9127 {
9128 if (isRedo)
9129 {
9130 face.MeasurementPoints = newPoints.Select(p => new Point4D(p.X, p.Y, p.Z, p.W)).ToList();
9131 face.HasManualMeasurementPoints = true;
9132 }
9133 else
9134 {
9135 face.MeasurementPoints = oldStates[face].Points.Select(p => new Point4D(p.X, p.Y, p.Z, p.W)).ToList();
9136 face.HasManualMeasurementPoints = oldStates[face].HasManual;
9137 }
9138 }
9139 if (ShowAllMeasurementPoints)
9140 {
9141 ToggleAllMeasurementPointsVisibility(false);
9142 ToggleAllMeasurementPointsVisibility(true);
9143 }
9144 };
9145
9146 setPointsAction(true);
9147
9148 UndoManager.PushCommand(new ActionUndoCommand(
9149 () => setPointsAction(false),
9150 () => setPointsAction(true),
9151 description: $"Manual marking on Hole {hole.HoleId} ({ColorNamer.FormatColorWithRgb(hole.HoleColor)})",
9152 category: "Measurement Points"
9153 ));
9154
9155 string message = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Eyeshot_ManualMarkingComplete")
9156 ?? "Manual marking complete. {0} measurement points marked.";
9157 EyeshotStatus_Text = string.Format(message, _manuallyMarkedPoints.Count);
9158 }
9159 else
9160 {
9161 EyeshotStatus_Text = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Eyeshot_ManualMarkingCancelled")
9162 ?? "Manual marking cancelled - no points marked.";
9163 }
9164
9165 // Refresh measurement point visualization if currently shown
9166 if (ShowAllMeasurementPoints)
9167 {
9168 ToggleAllMeasurementPointsVisibility(false);
9169 ToggleAllMeasurementPointsVisibility(true);
9170 }
9171 }
9172 finally
9173 {
9174 _isManualMarkingActive = false;
9175 _faceBeingMarkedManually = null;
9176 _holeBeingMarkedManually = null;
9177 _manuallyMarkedPoints.Clear();
9178 ClearManualMarkingSpheres();
9179 _designControl.Invalidate();
9180 SaveCurrentSession();
9181 }
9182 }

9215 private bool IsSpecificContextMenuTargetUnderCursor()
9216 {
9217 if (_designControl == null)
9218 return false;
9219
9220 try
9221 {
9222 var mousePosition = Mouse.GetPosition(_designControl);
9223 if (double.IsNaN(mousePosition.X) ||
9224 double.IsNaN(mousePosition.Y) ||
9225 mousePosition.X < 0 ||
9226 mousePosition.Y < 0 ||
9227 mousePosition.X > _designControl.ActualWidth ||
9228 mousePosition.Y > _designControl.ActualHeight)
9229 {
9230 return false;
9231 }
9232
9233 var screenPoint = new System.Drawing.Point((int)mousePosition.X, (int)mousePosition.Y);
9234 var itemUnderCursor = _designControl.GetItemUnderMouseCursor(screenPoint);
9235 if (itemUnderCursor != null)
9236 return true;
9237
9238 int entityIndex = _designControl.GetEntityUnderMouseCursor(screenPoint);
9239 if (entityIndex < 0 || entityIndex >= _designControl.Entities.Count)
9240 return false;
9241
9242 return IsSpecificContextEntity(_designControl.Entities[entityIndex]);
9243 }
9244 catch (Exception ex)
9245 {
9246 Debug.WriteLine($"Context menu hit-test failed: {ex.Message}");
9247 return false;
9248 }
9249 }
9250
9256 private bool IsSpecificContextEntity(Entity? entity)
9257 {
9258 if (entity == null)
9259 return false;
9260
9261 if (entity.EntityData is WaypointData ||
9262 entity.EntityData is PathSegmentData ||
9263 entity is LinearPath linearPath &&
9264 linearPath.LayerName != null &&
9265 linearPath.LayerName.StartsWith(PathManager.PATH_LAYER_PREFIX, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
9266 {
9267 return true;
9268 }
9269
9270 if (_visualsManager?.ControlPointSpheres?.Contains(entity) == true ||
9271 _manualMarkingSpheres.Contains(entity))
9272 {
9273 return true;
9274 }
9275
9276 if (entity.EntityData is string entityData &&
9277 entityData.StartsWith("PART_ORIGIN", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
9278 {
9279 return true;
9280 }
9281
9282 if (entity is Brep || entity is Mesh)
9283 {
9284 return !IsDesignerUtilityLayer(entity.LayerName);
9285 }
9286
9287 return false;
9288 }
9289
9295 private static bool IsDesignerUtilityLayer(string? layerName)
9296 {
9297 return !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(layerName) &&
9298 (layerName.StartsWith("SHELL_", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
9299 layerName.Contains("IGNORED", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
9300 layerName.StartsWith("PATH_", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
9301 layerName.Contains("SIMULATION", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
9302 string.Equals(layerName, "MARKERS", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
9303 string.Equals(layerName, "COLLISION_MARKERS", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
9304 string.Equals(layerName, "RAYCAST_HITS", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
9305 string.Equals(layerName, "PROBE_TRACKING", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
9306 string.Equals(layerName, "SCANNER_FOV_VISUALIZATION", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));
9307 }

9338 private int GetNextHoleId()
9339 {
9340 int maxId = 0;
9341
9342 if (_holesByColor != null)
9343 {
9344 foreach (var holeList in _holesByColor.Values)
9345 {
9346 foreach (var hole in holeList)
9347 {
9348 if (hole.HoleId > maxId) maxId = hole.HoleId;
9349 }
9350 }
9351 }
9352
9353 return maxId + 1;
9354 }

9359 private void AddNewHole(CADHole hole)
9360 {
9361 // Determine the color key from the constituent faces
9362 string colorKey = "Default";
9363
9364 if (hole.FaceGlobalIndices != null && hole.FaceGlobalIndices.Any() && _allFacesByColor != null)
9365 {
9366 foreach (var kvp in _allFacesByColor)
9367 {
9368 if (kvp.Value.Any(f => hole.FaceGlobalIndices.Contains(f.FaceGlobalIndex)))
9369 {
9370 colorKey = kvp.Key;
9371 break;
9372 }
9373 }
9374 }
9375
9376 // Add to holes collection
9377 if (_holesByColor != null)
9378 {
9379 if (!_holesByColor.ContainsKey(colorKey))
9380 {
9381 _holesByColor[colorKey] = new List<CADHole>();
9382 }
9383
9384 _holesByColor[colorKey].Add(hole);
9385 }
9386
9387 // Update face-to-hole mapping if it exists
9388 if (_faceIndexToHoleMap != null && hole.FaceGlobalIndices != null)
9389 {
9390 foreach (var faceIdx in hole.FaceGlobalIndices)
9391 {
9392 _faceIndexToHoleMap[faceIdx] = hole;
9393 }
9394 }
9395
9396 // Automatically remove constituent faces from _facesByColor
9397 if (hole.FaceGlobalIndices != null && _facesByColor != null)
9398 {
9399 var keysToClean = new List<string>();
9400 foreach (var kvp in _facesByColor)
9401 {
9402 kvp.Value.RemoveAll(f => hole.FaceGlobalIndices.Contains(f.FaceGlobalIndex));
9403 if (kvp.Value.Count == 0)
9404 {
9405 keysToClean.Add(kvp.Key);
9406 }
9407 }
9408 foreach (var key in keysToClean)
9409 {
9410 _facesByColor.Remove(key);
9411 }
9412 }
9413 }

9568 public async Task<bool> GenerateAndVisualizePaths()
9569 {
9570 // Create new cancellation token for this generation
9571 _pathGenerationCancellationTokenSource?.Dispose();
9572 _pathGenerationCancellationTokenSource = new System.Threading.CancellationTokenSource();
9573
9574 // Update button text to "Cancel"
9575 var measuring_sp = Application.Current.Windows.OfType<Window>().FirstOrDefault()?
9576 .FindName("Measuring_SidePanelContainer") as Measuring_SidePanel ?? this.measuring_sp;
9577 if (measuring_sp != null)
9578 {
9579 measuring_sp.IsPathGenerationRunning = true;
9580 }
9581
9582 Mouse.OverrideCursor = Cursors.Wait;
9583
9584 // Set progress bar to a subtle light gray color for path generation
9585 StatusProgressBarColor = new SolidColorBrush(System.Windows.Media.Color.FromRgb(220, 220, 230));
9586 Machine_Status_Progress = 10;
9587 Machine_Status_ProgressText = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Progress_StartingPathGeneration") ?? "Starting path generation...";
9588 EyeshotStatus_Text = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "PathManager_GeneratingPaths") ?? "Generating measurement paths...";
9589
9590 int? previousMinimumFramerate = null;
9591 void EnablePathGenerationRenderGuard()
9592 {
9593 if (_designControl == null)
9594 return;
9595
9596 previousMinimumFramerate ??= _designControl.MinimumFramerate;
9597 if (_designControl.MinimumFramerate != 0)
9598 _designControl.MinimumFramerate = 0;
9599
9600 _designControl.Entities.Regen();
9601 _designControl.Invalidate();
9602 }
9603
9604 void RestorePathGenerationRenderGuard()
9605 {
9606 if (_designControl == null || previousMinimumFramerate == null)
9607 return;
9608
9609 _designControl.MinimumFramerate = previousMinimumFramerate.Value;
9610 _designControl.Entities.Regen();
9611 _designControl.Invalidate();
9612 }
9613
9614 try
9615 {
9616 if (_pathManager == null) return false;
9617
9618 EnablePathGenerationRenderGuard();
9619
9620 CMMType selectedCmmType = GetSelectedCmmType();
9621 _pathManager.SetCmmType(selectedCmmType);
9622
9623 // 1. Clear previous paths
9624 Machine_Status_Progress = 15;
9625 Machine_Status_ProgressText = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Progress_ClearingPaths") ?? "Clearing previous paths...";
9626
9627 _pathManager.ClearAllPaths();
9628 UpdateProbeCollisionCheckMenuVisibility();
9629
9630 Machine_Status_Progress = 20;
9631 Machine_Status_ProgressText = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Progress_CollectingFaces") ?? "Collecting faces...";
9632
9633 // 2. Collect all faces
9634 var allFaces = _allFacesByColor.Values.SelectMany(f => f).ToList();
9635 if (!allFaces.Any())
9636 {
9637 MessageBox.Show(
9638 GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "PathManager_NoFacesAvailable") ?? "No faces have been extracted. Please extract faces first.",
9639 GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "PathManager_PathPlanningErrorTitle") ?? "Path Planning Error",
9640 MessageBoxButton.OK,
9641 MessageBoxImage.Warning);
9642
9643 EyeshotStatus_Text = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "PathManager_PathPlanningFailed") ?? "Path planning failed";
9644 Machine_Status_Progress = 0;
9645 Machine_Status_ProgressText = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Idle") ?? "Idle";
9646 return false;
9647 }
9648
9649 // 3. Create color-tool dictionary using MeasuringToolByColor.xml configuration
9650 var colorToolDictionary = new Dictionary<Color, string>();
9651 var allColors = allFaces.Select(f => f.FaceColor).Distinct();
9652 foreach (var color in allColors)
9653 {
9654 if (!colorToolDictionary.ContainsKey(color))
9655 {
9656 // Get tool from configuration (will auto-add to config if not found)
9657 string toolName = _measuringToolConfig.GetToolForColor(color);
9658 colorToolDictionary.Add(color, toolName);
9659 }
9660 }
9661
9662 // 4. Path planning parameters
9663 bool filterPointsToBeInsideFace = true;
9664 double retractDistance = 10.0;
9665
9666 Application.Current.Dispatcher.Invoke(() =>

9699 Machine_Status_Progress = progressPercent;

9702 : e.ProgressMessage;

9705 if (!e.CurrentColor.IsEmpty)

9708 StatusProgressBarColor = new SolidColorBrush(System.Windows.Media.Color.FromRgb(
9709 normalizedColor.R,
9710 normalizedColor.G,
9711 normalizedColor.B));
9712 }
9713 });

9827 EventHandler<ScanPathProgressEventArgs> scanProgressHandler = (s, e) =>
9828 {
9829 Application.Current.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke(() =>
9830 {
9831 int mappedPercent = 45 + (int)Math.Round(e.Percent * 0.25);

9841 {

9847 });

9864 // Convert scanner paths to the dictionary format expected by the rest of the method.
9865 // Keep scanner orientations separately so simulation can rotate the scanner/FOV correctly.
9866 plannedPaths = new Dictionary<Color, List<Point3D>>();
9867 var scannerNormalsByColor = new Dictionary<Color, List<Vector3D>>();
9868 var scannerUpVectorsByColor = new Dictionary<Color, List<Vector3D>>();
9869 var scannerPointTypesByColor = new Dictionary<Color, List<string>>();
9870 var scannerEntityIndicesByColor = new Dictionary<Color, List<int>>();
9871 if (scanPaths.Any())
9872 {
9873 // All positions live on one spherical path; group by the parent face color
9874 // so the existing LoadPaths / DrawAllPaths infrastructure is unchanged.
9875 var pathsByColor = scanPaths
9876 .Where(sp => sp.Face != null)
9877 .GroupBy(sp => sp.Face.FaceColor);
9878
9879 foreach (var group in pathsByColor)
9880 {
9881 var points = group
9882 .SelectMany(p => p.Points.Select(sp => sp.Position))
9883 .ToList();
9884 var normals = group
9885 .SelectMany(p => p.Points.Select(sp => ScannerOrientationToToolNormal(sp.Orientation)))
9886 .ToList();
9887 var upVectors = group
9888 .SelectMany(p => p.Points.Select(sp => sp.UpVector))
9889 .ToList();
9890 var pointTypes = group
9891 .SelectMany(p => p.Points.Select(sp => sp.PointType))
9892 .ToList();
9893 var entityIndices = group
9894 .SelectMany(p => p.Points.Select(sp => sp.ParentFace?.EntityIndex ?? group.First().Face?.EntityIndex ?? -1))
9895 .ToList();
9896 plannedPaths[group.Key] = points;
9897 scannerNormalsByColor[group.Key] = normals;
9898 scannerUpVectorsByColor[group.Key] = upVectors;
9899 scannerPointTypesByColor[group.Key] = pointTypes;
9900 scannerEntityIndicesByColor[group.Key] = entityIndices;
9901 }
9902
9903 // If all ScanPoints ended up with a null ParentFace (greedy-selected
9904 // positions get null from FindNearestFace), fall back to a single entry
9905 // keyed on the first face color so at least one path is drawn.
9906 if (!plannedPaths.Any() && allFaces.Any())
9907 {
9908 var allPoints = scanPaths
9909 .SelectMany(sp => sp.Points.Select(p => p.Position))
9910 .ToList();
9911 var allNormals = scanPaths
9912 .SelectMany(sp => sp.Points.Select(p => ScannerOrientationToToolNormal(p.Orientation)))
9913 .ToList();
9914 var allUpVectors = scanPaths
9915 .SelectMany(sp => sp.Points.Select(p => p.UpVector))
9916 .ToList();
9917 var allPointTypes = scanPaths
9918 .SelectMany(sp => sp.Points.Select(p => p.PointType))
9919 .ToList();
9920 var fallbackColor = allFaces.First().FaceColor;
9921 plannedPaths[fallbackColor] = allPoints;
9922 scannerNormalsByColor[fallbackColor] = allNormals;
9923 scannerUpVectorsByColor[fallbackColor] = allUpVectors;
9924 scannerPointTypesByColor[fallbackColor] = allPointTypes;
9925 scannerEntityIndicesByColor[fallbackColor] = scanPaths
9926 .SelectMany(sp => sp.Points.Select(p => p.ParentFace?.EntityIndex ?? sp.Face?.EntityIndex ?? -1))
9927 .ToList();
9928 }
9929 }

9931 _pendingScannerNormalsByColor = scannerNormalsByColor;
9932 _pendingScannerUpVectorsByColor = scannerUpVectorsByColor;
9933 _pendingScannerPointTypesByColor = scannerPointTypesByColor;

9985 int validationCollisions = -1;
9986 bool segmentValidationCancelled = false;
9987 bool segmentValidationSkipped = false;
9988 if (selectedCmmType == CMMType.Probe)
9989 {
9990 bool canRunSegmentValidation = _pathManager.CanRunGeneratedPathSegmentCollisionValidation;
9991 if (!canRunSegmentValidation)
9992 {
9993 segmentValidationSkipped = true;
9994 Machine_Status_Progress = 99;
9995 Machine_Status_ProgressText = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Progress_SegmentCollisionValidationSkipped")
9996 ?? "Segment collision validation skipped";
9997 }
9998 else
9999 {
10000 DateTime lastSegmentProgressUpdateUtc = DateTime.MinValue;
10001 Action<int, int, int> segmentValidationProgress = (processed, total, collisions) =>
10002 {
10003 if (total <= 0)
10004 return;
10005
10006 if (processed < total &&
10007 (DateTime.UtcNow - lastSegmentProgressUpdateUtc).TotalMilliseconds < 30)
10008 {
10009 return;
10010 }
10011
10012 lastSegmentProgressUpdateUtc = DateTime.UtcNow;
10013 int remaining = Math.Max(0, total - processed);
10014 int mappedPercent = 96 + (int)Math.Round((processed / (double)Math.Max(1, total)) * 3.0);
10015 mappedPercent = Math.Max(96, Math.Min(99, mappedPercent));
10016 string progressFormat = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Progress_SegmentCollisionValidation")
10017 ?? "Validating segment collisions: {0}/{1} checked, {2} left, {3} collisions";
10018 string progressMessage = string.Format(
10019 CultureInfo.CurrentCulture,
10020 progressFormat,
10021 processed,
10022 total,
10023 remaining,
10024 collisions);
10025
10026 Application.Current.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke(() =>
10027 {
10028 Machine_Status_Progress = mappedPercent;
10029 Machine_Status_ProgressText = $"{progressMessage} ({mappedPercent}%)";
10030 });
10031 };
10032
10033 if (measuring_sp != null)
10034 {
10035 measuring_sp.IsPathGenerationRunning = false;
10036 measuring_sp.IsSegmentCollisionCheckRunning = true;
10037 }
10038
10039 var validationResult = await _pathManager.RunGeneratedPathSegmentCollisionValidationAsync(
10040 segmentValidationProgress,
10041 _pathGenerationCancellationTokenSource.Token);
10042
10043 if (measuring_sp != null)
10044 {
10045 measuring_sp.IsSegmentCollisionCheckRunning = false;
10046 measuring_sp.IsPathGenerationRunning = true;
10047 }
10048
10049 if (!validationResult.Completed)
10050 {
10051 segmentValidationCancelled = true;
10052 Machine_Status_ProgressText = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "PathPlanning_SegmentCollisionValidationCancelled")
10053 ?? "Segment collision validation cancelled. Generated paths were kept.";
10054 }
10055 else
10056 {
10057 validationCollisions = validationResult.Collisions;
10058 if (validationCollisions > 0)
10059 {
10060 Application.Current.Dispatcher.Invoke(() => _pathManager?.RegeneratePathVisuals());
10061 }
10062 }
10063 }
10064 }
10065
10066 Machine_Status_Progress = 100;
10067 Machine_Status_ProgressText = segmentValidationCancelled
10068 ? (GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "PathPlanning_SegmentCollisionValidationCancelled") ?? "Segment collision validation cancelled. Generated paths were kept.")
10069 : (GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Progress_PathGenerationComplete") ?? "Path generation complete!");
10070 if (selectedCmmType == CMMType.Scanner)
10071 {
10072 AppendScanPathGenerationLog(measuring_sp, "ScanPathGenerationComplete", 100, isComplete: true);
10073 }
10074
10075 // 8. Success message with formatting
10076 string successMessage = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "PathManager_PathPlanningComplete") ??
10077 "Path planning complete. Generated {0} paths. Total points: {1}";
10078
10079 if (segmentValidationCancelled)
10080 {
10081 successMessage += $"\n{GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "PathPlanning_SegmentCollisionValidationCancelled") ?? "Segment collision validation cancelled. Generated paths were kept."}";
10082 }
10083 else if (segmentValidationSkipped)
10084 {
10085 successMessage += $"\n{GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Progress_SegmentCollisionValidationSkipped") ?? "Segment collision validation skipped"}";
10086 }
10087 else if (validationCollisions == 0)
10088 {
10089 successMessage += $"\n{GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "PathGeneration_CollisionSummary_None") ?? "All segments were validated to not have collisions."}";
10090 }
10091 else if (validationCollisions > 0)
10092 {
10093 successMessage += $"\n{GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "PathGeneration_CollisionSummary_Count")?.Replace("{0}", validationCollisions.ToString()) ?? $"Warning: {validationCollisions} segments collided."}";
10094 }
10095
10096 string formattedSuccessMessage = string.Format(
10097 CultureInfo.CurrentCulture,
10098 successMessage,
10099 plannedPaths.Count,
10100 plannedPaths.Sum(p => p.Value.Count));
10101
10102 EyeshotStatus_Text = formattedSuccessMessage;
10103
10104 // 9. Display path information
10105 ShowPathInfo(formattedSuccessMessage);
10106
10107 // 10. Refresh the tool-color list in Measuring_SidePanel
10108 measuring_sp?.RefreshColorToolList();
10109
10110 // Reset progress bar after completion
10111 StatusProgressBarColor = new SolidColorBrush(Colors.Gray);
10112 Machine_Status_Progress = 0;
10113 Machine_Status_ProgressText = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Idle") ?? "Idle";
10114
10115 SaveCurrentSession();
10116 }
10117 catch (OperationCanceledException)
10118 {
10119 // SUCCESS: Path generation was cancelled by user
10120 Debug.WriteLine(GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "PathManager_Log_CancelledByUser") ??" \n🚫 Path generation cancelled by user.");
10121 Application.Current.Dispatcher.Invoke(() =>
10122 {
10123 Machine_Status_ProgressText = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "PathGeneration_Cancelled") ?? "Path generation cancelled";
10124 Machine_Status_Progress = 0;
10125 StatusProgressBarColor = new SolidColorBrush(Colors.Orange);
10126 EyeshotStatus_Text = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "PathGeneration_Cancelled") ?? "Cancelled";
10127 });
10128
10129 SaveCurrentSession();
10130
10131 return false;
10132 }
10133 catch (Exception ex)
10134 {
10135 string errorMessage = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "PathManager_PathPlanningFailed") ?? "Path planning failed";
10136
10137 Application.Current.Dispatcher.Invoke(() =>
10138 {
10139 MessageBox.Show(
10140 $"{errorMessage}: {ex.Message}",
10141 GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "MessageBox_InternalError") ?? "HirEV SmartFitSystems - Internal Error",
10142 MessageBoxButton.OK,
10143 MessageBoxImage.Error);

10151 });
10152
10153 return false;

10155 finally

10157 // SUCCESS: Always reset state, even if cancelled or error
10158 Application.Current.Dispatcher.Invoke(() =>

10175 _pathGenerationCancellationTokenSource = null;

10177 return true;
10178 }

10184 private bool _isModelLoading = false;

10186 private bool _isStoppingSimulation = false;

10192 public async void StartPathSimulation()
10193 {
10194 if (_isStartingSimulation || _isModelLoading || (_pathManager?.IsSimulating ?? false)) return;
10195 if (_pathManager != null && _pathManager.IsProbeCollisionValidationRunning)
10196 {
10197 MessageBox.Show(
10198 GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Simulation_Error_ProbeCollisionRunning") ?? "Cannot start simulation while a probe collision check is running. Please wait for it to finish or cancel it.",
10199 GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "PathManager_SimulationErrorTitle") ?? "Simulation Error",
10200 MessageBoxButton.OK,
10201 MessageBoxImage.Warning);
10202 return;
10203 }
10204
10205 _isStartingSimulation = true;
10206 try
10207 {
10208 if (_pathManager == null || !_pathManager.ColorPaths.Any())
10209 {
10210 MessageBox.Show(
10211 GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "PathManager_NoPathsGenerated") ?? "Please generate paths first.",
10212 GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "PathManager_SimulationErrorTitle") ?? "Simulation Error",
10213 MessageBoxButton.OK,
10214 MessageBoxImage.Warning);
10215 return;
10216 }
10217
10218 CMMType selectedCmmType = GetSelectedCmmType();
10219 _pathManager.SetCmmType(selectedCmmType);
10220
10221 if (_pathManager.HasTrajectoryTypeMismatch(out _, out _))
10222 {
10223 MessageBox.Show(
10224 GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "TrajectoryMismatchSimulationMessage")?.Replace("\\n", "\n") ?? PathManager.TrajectoryMismatchSimulationMessage,
10225 GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "TrajectoryMismatchSimulationTitle") ?? "CMM Type Mismatch",
10226 MessageBoxButton.OK,
10227 MessageBoxImage.Warning);
10228 return;
10229 }
10230
10231 string startingSimText = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "StartingSimulation") ?? "Starting Simulation...";
10232
10233 if (measuring_sp != null)
10234 {
10235 measuring_sp.SimulatePathButton_Text = startingSimText;
10236 }
10237
10238 // Say "Simulation Starting..." on progress bar and text immediately
10239 StatusProgressBarColor = new SolidColorBrush(System.Windows.Media.Color.FromRgb(128, 128, 128));
10240 Machine_Status_Progress = 0;
10241 Machine_Status_ProgressText = startingSimText;
10242
10243 if (_cameraUtils != null && cameraFollowEnabled && selectedCmmType == CMMType.Probe)
10244 {
10245 _cameraUtils.StartCameraFollowing();
10246 _cameraFollowPrimedForSimulation = true;
10247 }
10248
10249 // Ensure tools are up to date before simulation
10250 _measuringToolConfig.ReloadConfiguration();
10251 if (_pathManager.ColorPaths != null)
10252 {
10253 foreach (var colorPath in _pathManager.ColorPaths.Values)
10254 {
10255 if (colorPath.PathCmmType == Models.CMMType.Probe || colorPath.PathCmmType == Models.CMMType.Scanner)
10256 {
10257 string currentToolName = _measuringToolConfig.GetToolForColor(colorPath.Color);
10258 if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(currentToolName) && colorPath.ToolName != currentToolName)
10259 {
10260 colorPath.ToolName = currentToolName;
10261 }
10262 }
10263 }
10264 }
10265
10266 _pathManager.SimulationSpeed = SimulationSpeed;
10267 HideBaseAvoidancePlaneForCollisionOrSimulation();
10268 await PreloadToolModelsAsync(selectedCmmType == CMMType.Scanner);
10269
10270 System.Windows.Application.Current?.Dispatcher?.Invoke(() =>
10271 {
10272 Machine_Status_ProgressText = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Simulation_LoadingTool") ?? "Loading tool model";
10273 });
10274 await Task.Delay(100); // Allow UI to render
10275
10276 if (_pathManager.FilterConfig.SimulationHideApproachPoints || _pathManager.FilterConfig.SimulationHideMeasurePoints || _pathManager.FilterConfig.SimulationHidePathLines)
10277 {
10278 System.Windows.Application.Current?.Dispatcher?.Invoke(() =>
10279 {
10280 Mouse.OverrideCursor = Cursors.Arrow;
10281 Machine_Status_ProgressText = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Simulation_Optimizing") ?? "Starting Simulation - Optimizing and preparing...";
10282 });
10283 await Task.Delay(100); // Allow UI to render
10284 }
10285
10286 _pathManager.StartSimulation();
10287
10288 System.Windows.Application.Current?.Dispatcher?.Invoke(() => { Mouse.OverrideCursor = null; });
10289
10290 SimulationSpeedPanelVisibility = Visibility.Visible;
10291 IsSimulationSeekEnabled = true;
10292 IsSimulationActive = true;
10293 UpdateCameraControlsVisibility();
10294 PauseSimulationVisibility = Visibility.Visible;
10295 EyeshotStatus_Text = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "PathManager_SimulationStarted") ?? "Simulation started...";
10296 }
10297 catch (Exception ex)
10298 {
10299 string errorMessage = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "PathManager_ErrorStartingSimulation") ?? "Error starting simulation";
10300 MessageBox.Show(
10301 $"{errorMessage}: {ex.Message}",
10302 GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "MessageBox_InternalError") ?? "Error",
10303 MessageBoxButton.OK,
10304 MessageBoxImage.Error);

10318
10325 private System.Drawing.Color NormalizeColorLightness(System.Drawing.Color color, double targetLightness)
10326 {
10327 // Convert RGB to HSL
10328 double r = color.R / 255.0;
10329 double g = color.G / 255.0;
10330 double b = color.B / 255.0;
10331
10332 double max = Math.Max(r, Math.Max(g, b));
10333 double min = Math.Min(r, Math.Min(g, b));
10334 double delta = max - min;
10335
10336 // Calculate Hue
10337 double hue = 0.0;
10338 if (delta != 0)
10339 {
10340 if (max == r)
10341 hue = 60 * (((g - b) / delta) % 6);
10342 else if (max == g)
10343 hue = 60 * (((b - r) / delta) + 2);
10344 else
10345 hue = 60 * (((r - g) / delta) + 4);
10346 }
10347 if (hue < 0) hue += 360;
10348
10349 // Calculate Lightness
10350 double lightness = (max + min) / 2.0;
10351
10352 // Calculate Saturation
10353 double saturation = 0.0;
10354 if (delta != 0)
10355 saturation = delta / (1 - Math.Abs(2 * lightness - 1));
10356
10357 // Set new lightness
10358 lightness = targetLightness;
10359
10360 // Convert HSL back to RGB
10361 double c = (1 - Math.Abs(2 * lightness - 1)) * saturation;
10362 double x = c * (1 - Math.Abs((hue / 60.0) % 2 - 1));
10363 double m = lightness - c / 2.0;
10364
10365 double rPrime = 0, gPrime = 0, bPrime = 0;
10366 if (hue < 60) { rPrime = c; gPrime = x; bPrime = 0; }
10367 else if (hue < 120) { rPrime = x; gPrime = c; bPrime = 0; }
10368 else if (hue < 180) { rPrime = 0; gPrime = c; bPrime = x; }
10369 else if (hue < 240) { rPrime = 0; gPrime = x; bPrime = c; }
10370 else if (hue < 300) { rPrime = x; gPrime = 0; bPrime = c; }
10371 else { rPrime = c; gPrime = 0; bPrime = x; }
10372
10373 byte newR = (byte)((rPrime + m) * 255);
10374 byte newG = (byte)((gPrime + m) * 255);
10375 byte newB = (byte)((bPrime + m) * 255);
10376
10377 return System.Drawing.Color.FromArgb(newR, newG, newB);
10378 }

10383 public async void StopPathSimulation()
10384 {
10385 if (_isStoppingSimulation) return;
10386
10387 try
10388 {
10389 if (_pathManager == null)
10390 {
10391 return;
10392 }
10393
10394 _isStoppingSimulation = true;
10395 string stoppingSimText = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "StoppingSimulation") ?? "Stopping Simulation...";
10396
10397 if (measuring_sp != null)
10398 {
10399 measuring_sp.SimulatePathButton_Text = stoppingSimText;
10400 }
10401
10402 StatusProgressBarColor = new SolidColorBrush(System.Windows.Media.Color.FromRgb(128, 128, 128));
10403 Machine_Status_ProgressText = stoppingSimText;
10404 EyeshotStatus_Text = stoppingSimText;
10405
10406 if (_pathManager.FilterConfig.SimulationHideApproachPoints || _pathManager.FilterConfig.SimulationHideMeasurePoints || _pathManager.FilterConfig.SimulationHidePathLines)
10407 {
10408 System.Windows.Application.Current?.Dispatcher?.Invoke(() =>
10409 {
10410 Mouse.OverrideCursor = Cursors.Arrow;
10411 Machine_Status_ProgressText = stoppingSimText;
10412 });
10413 await Task.Delay(100);
10414 }
10415
10416 _pathManager.StopSimulation();
10417 System.Windows.Application.Current?.Dispatcher?.Invoke(() => { Mouse.OverrideCursor = null; });
10418 SimulationSpeedPanelVisibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
10419 CameraControlsButtonVisibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
10420 CameraControlsPanelVisibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
10421 IsSimulationSeekEnabled = false;
10422 IsSimulationActive = false;
10423 PauseSimulationVisibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
10424 EyeshotStatus_Text = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "PathManager_SimulationStopped") ?? "Simulation stopped.";
10425
10426 // Reset progress bar when manually stopped
10427 StatusProgressBarColor = new SolidColorBrush(Colors.Gray);
10428 Machine_Status_Progress = 0;
10429
10430 string idleText = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Idle") ?? "Idle";
10431 Machine_Status_ProgressText = idleText;
10432
10433 if (measuring_sp != null)
10434 {
10435 measuring_sp.SimulatePathButton_Text = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "StartPathSimulation") ?? "Start Path Simulation";
10436 }
10437 }
10438 catch (Exception ex)
10439 {
10440 Debug.WriteLine($"Error stopping simulation: {ex.Message}");
10441 EyeshotStatus_Text = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "PathManager_ErrorStoppingSimulation") ?? "Error stopping simulation";
10442
10443 // Set error state
10444 StatusProgressBarColor = new SolidColorBrush(Colors.Red);
10445 string errorText = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Simulation_Error") ?? "Simulation Error";
10446 Machine_Status_ProgressText = errorText;
10447 }
10448 finally
10449 {
10450 _isStoppingSimulation = false;
10451 }
10452 }

10547 public void SetCustomExecutionOrder(List<string> colorNames)
10548 {
10549 List<Color> colors = new List<Color>();
10550
10551 foreach (string colorName in colorNames)
10552 {
10553 try
10554 {
10555 // Parse the RGB values from the format "Name (R95_G0_B0)" using regex
10556 var colorMatch = Regex.Match(colorName, @"R(\d{1,3})_G(\d{1,3})_B(\d{1,3})");
10557 if (colorMatch.Success)
10558 {
10559 byte r = byte.Parse(colorMatch.Groups[1].Value);
10560 byte g = byte.Parse(colorMatch.Groups[2].Value);
10561 byte b = byte.Parse(colorMatch.Groups[3].Value);
10562
10563 Color color = Color.FromArgb(255, r, g, b);
10564 colors.Add(color);
10565 }
10566 }
10567 catch
10568 {
10569 // Ignore invalid color names
10570 }
10571 }
10572
10573 SetCustomExecutionOrder(colors);
10574 }

10667 private void OnSimulationStopped(object sender, SimulationEventArgs e)
10668 {
10669 EyeshotStatus_Text = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "PathManager_SimulationCompleted") ?? "Simulation completed.";
10670
10671 // Show the restoring message BEFORE the heavy Eyeshot cleanup freezes the UI
10672 StatusProgressBarColor = new SolidColorBrush(System.Windows.Media.Color.FromRgb(128, 128, 128));
10673 Machine_Status_ProgressText = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "ProbeCollision_RestoringPaths") ?? "Restoring visualization components...";
10674 IsSimulationActive = false;
10675 IsSimulationSeekEnabled = false;
10676 PauseSimulationVisibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
10677 SimulationSpeedPanelVisibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
10678 CameraControlsButtonVisibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
10679 CameraControlsPanelVisibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
10680
10681 // Notify context menu visibility changes
10682 OnPropertyChanged(nameof(ShowFollowProbeMenuItem));
10683 OnPropertyChanged(nameof(ShowStopFollowingMenuItem));
10684
10685 // Stop camera following and reset the follow state so a subsequent
10686 // auto-triggered probe collision check starts with a clean slate.
10687 if (_cameraUtils != null)
10688 {
10689 _cameraUtils.StopCameraFollowing();
10690 }
10691 // Reset the follow-enabled flag: after the simulation ends the camera
10692 // is no longer tracking the probe, so the UI state should reflect that.
10693 // If the user explicitly had follow-probe on they can re-enable it.
10694 cameraFollowEnabled = false;
10695 OnPropertyChanged(nameof(CameraFollowEnabled));
10696 OnPropertyChanged(nameof(ShowFollowProbeMenuItem));
10697 OnPropertyChanged(nameof(ShowStopFollowingMenuItem));
10698
10699 // Update cleanup button visibility
10700 UpdateCollisionMarkersVisibility();
10701
10702 // After 1 second, clear the restoring message to Idle
10703 var timer = new System.Windows.Threading.DispatcherTimer { Interval = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(1) };
10704 timer.Tick += (s, args) =>
10705 {
10706 timer.Stop();
10707 Machine_Status_ProgressText = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Idle") ?? "Idle";
10708 Machine_Status_Progress = 0;
10709 StatusProgressBarColor = new SolidColorBrush(Colors.Gray);
10710 };
10711 timer.Start();
10712 }

11004 public void OpenPathEditDialog()
11005 {
11006 // Verifique se existem caminhos carregados antes de abrir a janela
11007 if (_pathManager == null || !_pathManager.ColorPaths.Any())
11008 {
11009 string message = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "PathManager_NoPathsGenerated") ?? "Please generate paths first.";
11010 string title = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "PathManager_PathPlanningErrorTitle") ?? "Path Planning Error";
11011 MessageBox.Show(message, title, MessageBoxButton.OK, MessageBoxImage.Information);
11012
11013 if (measuring_sp != null)
11014 {
11015 measuring_sp.GeneratePaths_Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
11016 }
11017
11018 return;
11019 }
11020
11021 // Reset visibility toggles so the user can see everything while editing
11022 ShowAllControlPoints = true;
11023 ShowAllMeasurementPoints = true;
11024
11025 // Crie e mostre a janela de diálogo
11026 var pathDialog = new PathEditDialog(_pathManager, _designControl, DocLanguage)
11027 {
11028 Owner = Application.Current.MainWindow // Define a janela principal como proprietária
11029 };
11030
11031 bool? dialogResult = pathDialog.ShowDialog();
11032
11033 if (dialogResult == true && !_pathManager.ColorPaths.Any())
11034 {
11035 // Discard All Paths was called
11036 if (measuring_sp != null)
11037 {
11038 measuring_sp.GeneratePaths_Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
11039 }
11040 SaveCurrentSession(); // Save the cleared path state
11041 }
11042
11043 // Após o fecho do diálogo, a ordem no _pathManager já estará atualizada se o utilizador clicou em OK.
11044 // The path entities will be restored by the dialog
11045
11046 // Refresh the tool-color list in Measuring_SidePanel to reflect any order changes
11047 measuring_sp?.RefreshColorToolList();
11048 }

11062 private static double DistancePointToLine(Point3D p, Point3D lineOrigin, Vector3D lineDir)
11063 {
11064 Vector3D v = new Vector3D(lineOrigin, p);
11065 Vector3D cross = EyeshotGeometryUtils.CrossProduct(v, lineDir);
11066 double dirLen = Math.Sqrt(lineDir.X * lineDir.X + lineDir.Y * lineDir.Y + lineDir.Z * lineDir.Z);
11067 if (dirLen < 1e-9) return p.DistanceTo(lineOrigin);
11068 return Math.Sqrt(cross.X * cross.X + cross.Y * cross.Y + cross.Z * cross.Z) / dirLen;
11069 }

11076 private string GetLocalizedFormattedString(string key, params object[] args)

11085 catch (FormatException)
11086 {
11087 // Fallback in case of formatting error, e.g., key found but args mismatch
11088 return $"{rawValue} (Format Error)";

11090 }
11091 return rawValue; // Return raw value if no args or key not found

11143 public static string? GetXMLElementValue(XmlDocument doc, string key)
11144 {
11145 // Check if the document is null
11146 if (doc.DocumentElement == null)
11147 {
11148 return null; // or handle the error appropriately
11149 }
11150
11151 if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(key))
11152 {
11153 return null;
11154 }
11155
11156 try
11157 {
11158 // Use XPath to find the element with the specified key
11159 XmlNode? node = doc.SelectSingleNode($"//{key}");
11160 return node?.Attributes?["Value"]?.Value; // Return the value or an empty string if not found
11161 }
11162 catch (System.Xml.XPath.XPathException)
11163 {
11164 // Invalid key for XPath (e.g. status text containing spaces/special chars)
11165 return null;
11166 }
11167 }

11169 // Method to convert a SecureString to a plain string
11175 private string? SecureStringToString(SecureString secureString)
11176 {
11177 IntPtr unmanagedString = IntPtr.Zero;
11178
11179 try
11180 {
11181 unmanagedString = Marshal.SecureStringToGlobalAllocUnicode(secureString);
11182 return Marshal.PtrToStringUni(unmanagedString);
11183 }
11184 finally
11185 {
11186 Marshal.ZeroFreeGlobalAllocUnicode(unmanagedString);
11187 }
11188 }
11189
11190 // Method to convert a plain string to a SecureString
11196 private SecureString ConvertToSecureString(string plainString)
11197 {
11198 SecureString secureString = new SecureString();
11199
11200 foreach (char c in plainString)
11201 {
11202 secureString.AppendChar(c);
11203 }
11204
11205 secureString.MakeReadOnly();
11206 return secureString;
11207 }

11214 private void PerformManualPicking(System.Drawing.Point mousePos, Entity entity)
11215 {
11216 try
11217 {
11218 Point3D cameraTarget = _designControl.Camera.Target;
11219 Point3D cameraEye = _designControl.Camera.Location;
11220 Vector3D cameraDirection = new Vector3D(
11221 cameraTarget.X - cameraEye.X,
11222 cameraTarget.Y - cameraEye.Y,
11223 cameraTarget.Z - cameraEye.Z);
11224
11225 EyeshotGeometryUtils.NormalizeVector(ref cameraDirection);
11226
11227 Point3D intersectionPoint = Point3D.Origin;
11228 bool foundIntersection = false;
11229
11230 if (entity is Mesh mesh)
11231 {
11232 foundIntersection = EyeshotGeometryUtils.IntersectWithMesh(mesh, cameraEye, cameraDirection, out intersectionPoint);
11233 }
11234 else if (entity is Brep brep)
11235 {
11236 foundIntersection = EyeshotGeometryUtils.IntersectWithBrep(brep, cameraEye, cameraDirection, out intersectionPoint);
11237 }
11238
11239 if (foundIntersection && (intersectionPoint != null) && EyeshotGeometryUtils.IsValidWorldPosition(intersectionPoint))
11240 {
11241 CurrentPointCoords = $"X: {intersectionPoint.X:F3}, Y: {intersectionPoint.Y:F3}, Z: {intersectionPoint.Z:F3}";
11242 if (IsModelEntity(entity))
11243 {
11244 Point3D partOrigin = GetPartOrigin(entity);
11245 CurrentRelativePointCoords = $"X: {(intersectionPoint.X - partOrigin.X):F3}, Y: {(intersectionPoint.Y - partOrigin.Y):F3}, Z: {(intersectionPoint.Z - partOrigin.Z):F3}";
11246 }
11247 }
11248 }
11249 catch (Exception ex)
11250 {
11251 EyeshotStatus_Text = string.Format(GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Eyeshot_ManualPickingError")!, ex.Message);
11252 }
11253 }

11258 private Point3D GetPartOrigin(Entity partEntity)
11259 {
11260 if (partEntity == null) return Point3D.Origin;
11261
11262 Point3D origin = partEntity.BoxMin ?? Point3D.Origin;
11263
11264 if (_designControl == null || _designControl.Entities == null) return origin;
11265
11266 BlockReference? associatedOrigin = null;
11267 double minDistance = double.MaxValue;
11268
11269 string? sourcePath = partEntity.EntityData as string;
11270 bool hasSourcePath = !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(sourcePath);
11271 string? targetOriginData = hasSourcePath ? $"PART_ORIGIN:{sourcePath}" : null;
11272
11273 foreach (var e in _designControl.Entities)
11274 {
11275 if (e.EntityData is string str && str.StartsWith("PART_ORIGIN"))
11276 {
11277 if (hasSourcePath && string.Equals(str, targetOriginData, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
11278 {
11279 if (e is BlockReference specificBr)
11280 {
11281 return specificBr.InsertionPoint;
11282 }
11283 }
11284
11285 if (e is BlockReference br)
11286 {
11287 double dist = br.InsertionPoint.DistanceTo(origin);
11288 if (dist < minDistance)
11289 {
11290 minDistance = dist;
11291 associatedOrigin = br;
11292 }
11293 }
11294 }
11295 }
11296
11297 if (associatedOrigin != null)
11298 {
11299 return associatedOrigin.InsertionPoint;
11300 }
11301
11302 return origin;
11303 }

11308 private bool IsModelEntity(Entity ent)
11309 {
11310 if (ent == null) return false;
11311 if (IsBaseAvoidanceVisualEntity(ent)) return false;
11312
11313 if (ent.GetType().Name == "SimulationBlockReference") return false;
11314
11315 // 1. Check for system EntityData identifiers
11316 if (ent.EntityData is string data)
11317 {
11318 if (data == "PART_ORIGIN" ||
11319 data == "SECTION_VISUAL" ||
11320 data == "IgnoredOverlay_Ref" ||
11321 data == "COMPACT_PATH_VISUAL" ||
11322 data.StartsWith("BASE_AVOIDANCE"))
11323 return false;
11324 }
11325 else if (ent.EntityData != null)
11326 {
11327 // If it's an object (like CADHole or CADFace or WaypointData), it's a system marker
11328 return false;
11329 }
11330
11331 // 2. Check for system layers (PathManager and SdfShellGenerator use these)
11332 if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(ent.LayerName))
11333 {
11334 string layer = ent.LayerName.ToUpper();
11335 if (layer.StartsWith("PATH_") ||
11336 layer.StartsWith("PROBE_") ||
11337 layer.StartsWith("SCANNER_") ||
11338 layer.StartsWith("COLLISION_") ||
11339 layer.StartsWith("RAYCAST_") ||
11340 layer.StartsWith("SHELL_") || // Skip SDF shells
11341 layer.Contains("SIMULATION") ||
11342 layer.Contains("MARKERS"))
11343 return false;
11344 }
11345
11346 // 3. Only process 3D geometric entities that can reasonably contain faces
11347 return ent is Mesh || ent is Brep || ent is Solid || ent is BlockReference;
11348 }

11421 private void HandleDesignControlSelectionChanged(object parameter)
11422 {
11423 if (!(_designControl.IsLoaded) || isUpdatingSelection || !(parameter is devDept.Eyeshot.Control.SelectionChangedEventArgs e)) return;
11424
11425 if (_waitingForSectionPartSelection)
11426 {
11427 var candidates = GetSectionCandidateParts();
11428 var selectedPart = candidates.FirstOrDefault(ent => ent.Selected);
11429
11430 // Fallback if the raw entity was not flagged as selected yet, extract from AddedItems wrapper
11431 if (selectedPart == null && e.AddedItems != null && e.AddedItems.Count > 0)
11432 {
11433 var first = e.AddedItems[0];
11434 if (first != null)
11435 {
11436 var firstType = first.GetType();
11437
11438 Entity? rawEnt = (firstType.GetProperty("Item")?.GetValue(first) as Entity)
11439 ?? (firstType.GetProperty("Entity")?.GetValue(first) as Entity)
11440 ?? (firstType.GetProperty("Item")?.GetValue(first) is object inner ?
11441 (inner.GetType().GetProperty("Entity")?.GetValue(inner) as Entity ?? inner.GetType().GetProperty("Item")?.GetValue(inner) as Entity) : null);
11442
11443 // Eyeshot Selection sometimes directly gives Entity
11444 var firstObj = first as object;
11445 if (rawEnt == null && firstObj is Entity eEnt)
11446 rawEnt = eEnt;
11447
11448 if (rawEnt != null && candidates.Contains(rawEnt))
11449 {
11450 selectedPart = rawEnt;
11451 // Do not force rawEnt.Selected = true to preserve face/vertex selection
11452 }
11453 }
11454 }
11455
11456 if (selectedPart != null)
11457 {
11458 _waitingForSectionPartSelection = false;
11459 SectionViewOverlayVisibility = Visibility.Visible;
11460 UpdateSectionPlaneMaxAndPos();
11461 SectionPlanePosition = SectionPlaneMaxPosition;
11462 UpdateSectionPlane();
11463
11464 if (_designControl.Viewports.Count > 0 && _designControl.Viewports[0].ToolBars.Count > 0)
11465 {
11466 var btn = _designControl.Viewports[0].ToolBars[0].Buttons.FirstOrDefault(b => b.Name == "SectionViewMain") as ToolBarButton;
11467 if (btn != null) btn.Pushed = true;
11468 }
11469 }
11470 return;
11471 }
11472
11473 // Check if selection change only involves path entities (waypoints, segments, dragging spheres)
11474 bool onlyPathEntities = true;
11475 if (e != null)
11476 {
11477 if (e.AddedItems != null && e.AddedItems.Count > 0)
11478 {
11479 foreach (var item in e.AddedItems)
11480 {
11481 var ent = GetEntityFromSelectionItem(item);
11482 if (ent == null || !(ent.EntityData is WaypointData || ent.EntityData is PathSegmentData || ent == _draggingSphere || (ent is LinearPath && ent.LayerName != null && ent.LayerName.StartsWith(PathManager.PATH_LAYER_PREFIX))))
11483 {
11484 onlyPathEntities = false;
11485 break;
11486 }
11487 }
11488 }
11489 if (onlyPathEntities && e.RemovedItems != null && e.RemovedItems.Count > 0)
11490 {
11491 foreach (var item in e.RemovedItems)
11492 {
11493 var ent = GetEntityFromSelectionItem(item);
11494 if (ent == null || !(ent.EntityData is WaypointData || ent.EntityData is PathSegmentData || ent == _draggingSphere || (ent is LinearPath && ent.LayerName != null && ent.LayerName.StartsWith(PathManager.PATH_LAYER_PREFIX))))
11495 {
11496 onlyPathEntities = false;
11497 break;
11498 }
11499 }
11500 }
11501 if (e.AddedItems?.Count == 0 && e.RemovedItems?.Count == 0)
11502 {
11503 onlyPathEntities = true;
11504 }
11505 }
11506 else
11507 {
11508 onlyPathEntities = false;
11509 }
11510
11511 if (onlyPathEntities)
11512 {
11513 if (e?.AddedItems != null && e.AddedItems.Count > 0)
11514 {
11515 var item = e.AddedItems[0];
11516 var ent = GetEntityFromSelectionItem(item);
11517 if (ent != null)
11518 {
11519 if (ent.EntityData is PathSegmentData segmentData && segmentData.Path != null)
11520 {
11521 var segmentEntity = segmentData.Path.SegmentEntities?.FirstOrDefault(s => ReferenceEquals(s.EntityData, segmentData));
11522 if (segmentEntity != null)
11523 _treeViewHelper.SelectPathSegmentInTree(segmentEntity);
11524 }
11525 else if (ent.EntityData is WaypointData waypointData && waypointData.Path != null)
11526 {
11527 if (waypointData.PointIndex >= 0 && waypointData.PointIndex < waypointData.Path.Points.Count)
11528 {
11529 var pt = waypointData.Path.Points[waypointData.PointIndex];
11530 if (pt != null)
11531 _treeViewHelper.SelectPathPointInTree(pt);
11532 }
11533 }
11534 else if (ent is LinearPath pathEntity && pathEntity.LayerName != null && pathEntity.LayerName.StartsWith(PathManager.PATH_LAYER_PREFIX))
11535 {
11536 _treeViewHelper.SelectPathSegmentInTree(pathEntity);
11537 }
11538 }
11539 }
11540 return;
11541 }
11542
11543 try
11544 {
11545 isUpdatingSelection = true;
11546 _treeViewHelper.ClearTreeViewSelection();
11547 _visualsManager.ClearAllMarkers(); // Clear ALL markers when selection changes
11548
11549 if (e?.AddedItems == null || e.AddedItems.Count == 0) return;
11550
11551 // Complex Eyeshot selection details extraction (kept largely as-is due to Eyeshot's API)
11552 var first = e.AddedItems[0];
11553 if (first == null) return;
11554
11555 var firstType = first.GetType();
11556 string firstTypeName = firstType.Name.ToLowerInvariant();
11557
11558 Entity? selEntity = (firstType.GetProperty("Item")?.GetValue(first) as Entity)
11559 ?? (firstType.GetProperty("Entity")?.GetValue(first) as Entity)
11560 ?? (firstType.GetProperty("Item")?.GetValue(first) is object inner ?
11561 (inner.GetType().GetProperty("Entity")?.GetValue(inner) as Entity ?? inner.GetType().GetProperty("Item")?.GetValue(inner) as Entity) : null);
11562
11563 int subIndex = (int?)(firstType.GetProperty("Index")?.GetValue(first)
11564 ?? firstType.GetProperty("FaceIndex")?.GetValue(first)
11565 ?? firstType.GetProperty("VertexIndex")?.GetValue(first)
11566 ?? firstType.GetProperty("SubIndex")?.GetValue(first)) ?? -1;
11567
11568 if (selEntity == null) return;
11569
11570 int entityIndex = _designControl.Entities.IndexOf(selEntity);
11571 if (entityIndex < 0) return;
11572
11573 // Flatten all faces for easy lookup
11574 // FIX: Changed from _facesByColor to _allFacesByColor to include hole faces in selection lookup.
11575 var allFaces = _allFacesByColor.Values.SelectMany(l => l).ToList();
11576 _visualsManager.CurrentSelectedFace = null;
11577
11578 if (firstTypeName.Contains("face") || firstTypeName.Contains("selectedface"))
11579 {
11580 var match = allFaces.FirstOrDefault(f => f.EntityIndex == entityIndex && f.FaceIndex == subIndex);
11581 if (match != null)
11582 {
11583 _treeViewHelper.SelectFaceInTree(match);
11584 _visualsManager.ShowControlPointsForFace(match);
11585 _visualsManager.ShowCornerMarkersForFace(match);
11586 _visualsManager.CurrentSelectedFace = match;
11587
11588 var parentHole = FindParentHoleForFace(match);
11589 if (parentHole != null)
11590 {
11591 _visualsManager.ShowHoleCenterAndDepth(parentHole);
11592 _treeViewHelper.SelectHoleInTree(parentHole); // Also select the hole in the tree
11593 }
11594 }
11595 else
11596 {
11597 var fallback = allFaces.FirstOrDefault(f => f.EntityIndex == entityIndex);
11598 if (fallback != null)
11599 {
11600 _treeViewHelper.SelectFaceInTree(fallback);
11601 _visualsManager.ShowControlPointsForFace(fallback);
11602 _visualsManager.ShowCornerMarkersForFace(fallback);
11603 _visualsManager.CurrentSelectedFace = fallback;
11604
11605 var parentHole = FindParentHoleForFace(fallback);
11606 if (parentHole != null)
11607 {
11608 _visualsManager.ShowHoleCenterAndDepth(parentHole);
11609 _treeViewHelper.SelectHoleInTree(parentHole);
11610 }
11611 }
11612 }
11613 }
11614 else if (firstTypeName.Contains("vertex") || firstTypeName.Contains("selectedvertex"))
11615 {
11616 if (subIndex >= 0)
11617 {
11618 var facesWithVertex = allFaces.Where(f => f.EntityIndex == entityIndex && f.KeyPoints.Any(k => k.VertexIndex == subIndex)).ToList();
11619 if (facesWithVertex.Count > 0)
11620 {
11621 var face = facesWithVertex.First();
11622 _treeViewHelper.SelectVertexInTree(face, subIndex);
11623 _visualsManager.ShowCornerMarkersForFace(face, highlightVertexIndex: subIndex);
11624 _visualsManager.ShowControlPointsForFace(face);
11625 _visualsManager.CurrentSelectedFace = face;
11626
11627 var parentHole = FindParentHoleForFace(face);
11628 if (parentHole != null)
11629 {
11630 _visualsManager.ShowHoleCenterAndDepth(parentHole);
11631 _treeViewHelper.SelectHoleInTree(parentHole);
11632 }
11633 }
11634 else
11635 {
11636 var fallback = allFaces.FirstOrDefault(f => f.EntityIndex == entityIndex);
11637 if (fallback != null)
11638 {
11639 _treeViewHelper.SelectFaceInTree(fallback);
11640 _visualsManager.ShowCornerMarkersForFace(fallback);
11641 _visualsManager.ShowControlPointsForFace(fallback);
11642 _visualsManager.CurrentSelectedFace = fallback;
11643
11644 var parentHole = FindParentHoleForFace(fallback);
11645 if (parentHole != null)
11646 {
11647 _visualsManager.ShowHoleCenterAndDepth(parentHole);
11648 _treeViewHelper.SelectHoleInTree(parentHole);
11649 }
11650 }
11651 }
11652 }
11653 }
11654 else // Generic entity selection fallback
11655 {
11656 var firstFaceOfEntity = allFaces.FirstOrDefault(f => f.EntityIndex == entityIndex);
11657 if (firstFaceOfEntity != null)
11658 {
11659 _treeViewHelper.SelectFaceInTree(firstFaceOfEntity);
11660 _visualsManager.ShowControlPointsForFace(firstFaceOfEntity);
11661 _visualsManager.ShowCornerMarkersForFace(firstFaceOfEntity);
11662 _visualsManager.CurrentSelectedFace = firstFaceOfEntity;
11663
11664 var parentHole = FindParentHoleForFace(firstFaceOfEntity);
11665 if (parentHole != null)
11666 {
11667 _visualsManager.ShowHoleCenterAndDepth(parentHole);
11668 _treeViewHelper.SelectHoleInTree(parentHole);
11669 }
11670 }
11671 }
11672 }
11673 catch (Exception ex)
11674 {
11675 EyeshotStatus_Text = string.Format(GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Eyeshot_SelectionSyncError")!, ex.Message);
11676 }
11677 finally
11678 {
11679 isUpdatingSelection = false;
11680 _designControl.Invalidate();
11681 }
11682 }

11760

11771 if (_activeContextMenu != null || _justClosedContextMenu)

11783 var screenPoint = new System.Drawing.Point((int)e.GetPosition(_designControl).X, (int)e.GetPosition(_designControl).Y);

11785 // --- Right-Click Handling for Context Menus ---

11791 if (rightClickItem != null)

12415 _designControl.Camera.Target.X - _designControl.Camera.Location.X,
12416 _designControl.Camera.Target.Y - _designControl.Camera.Location.Y,
12417 _designControl.Camera.Target.Z - _designControl.Camera.Location.Z);
12418 rayDir.Normalize();
12419 rayStart = worldPos - rayDir * 100000.0;
12420 }
12421 Point3D intersectPt;
12422 if (EyeshotGeometryUtils.IntersectWithMesh(_draggingFaceMesh, rayStart, rayDir, out intersectPt))
12423 {
12424 snappedPt = intersectPt;
12425 }
12426 else
12427 {
12428 snappedPt = EyeshotGeometryUtils.ProjectPointToMesh(worldPos, _draggingFaceMesh);
12429 }
12430 }
12431 else
12432 {
12433 snappedPt = EyeshotGeometryUtils.ProjectPointToFaceSurface(worldPos, _draggingMeasurePointBrep, _draggingMeasurePointFace.FaceIndex);
12434 }
12435 }
12436 else
12437 {
12438 // Fallback to snapping to closest part surface
12439 Entity? targetPart;
12440 Vector3D newNormal;
12441 snappedPt = SnapToClosestPartSurface(worldPos, out newNormal, out targetPart);
12442 }
12443
12444 if (_draggingSphere != null && _draggingSpherePosition != null && snappedPt != null)
12445 {
12446 Vector3D sphereTrans = new Vector3D(_draggingSpherePosition, snappedPt);
12447 _draggingSphere.Translate(sphereTrans);
12448 _draggingSpherePosition = (Point3D)snappedPt.Clone();
12449
12450 ApplySharedWaypointPosition(wpData, snappedPt);
12451 }
12452
12453 _designControl.Invalidate();
12454 }
12455 else if (_designControl != null && _designControl.ObjectManipulator.Visible && _manipulatingEntity != null && _manipulatingEntity.EntityData is WaypointData dragWp && !_isCustomDragging)
12456 {
12457 var trans = _designControl.ObjectManipulator.Transformation;
12458 if (trans == null)
12459 {
12460 _designControl.ObjectManipulator.Cancel();
12461 _designControl.Entities.ClearSelection();
12462 _designControl.Invalidate();
12463 _manipulatingEntity = null;
12464 return;
12465 }
12466 if (trans != null && _initialTriadTrans != null)
12467 {
12468 Point3D currentPt = (Point3D)dragWp.OriginalPosition.Clone();
12469 currentPt.TransformBy(trans);
12470 currentPt = ConstrainSharedWaypointPosition(dragWp, currentPt);
12471
12472 // If it's an approach point, project/constrain it along the normal of the associated measure point
12473 bool isApproach = false;
12474 int mIdx = -1;
12475 if (dragWp.Path.IsMeasure != null)
12476 {
12477 if (dragWp.PointIndex + 1 < dragWp.Path.Points.Count && dragWp.Path.IsMeasure[dragWp.PointIndex + 1])
12478 {
12479 isApproach = true;
12480 mIdx = dragWp.PointIndex + 1;
12481 }
12482 else if (dragWp.PointIndex > 0 && dragWp.Path.IsMeasure[dragWp.PointIndex - 1])
12483 {
12484 isApproach = true;
12485 mIdx = dragWp.PointIndex - 1;
12486 }
12487 }
12488
12489 if (isApproach && mIdx != -1)
12490 {
12491 Point3D measurePt = dragWp.Path.Points[mIdx];
12492 Vector3D normal = dragWp.Path.Normals[mIdx];
12493 if (normal.LengthSquared < 1e-6) normal = Vector3D.AxisZ;
12494 normal.Normalize();
12495
12496 double t = Vector3D.Dot(new Vector3D(measurePt, currentPt), normal);
12497 t = Math.Max(0.0, t); // Cannot go below the surface (inside the part)
12498 currentPt = measurePt + normal * t;
12499 }
12500
12501 ApplySharedWaypointPosition(dragWp, currentPt);
12502
12503 _designControl.Invalidate();
12504 }
12505 }
12506
12507 int entityIndex = _designControl!.GetEntityUnderMouseCursor(mousePos);
12508
12509 if (entityIndex >= 0 && entityIndex < _designControl.Entities.Count)
12510 {
12511 if ((worldPos != null) && EyeshotGeometryUtils.IsValidWorldPosition(worldPos))
12512 {
12513 CurrentPointCoords = $"X: {worldPos.X:F3}, Y: {worldPos.Y:F3}, Z: {worldPos.Z:F3}";
12514 Entity hoveredEntity = _designControl.Entities[entityIndex];
12515 if (IsModelEntity(hoveredEntity))
12516 {
12517 Point3D partOrigin = GetPartOrigin(hoveredEntity);
12518 CurrentRelativePointCoords = $"X: {(worldPos.X - partOrigin.X):F3}, Y: {(worldPos.Y - partOrigin.Y):F3}, Z: {(worldPos.Z - partOrigin.Z):F3}";
12519 }
12520 }
12521 else
12522 {
12523 PerformManualPicking(mousePos, _designControl.Entities[entityIndex]);
12524 }
12525 }
12526 else
12527 {
12528 if ((worldPos != null) && EyeshotGeometryUtils.IsValidWorldPosition(worldPos))
12529 {
12530 CurrentPointCoords = $"X: {worldPos.X:F3}, Y: {worldPos.Y:F3}, Z: {worldPos.Z:F3}";
12531 }
12532 }
12533 }
12534 catch { /* Suppressing common mouse move errors for smoother experience */ }
12535 }

12545 private void HandleTreeViewSelectedItemChanged(object? selectedItem)
12546 {
12547 if (isUpdatingSelection || selectedItem == null) return;
12548
12549 try
12550 {
12551 isUpdatingSelection = true;
12552 _visualsManager.ClearAllMarkers();
12553
12554 _designControl.SelectionFilterMode = selectionFilterType.Face | selectionFilterType.Vertex;
12555 _designControl.ActionMode = actionType.SelectVisibleByPickDynamic;
12556
12557 // Caso: nó de cor ou grupo (sem Tag)
12558 if (selectedItem is TreeViewItem tvi && tvi.Tag == null)
12559 {
12560 _selectionUtils.ClearDesignControlSelection();
12561 _visualsManager.ClearAllMarkers();
12562 _designControl.Invalidate();
12563 return;
12564 }
12565
12566 // Caso: Face selecionada
12567 if (selectedItem is TreeViewItem faceTvi && faceTvi.Tag is CADFace cadFace)
12568 {
12569 if (cadFace.EntityIndex < 0 || cadFace.EntityIndex >= _designControl.Entities.Count)
12570 {
12571 EyeshotStatus_Text = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Eyeshot_InvalidEntityIndexFace");
12572 return;
12573 }
12574 _selectionUtils.ClearDesignControlSelection();
12575 var entObj = _designControl.Entities[cadFace.EntityIndex];
12576 _visualsManager.ShowControlPointsForFace(cadFace);
12577 _visualsManager.ShowCornerMarkersForFace(cadFace);
12578 _visualsManager.HighlightFaceVisualFallback(entObj as Brep, cadFace.FaceIndex);
12579 _designControl.Invalidate();
12580 EyeshotStatus_Text = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Eyeshot_FaceHighlightApplied");
12581 _visualsManager.CurrentSelectedFace = cadFace;
12582
12583 var parentHole = FindParentHoleForFace(cadFace);
12584 if (parentHole != null)
12585 {
12586 _visualsManager.ShowHoleCenterAndDepth(parentHole);
12587 }
12588 return;
12589 }
12590
12591 // Caso: Vértice selecionado
12592 if (selectedItem is TreeViewItem vertexTvi && vertexTvi.Tag is FacePoint fp)
12593 {
12594 CADFace? parentFace = FindParentFaceForVertex(vertexTvi) ?? FindParentFaceForVertexPoint(fp);
12595 if (parentFace != null && parentFace.EntityIndex >= 0 && parentFace.EntityIndex < _designControl.Entities.Count)
12596 {
12597 _selectionUtils.ClearDesignControlSelection();
12598 var entObj = _designControl.Entities[parentFace.EntityIndex];
12599 if (fp.VertexIndex >= 0 && entObj is Brep brepForVertex)
12600 {
12601 try
12602 {
12603 var t = brepForVertex.GetType();
12604 var setVertex = t.GetMethod("SetVertexSelection", new Type[] { typeof(int), typeof(bool) })
12605 ?? t.GetMethod("SetVertexSelection", new Type[] { typeof(int) });
12606
12607 if (setVertex != null)
12608 {
12609 try
12610 {
12611 setVertex.Invoke(brepForVertex, new object[] { fp.VertexIndex, true });
12612 }
12613 catch
12614 {
12615 setVertex.Invoke(brepForVertex, new object[] { fp.VertexIndex });
12616 }
12617 }
12618 }
12619 catch { /* ignore */ }
12620 }
12621 _visualsManager.ShowCornerMarkersForFace(parentFace, highlightVertexIndex: fp.VertexIndex);
12622 _visualsManager.ShowControlPointsForFace(parentFace);
12623 _visualsManager.ShowZoomVertexHighlight(new devDept.Geometry.Point3D(fp.X, fp.Y, fp.Z), cubeSize: EyeshotVisualsManager.PreviewVertexCubeSize);
12624 _selectionUtils.TryRefreshDesignControlSelection();
12625 _designControl.Invalidate();
12626 _visualsManager.CurrentSelectedFace = parentFace;
12627
12628 var parentHole = FindParentHoleForFace(parentFace);
12629 if (parentHole != null)
12630 {
12631 _visualsManager.ShowHoleCenterAndDepth(parentHole);
12632 }
12633 }
12634 else
12635 {
12636 _visualsManager.ShowZoomVertexHighlight(new devDept.Geometry.Point3D(fp.X, fp.Y, fp.Z), cubeSize: EyeshotVisualsManager.PreviewVertexCubeSize);
12637 _designControl.Invalidate();
12638 }
12639 return;
12640 }
12641
12642 // Caso: Ponto de controle selecionado
12643 if (selectedItem is TreeViewItem cpTvi && cpTvi.Tag is Point4D controlPoint)
12644 {
12645 _visualsManager.ShowTemporaryControlPointSphere(controlPoint);
12646 _designControl.Invalidate();
12647 EyeshotStatus_Text = string.Format(GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Eyeshot_HighlightingControlPoint")!, controlPoint.X, controlPoint.Y, controlPoint.Z);
12648 return;
12649 }
12650
12651 // Caso: Furo selecionado
12652 if (selectedItem is TreeViewItem holeTvi && holeTvi.Tag is CADHole cadHole)
12653 {
12654 _selectionUtils.ClearDesignControlSelection();
12655 _visualsManager.ShowHoleCenterAndDepth(cadHole);
12656 _designControl.Invalidate();
12657 EyeshotStatus_Text = string.Format(GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Eyeshot_HighlightingHole")!, cadHole.HoleId);
12658 return;
12659 }
12660
12661 // Default: limpa seleção
12662 _selectionUtils.ClearDesignControlSelection();
12663 _visualsManager.ClearAllMarkers();
12664 _designControl.Invalidate();
12665 }
12666 catch (Exception ex)
12667 {
12668 EyeshotStatus_Text = string.Format(GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Eyeshot_TreeViewSelectionError")!, ex.Message);
12669 }
12670 finally
12671 {
12672 isUpdatingSelection = false;
12673 }
12674 }

12682 private CADFace? FindParentFaceForVertex(TreeViewItem vertexTvi)
12683 {
12684 if (vertexTvi == null) return null;
12685
12686 // Assuming parent is a "Vertices" header, and its parent is the CADFace
12687 if (vertexTvi.Parent is TreeViewItem keyPointsHeader)
12688 {
12689 string headerText = keyPointsHeader.Header?.ToString() ?? "";
12690 string localizedVertices = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "TreeView_Vertices") ?? "Vertices";
12691
12692 if (headerText.StartsWith("Vertices", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
12693 headerText.StartsWith("Vértices", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
12694 headerText.Contains(localizedVertices, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
12695 headerText.Contains("Vertic", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
12696 {
12697 if (keyPointsHeader.Parent is TreeViewItem faceTvi && faceTvi.Tag is CADFace cadFace)
12698 {
12699 return cadFace;
12700 }
12701 }
12702 }
12703 return null;
12704 }

12722 private void AddManipulateAndMoveMenuItems(ContextMenu contextMenu, object item)
12723 {
12724 Entity? partEntity = ResolvePartEntity(item);
12725
12726 if (partEntity != null && _designControl != null)
12727 {
12728 var toggleOriginItem = new MenuItem
12729 {
12730 Header = OriginGridVisibilityMenuText,
12731 Command = ToggleOriginGridsCommand,
12732 Icon = new TextBlock { Text = "▦", FontSize = 17, Padding = new Thickness(2, 0, 0, 0), VerticalAlignment = VerticalAlignment.Center, HorizontalAlignment = HorizontalAlignment.Center },
12733 ToolTip = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "ContextMenu_OriginGridVisibility_ToolTip") ?? "Shows or hides the part origin grid and triad."
12734 };
12735 contextMenu.Items.Add(toggleOriginItem);
12736
12737 if (IsCmmBoundingBoxEnabled)

12740 {
12741 Header = CmmBoundingBoxVisibilityMenuText,

12744 ToolTip = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "ContextMenu_CmmBoundingBoxVisibility_ToolTip") ?? "Shows or hides the CMM machine volume bounding box."
12745 };
12746 contextMenu.Items.Add(toggleCmmBoxItem);
12747 }
12748
12749 //contextMenu.Items.Add(new Separator());
12750
12751 var alignTriadItem = new MenuItem
12752 {
12753 Header = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "ContextMenu_AlignTriadWithGrid") ?? "Align triad with origin grid",
12754 Command = AlignTriadWithOriginGridCommand,
12755 CommandParameter = item,
12756 Icon = new TextBlock { Text = "📐", FontSize = 11, Padding = new Thickness(2, 0, 0, 0) },
12757 ToolTip = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "ContextMenu_AlignTriadWithGrid_ToolTip") ?? "Aligns the triad axes with the part bounding box grid sides."
12758 };
12759 contextMenu.Items.Add(alignTriadItem);
12760
12761
12762 contextMenu.Items.Add(new Separator());
12763
12764 // Find if this entity is being manipulated
12765 bool isManipulating = _designControl.ObjectManipulator.Visible && _isPartManipulating;
12766 bool hasStoredPosition = false;
12767 if (_originalPositions.TryGetValue(partEntity, out var originalData) && originalData.Entities.Count > 0)
12768 {
12769 var trans = originalData.Entities[0].trans;
12770 if (trans != null)
12771 {
12772 // Check if trans is not Identity
12773 bool isIdentity = true;
12774 for (int row = 0; row < 4; row++)
12775 {
12776 for (int col = 0; col < 4; col++)
12777 {
12778 double expected = (row == col) ? 1.0 : 0.0;
12779 if (Math.Abs(trans[row, col] - expected) > 1e-6)
12780 {
12781 isIdentity = false;
12782 break;
12783 }
12784 }
12785 if (!isIdentity) break;
12786 }
12787 if (!isIdentity)
12788 {
12789 hasStoredPosition = true;
12790 }
12791 }
12792 }
12793
12794 if (isManipulating)
12795 {
12796 var stopManipulatingItem = new MenuItem
12797 {

12805

12811 Icon = new TextBlock { Text = "❌", FontSize = 12 },

12813 };
12814 contextMenu.Items.Add(cancelManipulatingItem);
12815 }
12816 else
12817 {
12818 var manipulateObjectItem = new MenuItem
12819 {
12820 Header = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "ContextMenu_ManipulateObject") ?? "Manipulate Object",
12821 Command = ManipulateObjectCommand,
12822 CommandParameter = item,
12823 Icon = new TextBlock { Text = "🎮", FontSize = 12 },
12824 ToolTip = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "ContextMenu_ManipulateObject_ToolTip") ?? "Enables the object manipulator to move the part."
12825 };
12826 contextMenu.Items.Add(manipulateObjectItem);
12827
12828 var savePositionItem = new MenuItem
12829 {
12830 Header = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "ContextMenu_SaveNewPosition") ?? "Save New Position",
12831 Command = SaveNewPositionCommand,
12832 CommandParameter = item,
12833 Icon = new TextBlock { Text = "💾", FontSize = 12 },
12834 ToolTip = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "ContextMenu_SaveNewPosition_ToolTip") ?? "Keeps the current position as the new reference.",
12835 Visibility = isManipulating ? Visibility.Visible : Visibility.Collapsed
12836 };
12837 contextMenu.Items.Add(savePositionItem);
12838 }
12839
12840 var resetPositionItem = new MenuItem
12841 {
12842 Header = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "ContextMenu_ResetObjectPosition") ?? "Reset Object Position",
12843 Command = ResetObjectPositionCommand,
12844 CommandParameter = item,
12845 Icon = new TextBlock { Text = "↩️", FontSize = 13, Padding = new Thickness(3, 0, 0, 0) },
12846 ToolTip = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "ContextMenu_ResetObjectPosition_ToolTip") ?? "Resets the object to its original position.",
12847 Visibility = hasStoredPosition ? Visibility.Visible : Visibility.Collapsed
12848 };
12849 contextMenu.Items.Add(resetPositionItem);
12850
12851 var moveToOriginItem = new MenuItem
12852 {
12853 Header = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "ContextMenu_MoveObjectToOrigin") ?? "Move Object to Origin",
12854 Command = MoveObjectToOriginCommand,
12855 CommandParameter = item,
12856 Icon = new TextBlock { Text = "🏠", FontSize = 11, Padding = new Thickness(2, 0, 0, 0) },
12857 ToolTip = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "ContextMenu_MoveObjectToOrigin_ToolTip") ?? "Moves the part to the origin."
12858 };
12859 contextMenu.Items.Add(moveToOriginItem);
12860
12861 if (_pathManager != null && _pathManager.HasGeneratedProbePaths() && item is CADFace faceForCollision)
12862 {
12863 contextMenu.Items.Add(new Separator());
12864 var redoFaceCollisionCheckMenuItem = new MenuItem
12865 {
12866 Header = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "ContextMenu_RerunFaceSegmentsCollisionCheck") ?? "Check Face Path Segments Collisions",
12867 Command = RedoFaceCollisionCheckCommand,

12870 ToolTip = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "ContextMenu_RerunFaceSegmentsCollisionCheck_ToolTip") ?? "Run the face segments collision check with the part."
12871 };
12872 contextMenu.Items.Add(redoFaceCollisionCheckMenuItem);
12873 }
12874 }

12951 private void ClearOriginGrids()
12952 {
12953 if (_designControl == null || _designControl.Viewports.Count == 0) return;
12954
12955 while (_designControl.Viewports[0].Grids.Count > 1)
12956 {
12957 _designControl.Viewports[0].Grids.RemoveAt(1);

12960
12961 private void CleanUpOverlappingOriginGrids()
12962 {
12963 if (_designControl == null || _designControl.Viewports.Count == 0) return;
12964
12965 var gridsToRemove = _designControl.Viewports[0].Grids
12966 .Skip(1) // Skip main grid
12967 .Where(g => g != null &&
12968 Math.Abs(g.Plane.Origin.X) < 1.0 &&
12969 Math.Abs(g.Plane.Origin.Y) < 1.0 &&
12970 Math.Abs(g.Plane.Origin.Z) < 1.0)
12971 .ToList();
12972
12973 foreach (var g in gridsToRemove)
12974 {
12975 _designControl.Viewports[0].Grids.Remove(g);
12976 }
12977
12978 // Remove orphan origin grids whose origin doesn't match any active PART_ORIGIN entity
12979 var partOrigins = _designControl.Entities
12980 .OfType<BlockReference>()
12981 .Where(e => e.EntityData is string tag && tag.StartsWith("PART_ORIGIN", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
12982 .ToList();
12983
12984 var orphanGrids = _designControl.Viewports[0].Grids
12985 .Skip(1)
12986 .Where(g => g != null && !partOrigins.Any(po => po.InsertionPoint.DistanceTo(g.Plane.Origin) < 1.0))
12987 .ToList();
12988
12989 foreach (var og in orphanGrids)
12990 {
12991 _designControl.Viewports[0].Grids.Remove(og);
12992 }
12993 }

13025 private void AddCmmBoundingBoxVisuals()
13026 {
13027 if (_designControl == null || !IsCmmBoundingBoxEnabled) return;
13028
13029 RemoveCmmBoundingBoxVisuals();
13030 EnsureCmmBoundingBoxLayerExists();
13031
13032 double halfX = CmmBoundingBoxSizeX / 2.0;
13033 double halfY = CmmBoundingBoxSizeY / 2.0;
13034 double cmmZ = CmmBoundingBoxSizeZ;
13035
13036 Point3D p0 = new Point3D(-halfX, -halfY, 0);
13037 Point3D p1 = new Point3D(halfX, -halfY, 0);
13038 Point3D p2 = new Point3D(halfX, halfY, 0);
13039 Point3D p3 = new Point3D(-halfX, halfY, 0);
13040 Point3D p4 = new Point3D(-halfX, -halfY, cmmZ);
13041 Point3D p5 = new Point3D(halfX, -halfY, cmmZ);
13042 Point3D p6 = new Point3D(halfX, halfY, cmmZ);
13043 Point3D p7 = new Point3D(-halfX, halfY, cmmZ);
13044
13045 var points = new Point3D[]
13046 {
13047 p0, p1, p2, p3, p0,
13048 p4, p5, p6, p7, p4,
13049 p5, p1,
13050 p2, p6,
13051 p7, p3
13052 };
13053

13139 private bool IsValidPartEntity(Entity e)
13140 {
13141 if (e is not Brep && e is not Mesh) return false;
13142 if (IsBaseAvoidanceVisualEntity(e)) return false;
13143 if (IsCmmBoundingBoxVisualEntity(e)) return false;
13144
13145 string? partSource = GetPartSourceKey(e);
13146 if (partSource == null) return false;
13147
13148 string? layerName = e.LayerName;
13149 if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(layerName))
13150 {
13151 if (layerName.Equals("MARKERS", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
13152 layerName.Equals("PROBE", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
13153 layerName.Equals("TRACKING", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
13154 layerName.Equals("COLLISION_MARKER", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
13155 layerName.Equals("SCANNER", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
13156 layerName.Equals("SCANNER_FOV", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
13157 layerName.Equals("RAYCAST_HITS", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
13158 layerName.StartsWith("PATH_", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
13159 layerName.StartsWith("SHELL_", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
13160 layerName.StartsWith("MEASUREMENT_", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
13161 layerName.Equals(BaseAvoidanceVisualLayerName, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
13162 layerName.Equals(CmmBoundingBoxLayerName, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
13163 layerName.Equals("VERIFICATION", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
13164 {
13165 return false;
13166 }
13167 }
13168
13169 return true;
13170 }

13184 private bool TryGetPartBoundsForSource(string? sourcePath, out Point3D min, out Point3D max, out double maxDim)
13185 {
13186 min = new Point3D(double.MaxValue, double.MaxValue, double.MaxValue);
13187 max = new Point3D(double.MinValue, double.MinValue, double.MinValue);
13188 maxDim = 0;
13189
13190 if (_designControl == null)
13191 return false;
13192
13193 IEnumerable<Entity> entities = _designControl.Entities.Where(IsValidPartEntity);
13194 if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(sourcePath))
13195 {
13196 entities = entities.Where(e => string.Equals(GetPartSourceKey(e), sourcePath, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));
13197 }
13198
13199 var parts = entities.ToList();
13200 if (!parts.Any())
13201 return false;
13202
13203 foreach (var ent in parts)
13204 {
13205 ent.UpdateBoundingBox(new devDept.Eyeshot.TraversalParams());
13206 if (ent.BoxMin.X < min.X) min.X = ent.BoxMin.X;
13207 if (ent.BoxMin.Y < min.Y) min.Y = ent.BoxMin.Y;
13208 if (ent.BoxMin.Z < min.Z) min.Z = ent.BoxMin.Z;
13209
13210 if (ent.BoxMax.X > max.X) max.X = ent.BoxMax.X;
13211 if (ent.BoxMax.Y > max.Y) max.Y = ent.BoxMax.Y;
13212 if (ent.BoxMax.Z > max.Z) max.Z = ent.BoxMax.Z;
13213 }
13214
13215 maxDim = Math.Max(Math.Max(50, max.X - min.X), Math.Max(50, max.Y - min.Y));
13216 maxDim = Math.Ceiling(maxDim / 10.0) * 10.0;
13217 return true;
13218 }

13220 private bool TryGetPartBoundsForEntity(Entity entity, out Point3D min, out Point3D max, out double maxDim)
13221 {
13222 min = new Point3D(double.MaxValue, double.MaxValue, double.MaxValue);
13223 max = new Point3D(double.MinValue, double.MinValue, double.MinValue);
13224 maxDim = 0.0;
13225
13226 if (entity == null || IsBaseAvoidanceVisualEntity(entity))
13227 return false;
13228
13229 entity.UpdateBoundingBox(new devDept.Eyeshot.TraversalParams());
13230 min = entity.BoxMin;
13231 max = entity.BoxMax;
13232 if (min == null || max == null)
13233 return false;
13234
13235 maxDim = Math.Max(Math.Max(50, max.X - min.X), Math.Max(50, max.Y - min.Y));
13236 maxDim = Math.Ceiling(maxDim / 10.0) * 10.0;
13237 return true;
13238 }

13266 private static (Point3D Position, Text.alignmentType Alignment) GetBaseAvoidanceLabelPlacement(
13267 Point3D min,
13268 double planeSize,
13269 double outsideOffset,
13270 double z)
13271 {
13272 string placement = (ConfigurationManager.AppSettings[BaseAvoidanceLabelPlacementSettingKey] ?? "TopRight").Trim();
13273 double maxX = min.X + planeSize;
13274 double maxY = min.Y + planeSize;
13275
13276 return placement.Equals("BottomLeft", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
13277 ? (new Point3D(min.X, min.Y - outsideOffset, z), Text.alignmentType.MiddleLeft)
13278 : placement.Equals("TopLeft", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
13279 ? (new Point3D(min.X, maxY + outsideOffset, z), Text.alignmentType.MiddleLeft)
13280 : placement.Equals("BottomRight", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
13281 ? (new Point3D(maxX, min.Y - outsideOffset, z), Text.alignmentType.MiddleRight)
13282 : (new Point3D(maxX, maxY + outsideOffset, z), Text.alignmentType.MiddleRight);
13283 }
