13344 private void AddPartOrigins(IEnumerable<Entity>? specificEntities = null, string? sourcePath = null)
13345 {
13346 if (_designControl == null) return;
13347
13348 IEnumerable<Entity> entitiesToProcess;
13349 if (specificEntities != null)
13350 {
13351 entitiesToProcess = specificEntities.Where(IsValidPartEntity);
13352 }
13353 else
13354 {
13355 entitiesToProcess = _designControl.Entities.Where(IsValidPartEntity);
13356 }
13357
13358 if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(sourcePath))
13359 {
13360 entitiesToProcess = entitiesToProcess.Where(e => string.Equals(GetPartSourceKey(e), sourcePath, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));
13361 }
13362
13363 if (!entitiesToProcess.Any()) return;
13364
13365 Point3D min = new Point3D(double.MaxValue, double.MaxValue, double.MaxValue);
13366 Point3D max = new Point3D(double.MinValue, double.MinValue, double.MinValue);
13367
13368 foreach (var ent in entitiesToProcess)
13369 {
13370 ent.UpdateBoundingBox(new devDept.Eyeshot.TraversalParams());
13371 if (ent.BoxMin.X < min.X) min.X = ent.BoxMin.X;
13372 if (ent.BoxMin.Y < min.Y) min.Y = ent.BoxMin.Y;
13373 if (ent.BoxMin.Z < min.Z) min.Z = ent.BoxMin.Z;
13374
13375 if (ent.BoxMax.X > max.X) max.X = ent.BoxMax.X;
13376 if (ent.BoxMax.Y > max.Y) max.Y = ent.BoxMax.Y;
13377 if (ent.BoxMax.Z > max.Z) max.Z = ent.BoxMax.Z;
13378 }
13379
13380 // Clean up any existing origin symbol and grid for this specific source path first to prevent duplication
13381 if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(sourcePath))
13382 {
13383 string originTag = $"PART_ORIGIN:{sourcePath}";
13384 var existingOrigins = _designControl.Entities
13385 .Where(e => e.EntityData is string tag && string.Equals(tag, originTag, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
13386 .ToList();
13387
13388 foreach (var o in existingOrigins)
13389 {
13390 if (o is BlockReference oldBr && _designControl.Viewports.Count > 0)
13391 {
13392 var oldMin = oldBr.InsertionPoint;
13393 var gridToRemove = _designControl.Viewports[0].Grids
13394 .Skip(1) // Skip main grid
13395 .FirstOrDefault(g => Math.Abs(g.Plane.Origin.X - oldMin.X) < 1.0 &&
13396 Math.Abs(g.Plane.Origin.Y - oldMin.Y) < 1.0 &&
13397 Math.Abs(g.Plane.Origin.Z - oldMin.Z) < 1.0);
13398 if (gridToRemove != null)
13399 {
13400 _designControl.Viewports[0].Grids.Remove(gridToRemove);
13401 }
13402 }
13403 _designControl.Entities.Remove(o);
13404 }
13405 }
13406 else
13407 {
13408 var existingOrigins = _designControl.Entities
13409 .Where(e => e.EntityData is string tag && string.Equals(tag, "PART_ORIGIN", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
13410 .ToList();
13411
13412 foreach (var o in existingOrigins)
13413 {
13414 if (o is BlockReference oldBr && _designControl.Viewports.Count > 0)
13415 {
13416 var oldMin = oldBr.InsertionPoint;
13417 var gridToRemove = _designControl.Viewports[0].Grids
13418 .Skip(1)
13419 .FirstOrDefault(g => Math.Abs(g.Plane.Origin.X - oldMin.X) < 1.0 &&
13420 Math.Abs(g.Plane.Origin.Y - oldMin.Y) < 1.0 &&
13421 Math.Abs(g.Plane.Origin.Z - oldMin.Z) < 1.0);
13422 if (gridToRemove != null)
13423 {
13424 _designControl.Viewports[0].Grids.Remove(gridToRemove);
13425 }
13426 }
13427 _designControl.Entities.Remove(o);
13428 }
13429 }
13430
13431 string baseBlockName = "OriginSymbol";
13432 if (!_designControl.Blocks.Contains(baseBlockName))
13433 {
13434 var b = new Block(baseBlockName);
13435 var l1 = new devDept.Eyeshot.Entities.Line(0, 0, 0, 20, 0, 0) { Color = System.Drawing.Color.Red, ColorMethod = colorMethodType.byEntity, LineWeight = 2, LineWeightMethod = colorMethodType.byEntity };
13436 var l2 = new devDept.Eyeshot.Entities.Line(0, 0, 0, 0, 20, 0) { Color = System.Drawing.Color.Green, ColorMethod = colorMethodType.byEntity, LineWeight = 2, LineWeightMethod = colorMethodType.byEntity };
13437 var l3 = new devDept.Eyeshot.Entities.Line(0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 20) { Color = System.Drawing.Color.Blue, ColorMethod = colorMethodType.byEntity, LineWeight = 2, LineWeightMethod = colorMethodType.byEntity };
13438 b.Entities.Add(l1);
13439 b.Entities.Add(l2);
13440 b.Entities.Add(l3);
13441 _designControl.Blocks.Add(b);
13442 }
13443
13444 var br = new BlockReference(min.X, min.Y, min.Z, baseBlockName, 1);
13445 br.EntityData = string.IsNullOrEmpty(sourcePath) ? "PART_ORIGIN" : $"PART_ORIGIN:{sourcePath}";
13446 _designControl.Entities.Add(br);
13447
13448 if (_designControl.Viewports.Count > 0)
13449 {
13450 var grid = new devDept.Eyeshot.Control.Grid();
13451 grid.Plane = new Plane(min, Vector3D.AxisX, Vector3D.AxisY);
13452 grid.Step = 10;
13453 grid.Min = new Point2D(0, 0);
13454
13455 double maxDim = Math.Max(Math.Max(50, max.X - min.X), Math.Max(50, max.Y - min.Y));
13456 maxDim = Math.Ceiling(maxDim / 10.0) * 10.0;
13457 grid.Max = new Point2D(maxDim, maxDim);
13458
13459 grid.Lighting = false;
13460 grid.Visible = showOriginGrids;
13461 _designControl.Viewports[0].Grids.Add(grid);
13462
13463 if (ReadBoolAppSetting(BaseAvoidanceShowOnImportSettingKey, false))
13464 {
13465 AddBaseAvoidancePlaneVisuals(min, maxDim, sourcePath);
13466 }
13467 }
13468 }

13475 private bool IsSectionCandidateEntity(Entity ent)
13476 {

13478
13479 if (_manualMarkingSpheres.Contains(ent) ||
13480 _measurementPointSpheres.Contains(ent) ||
13481 _allControlPointSpheres.Contains(ent) ||
13482 _visualsManager.ControlPointSpheres.Contains(ent))
13483 {

13490 entityData == "SECTION_VISUAL" ||
13491 entityData == "IgnoredOverlay_Ref")
13492 {
13493 return false;
13494 }
13495 }

13497 if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(ent.LayerName))
13498 {
13499 if (ent.LayerName.StartsWith("SHELL_", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
13500 ent.LayerName.StartsWith(PathManager.PATH_LAYER_PREFIX, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
13501 ent.LayerName.Contains("IGNORED", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
13502 ent.LayerName.Equals("SECTION_VISUAL", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
13503 {
13504 return false;
13505 }
13506 }
13507
13508 return true;

13517 private (CADFace Face, Brep Brep) FindClosestFace(Point3D pt)
13518 {
13519 CADFace? closestFace = null;
13520 Brep? closestBrep = null;
13521 double minDistance = double.MaxValue;
13522
13523 if (_allFacesByColor != null)
13524 {
13525 foreach (var face in _allFacesByColor.Values.SelectMany(f => f))
13526 {
13527 if (face.EntityIndex >= 0 && face.EntityIndex < _designControl.Entities.Count)
13528 {
13529 var brep = _designControl.Entities[face.EntityIndex] as Brep;
13530 if (brep != null)
13531 {
13532 Point3D projected = EyeshotGeometryUtils.ProjectPointToFaceSurface(pt, brep, face.FaceIndex);
13533 double dist = pt.DistanceTo(projected);
13534 if (dist < minDistance)
13535 {
13536 minDistance = dist;
13537 closestFace = face;
13538 closestBrep = brep;
13539 }
13540 }
13541 }
13542 }
13543 }
13544
13545 if (closestFace == null && _designControl != null && _designControl.Entities != null)
13546 {
13547 for (int entIdx = 0; entIdx < _designControl.Entities.Count; entIdx++)
13548 {
13549 if (_designControl.Entities[entIdx] is Brep brep)
13550 {
13551 for (int faceIdx = 0; faceIdx < brep.Faces.Length; faceIdx++)
13552 {
13553 try
13554 {
13555 Point3D projected = EyeshotGeometryUtils.ProjectPointToFaceSurface(pt, brep, faceIdx);
13556 double dist = pt.DistanceTo(projected);
13557 if (dist < minDistance)
13558 {
13559 minDistance = dist;
13560 closestBrep = brep;
13561 closestFace = new CADFace
13562 {
13563 EntityIndex = entIdx,
13564 FaceIndex = faceIdx,
13565 FaceColor = brep.Faces[faceIdx].Color ?? System.Drawing.Color.White
13566 };
13567 }
13568 }
13569 catch { }
13570 }
13571 }
13572 }
13573 }
13574
13575 return (closestFace!, closestBrep!);
13576 }
13577
13585 private Point3D SnapToClosestPartSurface(Point3D point, out Vector3D normal, out Entity? closestPart)
13586 {
13587 closestPart = null;
13588 normal = Vector3D.AxisZ;
13589 Point3D bestSnappedPoint = (Point3D)point.Clone();
13590 double minDistance = double.MaxValue;
13591
13592 var parts = GetSectionCandidateParts();
13593 foreach (var part in parts)
13594 {
13595 Point3D snappedPt = (Point3D)point.Clone();
13596 Vector3D partNormal = Vector3D.AxisZ;
13597 bool success = false;
13598
13599 try
13600 {
13601 if (part is Brep brep)
13602 {
13603 // Convert BREP to mesh for closest-point search
13604 var brepMesh = brep.ConvertToMesh();
13605 if (brepMesh != null && brepMesh.Triangles != null && brepMesh.Vertices != null)
13606 {
13607 double closestDist = double.MaxValue;
13608 int bestTriIdx = -1;
13609 Point3D bestClosest = point;
13610
13611 for (int ti = 0; ti < brepMesh.Triangles.Length; ti++)
13612 {
13613 var tri = brepMesh.Triangles[ti];
13614 var tv1 = brepMesh.Vertices[tri.V1];
13615 var tv2 = brepMesh.Vertices[tri.V2];
13616 var tv3 = brepMesh.Vertices[tri.V3];
13617 var cp = EyeshotGeometryUtils.ClosestPointOnTriangle(point, tv1, tv2, tv3);
13618 double d = point.DistanceTo(cp);
13619 if (d < closestDist)
13620 {
13621 closestDist = d;
13622 bestClosest = cp;
13623 bestTriIdx = ti;
13624 }
13625 }
13626
13627 snappedPt = bestClosest;
13628
13629 // Get face normal using Brep API; fall back to mesh triangle cross product
13630 if (bestTriIdx >= 0)
13631 {
13632 bool gotNormal = false;
13633 for (int fi = 0; fi < brep.Faces.Length; fi++)
13634 {
13635 try
13636 {
13637 var fn = brep.Faces[fi].Normal(snappedPt);
13638 if (fn != null && fn.Length > 1e-6)
13639 {
13640 partNormal = fn;
13641 partNormal.Normalize();
13642 gotNormal = true;
13643 break;
13644 }
13645 }
13646 catch { }
13647 }
13648 if (!gotNormal)
13649 {
13650 var tri = brepMesh.Triangles[bestTriIdx];
13651 var tv1 = brepMesh.Vertices[tri.V1];
13652 var tv2 = brepMesh.Vertices[tri.V2];
13653 var tv3 = brepMesh.Vertices[tri.V3];
13654 var e1 = new Vector3D(tv1, tv2);
13655 var e2 = new Vector3D(tv1, tv3);
13656 partNormal = Vector3D.Cross(e1, e2);
13657 if (partNormal.Length > 1e-6) partNormal.Normalize();
13658 }
13659 }
13660 success = true;
13661 }
13662 }
13663 else if (part is Mesh mesh)
13664 {
13665 if (mesh.Triangles != null && mesh.Vertices != null)
13666 {
13667 double closestDist = double.MaxValue;
13668 int bestTriIdx = -1;
13669 Point3D bestClosest = point;
13670
13671 for (int ti = 0; ti < mesh.Triangles.Length; ti++)
13672 {
13673 var tri = mesh.Triangles[ti];
13674 var tv1 = mesh.Vertices[tri.V1];
13675 var tv2 = mesh.Vertices[tri.V2];
13676 var tv3 = mesh.Vertices[tri.V3];
13677 var cp = EyeshotGeometryUtils.ClosestPointOnTriangle(point, tv1, tv2, tv3);
13678 double d = point.DistanceTo(cp);
13679 if (d < closestDist)
13680 {
13681 closestDist = d;
13682 bestClosest = cp;
13683 bestTriIdx = ti;
13684 }
13685 }
13686
13687 snappedPt = bestClosest;
13688
13689 if (bestTriIdx >= 0)
13690 {
13691 var tri = mesh.Triangles[bestTriIdx];
13692 var tv1 = mesh.Vertices[tri.V1];
13693 var tv2 = mesh.Vertices[tri.V2];
13694 var tv3 = mesh.Vertices[tri.V3];
13695 var e1 = new Vector3D(tv1, tv2);
13696 var e2 = new Vector3D(tv1, tv3);
13697 partNormal = Vector3D.Cross(e1, e2);
13698 if (partNormal.Length > 1e-6) partNormal.Normalize();
13699 }
13700 success = true;
13701 }
13702 }
13703 }
13704 catch (Exception ex)
13705 {
13706 Debug.WriteLine($"SnapToClosestPartSurface: skipping part {part?.GetType().Name}: {ex.Message}");
13707 }
13708
13709 if (success)
13710 {
13711 double dist = point.DistanceTo(snappedPt);
13712 if (dist < minDistance)
13713 {
13714 minDistance = dist;
13715 bestSnappedPoint = snappedPt;
13716 normal = partNormal;
13717 closestPart = part;
13718 }
13719 }
13720 }
13721
13722 return bestSnappedPoint;
13723 }

13729 private List<Entity> GetSectionCandidateParts()
13730 {
13731 if (_designControl == null || _designControl.Entities == null) return new List<Entity>();
13732 return _designControl.Entities.Where(IsSectionCandidateEntity).ToList();
13733 }
13734
13740 private Entity? GetClosestPart(List<Entity> parts)
13741 {
13742 if (parts == null || !parts.Any() || _designControl == null) return null;
13743
13744 var cameraLoc = _designControl.Camera.Location;
13745 double minDistance = double.MaxValue;
13746 Entity? closestPart = null;
13747
13748 foreach (var p in parts)
13749 {
13750 p.UpdateBoundingBox(new devDept.Eyeshot.TraversalParams());
13751 Point3D center = new Point3D(
13752 (p.BoxMin.X + p.BoxMax.X) / 2,
13753 (p.BoxMin.Y + p.BoxMax.Y) / 2,
13754 (p.BoxMin.Z + p.BoxMax.Z) / 2);
13755 double dist = center.DistanceTo(cameraLoc);
13756 if (dist < minDistance)
13757 {
13758 minDistance = dist;
13759 closestPart = p;
13760 }
13761 }
13762 return closestPart;
13763 }
13764
13769 private Entity? GetTargetPartForSection()
13770 {
13771 var parts = GetSectionCandidateParts();
13772 if (!parts.Any()) return null;
13773
13774 // 1. Priority: Currently selected part
13775 var targetPart = parts.FirstOrDefault(ent => ent.Selected);
13776
13777 // 2. Fallback: Face the user last clicked
13778 if (targetPart == null && _visualsManager?.CurrentSelectedFace != null &&
13779 _visualsManager.CurrentSelectedFace.EntityIndex >= 0 &&
13780 _visualsManager.CurrentSelectedFace.EntityIndex < _designControl.Entities.Count)
13781 {
13782 var faceEntity = _designControl.Entities[_visualsManager.CurrentSelectedFace.EntityIndex];
13783 if (parts.Contains(faceEntity))
13784 {
13785 targetPart = faceEntity;
13786 }
13787 }
13788
13789 // 3. Fallback: Closest part to camera
13790 return targetPart ?? GetClosestPart(parts);
13791 }

13881 if (_designControl != null && _designControl.Entities.Contains(kvp.Key))
13882 {
13883 kvp.Key.Visible = kvp.Value;

13888 foreach (var kvp in _preSectionGridVisibility)

13894 if (_designControl != null && _designControl.Viewports.Count > 0 && _designControl.Viewports[0].ToolBars.Count > 0)
13895 {
13896 var btn = _designControl.Viewports[0].ToolBars[0].Buttons.FirstOrDefault(b => b.Name == "SectionViewMain") as ToolBarButton;

13913 private void UpdateSectionPlane()
13914 {
13915 if (_designControl == null || SectionViewOverlayVisibility != Visibility.Visible) return;
13916
13917 var parts = GetSectionCandidateParts();
13918 if (!parts.Any()) return;
13919 var targetPart = GetTargetPartForSection();
13920 if (targetPart == null) return;
13921
13922 targetPart.UpdateBoundingBox(new devDept.Eyeshot.TraversalParams());
13923
13924 // Hide other parts to isolate section view
13925 foreach (var part in parts)
13926 {
13927 if (part != targetPart)
13928 {
13929 if (!_preSectionVisibility.ContainsKey(part))
13930 {
13931 _preSectionVisibility[part] = part.Visible;
13932 }
13933 part.Visible = false;
13934 }
13935 }
13936
13937 var min = targetPart.BoxMin;
13938 var size = targetPart.BoxSize;
13939
13940 // Hide other origins and grids
13941 var origins = _designControl.Entities.Where(e => (e.EntityData as string) == "PART_ORIGIN").ToList();
13942 foreach (var origin in origins)
13943 {
13944 if (origin is devDept.Eyeshot.Entities.BlockReference br)
13945 {
13946 bool isTargetOrigin = Math.Abs(br.InsertionPoint.X - min.X) < 1 &&
13947 Math.Abs(br.InsertionPoint.Y - min.Y) < 1 &&
13948 Math.Abs(br.InsertionPoint.Z - min.Z) < 1;
13949 if (!isTargetOrigin)
13950 {
13951 if (!_preSectionVisibility.ContainsKey(origin))
13952 _preSectionVisibility[origin] = origin.Visible;
13953 origin.Visible = false;
13954 }
13955 }
13956 }
13957
13958 if (_designControl.Viewports.Count > 0)
13959 {
13960 foreach (var grid in _designControl.Viewports[0].Grids)
13961 {
13962 if (grid == _designControl.Viewports[0].Grids[0]) continue; // Skip main grid
13963
13964 bool isTargetGrid = Math.Abs(grid.Plane.Origin.X - min.X) < 1 &&
13965 Math.Abs(grid.Plane.Origin.Y - min.Y) < 1 &&
13966 Math.Abs(grid.Plane.Origin.Z - min.Z) < 1;
13967 if (!isTargetGrid)
13968 {
13969 if (!_preSectionGridVisibility.ContainsKey(grid))
13970 _preSectionGridVisibility[grid] = grid.Visible;
13971 grid.Visible = false;
13972 }
13973 }
13974 }
13975
13976 Plane plane;
13977 Point3D planeOrigin;
13978 double planeWidth, planeHeight;
13979
13980 switch (sectionPlaneAxis)
13981 {
13982 case "X":
13983 planeOrigin = new Point3D(min.X + SectionPlanePosition, min.Y, min.Z);
13984 plane = new Plane(planeOrigin, Vector3D.AxisY, Vector3D.AxisZ);
13985 SectionPlaneMaxPosition = size.X;
13986 planeWidth = size.Y + 20; // 10 padding on each side based on grid
13987 planeHeight = size.Z + 20;
13988 break;
13989 case "Y":
13990 planeOrigin = new Point3D(min.X, min.Y + SectionPlanePosition, min.Z);
13991 plane = new Plane(planeOrigin, Vector3D.AxisX, Vector3D.AxisZ);
13992 SectionPlaneMaxPosition = size.Y;
13993 planeWidth = size.X + 20;
13994 planeHeight = size.Z + 20;
13995 break;
13996 case "Z":
13997 default:
13998 planeOrigin = new Point3D(min.X, min.Y, min.Z + SectionPlanePosition);
13999 plane = new Plane(planeOrigin, Vector3D.AxisX, Vector3D.AxisY);
14000 SectionPlaneMaxPosition = size.Z;
14001 planeWidth = size.X + 20;
14002 planeHeight = size.Y + 20;
14003 break;
14004 }
14005
14006 if (_designControl.ClippingPlane1 != null)
14007 {
14008 _designControl.ClippingPlane1.Plane = plane;
14009 _designControl.ClippingPlane1.Capping = false;
14010 _designControl.ClippingPlane1.Active = true;
14011 }
14012
14013 // Optional: Draw a visual boundary for the plane
14014 _designControl.Invalidate();
14015 _ignoredItemManager?.SyncVisibility();
14016
14017 // Auto-update section view window if it's open
14018 if (_activeSectionWindow != null && _activeSectionWindow.IsLoaded)
14019 {
14020 ShowSectionViewWindow();
14021 }
14022 }
14023
14029 private void ObjectManipulator_SectionPlaneDrag(object sender, devDept.Eyeshot.Control.ObjectManipulator.ObjectManipulatorEventArgs e)
14030 {
14031 if (_designControl == null || SectionViewOverlayVisibility != Visibility.Visible || _designControl.ClippingPlane1 == null) return;
14032
14033 // Extract the new translation from the manipulator
14034 var newTrans = _designControl.ObjectManipulator.Transformation;
14035
14036 // Extract position based on axis
14037 double newPosition = 0;
14038 var targetPart = GetTargetPartForSection();
14039 if (targetPart == null) return;
14040
14041 targetPart.UpdateBoundingBox(new devDept.Eyeshot.TraversalParams());
14042 var min = targetPart.BoxMin;
14043
14044 switch (sectionPlaneAxis)
14045 {
14046 case "X":
14047 newPosition = newTrans.Matrix[0, 3] - min.X;
14048 break;
14049 case "Y":
14050 newPosition = newTrans.Matrix[1, 3] - min.Y;
14051 break;
14052 case "Z":
14053 default:
14054 newPosition = newTrans.Matrix[2, 3] - min.Z;
14055 break;
14056 }
14057
14058 // Set the value via property to trigger UI updates and plane sync
14059 SectionPlanePosition = newPosition;
14060
14061 // Update the clipping plane position
14062 var currentPlane = _designControl.ClippingPlane1.Plane;
14063 currentPlane.Origin = new Point3D(newTrans.Matrix[0, 3], newTrans.Matrix[1, 3], newTrans.Matrix[2, 3]);
14064 _designControl.ClippingPlane1.Plane = currentPlane;
14065
14066 // Ensure SectionViewWindow updates in real-time if open
14067 if (_activeSectionWindow != null && _activeSectionWindow.IsLoaded)
14068 {
14069 ShowSectionViewWindow();
14070 }
14071
14072 var oldVisual = _designControl.Entities.FirstOrDefault(ent => ent.EntityData as string == "SECTION_VISUAL") as devDept.Eyeshot.Entities.Mesh;
14073 if (oldVisual != null)
14074 {
14075 _designControl.Entities.Remove(oldVisual);
14076
14077 double pWidth = 0, pHeight = 0;
14078 switch (sectionPlaneAxis)
14079 {
14080 case "X": pWidth = targetPart.BoxSize.Y + 20; pHeight = targetPart.BoxSize.Z + 20; break;
14081 case "Y": pWidth = targetPart.BoxSize.X + 20; pHeight = targetPart.BoxSize.Z + 20; break;
14082 case "Z": default: pWidth = targetPart.BoxSize.X + 20; pHeight = targetPart.BoxSize.Y + 20; break;
14083 }
14084 var p1 = currentPlane.Origin;
14085 var p2 = currentPlane.Origin + currentPlane.AxisX * pWidth;
14086 var p3 = currentPlane.Origin + currentPlane.AxisX * pWidth + currentPlane.AxisY * pHeight;
14087 var p4 = currentPlane.Origin + currentPlane.AxisY * pHeight;
14088
14089 devDept.Eyeshot.Entities.LinearPath lp = new devDept.Eyeshot.Entities.LinearPath(p1, p2, p3, p4, p1);
14090 var visualPlane = lp.ExtrudeAsMesh(currentPlane.AxisZ * 0.2, 0.01, devDept.Eyeshot.Entities.Mesh.natureType.Plain);
14091 visualPlane.Translate(currentPlane.AxisZ * -0.1);
14092
14093 visualPlane.EntityData = "SECTION_VISUAL";
14094 visualPlane.LayerName = "SECTION_VISUAL";
14095 visualPlane.Color = System.Drawing.Color.FromArgb(100, System.Drawing.Color.Red);
14096 visualPlane.ColorMethod = colorMethodType.byEntity;
14097 _designControl.Entities.Add(visualPlane);
14098 }
14099
14100 _designControl.Invalidate();
14101 }

14103 private SectionViewWindow? _activeSectionWindow = null;
14104 private List<LinearDim>? _lastSectionMeasurements = null;
14105 private devDept.Geometry.Plane? _lastSectionPlane = null;
14106
14110 private void ShowSectionViewWindow()
14111 {
14112 try
14113 {
14114 // Calculate section curves
14115 var plane = _designControl.ClippingPlane1.Plane;
14116 var curves = new List<ICurve>();
14117
14118 var targetPart = GetTargetPartForSection();
14119 if (targetPart == null) return;
14120 int targetEntityIndex = _designControl.Entities.IndexOf(targetPart);
14121
14122 var cadFaces = _allFacesByColor.Values.SelectMany(f => f).ToList();
14123 var cadFacesToProcess = cadFaces.Where(f => f.EntityIndex == targetEntityIndex).ToList();
14124 bool generatedAny = false;
14125
14126 if (cadFacesToProcess.Any())
14127 {
14128 var ent = _designControl.Entities[targetEntityIndex];
14129 if (ent is Brep brep)
14130 {
14131 var clone = (Brep)brep.Clone();
14132 try { clone.Regen(0.1); } catch { }
14133
14134 foreach (var cadFace in cadFacesToProcess)
14135 {
14136 if (cadFace.FaceIndex >= 0 && cadFace.FaceIndex < clone.Faces.Length)
14137 {
14138 var face = clone.Faces[cadFace.FaceIndex];
14139 var mesh = face.ConvertToMesh();
14140 if (mesh != null)
14141 {
14142 var sectionCurves = mesh.Section(plane, 0.01);
14143 if (sectionCurves != null && sectionCurves.Length > 0)
14144 {
14145 foreach (var curve in sectionCurves)
14146 {
14147 if (curve is Entity curveEnt)
14148 {
14149 curveEnt.Color = cadFace.FaceColor;
14150 curveEnt.ColorMethod = colorMethodType.byEntity;
14151 curveEnt.LineWeight = 2;
14152 curveEnt.LineWeightMethod = colorMethodType.byEntity;
14153
14154 // Store CADHole or CADFace for Context Menu
14155 if (_faceIndexToHoleMap != null && _faceIndexToHoleMap.TryGetValue(cadFace.FaceGlobalIndex, out var cadHole))
14156 curveEnt.EntityData = cadHole;
14157 else
14158 curveEnt.EntityData = cadFace;
14159
14160 curves.Add(curve);
14161 }
14162 }
14163 generatedAny = true;
14164 }
14165 }
14166 }
14167 }
14168 }
14169 }
14170 else
14171 {
14172 // Fallback: faces not yet extracted
14173 if (targetPart is Brep brep)
14174 {
14175 var clone = (Brep)brep.Clone();
14176 try { clone.Regen(0.1); } catch { }
14177
14178 for (int fIdx = 0; fIdx < clone.Faces.Length; fIdx++)
14179 {
14180 var face = clone.Faces[fIdx];
14181 var mesh = face.ConvertToMesh();
14182 if (mesh == null) continue;
14183
14184 var sectionCurves = mesh.Section(plane, 0.01);
14185 if (sectionCurves == null || sectionCurves.Length == 0) continue;
14186
14187 // Use the face's own color, or fall back to the entity color
14188 var faceColor = face.Color ?? targetPart.Color;
14189
14190 foreach (var curve in sectionCurves)
14191 {
14192 if (curve is Entity curveEnt)
14193 {
14194 curveEnt.Color = faceColor;
14195 curveEnt.ColorMethod = colorMethodType.byEntity;
14196 curveEnt.LineWeight = 2;
14197 curveEnt.LineWeightMethod = colorMethodType.byEntity;
14198 // No EntityData — faces haven't been extracted yet, so no properties to show
14199 curves.Add(curve);
14200 }
14201 }
14202 generatedAny = true;
14203 }
14204 }
14205 else if (targetPart is Mesh mesh)
14206 {
14207 var sectionCurves = mesh.Section(plane, 0.01);
14208 if (sectionCurves != null) { curves.AddRange(sectionCurves); generatedAny = true; }
14209 }
14210 }
14211
14212 if (!generatedAny)
14213 {
14214 MessageBox.Show(GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "MessageBox_EmptySectionViewSlice") ?? "No section curves generated. The plane might not intersect any part.", "Section View", MessageBoxButton.OK, MessageBoxImage.Information);
14215 return;
14216 }
14217
14218 var existingWindow = _activeSectionWindow;
14219 if (existingWindow != null && existingWindow.IsLoaded)
14220 {
14221 existingWindow.UpdateCurves(curves, plane);
14222 }
14223 else
14224 {
14225 // Check if we have saved measurements for this exact plane
14226 List<LinearDim>? dimsToRestore = null;
14227 if (_lastSectionPlane != null && plane.Equals(_lastSectionPlane))
14228 {
14229 dimsToRestore = _lastSectionMeasurements;
14230 }
14231
14232 // Create and show the new window
14233 _activeSectionWindow = new SectionViewWindow(this, curves, DocLanguage, plane, (dims) =>
14234 {
14235 // Clone dimensions before the window (and its entities) are disposed
14236 _lastSectionMeasurements = dims.Select(d => (LinearDim)d.Clone()).ToList();
14237 _lastSectionPlane = plane;
14238 Application.Current.Dispatcher.Invoke(DeactivateSectionView);
14239 }, dimsToRestore);
14240
14241 _activeSectionWindow.Owner = MainParent;
14242 _activeSectionWindow.Show();
14243 _activeSectionWindow.Closed += SectionWindow_Closed;
14244 }
14245 }
14246 catch (Exception ex)
14247 {
14248 Debug.WriteLine($"Error in ShowSectionViewWindow: {ex.Message}");
14249 MessageBox.Show($"Failed to open Section View:\n{ex.Message}\n\n{ex.StackTrace}", GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "MessageBox_InternalError") ?? "Section View Error", MessageBoxButton.OK, MessageBoxImage.Error);
14250 }
14251 }

14358 private static bool TryGetApproachMeasurementIndex(ColorPath path, int pointIndex, out int measurementIndex)
14359 {
14360 measurementIndex = -1;
14361 if (path == null || path.Points == null || path.IsMeasure == null ||
14362 pointIndex < 0 || pointIndex >= path.Points.Count)
14363 {
14364 return false;
14365 }
14366
14367 if (path.PointTypes != null && pointIndex < path.PointTypes.Count &&
14368 string.Equals(path.PointTypes[pointIndex], "scanpoints", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
14369 {
14370 return false;
14371 }
14372
14373 if (pointIndex < path.IsMeasure.Count && path.IsMeasure[pointIndex])
14374 return false;
14375
14376 if (pointIndex + 1 < path.Points.Count &&
14377 pointIndex + 1 < path.IsMeasure.Count &&
14378 path.IsMeasure[pointIndex + 1])
14379 {
14380 measurementIndex = pointIndex + 1;
14381 return true;
14382 }
14383
14384 if (pointIndex > 0 && pointIndex - 1 < path.IsMeasure.Count && path.IsMeasure[pointIndex - 1])
14385 {
14386 measurementIndex = pointIndex - 1;
14387 return true;
14388 }
14389
14390 return false;
14391 }
14392
14393 private static List<WaypointReference> GetValidWaypointReferences(WaypointData waypointData)
14394 {
14395 var result = new List<WaypointReference>();
14396 foreach (var reference in waypointData.GetReferences())
14397 {
14398 if (reference.Path == null || reference.Path.Points == null ||
14399 reference.PointIndex < 0 || reference.PointIndex >= reference.Path.Points.Count)
14400 {
14401 continue;
14402 }
14403
14404 if (!result.Any(existing =>
14405 ReferenceEquals(existing.Path, reference.Path) &&
14406 existing.PointIndex == reference.PointIndex))
14407 {
14408 result.Add(reference);
14409 }
14410 }
14411
14412 return result;
14413 }
14414
14415 private static bool IsSurfaceMeasurementReference(WaypointReference reference)
14416 {
14417 if (reference.Path.IsMeasure == null ||
14418 reference.PointIndex >= reference.Path.IsMeasure.Count ||
14419 !reference.Path.IsMeasure[reference.PointIndex])
14420 {
14421 return false;
14422 }
14423
14424 return reference.Path.PointTypes == null ||
14425 reference.PointIndex >= reference.Path.PointTypes.Count ||
14426 !string.Equals(
14427 reference.Path.PointTypes[reference.PointIndex],
14428 "scanpoints",
14429 StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
14430 }
14431
14432 private static bool HasSurfaceMeasurementReference(WaypointData waypointData)
14433 {
14434 return GetValidWaypointReferences(waypointData).Any(IsSurfaceMeasurementReference);
14435 }
14436
14442 private List<SharedWaypointMovementChoice> BuildSharedWaypointMovementChoices(
14443 WaypointData waypointData)
14444 {
14445 var constrainedGroups = new List<SharedWaypointMovementChoice>();
14446 var unrestrictedReferences = new List<WaypointReference>();
14447 double toleranceDegrees = Math.Clamp(
14448 _pathManager?.FilterConfig.MeasureAngleToleranceDegrees ?? 1.0,
14449 0.0,
14450 5.0);
14451
14452 foreach (var reference in GetValidWaypointReferences(waypointData))
14453 {
14454 SharedWaypointMovementKind kind;
14455 Vector3D axis;
14456
14457 if (TryGetApproachMeasurementIndex(
14458 reference.Path,
14459 reference.PointIndex,
14460 out int measurementIndex))
14461 {
14462 kind = SharedWaypointMovementKind.ApproachAxis;
14463 axis = measurementIndex < reference.Path.Normals.Count
14464 ? (Vector3D)reference.Path.Normals[measurementIndex].Clone()
14465 : new Vector3D(0, 0, 1);
14466 }
14467 else if (IsSurfaceMeasurementReference(reference))
14468 {
14469 kind = SharedWaypointMovementKind.Surface;
14470 axis = reference.PointIndex < reference.Path.Normals.Count
14471 ? (Vector3D)reference.Path.Normals[reference.PointIndex].Clone()
14472 : new Vector3D(0, 0, 1);
14473 }
14474 else
14475 {
14476 unrestrictedReferences.Add(reference);
14477 continue;
14478 }
14479
14480 if (axis.LengthSquared < 1e-12)
14481 axis = new Vector3D(0, 0, 1);
14482 axis.Normalize();
14483
14484 var compatibleGroup = constrainedGroups.FirstOrDefault(group =>
14485 group.Kind == kind &&
14486 (kind == SharedWaypointMovementKind.ApproachAxis
14487 ? GetDirectedAxisAngleDegrees(group.Axis, axis)
14488 : GetUndirectedAxisAngleDegrees(group.Axis, axis)) <= toleranceDegrees + 1e-9);
14489 if (compatibleGroup == null)
14490 {
14491 compatibleGroup = new SharedWaypointMovementChoice
14492 {
14493 Kind = kind,
14494 Axis = axis
14495 };
14496 constrainedGroups.Add(compatibleGroup);
14497 }
14498
14499 compatibleGroup.References.Add(reference);
14500 }
14501
14502 // Preserve the existing least-freedom behavior when there is only one
14503 // constrained group: unrestricted coincident waypoints move with it. When
14504 // several incompatible axes exist, leave unrestricted points as their own
14505 // explicit choice rather than assigning them to an arbitrary axis.
14506 if (constrainedGroups.Count == 0)
14507 {
14508 if (unrestrictedReferences.Count > 0)
14509 {
14510 var unrestrictedGroup = new SharedWaypointMovementChoice
14511 {
14512 Kind = SharedWaypointMovementKind.Unrestricted
14513 };
14514 unrestrictedGroup.References.AddRange(unrestrictedReferences);
14515 constrainedGroups.Add(unrestrictedGroup);
14516 }
14517 }
14518 else if (constrainedGroups.Count == 1)
14519 {
14520 constrainedGroups[0].References.AddRange(unrestrictedReferences);
14521 }
14522 else if (unrestrictedReferences.Count > 0)
14523 {
14524 var unrestrictedGroup = new SharedWaypointMovementChoice
14525 {
14526 Kind = SharedWaypointMovementKind.Unrestricted
14527 };
14528 unrestrictedGroup.References.AddRange(unrestrictedReferences);
14529 constrainedGroups.Add(unrestrictedGroup);
14530 }
14531
14532 foreach (var group in constrainedGroups)
14533 {
14534 string occurrenceDescription = DescribeWaypointMovementOccurrences(group.References);
14535 switch (group.Kind)
14536 {
14537 case SharedWaypointMovementKind.ApproachAxis:
14538 group.Label = $"Approach axis — {occurrenceDescription} — {FormatMovementAxis(group.Axis)}";
14539 group.ToolTip = "Detach this compatible approach-axis group and move it along the displayed axis.";
14540 break;
14541 case SharedWaypointMovementKind.Surface:
14542 group.Label = $"Surface movement — {occurrenceDescription} — {FormatMovementAxis(group.Axis)}";
14543 group.ToolTip = "Detach this compatible surface group and move it on its measurement surface.";
14544 break;
14545 default:
14546 group.Label = $"Unrestricted — {occurrenceDescription}";
14547 group.ToolTip = "Detach these unrestricted occurrences and move them independently.";
14548 break;
14549 }
14550 }
14551
14552 return constrainedGroups;
14553 }
14554
14555 private static double GetUndirectedAxisAngleDegrees(Vector3D first, Vector3D second)
14556 {
14557 double dot = Math.Clamp(Vector3D.Dot(first, second), -1.0, 1.0);
14558 return Math.Acos(Math.Abs(dot)) * 180.0 / Math.PI;
14559 }
14560
14561 private static double GetDirectedAxisAngleDegrees(Vector3D first, Vector3D second)
14562 {
14563 double dot = Math.Clamp(Vector3D.Dot(first, second), -1.0, 1.0);
14564 return Math.Acos(dot) * 180.0 / Math.PI;
14565 }
14566
14567 private static string DescribeWaypointMovementOccurrences(
14568 IReadOnlyCollection<WaypointReference> references)
14569 {
14570 var first = references.First();
14571 Color color = first.Path.Color;
14572 string colorName = color.IsNamedColor
14573 ? color.Name
14574 : $"RGB {color.R},{color.G},{color.B}";
14575 string firstOccurrence = $"{colorName} point {first.PointIndex + 1}";
14576 return references.Count == 1
14577 ? firstOccurrence
14578 : $"{firstOccurrence} + {references.Count - 1} compatible";
14579 }
14580
14581 private static string FormatMovementAxis(Vector3D axis)
14582 {
14583 return string.Format(
14584 CultureInfo.InvariantCulture,
14585 "axis ({0:0.###}, {1:0.###}, {2:0.###})",
14586 axis.X,
14587 axis.Y,
14588 axis.Z);
14589 }
14590
14596 private bool TryGetSharedWaypointMovementAxis(
14597 WaypointData waypointData,
14598 out Vector3D movementAxis,
14599 out bool incompatible)
14600 {
14601 movementAxis = Vector3D.AxisZ;
14602 incompatible = false;
14603 var constrainedAxes = new List<Vector3D>();
14604 var surfaceNormals = new List<Vector3D>();
14605
14606 foreach (var reference in GetValidWaypointReferences(waypointData))
14607 {
14608 if (IsSurfaceMeasurementReference(reference))
14609 {
14610 Vector3D surfaceNormal = reference.PointIndex < reference.Path.Normals.Count
14611 ? (Vector3D)reference.Path.Normals[reference.PointIndex].Clone()
14612 : Vector3D.AxisZ;
14613 if (surfaceNormal.LengthSquared < 1e-12)
14614 surfaceNormal = Vector3D.AxisZ;
14615 surfaceNormal.Normalize();
14616 surfaceNormals.Add(surfaceNormal);
14617 }
14618
14619 if (!TryGetApproachMeasurementIndex(reference.Path, reference.PointIndex, out int measurementIndex))
14620 continue;
14621
14622 Vector3D axis = measurementIndex < reference.Path.Normals.Count
14623 ? (Vector3D)reference.Path.Normals[measurementIndex].Clone()
14624 : Vector3D.AxisZ;
14625 if (axis.LengthSquared < 1e-12)
14626 axis = Vector3D.AxisZ;
14627 axis.Normalize();
14628 constrainedAxes.Add(axis);
14629 }
14630
14631 double toleranceDegrees = Math.Clamp(
14632 _pathManager?.FilterConfig.MeasureAngleToleranceDegrees ?? 1.0,
14633 0.0,
14634 5.0);
14635
14636 if (surfaceNormals.Count > 1)
14637 {
14638 Vector3D firstSurfaceNormal = surfaceNormals[0];
14639 if (surfaceNormals.Skip(1).Any(normal =>
14640 Math.Acos(Math.Abs(Math.Clamp(Vector3D.Dot(firstSurfaceNormal, normal), -1.0, 1.0))) * 180.0 / Math.PI >
14641 toleranceDegrees + 1e-9))
14642 {
14643 incompatible = true;
14644 return false;
14645 }
14646 }
14647
14648 if (constrainedAxes.Count == 0)
14649 return false;
14650
14651 // A point cannot safely be kept both on an unknown trimmed face and on an
14652 // approach axis. Keep the visual reuse, but do not expose an unsafe motion.
14653 if (surfaceNormals.Count > 0)
14654 {
14655 incompatible = true;
14656 return true;
14657 }
14658
14659 Vector3D referenceAxis = constrainedAxes[0];
14660 Vector3D sum = new Vector3D(referenceAxis.X, referenceAxis.Y, referenceAxis.Z);
14661 for (int i = 1; i < constrainedAxes.Count; i++)
14662 {
14663 Vector3D candidate = constrainedAxes[i];
14664 double dot = Math.Clamp(Vector3D.Dot(referenceAxis, candidate), -1.0, 1.0);
14665 double axisAngleDegrees = Math.Acos(dot) * 180.0 / Math.PI;
14666 if (axisAngleDegrees > toleranceDegrees + 1e-9)
14667 {
14668 incompatible = true;
14669 return true;
14670 }
14671 sum += candidate;
14672 }
14673
14674 if (sum.LengthSquared < 1e-12)
14675 sum = referenceAxis;
14676 sum.Normalize();
14677 movementAxis = sum;
14678 return true;
14679 }
14680
14681 private Point3D ConstrainSharedWaypointPosition(WaypointData waypointData, Point3D candidate)
14682 {
14683 if (!TryGetSharedWaypointMovementAxis(waypointData, out Vector3D axis, out bool incompatible) || incompatible)
14684 return candidate;
14685
14686 Point3D origin = waypointData.OriginalPosition ?? waypointData.Path.Points[waypointData.PointIndex];
14687 double requestedDistance = Vector3D.Dot(new Vector3D(origin, candidate), axis);
14688 double minimumDistance = double.NegativeInfinity;
14689 double maximumDistance = double.PositiveInfinity;
14690
14691 foreach (var reference in GetValidWaypointReferences(waypointData))
14692 {
14693 if (!TryGetApproachMeasurementIndex(reference.Path, reference.PointIndex, out int measurementIndex))
14694 continue;
14695
14696 Point3D measurementPoint = reference.Path.Points[measurementIndex];
14697 Vector3D normal = measurementIndex < reference.Path.Normals.Count
14698 ? (Vector3D)reference.Path.Normals[measurementIndex].Clone()
14699 : Vector3D.AxisZ;
14700 if (normal.LengthSquared < 1e-12)
14701 normal = Vector3D.AxisZ;
14702 normal.Normalize();
14703
14704 double initialHeight = Vector3D.Dot(new Vector3D(measurementPoint, origin), normal);
14705 double coefficient = Vector3D.Dot(axis, normal);
14706 if (Math.Abs(coefficient) < 1e-12)
14707 continue;
14708
14709 double boundary = -initialHeight / coefficient;
14710 if (coefficient > 0.0)
14711 minimumDistance = Math.Max(minimumDistance, boundary);
14712 else
14713 maximumDistance = Math.Min(maximumDistance, boundary);
14714 }
14715
14716 if (minimumDistance <= maximumDistance)
14717 requestedDistance = Math.Clamp(requestedDistance, minimumDistance, maximumDistance);
14718 else
14719 requestedDistance = 0.0;
14720
14721 return origin + axis * requestedDistance;
14722 }
14723
14724 private void ApplySharedWaypointPosition(WaypointData waypointData, Point3D position)
14725 {
14726 var affectedPaths = new HashSet<ColorPath>();
14727 foreach (var reference in GetValidWaypointReferences(waypointData))
14728 {
14729 reference.Path.Points[reference.PointIndex] = (Point3D)position.Clone();
14730 affectedPaths.Add(reference.Path);
14731 }
14732
14733 foreach (var path in affectedPaths)
14734 {
14735 if (path.PathEntity != null)
14736 {
14737 path.PathEntity.Vertices = path.Points.ToArray();
14738 path.PathEntity.Regen(0.1);
14739 }
14740 _pathManager?.UpdatePathSegmentVertices(path);
14741 }
14742 }
14743
14744 private void SetPathPointPositionWithSharedOccurrences(ColorPath path, int pointIndex, Point3D position)
14745 {
14746 Entity? sharedMarker = path.WaypointEntities?.FirstOrDefault(entity =>
14747 entity.EntityData is WaypointData data && data.GetReferences().Any(reference =>
14748 ReferenceEquals(reference.Path, path) && reference.PointIndex == pointIndex));
14749
14750 if (sharedMarker?.EntityData is WaypointData sharedData)
14751 ApplySharedWaypointPosition(sharedData, position);
14752 else if (pointIndex >= 0 && pointIndex < path.Points.Count)
14753 path.Points[pointIndex] = (Point3D)position.Clone();
14754 }
14755
14756 private void UpdateOtherSharedSurfaceMeasurementOccurrences(
14757 WaypointData waypointData,
14758 Point3D originalPosition,
14759 Point3D snappedPosition,
14760 bool primaryWasSurfaceMeasurement)
14761 {
14762 var references = GetValidWaypointReferences(waypointData);
14763 var firstSurfaceReference = references.FirstOrDefault(IsSurfaceMeasurementReference);
14764 if (firstSurfaceReference == null)
14765 return;
14766
14767 Vector3D sharedSurfaceNormal = firstSurfaceReference.PointIndex < firstSurfaceReference.Path.Normals.Count
14768 ? (Vector3D)firstSurfaceReference.Path.Normals[firstSurfaceReference.PointIndex].Clone()
14769 : Vector3D.AxisZ;
14770
14771 if (_draggingMeasurePointBrep != null && _draggingMeasurePointFace != null)
14772 {
14773 try
14774 {
14775 Vector3D exactNormal = _draggingMeasurePointBrep.Faces[_draggingMeasurePointFace.FaceIndex].Normal(snappedPosition);
14776 if (exactNormal != null && exactNormal.LengthSquared > 1e-12)
14777 sharedSurfaceNormal = exactNormal;
14778 }
14779 catch
14780 {
14781 // Retain the generated normal when exact evaluation is unavailable.
14782 }
14783 }
14784
14785 if (sharedSurfaceNormal.LengthSquared < 1e-12)
14786 sharedSurfaceNormal = Vector3D.AxisZ;
14787 sharedSurfaceNormal.Normalize();
14788
14789 foreach (var reference in references.Where(IsSurfaceMeasurementReference))
14790 {
14791 if (primaryWasSurfaceMeasurement &&
14792 ReferenceEquals(reference.Path, waypointData.Path) &&
14793 reference.PointIndex == waypointData.PointIndex)
14794 {
14795 continue;
14796 }
14797
14798 Vector3D occurrenceNormal = new Vector3D(
14799 sharedSurfaceNormal.X,
14800 sharedSurfaceNormal.Y,
14801 sharedSurfaceNormal.Z);
14802 if (reference.PointIndex < reference.Path.Normals.Count &&
14803 Vector3D.Dot(occurrenceNormal, reference.Path.Normals[reference.PointIndex]) < 0.0)
14804 {
14805 occurrenceNormal = new Vector3D(
14806 -occurrenceNormal.X,
14807 -occurrenceNormal.Y,
14808 -occurrenceNormal.Z);
14809 }
14810 reference.Path.Normals[reference.PointIndex] = occurrenceNormal;
14811
14812 foreach (int neighborIndex in new[] { reference.PointIndex - 1, reference.PointIndex + 1 })
14813 {
14814 if (!TryGetApproachMeasurementIndex(reference.Path, neighborIndex, out int measurementIndex) ||
14815 measurementIndex != reference.PointIndex)
14816 {
14817 continue;
14818 }
14819
14820 bool belongsToMeasurement = true;
14821 if (reference.Path.OriginalPoints != null &&
14822 reference.PointIndex < reference.Path.OriginalPoints.Count &&
14823 neighborIndex >= 0 && neighborIndex < reference.Path.OriginalPoints.Count)
14824 {
14825 belongsToMeasurement = reference.Path.OriginalPoints[neighborIndex]
14826 .DistanceTo(reference.Path.OriginalPoints[reference.PointIndex]) <= 100.0;
14827 }
14828 if (!belongsToMeasurement)
14829 continue;
14830
14831 Point3D originalApproachPosition = _indirectlyMovedSharedPoints?
14832 .FirstOrDefault(item =>
14833 ReferenceEquals(item.Path, reference.Path) && item.PointIndex == neighborIndex)
14834 .OldPosition ?? reference.Path.Points[neighborIndex];
14835 double offsetDistance = originalApproachPosition.DistanceTo(originalPosition);
14836 if (offsetDistance < 0.001)
14837 offsetDistance = 15.0;
14838 Point3D approachPosition = snappedPosition + occurrenceNormal * offsetDistance;
14839 SetPathPointPositionWithSharedOccurrences(reference.Path, neighborIndex, approachPosition);
14840 reference.Path.Normals[neighborIndex] = occurrenceNormal;
14841 }
14842 }
14843 }
14844
14845 private void CaptureSharedSurfaceDependentPoints(WaypointData waypointData)
14846 {
14847 _indirectlyMovedSharedPoints ??= new List<(ColorPath Path, int PointIndex, Point3D OldPosition)>();
14848
14849 foreach (var measurementReference in GetValidWaypointReferences(waypointData)
14850 .Where(IsSurfaceMeasurementReference))
14851 {
14852 foreach (int neighborIndex in new[]
14853 {
14854 measurementReference.PointIndex - 1,
14855 measurementReference.PointIndex + 1
14856 })
14857 {
14858 if (!TryGetApproachMeasurementIndex(
14859 measurementReference.Path,
14860 neighborIndex,
14861 out int measurementIndex) ||
14862 measurementIndex != measurementReference.PointIndex)
14863 {
14864 continue;
14865 }
14866
14867 Entity? marker = measurementReference.Path.WaypointEntities?.FirstOrDefault(entity =>
14868 entity.EntityData is WaypointData markerData && markerData.GetReferences().Any(reference =>
14869 ReferenceEquals(reference.Path, measurementReference.Path) &&
14870 reference.PointIndex == neighborIndex));
14871
14872 var dependentReferences = marker?.EntityData is WaypointData sharedData
14873 ? GetValidWaypointReferences(sharedData)
14874 : new List<WaypointReference>
14875 {
14876 new WaypointReference
14877 {
14878 Path = measurementReference.Path,
14879 PointIndex = neighborIndex
14880 }
14881 };
14882
14883 foreach (var dependent in dependentReferences)
14884 {
14885 if (_indirectlyMovedSharedPoints.Any(item =>
14886 ReferenceEquals(item.Path, dependent.Path) &&
14887 item.PointIndex == dependent.PointIndex))
14888 {
14889 continue;
14890 }
14891
14892 _indirectlyMovedSharedPoints.Add((
14893 dependent.Path,
14894 dependent.PointIndex,
14895 (Point3D)dependent.Path.Points[dependent.PointIndex].Clone()));
14896
14897 if (!ReferenceEquals(dependent.Path, waypointData.Path) &&
14898 _otherOverlappingBridgePathsUndoInfo != null &&
14899 !_otherOverlappingBridgePathsUndoInfo.Any(item =>
14900 ReferenceEquals(item.Path, dependent.Path)))
14901 {
14902 _otherOverlappingBridgePathsUndoInfo.Add((
14903 dependent.Path,
14904 dependent.Path.CloneState()));
14905 }
14906 }
14907 }
14908 }
14909 }

14914 private void ManipulateObject(object parameter)
14915 {
14916 try
14917 {
14918 // Identify the main part entity
14919 Entity? partEntity = ResolvePartEntity(parameter);
14920 if (partEntity == null) return;
14921
14922 if (partEntity.EntityData is WaypointData)
14923 {
14924 // Waypoints should be moved via direct mouse dragging. Using ObjectManipulator on them
14925 // is blocked to prevent accidental trajectory recalculation logic.
14926 return;
14927 }
14928
14929 _isPartManipulating = true;
14930 _pathManager?.SavePathSnapshot();
14931
14932 var allParts = _designControl.Entities.Where(IsValidPartEntity).ToList();
14933 bool isMultiPart = allParts.Count > 1;
14934 var shellMeshEntities = _designControl.Entities.Where(e => e.LayerName != null && e.LayerName.StartsWith("SHELL_", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)).ToList();
14935 bool hasShellMesh = shellMeshEntities.Count > 0;
14936 bool moveAllParts = false;
14937
14938 if (isMultiPart && hasShellMesh)
14939 {
14940 var result = MessageBox.Show(GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "MessageBoxQuestion_MoveAllPartsWithShell") ?? "You are moving a part in a multiple part setup. Do you want to move all the parts together? If you choose 'No' to move only this part, the generated shell mesh will become broken and will require regenerating.", "SmartFitSystems", MessageBoxButton.YesNo, MessageBoxImage.Question);
14941 moveAllParts = result == MessageBoxResult.Yes;
14942 }
14943
14944 var associatedEntities = GetManipulationEntitiesForPart(partEntity);
14945 if (moveAllParts)
14946 {
14947 foreach (var part in allParts)
14948 {
14949 var assoc = GetManipulationEntitiesForPart(part);
14950 foreach (var a in assoc)
14951 {
14952 if (!associatedEntities.Contains(a))
14953 associatedEntities.Add(a);
14954 }
14955 }
14956 }
14957
14958 // Always include shell mesh entities so the manipulator captures and moves them
14959 // via Apply(), regardless of whether all parts are being moved together or not.
14960 foreach (var shellMeshEntity in shellMeshEntities)
14961 {
14962 if (!associatedEntities.Contains(shellMeshEntity))
14963 associatedEntities.Add(shellMeshEntity);
14964 }
14965
14966 var entitiesToManipulate = associatedEntities
14967 .Where(e => e != null && !IsPathVisualEntity(e))
14968 .Distinct()
14969 .ToList();
14970
14971 // Select all associated entities
14972 _selectionUtils.ClearDesignControlSelection();
14973 foreach (var ent in entitiesToManipulate)
14974 {
14975 ent.Selected = true;
14976 }
14977
14978 // Calculate manipulator position - Align with Bounding Box min or Part Origin for CNC origin representation
14979 partEntity.UpdateBoundingBox(new devDept.Eyeshot.TraversalParams());
14980 Point3D partOrigin = partEntity.BoxMin;
14981
14982 var originEntity = associatedEntities.FirstOrDefault(e => IsPartOriginEntityForPart(e, partEntity));
14983 if (originEntity is devDept.Eyeshot.Entities.BlockReference brOrigin)
14984 {
14985 partOrigin = brOrigin.InsertionPoint;
14986 }
14987
14988 // Enable manipulator at partOrigin
14989 _initialTriadTrans = devDept.Geometry.Transformation.CreateTranslation(partOrigin.X, partOrigin.Y, partOrigin.Z);
14990 _manipulatingEntity = partEntity;
14991
14992 _designControl.ObjectManipulator.TranslateX.Visible = true;
14993 _designControl.ObjectManipulator.TranslateX.Selectable = true;
14994 _designControl.ObjectManipulator.TranslateY.Visible = true;
14995 _designControl.ObjectManipulator.TranslateY.Selectable = true;
14996 _designControl.ObjectManipulator.TranslateZ.Visible = true;
14997 _designControl.ObjectManipulator.TranslateZ.Selectable = true;
14998
14999 _designControl.ObjectManipulator.RotateX.Visible = true;
15000 _designControl.ObjectManipulator.RotateX.Selectable = true;
15001 _designControl.ObjectManipulator.RotateY.Visible = true;
15002 _designControl.ObjectManipulator.RotateY.Selectable = true;
15003 _designControl.ObjectManipulator.RotateZ.Visible = true;
15004 _designControl.ObjectManipulator.RotateZ.Selectable = true;
15005
15006 _designControl.ObjectManipulator.Ball.Visible = true;
15007 _designControl.ObjectManipulator.Ball.Selectable = true;
15008
15009 _designControl.Invalidate();
15010 _designControl.ObjectManipulator.Enable(_initialTriadTrans, false);
15011
15012 }
15013 catch (Exception ex)
15014 {
15015 Debug.WriteLine($"Error in ManipulateObject: {ex.Message}");
15016 }
15017 }

15024 private static bool IsBridgeManipulationType(string? pointType) =>
15025 string.Equals(pointType, "Bridge", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
15026 string.Equals(pointType, "BridgeIntermediary", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
15027
15033 private static bool IsPathVisualEntity(Entity ent) =>
15034 ent.EntityData is WaypointData ||
15035 ent.EntityData is PathSegmentData ||
15036 (ent.LayerName != null && ent.LayerName.StartsWith(PathManager.PATH_LAYER_PREFIX));
15037
15043 private static bool IsBridgePathVisualEntity(Entity ent)
15044 {
15045 if (ent.EntityData is WaypointData waypointData)
15046 return IsBridgeManipulationType(GetPathPointType(waypointData.Path, waypointData.PointIndex));
15047
15048 if (ent.EntityData is PathSegmentData segmentData)
15049 {
15050 return IsBridgeManipulationType(GetPathPointType(segmentData.Path, segmentData.StartIndex)) ||
15051 IsBridgeManipulationType(GetPathPointType(segmentData.Path, segmentData.EndIndex));
15052 }
15053
15054 return false;
15055 }

15062 private List<Entity> GetManipulationEntitiesForPart(Entity partEntity)
15063 {
15064 var entities = GetAssociatedEntities(partEntity);
15065 int partIndex = _designControl.Entities.IndexOf(partEntity);
15066 if (partIndex >= 0)
15067 {
15068 RepairMissingPathPointOwnershipFromModelGeometry();
15069 var fallbackColors = GetExclusiveFallbackColorsForPart(partIndex);
15070 entities.AddRange(GetPartPathVisualEntities(partIndex, fallbackColors));
15071 }
15072
15073 return entities.Where(e => e != null).Distinct().ToList();

15082 private List<Entity> GetPartPathVisualEntities(int partIndex, HashSet<Color> exclusiveFallbackColors)
15083 {
15084 var result = new List<Entity>();
15085 if (_pathManager == null || _pathManager.ColorPaths == null || !_pathManager.ColorPaths.Any())
15086 return result;
15087
15088 foreach (var ent in _designControl.Entities)
15089 {
15090 if (ent == null)
15091 continue;
15092
15093 if (ent.EntityData is WaypointData waypointData)
15094 {
15095 if (IsNonBridgePathPointForPart(waypointData.Path, waypointData.PointIndex, partIndex, exclusiveFallbackColors))
15096 result.Add(ent);
15097 }
15098 else if (ent.EntityData is PathSegmentData segmentData)
15099 {
15100 if (IsNonBridgePathSegmentForPart(segmentData.Path, segmentData.StartIndex, segmentData.EndIndex, partIndex, exclusiveFallbackColors))
15101 {
15102 result.Add(ent);
15103 }
15104 }
15105 }
15106
15107 return result;
15108 }
15109
15116 private HashSet<Color> GetPathColorsForPart(int partIndex, HashSet<Color> exclusiveFallbackColors)
15117 {
15118 var colors = new HashSet<Color>();
15119 if (_pathManager == null || _pathManager.ColorPaths == null)
15120 return colors;
15121
15122 foreach (var kvp in _pathManager.ColorPaths)
15123 {
15124 var path = kvp.Value;
15125 if (path.Points == null)
15126 continue;
15127
15128 if (HasUsablePathPointOwnership(path))
15129 {
15130 if (path.PointEntityIndices.Any(idx => idx == partIndex))
15131 colors.Add(kvp.Key);
15132 }
15133 else if (ColorSetContains(exclusiveFallbackColors, kvp.Key) ||
15134 ColorSetContains(exclusiveFallbackColors, path.Color))
15135 {
15136 colors.Add(kvp.Key);
15137 }
15138 }
15139
15140 return colors;
15141 }
15142
15148 private static HashSet<Color> GetPathColorsFromVisualEntities(IEnumerable<Entity> pathVisualEntities)

15153 if (entity.EntityData is WaypointData waypointData && waypointData.Path != null)
15154 colors.Add(waypointData.Path.Color);
15155 else if (entity.EntityData is PathSegmentData segmentData && segmentData.Path != null)
15156 colors.Add(segmentData.Path.Color);

15158
15159 return colors;

15187 private HashSet<Color> GetExclusiveFallbackColorsForPart(int partIndex)

15198 .Distinct()
15199 .ToList();

15220 private static bool IsNonBridgePathSegmentForPart(ColorPath path, int startIndex, int endIndex, int partIndex, HashSet<Color> exclusiveFallbackColors)
15221 {
15222 if (path == null ||
15223 path.Points == null ||
15224 startIndex < 0 ||
15225 endIndex < 0 ||
15226 startIndex >= path.Points.Count ||
15227 endIndex >= path.Points.Count)
15228 {
15229 return false;
15230 }
15231
15232 if (IsBridgeManipulationType(GetPathPointType(path, startIndex)) ||
15233 IsBridgeManipulationType(GetPathPointType(path, endIndex)))
15234 return false;
15235
15236 bool startPertinent = IsNonBridgePathPointForPart(path, startIndex, partIndex, exclusiveFallbackColors);
15237 bool endPertinent = IsNonBridgePathPointForPart(path, endIndex, partIndex, exclusiveFallbackColors);
15238 if (!startPertinent && !endPertinent)
15239 return false;
15240
15241 return !IsPathPointOwnedByAnotherPart(path, startIndex, partIndex) &&
15242 !IsPathPointOwnedByAnotherPart(path, endIndex, partIndex);
15243 }
15244
15253 private static bool IsNonBridgePathPointForPart(ColorPath path, int pointIndex, int partIndex, HashSet<Color> exclusiveFallbackColors)
15254 {
15255 if (path == null ||
15256 path.Points == null ||
15257 pointIndex < 0 ||
15258 pointIndex >= path.Points.Count)
15259 {
15260 return false;
15261 }
15262
15263 if (IsBridgeManipulationType(GetPathPointType(path, pointIndex)))
15264 return false;
15265
15266 return IsPathPointPertinentToPart(path, pointIndex, partIndex, exclusiveFallbackColors);
15267 }
15268
15277 private static bool IsPathPointPertinentToPart(ColorPath path, int pointIndex, int partIndex, HashSet<Color> exclusiveFallbackColors)
15278 {
15279 if (path == null ||
15280 path.Points == null ||
15281 pointIndex < 0 ||
15282 pointIndex >= path.Points.Count)
15283 {
15284 return false;
15285 }
15286
15287 if (HasUsablePathPointOwnership(path))
15288 {
15289 int ownerIndex = GetPathPointOwnerIndex(path, pointIndex);
15290 if (ownerIndex == partIndex)
15291 return true;
15292 if (ownerIndex >= 0)
15293 return false;
15294
15295 return IsUnownedPointInsidePartRun(path, pointIndex, partIndex);
15296 }
15297
15298 return ColorSetContains(exclusiveFallbackColors, path.Color);
15299 }
15300
15308 private static bool IsUnownedPointInsidePartRun(ColorPath path, int pointIndex, int partIndex)
15309 {
15310 if (path.Points == null ||
15311 pointIndex < 0 ||
15312 pointIndex >= path.Points.Count ||
15313 IsBridgeManipulationType(GetPathPointType(path, pointIndex)))
15314 {
15315 return false;
15316 }
15317
15318 int runStart = pointIndex;
15319 while (runStart > 0 && !IsBridgeManipulationType(GetPathPointType(path, runStart - 1)))
15320 runStart--;
15321
15322 int runEnd = pointIndex;
15323 while (runEnd + 1 < path.Points.Count && !IsBridgeManipulationType(GetPathPointType(path, runEnd + 1)))
15324 runEnd++;
15325
15326 bool runHasSelectedPart = false;
15327 bool runHasOtherPart = false;
15328 for (int i = runStart; i <= runEnd; i++)
15329 {
15330 int ownerIndex = GetPathPointOwnerIndex(path, i);
15331 if (ownerIndex == partIndex)
15332 runHasSelectedPart = true;
15333 else if (ownerIndex >= 0)
15334 runHasOtherPart = true;
15335 }
15336
15337 return runHasSelectedPart && !runHasOtherPart;
15338 }
15339
15347 private static bool IsPathPointOwnedByAnotherPart(ColorPath path, int pointIndex, int partIndex)
15348 {
15349 int ownerIndex = GetPathPointOwnerIndex(path, pointIndex);
15350 return ownerIndex >= 0 && ownerIndex != partIndex;
15351 }
15352
15359 private static int GetPathPointOwnerIndex(ColorPath path, int pointIndex)
15360 {
15361 return path?.PointEntityIndices != null &&
15362 pointIndex >= 0 &&
15363 pointIndex < path.PointEntityIndices.Count
15364 ? path.PointEntityIndices[pointIndex]
15365 : -1;
15366 }
15367
15373 private static bool HasUsablePathPointOwnership(ColorPath path)
15374 {
15375 return path?.Points != null &&
15376 path.PointEntityIndices != null &&
15377 path.PointEntityIndices.Count == path.Points.Count &&
15378 path.PointEntityIndices.Any(index => index >= 0);
15379 }
15380
15387 private static string? GetPathPointType(ColorPath path, int pointIndex)
15388 {
15389 return path?.PointTypes != null &&
15390 pointIndex >= 0 &&
15391 pointIndex < path.PointTypes.Count
15392 ? path.PointTypes[pointIndex]
15393 : null;
15394 }

15402 private static bool ColorSetContains(HashSet<Color> colors, Color color)
15403 {
15404 return colors.Contains(color) || colors.Any(existing => existing.ToArgb() == color.ToArgb());

15412 private void RestorePathStates(Dictionary<Color, ColorPath> oldStates, HashSet<Color> colorsToRestore)
15413 {
15414 if (_pathManager == null || _pathManager.ColorPaths == null || oldStates == null)
15415 return;
15416
15417 foreach (var color in colorsToRestore)
15418 {
15419 if (!TryGetColorMatchedPathState(oldStates, color, out var oldState, out var stateColor))
15420 continue;
15421
15422 if (TryGetColorMatchedCurrentPath(color, out _, out var currentPath))
15423 currentPath.RestoreState(oldState);
15424 else
15425 _pathManager.ColorPaths[stateColor] = oldState.CloneState();
15426 }
15427 }

15433 return states;
15434
15435 foreach (var kvp in _pathManager.ColorPaths)
15436 {
15437 states[kvp.Key] = kvp.Value.CloneState();
15438 }
15439

15443 private static void CaptureOriginalObjectPathStates(
15444 OriginalObjectPositionState state,
15445 Dictionary<Color, ColorPath>? pathStates,
15446 HashSet<Color>? pathColors)
15447 {
15448 if (state == null || pathStates == null || pathStates.Count == 0)
15449 return;
15450
15451 var colors = pathColors != null && pathColors.Count > 0
15452 ? pathColors
15453 : new HashSet<Color>(pathStates.Keys);
15454
15455 foreach (var color in colors)
15456 {
15457 if (!TryGetColorMatchedPathState(pathStates, color, out var pathState, out var stateColor))
15458 continue;
15459
15460 if (!state.PathStates.Keys.Any(existing => existing.ToArgb() == stateColor.ToArgb()))
15461 state.PathStates[stateColor] = pathState.CloneState();
15462
15463 if (!state.PathColors.Any(existing => existing.ToArgb() == stateColor.ToArgb()))
15464 state.PathColors.Add(stateColor);
15465 }
15466 }

15526 private static bool TryGetColorMatchedPathState(
15527 Dictionary<Color, ColorPath> states,
15528 Color color,
15529 out ColorPath pathState,
15530 out Color stateColor)
15531 {
15532 if (states.TryGetValue(color, out pathState!))
15533 {
15534 stateColor = color;
15535 return true;
15536 }
15537
15538 foreach (var kvp in states)
15539 {
15540 if (kvp.Key.ToArgb() == color.ToArgb())
15541 {
15542 stateColor = kvp.Key;
15543 pathState = kvp.Value;
15544 return true;
15545 }
15546 }
15547
15548 stateColor = default;
15549 pathState = null!;
15550 return false;
15551 }
15552
15553 private bool TryGetColorMatchedCurrentPath(Color color, out Color currentColor, out ColorPath currentPath)
15554 {
15555 currentColor = default;
15556 currentPath = null!;
15557
15558 if (_pathManager?.ColorPaths == null)
15559 return false;
15560
15561 if (_pathManager.ColorPaths.TryGetValue(color, out currentPath!))
15562 {
15563 currentColor = color;
15564 return true;
15565 }
15566
15567 foreach (var kvp in _pathManager.ColorPaths)
15568 {
15569 if (kvp.Key.ToArgb() == color.ToArgb())
15570 {
15571 currentColor = kvp.Key;
15572 currentPath = kvp.Value;
15573 return true;
15574 }
15575 }
15576
15577 return false;
15578 }
15579
15586 private static bool ColorPathStatesEqual(ColorPath oldState, ColorPath currentState)
15587 {
15588 const double tolerance = 0.001;
15589 if (oldState == null || currentState == null)
15590 return oldState == currentState;
15591
15592 return PointListsEqual(oldState.Points, currentState.Points, tolerance) &&
15593 PointListsEqual(oldState.OriginalPoints, currentState.OriginalPoints, tolerance) &&
15594 VectorListsEqual(oldState.Normals, currentState.Normals, tolerance) &&
15595 VectorListsEqual(oldState.UpVectors, currentState.UpVectors, tolerance) &&
15596 BoolListsEqual(oldState.IsMeasure, currentState.IsMeasure) &&
15597 StringListsEqual(oldState.PointTypes, currentState.PointTypes) &&
15598 IntListsEqual(oldState.PointEntityIndices, currentState.PointEntityIndices) &&
15599 oldState.IsVisible == currentState.IsVisible &&
15600 oldState.ShowPathLines == currentState.ShowPathLines &&
15601 oldState.TrajectoryMode == currentState.TrajectoryMode;
15602 }
15603
15611 private static bool PointListsEqual(IReadOnlyList<Point3D>? first, IReadOnlyList<Point3D>? second, double tolerance)
15612 {
15613 if (first == null || second == null)
15614 return first == second;
15615 if (first.Count != second.Count)
15616 return false;
15617
15618 for (int i = 0; i < first.Count; i++)
15619 {
15620 if (first[i].DistanceTo(second[i]) > tolerance)
15621 return false;
15622 }
15623
15624 return true;
15625 }
15626
15634 private static bool VectorListsEqual(IReadOnlyList<Vector3D>? first, IReadOnlyList<Vector3D>? second, double tolerance)
15635 {
15636 if (first == null || second == null)
15637 return first == second;
15638 if (first.Count != second.Count)
15639 return false;
15640
15641 for (int i = 0; i < first.Count; i++)
15642 {
15643 if (Math.Abs(first[i].X - second[i].X) > tolerance ||
15644 Math.Abs(first[i].Y - second[i].Y) > tolerance ||
15645 Math.Abs(first[i].Z - second[i].Z) > tolerance)
15646 {
15647 return false;
15648 }
15649 }
15650
15651 return true;
15652 }
15653
15660 private static bool BoolListsEqual(IReadOnlyList<bool>? first, IReadOnlyList<bool>? second) =>
15661 (first == null || second == null)
15662 ? first == second
15663 : first.Count == second.Count && first.SequenceEqual(second);
15664
15671 private static bool StringListsEqual(IReadOnlyList<string>? first, IReadOnlyList<string>? second) =>
15672 (first == null || second == null)
15673 ? first == second
15674 : first.Count == second.Count && first.SequenceEqual(second);
15675
15682 private static bool IntListsEqual(IReadOnlyList<int>? first, IReadOnlyList<int>? second) =>
15683 (first == null || second == null)
15684 ? first == second
15685 : first.Count == second.Count && first.SequenceEqual(second);
15686
15690 private void MoveObjectToOrigin(object parameter)
15691 {
15692 try
15693 {
15694 // Cancel any existing manipulation session first
15695 if (_designControl.ObjectManipulator.Visible)
15696 {
15697 _designControl.ObjectManipulator.Cancel();
15698 _manipulatingEntity = null;
15699 _isPartManipulating = false;
15700 }
15701
15702 // Identify the main part entity
15703 Entity? partEntity = ResolvePartEntity(parameter);
15704 if (partEntity == null) return;
15705
15706 // --- Find the part origin point (same logic as ManipulateObject) ---
15707 partEntity.UpdateBoundingBox(new devDept.Eyeshot.TraversalParams());
15708 Point3D partOrigin = partEntity.BoxMin;
15709
15710 var associatedEntities = GetManipulationEntitiesForPart(partEntity);
15711 var originEntity = associatedEntities.FirstOrDefault(e => IsPartOriginEntityForPart(e, partEntity));
15712 if (originEntity is devDept.Eyeshot.Entities.BlockReference brOrigin)
15713 partOrigin = brOrigin.InsertionPoint;
15714
15715 // Skip if already at origin (no-op)
15716 if (Math.Abs(partOrigin.X) < 1e-6 &&
15717 Math.Abs(partOrigin.Y) < 1e-6 &&
15718 Math.Abs(partOrigin.Z) < 1e-6)
15719 return;
15720
15721 // --- Build entity list and indices ---
15722 int partIndex = _designControl.Entities.IndexOf(partEntity);
15723 var exclusiveFallbackColors = partIndex >= 0
15724 ? GetExclusiveFallbackColorsForPart(partIndex)
15725 : new HashSet<Color>();
15726 var affectedPathColors = partIndex >= 0
15727 ? GetPathColorsForPart(partIndex, exclusiveFallbackColors)
15728 : new HashSet<Color>();
15729 var oldPathsState = CaptureCurrentPathStates();
15730
15731 var allParts = _designControl.Entities.Where(IsValidPartEntity).ToList();
15732 bool isMultiPart = allParts.Count > 1;
15733 var shellMeshEntities = _designControl.Entities.Where(e => e.LayerName != null && e.LayerName.StartsWith("SHELL_", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)).ToList();
15734 bool hasShellMesh = shellMeshEntities.Count > 0;
15735 bool moveAllParts = false;
15736
15737 if (isMultiPart && hasShellMesh)
15738 {
15739 var result = MessageBox.Show(
15740 GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "MessageBoxQuestion_MoveAllPartsWithShell") ??
15741 "You are moving a part in a multiple part setup. Do you want to move all the parts together? If you choose 'No' to move only this part, the generated shell mesh will become broken and will require regenerating.",
15742 "SmartFitSystems", MessageBoxButton.YesNo, MessageBoxImage.Question);
15743 moveAllParts = result == MessageBoxResult.Yes;
15744 }
15745 else if (!isMultiPart)
15746 {
15747 moveAllParts = true;
15748 }
15749
15750 if (moveAllParts)
15751 {
15752 foreach (var part in allParts)
15753 {
15754 var assoc = GetManipulationEntitiesForPart(part);
15755 foreach (var a in assoc)
15756 if (!associatedEntities.Contains(a))
15757 associatedEntities.Add(a);
15758 }
15759 }
15760
15761 // ALWAYS add shell mesh if it exists, as requested by user
15762 if (hasShellMesh)
15763 {
15764 foreach (var shellMeshEntity in shellMeshEntities)
15765 {
15766 if (!associatedEntities.Contains(shellMeshEntity))
15767 {
15768 associatedEntities.Add(shellMeshEntity);
15769 }
15770 }
15771 }
15772
15773 var movedEntityIndices = new HashSet<int>();
15774 if (moveAllParts)
15775 {
15776 foreach (var part in allParts)
15777 {
15778 int idx = _designControl.Entities.IndexOf(part);
15779 if (idx >= 0) movedEntityIndices.Add(idx);
15780 }
15781 affectedPathColors.Clear();
15782 foreach (var idx in movedEntityIndices)
15783 {
15784 var exc = GetExclusiveFallbackColorsForPart(idx);
15785 foreach (var col in GetPathColorsForPart(idx, exc))
15786 affectedPathColors.Add(col);
15787 }
15788 }
15789 else if (partIndex >= 0)
15790 {
15791 movedEntityIndices.Add(partIndex);
15792 }
15793
15794 foreach (var ent in associatedEntities)
15795 {
15796 int idx = _designControl.Entities.IndexOf(ent);
15797 if (idx >= 0) movedEntityIndices.Add(idx);
15798 }
15799
15800 bool hasPathsToMove = affectedPathColors.Count > 0;
15801 bool shouldMovePaths = false;
15802 if (hasPathsToMove)
15803 {
15804 var result = MessageBox.Show(
15805 GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "MessageBoxQuestion_MovePathsWithObject") ??
15806 "Path planning was already generated for this object. Do you want to move the paths alongside the object?",
15807 "SmartFitSystems", MessageBoxButton.YesNo, MessageBoxImage.Question);
15808 shouldMovePaths = result == MessageBoxResult.Yes;
15809 }
15810
15811 var bridgeSnapshot = _pathManager?.CaptureAffectedBridgeState(movedEntityIndices, exclusiveFallbackColors);
15812
15813 // Build the translation
15814 Vector3D translation = new Vector3D(-partOrigin.X, -partOrigin.Y, -partOrigin.Z);
15815 devDept.Geometry.Transformation trans = devDept.Geometry.Transformation.CreateTranslation(translation);
15816
15817 // STEP 1: Transform all geometry entities
15818 var traversalParams = new devDept.Eyeshot.TraversalParams(_designControl);
15819 foreach (var ent in associatedEntities)
15820 {
15821 if (ent != null && !IsPathVisualEntity(ent))
15822 {
15823 ent.TransformBy(trans);
15824 ent.UpdateBoundingBox(traversalParams);
15825 }
15826 }
15827
15828 // STEP 2: Transform associated grid
15829 devDept.Eyeshot.Control.Grid? associatedGrid = null;
15830 if (_designControl.Viewports.Count > 0)
15831 {
15832 foreach (var grid in _designControl.Viewports[0].Grids.Skip(1))
15833 {
15834 if (Math.Abs(grid.Plane.Origin.X - partOrigin.X) < 1.0 &&
15835 Math.Abs(grid.Plane.Origin.Y - partOrigin.Y) < 1.0 &&
15836 Math.Abs(grid.Plane.Origin.Z - partOrigin.Z) < 1.0)
15837 {
15838 associatedGrid = grid;
15839 break;
15840 }
15841 }
15842 if (associatedGrid != null)
15843 {
15844 var plane = associatedGrid.Plane;
15845 plane.TransformBy(trans);
15846 associatedGrid.Plane = plane;
15847 }
15848 }
15849 CleanUpOverlappingOriginGrids();
15850
15851 // STEP 3: Regen Brep tessellation BEFORE rebuilding overlays
15852 // so GenerateOverlayForFace uses the new post-move face geometry.
15853 foreach (var idx in movedEntityIndices)
15854 {
15855 if (idx >= 0 && idx < _designControl.Entities.Count &&
15856 _designControl.Entities[idx] is devDept.Eyeshot.Entities.Brep brepToRegen)
15857 {
15858 brepToRegen.Regen(new devDept.Eyeshot.RegenParams(0.01, _designControl));
15859 }
15860 }
15861
15862 if (!moveAllParts && hasShellMesh)
15863 {
15864 // Relies on live fingerprint validation to regenerate automatically
15865 }
15866 else if (hasShellMesh)
15867 _pathManager?.TransformShellCache(trans);
15868
15869 // STEP 4: Paths
15870 foreach (var idx in movedEntityIndices)
15871 TransformCadPlanningMetadataForEntities(new HashSet<int> { idx }, trans);
15872
15873 if (hasPathsToMove && _pathManager != null)
15874 {
15875 if (shouldMovePaths)
15876 {
15877 var changedPathColors = _pathManager.ApplyPartMoveToPathDataFromSnapshot(
15878 oldPathsState, movedEntityIndices, exclusiveFallbackColors, trans);
15879 foreach (var color in _pathManager.ReconnectAffectedHighZBridges(bridgeSnapshot, movedEntityIndices, exclusiveFallbackColors, trans))
15880 changedPathColors.Add(color);
15881 foreach (var color in changedPathColors)
15882 affectedPathColors.Add(color);
15883 _pathManager.RegeneratePathVisuals();
15884 }
15885 else
15886 {
15887 RestorePathStates(oldPathsState, affectedPathColors);
15888 _pathManager.RegeneratePathVisuals();
15889 }
15890 }
15891
15892 // STEP 5: Rebuild IgnoredItems overlay
15893 int mainPartIndex = _designControl.Entities.IndexOf(partEntity);
15894 if (mainPartIndex >= 0)
15895 _ignoredItemManager?.ApplyTransformation(mainPartIndex, trans);
15896 _ignoredItemManager?.SyncVisibility();
15897
15898 // STEP 6: Undo command
15899 var compositeCommands = new List<IUndoCommand>();
15900 var movedGeometryEntities = associatedEntities
15901 .Where(e => e != null && !IsPathVisualEntity(e))
15902 .Distinct()
15903 .ToList();
15904 if (!movedGeometryEntities.Contains(partEntity))
15905 movedGeometryEntities.Add(partEntity);
15906
15907 var finalMovedEntityIndices = movedEntityIndices
15908 .Where(idx => idx >= 0 && idx < _designControl.Entities.Count)
15909 .ToHashSet();
15910
15911 var ignoredParents = finalMovedEntityIndices
15912 .Select(idx => _designControl.Entities[idx])
15913 .ToList();
15914
15915 if (movedGeometryEntities.Count > 0)
15916 {
15917 compositeCommands.Add(new MovePartCommand(
15918 _designControl,
15919 movedGeometryEntities,
15920 trans,
15921 _ignoredItemManager,
15922 ignoredParents));
15923 }
15924
15925 if (finalMovedEntityIndices.Count > 0)
15926 {
15927 var metadataEntityIndices = new HashSet<int>(finalMovedEntityIndices);
15928 var metadataRedoTransform = (devDept.Geometry.Transformation)trans.Clone();
15929 var metadataUndoTransform = (devDept.Geometry.Transformation)trans.Clone();
15930 metadataUndoTransform.Invert();
15931 compositeCommands.Add(new ActionUndoCommand(
15932 undoAction: () =>
15933 {
15934 TransformCadPlanningMetadataForEntities(metadataEntityIndices, (devDept.Geometry.Transformation)metadataUndoTransform.Clone());
15935 if (!moveAllParts && hasShellMesh)
15936 {
15937 // Relies on live fingerprint validation to regenerate automatically
15938 }
15939 else if (hasShellMesh)
15940 _pathManager?.TransformShellCache((devDept.Geometry.Transformation)metadataUndoTransform.Clone());
15941 },
15942 redoAction: () =>
15943 {
15944 TransformCadPlanningMetadataForEntities(metadataEntityIndices, (devDept.Geometry.Transformation)metadataRedoTransform.Clone());
15945 if (!moveAllParts && hasShellMesh)
15946 {
15947 // Relies on live fingerprint validation to regenerate automatically
15948 }
15949 else if (hasShellMesh)
15950 _pathManager?.TransformShellCache((devDept.Geometry.Transformation)metadataRedoTransform.Clone());
15951 },
15952 description: "Updated CAD planning metadata for moved object to origin",
15953 category: "Part Manipulation"));
15954 }
15955
15956 if (hasPathsToMove && _pathManager != null && _pathManager.ColorPaths != null)
15957 {
15958 foreach (var kvp in _pathManager.ColorPaths)
15959 {
15960 if (oldPathsState.TryGetValue(kvp.Key, out var oldState))
15961 {
15962 var cp = kvp.Value;
15963 if (!ColorPathStatesEqual(oldState, cp))
15964 compositeCommands.Add(new UpdateColorPathCommand(_pathManager, _designControl, kvp.Key, oldState, cp.CloneState(), regenerateAllPaths: true));
15965 }
15966 }
15967 }
15968
15969 if (compositeCommands.Count == 1)
15970 UndoManager.PushCommand(compositeCommands[0]);
15971 else if (compositeCommands.Count > 1)
15972 UndoManager.PushCommand(new CompositeCommand(compositeCommands));
15973
15974 // Transform cached shell mesh DTOs so they stay in sync with the moved geometry.
15975 // This must happen before Regen() which can destroy standalone Mesh vertex data.
15976 TransformCachedShellMeshDTOs(trans);
15977
15978 _designControl.Entities.UpdateBoundingBox();
15979 _designControl.Entities.Regen();
15980 _designControl.ZoomFit();
15981 _designControl.Invalidate();
15982
15983 _selectionUtils.ClearDesignControlSelection();
15984 StoreOriginalPosition(partEntity, associatedEntities, trans, associatedGrid, oldPathsState, affectedPathColors);
15985 }
15986 catch (Exception ex)
15987 {
15988 Debug.WriteLine($"Error in MoveObjectToOrigin: {ex.Message}");
15989 }
15990 }

15992 private sealed class OriginalObjectPositionState
15993
15994 {
15995 public List<(Entity ent, devDept.Geometry.Transformation trans)> Entities { get; } = new();
15996 public devDept.Eyeshot.Control.Grid? Grid { get; set; }
15997 public devDept.Geometry.Transformation GridTransform { get; set; } = devDept.Geometry.Transformation.CreateIdentity();
15998 public Dictionary<Color, ColorPath> PathStates { get; } = new();
15999 public HashSet<Color> PathColors { get; } = new();
16000 }
16001
16002 private Dictionary<Entity, OriginalObjectPositionState> _originalPositions = new();
16003
16011 private void StoreOriginalPosition(
16012 Entity mainPart,
16013 List<Entity> associated,
16014 devDept.Geometry.Transformation appliedTrans,
16015 devDept.Eyeshot.Control.Grid? grid = null,
16016 Dictionary<Color, ColorPath>? pathStates = null,
16017 HashSet<Color>? pathColors = null)
16018 {
16019 if (!_originalPositions.ContainsKey(mainPart))
16020 {
16021 var state = new OriginalObjectPositionState
16022 {
16023 Grid = grid
16024 };
16025
16026 foreach (var ent in associated.Where(ent => ent != null && !IsPathVisualEntity(ent)).Distinct())
16027 {
16028 // We store the inverse of the applied transformation to get back
16029 var inverse = (devDept.Geometry.Transformation)appliedTrans.Clone();
16030 inverse.Invert();
16031 state.Entities.Add((ent, inverse));
16032 }
16033
16034 var gridInverse = (devDept.Geometry.Transformation)appliedTrans.Clone();
16035 gridInverse.Invert();
16036 state.GridTransform = gridInverse;
16037 CaptureOriginalObjectPathStates(state, pathStates, pathColors);
16038
16039 _originalPositions[mainPart] = state;
16040 }
16041 else
16042 {
16043 // Update existing stored inverse by multiplying
16044 var inverse = (devDept.Geometry.Transformation)appliedTrans.Clone();
16045 inverse.Invert();
16046 var current = _originalPositions[mainPart];
16047
16048 for (int i = 0; i < current.Entities.Count; i++)
16049 {
16050 var item = current.Entities[i];
16051 current.Entities[i] = (item.ent, inverse * item.trans);
16052 }
16053
16054 current.Grid ??= grid;
16055 current.GridTransform = inverse * current.GridTransform;
16056 CaptureOriginalObjectPathStates(current, pathStates, pathColors);
16057 }
16058 }

16065 private void TransformCadPlanningMetadataForEntities(HashSet<int> entityIndices, devDept.Geometry.Transformation transform)
16066 {
16067 if (entityIndices == null || entityIndices.Count == 0 || transform == null)
16068 return;
16069
16070 var transformedFaces = new HashSet<CADFace>();
16071 var transformedFaceIndices = new HashSet<int>();
16072
16073 foreach (var face in EnumerateCadPlanningFaces())
16074 {
16075 if (face == null || !entityIndices.Contains(face.EntityIndex) || !transformedFaces.Add(face))
16076 continue;
16077
16078 TransformFacePointList(face.KeyPoints, transform);
16079 TransformPoint4DList(face.ControlPoints, transform);
16080 TransformPoint4DList(face.MeasurementPoints, transform);
16081 face.GeometricInfo = TransformGeometricInfoVectors(face.GeometricInfo, transform);
16082
16083 if (face.FaceGlobalIndex > 0)
16084 transformedFaceIndices.Add(face.FaceGlobalIndex);
16085 }
16086
16087 if (transformedFaceIndices.Count == 0)
16088 return;
16089
16090 var transformedHoles = new HashSet<CADHole>();
16091 foreach (var hole in EnumerateCadPlanningHoles())
16092 {
16093 if (hole == null ||
16094 hole.FaceGlobalIndices == null ||
16095 !hole.FaceGlobalIndices.Any(transformedFaceIndices.Contains) ||
16096 !transformedHoles.Add(hole))
16097 continue;
16098
16099 hole.TopCenterPoint = TransformNullablePoint3D(hole.TopCenterPoint, transform);
16100 hole.BottomCenterPoint = TransformNullablePoint3D(hole.BottomCenterPoint, transform);
16101 if (hole.AxisDirection != null)
16102 hole.AxisDirection = TransformDirection(hole.AxisDirection, transform);
16103 hole.GeometricInfo = TransformGeometricInfoVectors(hole.GeometricInfo, transform);
16104 }
16105 }
16106
16111 private IEnumerable<CADFace> EnumerateCadPlanningFaces()
16112 {
16113 foreach (var list in _allFacesByColor?.Values ?? Enumerable.Empty<List<CADFace>>())
16114 {
16115 foreach (var face in list)
16116 yield return face;
16117 }
16118
16119 foreach (var list in _facesByColor?.Values ?? Enumerable.Empty<List<CADFace>>())
16120 {
16121 foreach (var face in list)
16122 yield return face;
16123 }
16124 }
16125
16130 private IEnumerable<CADHole> EnumerateCadPlanningHoles()
16131 {
16132 foreach (var list in _holesByColor?.Values ?? Enumerable.Empty<List<CADHole>>())
16133 {
16134 foreach (var hole in list)
16135 yield return hole;
16136 }
16137 }
