16144 private static void TransformFacePointList(List<FacePoint>? points, devDept.Geometry.Transformation transform)
16145 {
16146 if (points == null)
16147 return;
16148
16149 foreach (var point in points)
16150 {
16151 if (point == null)
16152 continue;
16153
16154 var transformed = TransformPoint3D(new Point3D(point.X, point.Y, point.Z), transform);
16155 point.X = transformed.X;
16156 point.Y = transformed.Y;
16157 point.Z = transformed.Z;
16158 }
16159 }
16160
16166 private static void TransformPoint4DList(List<Point4D>? points, devDept.Geometry.Transformation transform)
16167 {
16168 if (points == null)
16169 return;
16170
16171 for (int i = 0; i < points.Count; i++)
16172 {
16173 var point = points[i];
16174 var transformed = TransformPoint3D(new Point3D(point.X, point.Y, point.Z), transform);
16175 point.X = transformed.X;
16176 point.Y = transformed.Y;
16177 point.Z = transformed.Z;
16178 points[i] = point;
16179 }
16180 }
16181
16188 private static Point3D? TransformNullablePoint3D(Point3D? point, devDept.Geometry.Transformation transform)
16189 {
16190 if (point == null)
16191 return null;
16192
16193 return TransformPoint3D(point, transform);
16194 }
16195
16202 private static Point3D TransformPoint3D(Point3D point, devDept.Geometry.Transformation transform)
16203 {
16204 var transformed = new Point3D(point.X, point.Y, point.Z);
16205 transformed.TransformBy(transform);
16206 return transformed;
16207 }
16208
16215 private static Vector3D TransformDirection(Vector3D direction, devDept.Geometry.Transformation transform)
16216 {
16217 var origin = new Point3D(0, 0, 0);
16218 var end = new Point3D(direction.X, direction.Y, direction.Z);
16219 origin.TransformBy(transform);
16220 end.TransformBy(transform);
16221
16222 var transformed = new Vector3D(end.X - origin.X, end.Y - origin.Y, end.Z - origin.Z);
16223 if (transformed.Length > 1e-8)
16224 transformed.Normalize();
16225 return transformed;
16226 }
16227
16234 private static string? TransformGeometricInfoVectors(string? geometricInfo, devDept.Geometry.Transformation transform)
16235 {
16236 if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(geometricInfo))
16237 return geometricInfo;
16238
16239 string result = TransformGeometricInfoVector(geometricInfo, "Normal", transform);
16240 result = TransformGeometricInfoVector(result, "Axis", transform);
16241 return result;
16242 }
16243
16251 private static string TransformGeometricInfoVector(string geometricInfo, string label, devDept.Geometry.Transformation transform)
16252 {
16253 return Regex.Replace(
16254 geometricInfo,
16255 $@"({Regex.Escape(label)}:\s*)\‍(([^,]+),\s*([^,]+),\s*([^)]+)\‍)",
16256 match =>
16257 {
16258 if (!double.TryParse(match.Groups[2].Value.Trim(), System.Globalization.NumberStyles.Float, System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, out double x) ||
16259 !double.TryParse(match.Groups[3].Value.Trim(), System.Globalization.NumberStyles.Float, System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, out double y) ||
16260 !double.TryParse(match.Groups[4].Value.Trim(), System.Globalization.NumberStyles.Float, System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, out double z))
16261 {
16262 return match.Value;
16263 }
16264
16265 var transformed = TransformDirection(new Vector3D(x, y, z), transform);
16266 return string.Format(
16267 System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture,
16268 "{0}({1:0.######}, {2:0.######}, {3:0.######})",
16269 match.Groups[1].Value,
16270 transformed.X,
16271 transformed.Y,
16272 transformed.Z);
16273 },
16274 RegexOptions.IgnoreCase);
16275 }

16327 private DelegateCommand<object>? stopManipulatingCommand;
16328 public ICommand StopManipulatingCommand => stopManipulatingCommand ??= new DelegateCommand<object>(StopManipulating);
16329
16334 private void StopManipulating(object parameter)
16335 {
16336 var designControl = _designControl;
16337 var objectManipulator = designControl?.ObjectManipulator;
16338 if (designControl != null && (objectManipulator?.Visible == true || _isCustomDragging))
16339 {
16340 bool wasCustomDragging = _isCustomDragging;
16341 _isCustomDragging = false;
16342 _prevDragPosition = null;
16343 bool wasPartManipulating = _isPartManipulating;
16344 _isPartManipulating = false;
16345
16346 var trans = objectManipulator?.Transformation;
16347 if (objectManipulator != null && trans != null)
16348 {
16349 devDept.Geometry.Transformation deltaTrans;
16350 if (_initialTriadTrans != null)
16351 {
16352 var invInitial = (devDept.Geometry.Transformation)_initialTriadTrans.Clone();
16353 invInitial.Invert();
16354 deltaTrans = trans * invInitial;
16355 }
16356 else
16357 {
16358 deltaTrans = trans;
16359 }
16360
16361 if (_isCreatingIntermediaryPoint)
16362 {
16363 if (_tempInsertPosition != null)
16364 {
16365 var testPos = (Point3D)_tempInsertPosition.Clone();
16366 testPos.TransformBy(deltaTrans);
16367 if (_tempInsertPosition.DistanceTo(testPos) < 1e-4)
16368 {
16369 CleanupPendingIntermediaryCreation();
16370 return;
16371 }
16372 }
16373
16374 _isCreatingIntermediaryPoint = false;
16375 if (_draggingSphere != null)
16376 {
16377 designControl.Entities.Remove(_draggingSphere);
16378 _draggingSphere = null;
16379 }
16380
16381 var tempInsertPath = _tempInsertPath;
16382 var tempInsertPosition = _tempInsertPosition;
16383 if (tempInsertPath != null && tempInsertPosition != null)
16384 {
16385 var newPos = (Point3D)tempInsertPosition.Clone();
16386 newPos.TransformBy(deltaTrans);
16387
16388 bool isBridgeInsertion = false;
16389 if (tempInsertPath.PointTypes != null &&
16390 _tempInsertIndex > 0 &&
16391 _tempInsertIndex < tempInsertPath.PointTypes.Count)
16392 {
16393 string startType = tempInsertPath.PointTypes[_tempInsertIndex - 1];
16394 string endType = tempInsertPath.PointTypes[_tempInsertIndex];
16395 isBridgeInsertion = IsBridgeManipulationType(startType) && IsBridgeManipulationType(endType);
16396 }
16397
16398 var bridgePathManager = _pathManager;
16399 if (isBridgeInsertion && bridgePathManager != null)
16400 {
16401 var oldStates = bridgePathManager.ColorPaths.ToDictionary(kvp => kvp.Key, kvp => kvp.Value.CloneState());
16402 if (bridgePathManager.TryInsertBridgeIntermediary(tempInsertPath, _tempInsertIndex, newPos, out var changedPaths))
16403 {
16404 var commands = new List<IUndoCommand>();
16405 foreach (var changedPath in changedPaths.Distinct())
16406 {
16407 if (oldStates.TryGetValue(changedPath.Color, out var oldState))
16408 {
16409 commands.Add(new UpdateColorPathCommand(
16410 bridgePathManager,
16411 designControl,
16412 changedPath.Color,
16413 oldState,
16414 changedPath.CloneState()));
16415 }
16416 }
16417
16418 if (commands.Count == 1)
16419 UndoManager.PushCommand(commands[0]);
16420 else if (commands.Count > 1)
16421 UndoManager.PushCommand(new CompositeCommand(commands));
16422
16423 _oldPathStateForWaypointMove = null;
16424 _tempInsertPath = null;
16425 _tempInsertPosition = null;
16426 _otherOverlappingBridgePathsUndoInfo = null;
16427
16428 bridgePathManager.RegeneratePathVisuals();
16429 designControl.Entities.Regen();
16430 objectManipulator.Cancel();
16431 designControl.Entities.ClearSelection();
16432 designControl.Invalidate();
16433 _manipulatingEntity = null;
16434 return;
16435 }
16436
16437 CleanupPendingIntermediaryCreation();
16438 return;
16439 }
16440
16441 // Insert into model
16442 tempInsertPath.Points.Insert(_tempInsertIndex, newPos);
16443 if (tempInsertPath.Normals != null && _tempInsertIndex - 1 < tempInsertPath.Normals.Count)
16444 tempInsertPath.Normals.Insert(_tempInsertIndex, (Vector3D)tempInsertPath.Normals[_tempInsertIndex - 1].Clone());
16445 else if (tempInsertPath.Normals != null)
16446 tempInsertPath.Normals.Insert(_tempInsertIndex, Vector3D.AxisZ);
16447
16448 if (tempInsertPath.IsMeasure != null)
16449 tempInsertPath.IsMeasure.Insert(_tempInsertIndex, false);
16450
16451 string newPointType = "Approach";
16452 if (tempInsertPath.PointTypes != null && _tempInsertIndex - 1 < tempInsertPath.PointTypes.Count)
16453 {
16454 string startType = tempInsertPath.PointTypes[_tempInsertIndex - 1];
16455 string endType = (_tempInsertIndex < tempInsertPath.PointTypes.Count) ? tempInsertPath.PointTypes[_tempInsertIndex] : "";
16456 if ((startType == "Bridge" || startType == "BridgeIntermediary") && (endType == "Bridge" || endType == "BridgeIntermediary"))
16457 {
16458 newPointType = "BridgeIntermediary";
16459 }
16460 }
16461
16462 if (tempInsertPath.PointTypes != null)
16463 tempInsertPath.PointTypes.Insert(_tempInsertIndex, newPointType);
16464
16465 if (tempInsertPath.OriginalPoints != null)
16466 tempInsertPath.OriginalPoints.Insert(_tempInsertIndex, (Point3D)newPos.Clone());
16467
16468 // Insert into other overlapping bridges
16469 if (_otherOverlappingBridgePathsUndoInfo != null && _otherOverlappingBridgePathsUndoInfo.Count > 0)
16470 {
16471 Point3D p1 = tempInsertPath.Points[_tempInsertIndex - 1];
16472 Point3D p2 = tempInsertPath.Points[_tempInsertIndex + 1]; // +1 because we just inserted at _tempInsertIndex
16473 foreach (var info in _otherOverlappingBridgePathsUndoInfo)
16474 {
16475 var otherPath = info.Path;
16476 // Find where to insert (between p1 and p2 or p2 and p1)
16477 for (int i = 0; i < otherPath.Points.Count - 1; i++)
16478 {
16479 if ((otherPath.Points[i].DistanceTo(p1) < 1e-4 && otherPath.Points[i + 1].DistanceTo(p2) < 1e-4) ||
16480 (otherPath.Points[i].DistanceTo(p2) < 1e-4 && otherPath.Points[i + 1].DistanceTo(p1) < 1e-4))
16481 {
16482 int insertIdx = i + 1;
16483 otherPath.Points.Insert(insertIdx, (Point3D)newPos.Clone());
16484 if (otherPath.Normals != null && insertIdx - 1 < otherPath.Normals.Count)
16485 otherPath.Normals.Insert(insertIdx, (Vector3D)otherPath.Normals[insertIdx - 1].Clone());
16486 else if (otherPath.Normals != null)
16487 otherPath.Normals.Insert(insertIdx, Vector3D.AxisZ);
16488
16489 if (otherPath.IsMeasure != null)
16490 otherPath.IsMeasure.Insert(insertIdx, false);
16491
16492 if (otherPath.PointTypes != null)
16493 otherPath.PointTypes.Insert(insertIdx, "BridgeIntermediary");
16494
16495 if (otherPath.OriginalPoints != null)
16496 otherPath.OriginalPoints.Insert(insertIdx, (Point3D)newPos.Clone());
16497
16498 var overlapPathManager = _pathManager;
16499 if (overlapPathManager != null)
16500 {
16501 UndoManager.PushCommand(new UpdateColorPathCommand(overlapPathManager, designControl, otherPath.Color, info.OldState, otherPath.CloneState()));
16502 }
16503 break;
16504 }
16505 }
16506 }
16507 }
16508
16509 // Register command in Undo history
16510 var insertPathManager = _pathManager;
16511 if (insertPathManager != null)
16512 {
16513 UndoManager.PushCommand(new UpdateColorPathCommand(insertPathManager, designControl, tempInsertPath.Color, _oldPathStateForWaypointMove ?? tempInsertPath.CloneState(), tempInsertPath.CloneState()));
16514 }
16515
16516 _oldPathStateForWaypointMove = null;
16517 _tempInsertPath = null;
16518 _tempInsertPosition = null;
16519 _otherOverlappingBridgePathsUndoInfo = null;
16520
16521 var refreshPathManager = _pathManager;
16522 if (refreshPathManager != null)
16523 {
16524 refreshPathManager.RegeneratePathVisuals();
16525 designControl.Entities.Regen();
16526 }
16527 }
16528
16529 objectManipulator.Cancel();
16530 designControl.Entities.ClearSelection();
16531 designControl.Invalidate();
16532 _manipulatingEntity = null;
16533 return;
16534 }
16535
16536 var selectedEntities = designControl.Entities.Where(e => e.Selected).ToList();
16537
16538 // Check if manipulating a Waypoint
16539 var waypointEntity = (!wasPartManipulating && (_manipulatingEntity != null && _manipulatingEntity.EntityData is WaypointData))
16540 ? _manipulatingEntity
16541 : (!wasPartManipulating ? selectedEntities.FirstOrDefault(e => e.EntityData is WaypointData) : null);
16542 if (waypointEntity != null)
16543 {
16544 var data = (WaypointData)waypointEntity.EntityData;
16545 var pathManager = _pathManager;
16546
16547 if (wasCustomDragging && _draggingSphere != null)
16548 {
16549 designControl.Entities.Remove(_draggingSphere);
16550 _draggingSphere = null;
16551 }
16552 waypointEntity.Visible = true;
16553
16554 // Select only this entity so ObjectManipulator.Apply applies the transformation to it!
16555 designControl.Entities.ClearSelection();
16556 waypointEntity.Selected = true;
16557
16558 objectManipulator.Apply();
16559
16560 Point3D oldPos = (Point3D)data.OriginalPosition.Clone();
16561 Vector3D oldNormal = (Vector3D)data.Path.Normals[data.PointIndex].Clone();
16562
16563 Point3D newPos;
16564 if (wasCustomDragging)
16565 {
16566 newPos = _draggingSpherePosition != null ? (Point3D)_draggingSpherePosition.Clone() : (Point3D)data.Path.Points[data.PointIndex].Clone();
16567 deltaTrans = new devDept.Geometry.Transformation(1);
16568 }
16569 else
16570 {
16571 newPos = (Point3D)data.OriginalPosition.Clone();
16572 newPos.TransformBy(deltaTrans);
16573 }
16574 newPos = ConstrainSharedWaypointPosition(data, newPos);
16575
16576 // Do not waste time doing calculations if the point didn't move
16577 if (newPos.DistanceTo(oldPos) < 1e-4)
16578 {
16579 CancelWaypointManipulation(waypointEntity);
16580 return;
16581 }
16582
16583 bool isMeasure = data.Path.IsMeasure != null && data.PointIndex < data.Path.IsMeasure.Count && data.Path.IsMeasure[data.PointIndex];
16584 bool isScanPoint = data.Path.PointTypes != null && data.PointIndex < data.Path.PointTypes.Count && string.Equals(data.Path.PointTypes[data.PointIndex], "scanpoints", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
16585
16586 if (isMeasure && !isScanPoint)
16587 {
16588 Vector3D newNormal = oldNormal;
16589 Point3D snappedPos = newPos;
16590
16591 if (wasCustomDragging)
16592 {
16593 snappedPos = (Point3D)newPos.Clone();
16594 newNormal = (Vector3D)data.Path.Normals[data.PointIndex].Clone();
16595 // Recalculate normal at snapped position
16596 if (_draggingMeasurePointBrep != null && _draggingMeasurePointFace != null)
16597 {
16598 try
16599 {
16600 var fn = _draggingMeasurePointBrep.Faces[_draggingMeasurePointFace.FaceIndex].Normal(snappedPos);
16601 if (fn != null && fn.Length > 1e-6)
16602 {
16603 newNormal = fn;
16604 newNormal.Normalize();
16605 }
16606 }
16607 catch { }
16608 }
16609 }
16610 else
16611 {
16612 // Find the parent face from the original position
16613 Entity targetPartForFace = null!;
16614 int targetFaceIndex = -1;
16615 double closestDist = double.MaxValue;
16616
16617 foreach (var ent in designControl.Entities)
16618 {
16619 if (ent is Brep brep)
16620 {
16621 for (int i = 0; i < brep.Faces.Length; i++)
16622 {
16623 try
16624 {
16625 var mesh = brep.Faces[i].ConvertToMesh();
16626 if (mesh != null)
16627 {
16628 var proj = EyeshotGeometryUtils.ProjectPointToFaceSurface(oldPos, brep, i);
16629 double dist = proj.DistanceTo(oldPos);
16630 if (dist < closestDist && dist < 1.0)
16631 {
16632 closestDist = dist;
16633 targetPartForFace = brep;
16634 targetFaceIndex = i;
16635 }
16636 }
16637 }
16638 catch { }
16639 }
16640 }
16641 }
16642
16643 if (targetPartForFace is Brep targetBrep && targetFaceIndex != -1)
16644 {
16645 snappedPos = EyeshotGeometryUtils.ProjectPointToFaceSurface(newPos, targetBrep, targetFaceIndex);
16646 try
16647 {
16648 var fn = targetBrep.Faces[targetFaceIndex].Normal(snappedPos);
16649 if (fn != null && fn.Length > 1e-6)
16650 {
16651 newNormal = fn;
16652 newNormal.Normalize();
16653 }
16654 }
16655 catch { }
16656 }
16657 else
16658 {
16659 Entity? targetPart;
16660 snappedPos = SnapToClosestPartSurface(newPos, out newNormal, out targetPart);
16661 }
16662 }
16663
16664 // Align newNormal direction to match the previous normal
16665 Vector3D prevNormal = data.Path.Normals[data.PointIndex];
16666 if (Vector3D.Dot(newNormal, prevNormal) < 0)
16667 {
16668 newNormal = new Vector3D(-newNormal.X, -newNormal.Y, -newNormal.Z);
16669 }
16670
16671 // Translate associated approach points (entrance and exit if applicable)
16672 // We move approach point(s) by the exact offset and normal rotation/alignment.
16673 // To stay perpendicular and aligned, the approach point should be placed at the
16674 // snapped position offset by the newNormal * offsetDistance.
16675
16676 // Entry approach point
16677 if (data.PointIndex > 0 && data.Path.IsMeasure != null && !data.Path.IsMeasure[data.PointIndex - 1])
16678 {
16679 bool isOurs = true;
16680 if (data.Path.OriginalPoints != null && data.PointIndex < data.Path.OriginalPoints.Count)
16681 {
16682 double originalOffset = data.Path.OriginalPoints[data.PointIndex - 1].DistanceTo(data.Path.OriginalPoints[data.PointIndex]);
16683 if (originalOffset > 100.0) isOurs = false;
16684 }
16685
16686 if (isOurs)
16687 {
16688 double offsetDistance = data.Path.Points[data.PointIndex - 1].DistanceTo(oldPos);
16689 if (offsetDistance < 0.001) offsetDistance = 15.0;
16690 SetPathPointPositionWithSharedOccurrences(
16691 data.Path,
16692 data.PointIndex - 1,
16693 snappedPos + newNormal * offsetDistance);
16694 data.Path.Normals[data.PointIndex - 1] = newNormal;
16695 }
16696 }
16697
16698 // Exit approach point
16699 if (data.PointIndex + 1 < data.Path.Points.Count && data.Path.IsMeasure != null && data.PointIndex + 1 < data.Path.IsMeasure.Count && !data.Path.IsMeasure[data.PointIndex + 1])
16700 {
16701 bool isOurs = true;
16702 if (data.Path.OriginalPoints != null && data.PointIndex + 1 < data.Path.OriginalPoints.Count)
16703 {
16704 double originalOffset = data.Path.OriginalPoints[data.PointIndex + 1].DistanceTo(data.Path.OriginalPoints[data.PointIndex]);
16705 if (originalOffset > 100.0) isOurs = false;
16706 }
16707
16708 if (isOurs)
16709 {
16710 double offsetDistance = data.Path.Points[data.PointIndex + 1].DistanceTo(oldPos);
16711 if (offsetDistance < 0.001) offsetDistance = 15.0;
16712 SetPathPointPositionWithSharedOccurrences(
16713 data.Path,
16714 data.PointIndex + 1,
16715 snappedPos + newNormal * offsetDistance);
16716 data.Path.Normals[data.PointIndex + 1] = newNormal;
16717 }
16718 }
16719
16720 newPos = snappedPos;
16721 data.Path.Normals[data.PointIndex] = newNormal;
16722 }
16723 else if (isScanPoint)
16724 {
16725 // Scanner scan point: save translated position directly and keep the normal as is
16726 data.Path.Points[data.PointIndex] = newPos;
16727 }
16728 else
16729 {
16730 // It's an approach/intermediary point.
16731 // Check if it is bound to a measurement point (adjacent).
16732 int mIdx = -1;
16733 if (data.Path.IsMeasure != null && data.PointIndex + 1 < data.Path.Points.Count && data.PointIndex + 1 < data.Path.IsMeasure.Count && data.Path.IsMeasure[data.PointIndex + 1])
16734 {
16735 mIdx = data.PointIndex + 1; // It is the entry approach point
16736 }
16737 else if (data.Path.IsMeasure != null && data.PointIndex > 0 && data.PointIndex - 1 < data.Path.IsMeasure.Count && data.Path.IsMeasure[data.PointIndex - 1])
16738 {
16739 mIdx = data.PointIndex - 1; // It is the exit approach point
16740 }
16741
16742 if (mIdx != -1)
16743 {
16744 // Bound to a measurement point. Snap to the normal axis of the face of that measurement point.
16745 Point3D measurePt = data.Path.Points[mIdx];
16746 Vector3D normal = data.Path.Normals[mIdx];
16747 if (normal.LengthSquared < 1e-6) normal = Vector3D.AxisZ;
16748 normal.Normalize();
16749
16750 // Project newPos onto the line starting at measurePt along the normal direction.
16751 double t = Vector3D.Dot(new Vector3D(measurePt, newPos), normal);
16752 t = Math.Max(0.0, t); // Cannot go below the surface (inside the part)
16753 Point3D projectedPos = measurePt + normal * t;
16754 newPos = projectedPos;
16755
16756 // If the other approach point (entry/exit) exists, update it to match the projected pos.
16757 if (mIdx - 1 >= 0 && data.Path.IsMeasure != null && mIdx - 1 < data.Path.IsMeasure.Count && !data.Path.IsMeasure[mIdx - 1])
16758 {
16759 SetPathPointPositionWithSharedOccurrences(data.Path, mIdx - 1, newPos);
16760 data.Path.Normals[mIdx - 1] = normal;
16761 }
16762 if (mIdx + 1 < data.Path.Points.Count && data.Path.IsMeasure != null && mIdx + 1 < data.Path.IsMeasure.Count && !data.Path.IsMeasure[mIdx + 1])
16763 {
16764 SetPathPointPositionWithSharedOccurrences(data.Path, mIdx + 1, newPos);
16765 data.Path.Normals[mIdx + 1] = normal;
16766 }
16767 }
16768 }

16775 newPos,

17252 private Entity? ResolvePartEntity(object? parameter)
17253 {
17254 if (_designControl == null || _designControl.Entities == null) return null;
17255
17256 Entity? partEntity = null;
17257 if (parameter is CADFace face)
17258 {
17259 if (face.EntityIndex >= 0 && face.EntityIndex < _designControl.Entities.Count)
17260 partEntity = _designControl.Entities[face.EntityIndex];
17261 }
17262 else if (parameter is CADHole hole)
17263 {
17264 partEntity = _designControl.Entities.FirstOrDefault(e => e is devDept.Eyeshot.Entities.Brep brep && hole.FaceGlobalIndices.Any(idx => brep.Faces.Length > idx));
17265 }
17266 else if (parameter is FacePoint)
17267 {
17268 partEntity = _designControl.Entities.FirstOrDefault(e => e is devDept.Eyeshot.Entities.Brep);
17269 }
17270 else if (parameter is Entity entParams)
17271 {
17272 partEntity = entParams;
17273 }
17274
17275 partEntity ??= GetSectionCandidateParts().FirstOrDefault();
17276 return partEntity;
17277 }
17278
17284 private List<Entity> GetAssociatedEntities(Entity partEntity)
17285 {
17286 var associatedEntities = new List<Entity> { partEntity };
17287
17288 associatedEntities.AddRange(_designControl.Entities.Where(e => IsPartOwnedManipulationHelper(e, partEntity)));
17289
17290 return associatedEntities.Distinct().ToList();
17291 }
17292
17299 private bool IsPartOwnedManipulationHelper(Entity entity, Entity partEntity)
17300 {
17301 if (entity == null || entity == partEntity || IsPathVisualEntity(entity))
17302 return false;
17303
17304 string? partSource = GetPartSourceKey(partEntity);
17305 if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(partSource))
17306 {
17307 string? entitySource = GetPartSourceKey(entity);
17308 if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(entitySource) &&
17309 string.Equals(entitySource, partSource, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
17310 {
17311 return true;
17312 }
17313 }
17314
17315 if (IsPartOriginEntityForPart(entity, partEntity))
17316 return true;
17317
17318 if (IsBaseAvoidanceVisualEntityForSource(entity, partSource))
17319 return true;
17320
17321 string? layerName = entity.LayerName;
17322 bool isHelperLayer = !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(layerName) &&
17323 (layerName.StartsWith("SHELL_", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
17324 layerName.Contains("IGNORED", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));
17325 if (!isHelperLayer)
17326 return false;
17327
17328 int partIndex = _designControl.Entities.IndexOf(partEntity);
17329 if (entity.EntityData is CADFace faceData && faceData.EntityIndex == partIndex)
17330 return true;
17331
17332 return !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(partSource) &&
17333 entity.EntityData is string helperSource &&
17334 string.Equals(helperSource, partSource, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
17335 }
17336
17343 private bool IsPartOriginEntityForPart(Entity entity, Entity partEntity)
17344 {
17345 if (entity.EntityData is not string entityData ||
17346 !entityData.StartsWith("PART_ORIGIN", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
17347 {
17348 return false;
17349 }
17350
17351 string? partSource = GetPartSourceKey(partEntity);
17352 if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(partSource))
17353 {
17354 return string.Equals(entityData, $"PART_ORIGIN:{partSource}", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
17355 }
17356
17357 if (!string.Equals(entityData, "PART_ORIGIN", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
17358 return false;
17359
17360 return IsOriginNearPart(entity, partEntity);
17361 }
17362
17368 private static string? GetPartSourceKey(Entity partEntity)
17369 {
17370 if (partEntity.EntityData is not string source ||
17371 string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(source) ||
17372 source.StartsWith("PART_ORIGIN", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
17373 source.StartsWith(BaseAvoidancePlaneEntityDataPrefix, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
17374 source.StartsWith(BaseAvoidanceLabelEntityDataPrefix, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
17375 string.Equals(source, "UI_MARKER", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
17376 string.Equals(source, "SECTION_VISUAL", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
17377 string.Equals(source, "IgnoredOverlay_Ref", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
17378 {
17379 return null;
17380 }
17381
17382 return source;
17383 }

17391 private static bool IsOriginNearPart(Entity originEntity, Entity partEntity)

17398 partEntity.UpdateBoundingBox(new devDept.Eyeshot.TraversalParams());
17399 return origin.InsertionPoint.DistanceTo(partEntity.BoxMin) < 1.0;
17400 }
17401 catch
17402 {
17403 return false;

17412 private Entity? GetAssociatedPart(Point3D point)
17413 {
17414 if (_allFacesByColor == null || !_allFacesByColor.Any()) return null;
17415
17416 CADFace? closestFace = null;
17417 double minDistance = double.MaxValue;
17418
17419 foreach (var faceList in _allFacesByColor.Values)
17420 {
17421 foreach (var face in faceList)
17422 {
17423 foreach (var mp in face.MeasurementPoints)
17424 {
17425 double dist = point.DistanceTo(new Point3D(mp.X, mp.Y, mp.Z));
17426 if (dist < minDistance)
17427 {
17428 minDistance = dist;
17429 closestFace = face;
17430 }
17431 }
17432 }
17433 }
17434
17435 if (closestFace != null && closestFace.EntityIndex >= 0 && closestFace.EntityIndex < _designControl.Entities.Count)
17436 {
17437 return _designControl.Entities[closestFace.EntityIndex];
17438 }
17439
17440 return null;
17441 }

17454 var assocPart = GetAssociatedPart(wpPosition);
17455 return assocPart == part;

17465 private void AlignTriadWithOriginGrid(object parameter)
17466 {
17467 if (_designControl == null) return;
17468
17469 Entity? partEntity = ResolvePartEntity(parameter);
17470 if (partEntity == null) return;
17471
17472 partEntity.UpdateBoundingBox(new devDept.Eyeshot.TraversalParams());
17473 Point3D newMin = partEntity.BoxMin;
17474 Point3D newMax = partEntity.BoxMax;
17475
17476 // Find associated origin and grid
17477 var originSymbols = _designControl.Entities.Where(e => e.EntityData is string str && str.StartsWith("PART_ORIGIN")).ToList();
17478 var associatedOrigin = originSymbols.OrderBy(o => (o is BlockReference br) ? br.InsertionPoint.DistanceTo(newMin) : double.MaxValue).FirstOrDefault() as BlockReference;
17479
17480 if (associatedOrigin != null)
17481 {
17482 associatedOrigin.Transformation = devDept.Geometry.Transformation.CreateIdentity();
17483 associatedOrigin.InsertionPoint = new Point3D(newMin.X, newMin.Y, newMin.Z);
17484 }
17485
17486 if (_designControl.Viewports.Count > 0)
17487 {
17488 var grid = _designControl.Viewports[0].Grids.OrderBy(g => g.Plane.Origin.DistanceTo(newMin)).FirstOrDefault();
17489 if (grid != null && grid != _designControl.Viewports[0].Grids[0])
17490 {
17491 grid.Plane = new Plane(newMin, Vector3D.AxisX, Vector3D.AxisY);
17492 grid.Max = new Point2D(Math.Max(50, newMax.X - newMin.X), Math.Max(50, newMax.Y - newMin.Y));
17493 }
17494 }
17495
17496 _designControl.Entities.Regen();
17497 _designControl.Invalidate();
17498 }

17508 private Entity? FindNearbyWaypoint(System.Drawing.Point screenPoint, double pixelTolerance = 30.0)
17509 {
17510 Entity? closestWaypoint = null;
17511 double minScreenDist = pixelTolerance;
17512
17513 foreach (var ent in _designControl.Entities)
17514 {
17515 if (ent.EntityData is WaypointData wd && wd.Path != null && wd.PointIndex >= 0 && wd.PointIndex < wd.Path.Points.Count)
17516 {
17517 Point3D pt = wd.Path.Points[wd.PointIndex];
17518 Point3D wpScreen = _designControl.WorldToScreen(pt);
17519 if (wpScreen == null) continue;
17520
17521 double dx = screenPoint.X - wpScreen.X;
17522 double dy = screenPoint.Y - wpScreen.Y;
17523 double dist = Math.Sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
17524
17525 if (dist < minScreenDist)
17526 {
17527 minScreenDist = dist;
17528 closestWaypoint = ent;
17529 }
17530 }
17531 }
17532 return closestWaypoint;
17533 }
17534
17541 private Point3D GetClosestPointOnPath(LinearPath pathLine, System.Drawing.Point screenPoint)
17542 {
17543 if (pathLine.Vertices.Length < 2) return null!;
17544
17545 var camera = _designControl.ActiveViewport.Camera;
17546 Point3D clickWorldPoint = _designControl.ScreenToWorld(screenPoint);
17547 if (clickWorldPoint == null) return null!;
17548
17549 Point3D rayOrigin;
17550 Vector3D rayDir;
17551
17552 if (camera.ProjectionMode == devDept.Eyeshot.projectionType.Perspective)
17553 {
17554 rayOrigin = camera.Location;
17555 rayDir = new Vector3D(camera.Location, clickWorldPoint);
17556 }
17557 else
17558 {
17559 rayOrigin = clickWorldPoint;
17560 rayDir = new Vector3D(camera.Location, camera.Target);
17561 }
17562 rayDir.Normalize();
17563
17564 Point3D a = pathLine.Vertices[0];
17565 Point3D b = pathLine.Vertices[1];
17566 Vector3D V = new Vector3D(a, b);
17567 Vector3D W0 = new Vector3D(a, rayOrigin);
17568
17569 double bDot = Vector3D.Dot(rayDir, V);
17570 double c = V.LengthSquared;
17571 double d = Vector3D.Dot(rayDir, W0);
17572 double e = Vector3D.Dot(V, W0);
17573
17574 double denom = c - bDot * bDot;
17575 double t = 0;
17576 if (denom < 1e-9)
17577 {
17578 if (c > 1e-9)
17579 {
17580 t = e / c;
17581 }
17582 }
17583 else
17584 {
17585 t = (e - bDot * d) / denom;
17586 }
17587 t = Math.Max(0.0, Math.Min(1.0, t));
17588
17589 return a + t * V;
17590 }
17591
17598 private LinearPath? FindNearbyPathLine(System.Drawing.Point screenPoint, double pixelTolerance = 150.0)
17599 {
17600 LinearPath? closestPathLine = null;
17601 double minScreenDist = pixelTolerance;
17602
17603 foreach (var ent in _designControl.Entities)
17604 {
17605 if (ent is LinearPath pathLine && pathLine.LayerName != null && pathLine.LayerName.StartsWith(PathManager.PATH_LAYER_PREFIX))
17606 {
17607 for (int i = 0; i < pathLine.Vertices.Length - 1; i++)
17608 {
17609 Point3D p1Screen = _designControl.WorldToScreen(pathLine.Vertices[i]);
17610 Point3D p2Screen = _designControl.WorldToScreen(pathLine.Vertices[i + 1]);
17611 if (p1Screen == null || p2Screen == null) continue;
17612
17613 double dist = DistanceToSegment(new Point2D(screenPoint.X, screenPoint.Y), new Point2D(p1Screen.X, p1Screen.Y), new Point2D(p2Screen.X, p2Screen.Y));
17614 if (dist < minScreenDist)
17615 {
17616 minScreenDist = dist;
17617 closestPathLine = pathLine;
17618 }
17619 }
17620 }
17621 }
17622 return closestPathLine;
17623 }
17624
17632 private double DistanceToSegment(Point2D p, Point2D a, Point2D b)
17633 {
17634 double dx = b.X - a.X;
17635 double dy = b.Y - a.Y;
17636 double l2 = dx * dx + dy * dy;
17637 if (l2 < 1e-9)
17638 {
17639 double px = p.X - a.X;
17640 double py = p.Y - a.Y;
17641 return Math.Sqrt(px * px + py * py);
17642 }
17643 double t = ((p.X - a.X) * dx + (p.Y - a.Y) * dy) / l2;
17644 t = Math.Max(0, Math.Min(1, t));
17645 double projX = a.X + t * dx;
17646 double projY = a.Y + t * dy;
17647 double diffX = p.X - projX;
17648 double diffY = p.Y - projY;
17649 return Math.Sqrt(diffX * diffX + diffY * diffY);
17650 }
17651
17659 private (int prevWp, int nextWp) FindSurroundingWaypoints(ColorPath path, int p)
17660 {
17661 int prevWp = 0;
17662 int nextWp = path.Points.Count - 1;
17663
17664 var waypointIndices = new HashSet<int>();
17665 foreach (var ent in _designControl.Entities)
17666 {
17667 if (ent.EntityData is WaypointData wd && wd.Path == path)
17668 {
17669 waypointIndices.Add(wd.PointIndex);
17670 }
17671 }
17672
17673 waypointIndices.Add(0);
17674 waypointIndices.Add(path.Points.Count - 1);
17675
17676 for (int i = p - 1; i >= 0; i--)
17677 {
17678 if (waypointIndices.Contains(i))
17679 {
17680 prevWp = i;
17681 break;
17682 }
17683 }
17684
17685 for (int i = p + 1; i < path.Points.Count; i++)
17686 {
17687 if (waypointIndices.Contains(i))
17688 {
17689 nextWp = i;
17690 break;
17691 }
17692 }
17693
17694 return (prevWp, nextWp);
17695 }

17785
17786 private void CheckToolCollisionOnPoint(Entity entity, WaypointData wpData)
17787 {
17788 // 1. Visually place the tool using the existing logic
17789 ShowToolPreviewOnPoint(entity, wpData);
17790
17791 if (_previewToolEntity == null) return;
17792
17793 // Allow UI to render it briefly before locking up with computation
17794 System.Windows.Application.Current.Dispatcher.Invoke(() => { }, System.Windows.Threading.DispatcherPriority.Render);
17795
17796 try
17797 {
17798 // 2. Gather ONLY the actual workpiece part entities
17799 var partEntities = OrderedPartEntities.Where(e => e.Visible).ToList();
17800 if (partEntities.Count == 0) return;
17801
17802 // 3. Extract tool mesh with transformation applied
17803 Mesh? toolMesh = ExtractTransformedToolMesh(_previewToolEntity);
17804 if (toolMesh == null || toolMesh.Vertices == null || toolMesh.Vertices.Length == 0) return;
17805
17806 // 4. Extract part meshes
17807 var partMeshes = new List<(Entity Entity, Mesh Mesh)>();
17808 foreach (var partEnt in partEntities)
17809 {
17810 Mesh? partMesh = ExtractEntityMesh(partEnt);
17811 if (partMesh != null)
17812 partMeshes.Add((partEnt, partMesh));
17813 }
17814 if (partMeshes.Count == 0) return;
17815
17816 // 5. SOLID COLLISION CHECK (ray-casting containment + surface intersection)
17817 bool hasExactCollision = false;
17818 var collidedParts = new HashSet<string>();
17819 int intersectionPointsCount = 0;
17820
17821 // 5a. Ray-cast containment: sample multiple tool vertices and check if inside part
17822 var samplePoints = GetToolSamplePoints(toolMesh);
17823 foreach (var (partEnt, partMesh) in partMeshes)
17824 {
17825 foreach (var samplePt in samplePoints)
17826 {
17827 if (IsToolPointInsideMesh(samplePt, partMesh))
17828 {
17829 hasExactCollision = true;
17830 string partName = partEnt.EntityData as string ?? "Unknown Part";
17831 collidedParts.Add(System.IO.Path.GetFileName(partName));
17832 break;
17833 }
17834 }
17835 if (hasExactCollision) break;
17836 }
17837
17838 // 5b. Also check surface intersection using Eyeshot (catches partial surface crossings)
17839 if (!hasExactCollision)
17840 {
17841 var testEntities = new List<Entity>(partEntities);
17842 testEntities.Add(_previewToolEntity);
17843 var cdExact = new devDept.Eyeshot.CollisionDetection(testEntities, _designControl.Blocks, false, devDept.Eyeshot.collisionCheckType.Accurate, nodeMaxItemCount: 5);
17844 cdExact.DoWork();
17845
17846 if (cdExact.Result != null && cdExact.Result.Length > 0)
17847 {
17848 var exactResults = cdExact.Result.Where(r =>
17849 r.CollidedEntities.Item1.Entity == _previewToolEntity ||
17850 r.CollidedEntities.Item2.Entity == _previewToolEntity).ToList();
17851 hasExactCollision = exactResults.Count > 0;
17852
17853 foreach (var r in exactResults)
17854 {
17855 var otherEnt = (r.CollidedEntities.Item1.Entity == _previewToolEntity) ? r.CollidedEntities.Item2.Entity : r.CollidedEntities.Item1.Entity;
17856 string partName = otherEnt.EntityData as string ?? "Unknown Part";
17857 collidedParts.Add(System.IO.Path.GetFileName(partName));
17858 if (r.CollisionItems != null) intersectionPointsCount += System.Linq.Enumerable.Count(r.CollisionItems);
17859 }
17860 }
17861 }
17862
17863 // Determine normal direction for tolerance/depth check: use the point's normal; for approach points use the adjacent measurement point normal
17864 devDept.Geometry.Vector3D normal = new devDept.Geometry.Vector3D(0, 0, 1);
17865 if (wpData.Path?.Normals != null && wpData.PointIndex >= 0 && wpData.PointIndex < wpData.Path.Normals.Count)
17866 {
17867 normal = wpData.Path.Normals[wpData.PointIndex];
17868
17869 bool isApproach = wpData.Path.PointTypes != null && wpData.PointIndex < wpData.Path.PointTypes.Count &&
17870 string.Equals(wpData.Path.PointTypes[wpData.PointIndex], "Approach", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
17871 if (isApproach)
17872 {
17873 int mIdx = -1;
17874 if (wpData.Path.IsMeasure != null && wpData.PointIndex + 1 < wpData.Path.Points.Count && wpData.PointIndex + 1 < wpData.Path.IsMeasure.Count && wpData.Path.IsMeasure[wpData.PointIndex + 1])
17875 mIdx = wpData.PointIndex + 1;
17876 else if (wpData.Path.IsMeasure != null && wpData.PointIndex > 0 && wpData.PointIndex - 1 < wpData.Path.IsMeasure.Count && wpData.Path.IsMeasure[wpData.PointIndex - 1])
17877 mIdx = wpData.PointIndex - 1;
17878 if (mIdx >= 0 && mIdx < wpData.Path.Normals.Count)
17879 normal = wpData.Path.Normals[mIdx];
17880 }
17881 }
17882
17883 // 6. TOLERANCE CHECK — always performed when tolerance > 0
17884 double tolerance = 2.0;
17885 if (_pathManager != null)
17886 {
17887 tolerance = _pathManager.FilterConfig.CollisionTolerance;
17888 }
17889 else
17890 {
17891 if (double.TryParse(System.Configuration.ConfigurationManager.AppSettings["ProbeCollision_CollisionTolerance"],
17892 System.Globalization.NumberStyles.Any, System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, out double parsedTol))
17893 {
17894 tolerance = Math.Max(0.0, parsedTol);
17895 }
17896 }
17897 bool hasToleranceCollision = false;
17898
17899 if (tolerance > 0)
17900 {
17901
17902 // Move tool outward along normal by tolerance and re-check with both methods
17903 devDept.Geometry.Vector3D moveVec = normal * tolerance;
17904
17905 // Ray-cast: offset sample points
17906 var offsetSamples = samplePoints.Select(p => new Point3D(p.X + moveVec.X, p.Y + moveVec.Y, p.Z + moveVec.Z)).ToList();
17907 foreach (var (partEnt, partMesh) in partMeshes)
17908 {
17909 foreach (var sp in offsetSamples)
17910 {
17911 if (IsToolPointInsideMesh(sp, partMesh)) { hasToleranceCollision = true; break; }
17912 }
17913 if (hasToleranceCollision) break;
17914 }
17915
17916 // Eyeshot surface intersection with translated tool
17917 if (!hasToleranceCollision)
17918 {
17919 _previewToolEntity.Translate(moveVec);
17920 _previewToolEntity.UpdateBoundingBox(new devDept.Eyeshot.TraversalParams(_designControl));
17921 var testEntities = new List<Entity>(partEntities) { _previewToolEntity };
17922 var cdTol = new devDept.Eyeshot.CollisionDetection(testEntities, _designControl.Blocks, false, devDept.Eyeshot.collisionCheckType.Accurate, nodeMaxItemCount: 5);
17923 cdTol.DoWork();
17924 if (cdTol.Result != null && cdTol.Result.Length > 0)
17925 hasToleranceCollision = cdTol.Result.Any(r => r.CollidedEntities.Item1.Entity == _previewToolEntity || r.CollidedEntities.Item2.Entity == _previewToolEntity);
17926 _previewToolEntity.Translate(moveVec * -1);
17927 _previewToolEntity.UpdateBoundingBox(new devDept.Eyeshot.TraversalParams(_designControl));
17928 }
17929 }
17930 else
17931 {
17932 hasToleranceCollision = hasExactCollision;
17933 }
17934
17935 // 7. Calculate exact penetration depth (binary search) if collides
17936 double collisionDepth = 0.0;
17937 if (hasExactCollision)
17938 {
17939 double maxCheck = 50.0;
17940 Func<double, bool> checkDist = (d) =>
17941 {
17942 devDept.Geometry.Vector3D mVec = normal * d;
17943 var offSamples = samplePoints.Select(p => new Point3D(p.X + mVec.X, p.Y + mVec.Y, p.Z + mVec.Z)).ToList();
17944 bool hit = false;
17945 foreach (var (partEnt, partMesh) in partMeshes)
17946 {
17947 foreach (var sp in offSamples)
17948 if (IsToolPointInsideMesh(sp, partMesh)) { hit = true; break; }
17949 if (hit) break;
17950 }
17951 if (!hit)
17952 {
17953 _previewToolEntity.Translate(mVec);
17954 _previewToolEntity.UpdateBoundingBox(new devDept.Eyeshot.TraversalParams(_designControl));
17955 var cdDist = new devDept.Eyeshot.CollisionDetection(new List<Entity>(partEntities) { _previewToolEntity }, _designControl.Blocks, false, devDept.Eyeshot.collisionCheckType.Accurate, nodeMaxItemCount: 5);
17956 cdDist.DoWork();
17957 if (cdDist.Result != null && cdDist.Result.Length > 0)
17958 hit = cdDist.Result.Any(r => r.CollidedEntities.Item1.Entity == _previewToolEntity || r.CollidedEntities.Item2.Entity == _previewToolEntity);
17959 _previewToolEntity.Translate(mVec * -1);
17960 _previewToolEntity.UpdateBoundingBox(new devDept.Eyeshot.TraversalParams(_designControl));
17961 }
17962 return hit;
17963 };
17964
17965 if (checkDist(maxCheck))
17966 {
17967 collisionDepth = maxCheck; // > maxCheck actually
17968 }
17969 else
17970 {
17971 double low = 0.0;
17972 double high = maxCheck;
17973 for (int iter = 0; iter < 8; iter++)
17974 {
17975 double mid = (low + high) / 2.0;
17976 if (checkDist(mid)) low = mid;
17977 else high = mid;
17978 }
17979 collisionDepth = high;
17980 }
17981 }
17982
17983 // 8. Display results
17984 string title = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "PointCollisionCheck_Title") ?? "Point Collision Check";
17985 string statsHeader = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "PointCollisionCheck_StatsHeader") ?? "--- Collision Stats ---";
17986 string exactStatStr = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "PointCollisionCheck_ExactStat") ?? "Exact Collision (0 mm):";
17987 string toleranceStatStr = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "PointCollisionCheck_ToleranceStat") ?? "Tolerance Collision";
17988 string yesStr = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "PointCollisionCheck_Yes") ?? "YES";
17989 string noStr = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "PointCollisionCheck_No") ?? "NO";
17990 string penGtr = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "PointCollisionCheck_PenetrationGreater") ?? "(Penetration > {0} mm)";
17991 string penLte = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "PointCollisionCheck_PenetrationLess") ?? "(Penetration <= {0} mm)";
17992 string colPartsStr = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "PointCollisionCheck_CollidedParts") ?? "Collided Parts:";
17993 string intPointsStr = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "PointCollisionCheck_IntersectionPoints") ?? "Intersection Points:";
17994 string estimatedDepthStr = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "PointCollisionCheck_EstimatedDepth") ?? "Estimated Collision Depth: ~{0} mm";
17995
17996 var sb = new System.Text.StringBuilder();
17997
17998 if (hasExactCollision)
17999 {
18000 bool isWarningOnly = tolerance > 0 && !hasToleranceCollision;
18001
18002 if (isWarningOnly)
18003 {
18004 string warnMsg = (GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "PointCollisionCheck_WarningCleared") ?? "Collision Detected within Tolerance!\nThe tool collides at exact position, but clears when moved out by {0} mm.").Replace("\\n", "\n");
18005 sb.AppendLine(string.Format(warnMsg, tolerance.ToString("F1")));
18006 }
18007 else
18008 {
18009 sb.AppendLine((GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "PointCollisionCheck_CollisionFound") ?? "Exact Collision Detected!\nThe tool model collides with the part.").Replace("\\n", "\n"));
18010 }
18011
18012 sb.AppendLine();
18013 sb.AppendLine(statsHeader);
18014 sb.AppendLine($"{exactStatStr} {yesStr}");
18015 sb.AppendLine(string.Format(estimatedDepthStr, collisionDepth.ToString("F1")));
18016
18017 if (hasToleranceCollision)
18018 sb.AppendLine($"{toleranceStatStr} (+{tolerance} mm): {yesStr} " + string.Format(penGtr, tolerance));
18019 else
18020 sb.AppendLine($"{toleranceStatStr} (+{tolerance} mm): {noStr} " + string.Format(penLte, tolerance));
18021
18022 sb.AppendLine();
18023 sb.AppendLine($"{colPartsStr} {string.Join(", ", collidedParts)}");
18024 if (intersectionPointsCount > 0) sb.AppendLine($"{intPointsStr} {intersectionPointsCount}");
18025
18026 if (isWarningOnly)
18027 {
18028 System.Windows.MessageBox.Show(sb.ToString(), title, System.Windows.MessageBoxButton.OK, System.Windows.MessageBoxImage.Warning);
18029 }
18030 else
18031 {
18032 System.Windows.MessageBox.Show(sb.ToString(), title, System.Windows.MessageBoxButton.OK, System.Windows.MessageBoxImage.Error);
18033 }
18034 }
18035 else
18036 {
18037 if (hasToleranceCollision)
18038 {
18039 string msg = (GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "PointCollisionCheck_ClearExactButToleranceHit") ?? "Clear of Exact Collision (0 mm),\nBUT Tolerance Collision (+{0} mm) Detected!\nThe tool is within {0} mm of the part.").Replace("\\n", "\n");
18040 sb.AppendLine(string.Format(msg, tolerance.ToString("F1")));
18041 }
18042 else
18043 {
18044 string msg = (GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "PointCollisionCheck_Clear") ?? "Clear of Collisions!\nThe tool does not collide with the part and the minimum distance ({0} mm) is safe (above {1} mm tolerance).").Replace("\\n", "\n");
18045 sb.AppendLine(string.Format(msg, "> " + tolerance.ToString("F1"), tolerance.ToString("F1")));
18046 }
18047 sb.AppendLine();
18048 sb.AppendLine(statsHeader);
18049 sb.AppendLine($"{exactStatStr} {noStr}");
18050 if (tolerance > 0)
18051 sb.AppendLine($"{toleranceStatStr} (+{tolerance} mm): {(hasToleranceCollision ? yesStr : noStr)}");
18052
18053 System.Windows.MessageBox.Show(sb.ToString(), title, System.Windows.MessageBoxButton.OK, hasToleranceCollision ? System.Windows.MessageBoxImage.Warning : System.Windows.MessageBoxImage.Information);
18054 }
18055 }
18056 catch (Exception ex)
18057 {
18058 System.Windows.MessageBox.Show("Error during collision check: " + ex.Message, "Error", System.Windows.MessageBoxButton.OK, System.Windows.MessageBoxImage.Error);
18059 }
18060 }

18062 private Mesh? ExtractEntityMesh(Entity entity)
18063 {
18064 if (entity == null) return null;
18065 if (entity is Mesh m) return m;
18066 if (entity is Brep brep)
18067 {
18068 var combinedMesh = new Mesh();
18069 foreach (var face in brep.Faces)
18070 {
18071 var faceMesh = face?.ConvertToMesh();
18072 if (faceMesh != null && faceMesh.Vertices != null && faceMesh.Vertices.Length > 0)
18073 {
18074 int offset = combinedMesh.Vertices?.Length ?? 0;
18075 var newVerts = (combinedMesh.Vertices ?? Array.Empty<Point3D>()).Concat(faceMesh.Vertices ?? Array.Empty<Point3D>()).ToArray();
18076 var newTris = (combinedMesh.Triangles?.ToList() ?? new List<IndexTriangle>());
18077 if (faceMesh.Triangles != null)
18078 {
18079 foreach (var tri in faceMesh.Triangles)
18080 newTris.Add(new IndexTriangle(tri.V1 + offset, tri.V2 + offset, tri.V3 + offset));
18081 }
18082 combinedMesh.Vertices = newVerts;
18083 combinedMesh.Triangles = newTris.ToArray();
18084 }
18085 }
18086 return combinedMesh.Vertices?.Length > 0 ? combinedMesh : null;
18087 }
18088 if (entity is devDept.Eyeshot.Entities.BlockReference br && _designControl?.Blocks != null && _designControl.Blocks.Contains(br.BlockName))
18089 {
18090 var block = _designControl.Blocks[br.BlockName];
18091 var combinedMesh = new Mesh();
18092 foreach (var innerEnt in block.Entities)
18093 {
18094 var innerMesh = ExtractEntityMesh(innerEnt);
18095 if (innerMesh != null && innerMesh.Vertices != null && innerMesh.Vertices.Length > 0)
18096 {
18097 var cloned = (Mesh)innerMesh.Clone();
18098 cloned.TransformBy(br.Transformation);
18099 int offset = combinedMesh.Vertices?.Length ?? 0;
18100 var newVerts = (combinedMesh.Vertices ?? Array.Empty<Point3D>()).Concat(cloned.Vertices ?? Array.Empty<Point3D>()).ToArray();
18101 var newTris = (combinedMesh.Triangles?.ToList() ?? new List<IndexTriangle>());
18102 if (cloned.Triangles != null)
18103 {
18104 foreach (var tri in cloned.Triangles)
18105 newTris.Add(new IndexTriangle(tri.V1 + offset, tri.V2 + offset, tri.V3 + offset));
18106 }
18107 combinedMesh.Vertices = newVerts;
18108 combinedMesh.Triangles = newTris.ToArray();
18109 }
18110 }
18111 return combinedMesh.Vertices?.Length > 0 ? combinedMesh : null;
18112 }
18113 return null;
18114 }

18121 private List<Point3D> GetToolSamplePoints(Mesh toolMesh)
18122 {
18123 var points = new List<Point3D>();
18124 if (toolMesh?.Vertices == null || toolMesh.Vertices.Length == 0)
18125 return points;
18126
18127 double cx = 0, cy = 0, cz = 0;
18128 double minX = double.MaxValue, minY = double.MaxValue, minZ = double.MaxValue;
18129 double maxX = double.MinValue, maxY = double.MinValue, maxZ = double.MinValue;
18130
18131 foreach (var v in toolMesh.Vertices)
18132 {
18133 cx += v.X; cy += v.Y; cz += v.Z;
18134 if (v.X < minX) minX = v.X; if (v.X > maxX) maxX = v.X;
18135 if (v.Y < minY) minY = v.Y; if (v.Y > maxY) maxY = v.Y;
18136 if (v.Z < minZ) minZ = v.Z; if (v.Z > maxZ) maxZ = v.Z;
18137 }
18138
18139 int count = toolMesh.Vertices.Length;
18140 points.Add(new Point3D(cx / count, cy / count, cz / count)); // Centroid
18141 points.Add(new Point3D((minX + maxX) / 2.0, (minY + maxY) / 2.0, (minZ + maxZ) / 2.0)); // BBox Center
18142 points.Add(new Point3D(minX, minY, minZ));
18143 points.Add(new Point3D(maxX, maxY, maxZ));
18144 points.Add(new Point3D(minX, maxY, maxZ));
18145 points.Add(new Point3D(maxX, minY, minZ));
18146
18147 // Also sample a subset of actual vertices if mesh is detailed
18148 int step = Math.Max(1, count / 16);
18149 for (int i = 0; i < count; i += step)
18150 {
18151 points.Add(toolMesh.Vertices[i]);
18152 }
18153
18154 return points;
18155 }
18156
18161 private bool IsToolPointInsideMesh(Point3D point, Mesh mesh)
18162 {
18163 if (mesh?.Vertices == null || mesh.Triangles == null || mesh.Triangles.Length == 0)
18164 return false;
18165
18166 try
18167 {
18168 // Bounding box check
18169 double minX = double.MaxValue, minY = double.MaxValue, minZ = double.MaxValue;
18170 double maxX = double.MinValue, maxY = double.MinValue, maxZ = double.MinValue;
18171 foreach (var v in mesh.Vertices)
18172 {
18173 if (v.X < minX) minX = v.X; if (v.X > maxX) maxX = v.X;
18174 if (v.Y < minY) minY = v.Y; if (v.Y > maxY) maxY = v.Y;
18175 if (v.Z < minZ) minZ = v.Z; if (v.Z > maxZ) maxZ = v.Z;
18176 }
18177 if (point.X < minX || point.X > maxX || point.Y < minY || point.Y > maxY || point.Z < minZ || point.Z > maxZ)
18178 return false;
18179
18180 // Ray casting along +Z axis to count intersections
18181 Vector3D rayDir = Vector3D.AxisZ;
18182 int intersectionCount = 0;
18183 const double EPSILON = 0.0000001;
18184
18185 foreach (var tri in mesh.Triangles)
18186 {
18187 if (tri.V1 >= mesh.Vertices.Length || tri.V2 >= mesh.Vertices.Length || tri.V3 >= mesh.Vertices.Length)
18188 continue;
18189
18190 var v0 = mesh.Vertices[tri.V1];
18191 var v1 = mesh.Vertices[tri.V2];
18192 var v2 = mesh.Vertices[tri.V3];
18193
18194 // Fast AABB check for the ray column
18195 double tMinX = Math.Min(v0.X, Math.Min(v1.X, v2.X));
18196 double tMaxX = Math.Max(v0.X, Math.Max(v1.X, v2.X));
18197 double tMinY = Math.Min(v0.Y, Math.Min(v1.Y, v2.Y));
18198 double tMaxY = Math.Max(v0.Y, Math.Max(v1.Y, v2.Y));
18199 if (point.X < tMinX || point.X > tMaxX || point.Y < tMinY || point.Y > tMaxY)
18200 continue;
18201 double tMaxZ = Math.Max(v0.Z, Math.Max(v1.Z, v2.Z));
18202 if (point.Z > tMaxZ)
18203 continue;
18204
18205 // Möller–Trumbore intersection test
18206 Vector3D edge1 = new Vector3D(v1.X - v0.X, v1.Y - v0.Y, v1.Z - v0.Z);
18207 Vector3D edge2 = new Vector3D(v2.X - v0.X, v2.Y - v0.Y, v2.Z - v0.Z);
18208 Vector3D h = Vector3D.Cross(rayDir, edge2);
18209 double a = Vector3D.Dot(edge1, h);
18210 if (a > -EPSILON && a < EPSILON) continue;
18211
18212 double f = 1.0 / a;
18213 Vector3D s = new Vector3D(point.X - v0.X, point.Y - v0.Y, point.Z - v0.Z);
18214 double u = f * Vector3D.Dot(s, h);
18215 if (u < 0.0 || u > 1.0) continue;
18216
18217 Vector3D q = Vector3D.Cross(s, edge1);
18218 double vParam = f * Vector3D.Dot(rayDir, q);
18219 if (vParam < 0.0 || u + vParam > 1.0) continue;
18220
18221 double t = f * Vector3D.Dot(edge2, q);
18222 if (t > EPSILON)
18223 intersectionCount++;
18224 }
18225
18226 return intersectionCount % 2 == 1;
18227 }
18228 catch
18229 {
18230 return false;
18231 }
18232 }

18234 private void ShowToolPreviewOnPoint(Entity entity, WaypointData wpData)
18235 {
18236 HideToolPreview();
18237
18238 if (_pathManager == null) return;
18239 string toolName = _pathManager.CurrentSimulationToolName;
18240 if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(toolName)) toolName = wpData.Path.ToolName;
18241 if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(toolName)) return;
18242
18243 Entity? toolEntity = null;
18244 if (wpData.Path.PathCmmType == Models.CMMType.Scanner)
18245 {
18246 toolEntity = Utilities.ToolModelLoader.LoadMachineModel(toolName, _designControl);
18247 }
18248 else
18249 {
18250 double r = _pathManager.FilterConfig.ProbeRadius;
18251 double h = _pathManager.FilterConfig.ProbeHeight;
18252 toolEntity = Utilities.ToolModelLoader.LoadToolModel(toolName, r, h, _designControl);
18253 if (toolEntity == null)
18254 {
18255 double defaultToolSizeMultiplier = Math.Max(0.01, _pathManager.FilterConfig.SimulationDefaultToolSizeMultiplier);
18256 double defaultRadius = r * defaultToolSizeMultiplier;
18257 double defaultHeight = h * defaultToolSizeMultiplier;
18258 toolEntity = Utilities.ToolModelLoader.CreateDefaultCylinderProbe(defaultRadius, defaultHeight, Point3D.Origin);
18259 toolEntity.Color = System.Drawing.Color.Red;
18260 toolEntity.ColorMethod = colorMethodType.byEntity;
18261 }
18262 }
18263
18264 if (toolEntity == null) return;
18265
18266 if (!(toolEntity is devDept.Eyeshot.Entities.BlockReference))
18267 {
18268 string blockName = "PreviewToolBlock_" + Guid.NewGuid().ToString();
18269 var block = new devDept.Eyeshot.Block(blockName);
18270 block.Entities.Add(toolEntity);
18271 _designControl.Blocks.Add(block);
18272 toolEntity = new devDept.Eyeshot.Entities.BlockReference(0, 0, 0, blockName, 1, 1, 1, 0);
18273 }
18274
18275 Point3D pt = wpData.Path.Points[wpData.PointIndex];
18276 Vector3D normal = wpData.Path.Normals[wpData.PointIndex];
18277 Vector3D? up = null;
18278 if (wpData.Path.UpVectors != null && wpData.PointIndex < wpData.Path.UpVectors.Count)
18279 up = wpData.Path.UpVectors[wpData.PointIndex];
18280
18281 if (toolEntity is devDept.Eyeshot.Entities.BlockReference blockRef)
18282 {
18283 blockRef.Transformation = BuildPreviewToolTransform(pt, normal, up);
18284 }
18285 _previewToolEntity = toolEntity;
18286 _previewToolEntity.UpdateBoundingBox(new devDept.Eyeshot.TraversalParams(_designControl));
18287 _designControl.Entities.Add(_previewToolEntity);
18288 _designControl.Invalidate();
18289 }

18291 private devDept.Geometry.Transformation BuildPreviewToolTransform(Point3D targetPoint, Vector3D surfaceNormal, Vector3D? upVector)
18292 {
18293 Vector3D rotationTarget = surfaceNormal.Length > 0.0001
18294 ? new Vector3D(surfaceNormal.X, surfaceNormal.Y, surfaceNormal.Z)
18295 : new Vector3D(0, 0, 1);
18296 rotationTarget.Normalize();
18297
18298 Vector3D zAxis = new Vector3D(0, 0, -1);
18299 devDept.Geometry.Transformation rotationTrans = new devDept.Geometry.Transformation();
18300 Vector3D rotationAxis = Vector3D.Cross(zAxis, rotationTarget);
18301 if (rotationAxis.Length > 0.0001)
18302 {
18303 rotationAxis.Normalize();
18304 double angle = Math.Acos(Math.Max(-1.0, Math.Min(1.0, Vector3D.Dot(zAxis, rotationTarget))));
18305 rotationTrans = devDept.Geometry.Transformation.CreateRotation(angle, rotationAxis);
18306 }
18307 else if (Vector3D.Dot(zAxis, rotationTarget) < -0.999)
18308 {
18309 rotationTrans = devDept.Geometry.Transformation.CreateRotation(Math.PI, Vector3D.AxisX);
18310 }
18311
18312 if (upVector != null && upVector.Length > 1e-6)
18313 {
18314 var localY = new Vector3D(0, 1, 0);
18315 localY.TransformBy(rotationTrans);
18316
18317 var projUp = upVector - rotationTarget * Vector3D.Dot(upVector, rotationTarget);
18318 if (projUp.Length > 1e-6)
18319 {
18320 projUp.Normalize();
18321 double rollAngle = Math.Acos(Math.Max(-1.0, Math.Min(1.0, Vector3D.Dot(localY, projUp))));
18322
18323 if (Vector3D.Dot(Vector3D.Cross(localY, projUp), rotationTarget) < 0)
18324 {
18325 rollAngle = -rollAngle;
18326 }
18327
18328 var rollTrans = devDept.Geometry.Transformation.CreateRotation(rollAngle, rotationTarget);
18329 rotationTrans = rollTrans * rotationTrans;
18330 }
18331 }
18332
18333 devDept.Geometry.Transformation translationTrans = devDept.Geometry.Transformation.CreateTranslation(targetPoint.X, targetPoint.Y, targetPoint.Z);
18334 return translationTrans * rotationTrans;
18335 }

18455 private async Task RedoFaceCollisionCheckAsync(object param)
18456 {
18457 if (_pathManager == null || !_pathManager.HasGeneratedProbePaths()) return;
18458 if (_pathManager.IsSimulating)
18459 {
18460 System.Windows.MessageBox.Show(
18461 GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "ProbeCollision_Error_SimulationRunning") ?? "Cannot start a probe collision check while a simulation is running. Please stop the simulation first.",
18462 GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "ContextMenu_RerunFaceSegmentsCollisionCheck") ?? "Check Face Path Segments Collisions",
18463 System.Windows.MessageBoxButton.OK,
18464 System.Windows.MessageBoxImage.Warning);
18465 return;
18466 }
18467
18468 int selectedEntityIndex = _lastRightClickedPart != null && _designControl != null ? _designControl.Entities.IndexOf(_lastRightClickedPart) : -1;
18469
18470 if (selectedEntityIndex >= 0)
18471 {
18472 var pathsToVerify = _pathManager.ColorPaths.Values
18473 .Where(p => p.PathCmmType == CMMType.Probe && p.Points != null && p.Points.Count > 1)
18474 .Where(p => p.PointEntityIndices != null && p.PointEntityIndices.Contains(selectedEntityIndex))
18475 .ToList();
18476
18477 if (pathsToVerify.Any())
18478 {
18479 HideBaseAvoidancePlaneForCollisionOrSimulation();
18480 await PreloadToolModelsAsync(false);
18481 // Clear previous red marks on these specific paths
18482 foreach (var path in pathsToVerify)
18483 {
18484 path.ProbeCollisionSegmentIndices?.Clear();
18485 }
18486 _pathManager.RegeneratePathVisuals();
18487
18488 await _pathManager.RunProbeCollisionValidationAsync(promptForSave: false, showNoCollisionMessage: true, pathsToVerify: pathsToVerify);
18489 }
18490 else
18491 {
18492 System.Windows.MessageBox.Show(
18493 GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "ProbeCollision_NoFaceProbePaths") ?? "No generated probe paths exist on this face.",
18494 GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "ContextMenu_RerunFaceSegmentsCollisionCheck") ?? "Check Face Path Segments Collisions",
18495 System.Windows.MessageBoxButton.OK,
18496 System.Windows.MessageBoxImage.Information);
18497 }
18498 }
18499 }
18500
18501 private async Task RunProbeCollisionCheckAsync()
18502 {
18503 if (_pathManager == null || !_pathManager.HasGeneratedProbePaths())
18504 return;
18505 if (_pathManager.IsSimulating)
18506 {
18507 System.Windows.MessageBox.Show(
18508 GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "ProbeCollision_Error_SimulationRunning") ?? "Cannot start a probe collision check while a simulation is running. Please stop the simulation first.",
18509 GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "ProbeCollision_Title") ?? "Probe Collision Check",
18510 System.Windows.MessageBoxButton.OK,
18511 System.Windows.MessageBoxImage.Warning);
18512 return;
18513 }
18514
18515 Mouse.OverrideCursor = Cursors.Wait;
18516 try
18517 {
18518 // Ensure tools are up to date before collision check
18519 _measuringToolConfig.ReloadConfiguration();
18520 if (_pathManager.ColorPaths != null)
18521 {
18522 foreach (var colorPath in _pathManager.ColorPaths.Values)
18523 {
18524 if (colorPath.PathCmmType == Models.CMMType.Probe || colorPath.PathCmmType == Models.CMMType.Scanner)
18525 {
18526 string currentToolName = _measuringToolConfig.GetToolForColor(colorPath.Color);
18527 if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(currentToolName) && colorPath.ToolName != currentToolName)
18528 {
18529 colorPath.ToolName = currentToolName;
18530 }
18531 }
18532 }
18533 }

18535 HideBaseAvoidancePlaneForCollisionOrSimulation();
18536 string startingText = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "StartingProbeCollisionCheck") ?? "Starting probe collision check...";

18540 await _pathManager.RunProbeCollisionValidationAsync();

18554 private async Task RunSegmentCollisionCheckAsync()
18555 {
18556 if (_pathManager == null)
18557 return;
18558
18559 HideBaseAvoidancePlaneForCollisionOrSimulation();
18560
18561 int removedUnsafePoints = _pathManager.PruneUnsafeBaseAvoidancePoints();
18562 if (removedUnsafePoints > 0)
18563 {
18564 _pathManager.RegeneratePathVisuals();
18565 measuring_sp?.PopulatePathViewerTree();
18566 }
18567
18568 if (!_pathManager.CanRunGeneratedPathSegmentCollisionValidation)
18569 {
18570 System.Windows.MessageBox.Show(
18571 GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "SegmentCollision_NoGeneratedSegments") ?? "No generated path segments are available for collision validation, or segment collision validation is disabled.",
18572 GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "PathPlanning_SegmentCollisionTitle") ?? "Path Planning Collision Check",
18573 System.Windows.MessageBoxButton.OK,
18574 System.Windows.MessageBoxImage.Information);
18575 return;
18576 }
18577
18578 if (_pathManager.IsSimulating || _pathManager.IsProbeCollisionValidationRunning)
18579 {
18580 System.Windows.MessageBox.Show(
18581 GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "SegmentCollision_Error_SimulationRunning") ?? "Cannot start a segment collision check while simulation or probe collision validation is running.",
18582 GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "PathPlanning_SegmentCollisionTitle") ?? "Path Planning Collision Check",
18583 System.Windows.MessageBoxButton.OK,
18584 System.Windows.MessageBoxImage.Warning);
18585 return;
18586 }
18587
18588 Mouse.OverrideCursor = Cursors.Wait;
18589
18590 _segmentCollisionCancellationTokenSource?.Dispose();
18591 _segmentCollisionCancellationTokenSource = new System.Threading.CancellationTokenSource();
18592
18593 if (measuring_sp != null)
18594 {
18595 measuring_sp.IsSegmentCollisionCheckRunning = true;
18596 measuring_sp.GeneratePaths_Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
18597 }
18598
18599 try
18600 {
18601 DateTime lastSegmentProgressUpdateUtc = DateTime.MinValue;
18602 string runningText = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "SegmentCollision_Running") ?? "Running segment collision validation...";
18603 Machine_Status_ProgressText = runningText;
18604 EyeshotStatus_Text = runningText;
18605
18606 _designControl.Entities.Regen();
18607 _designControl.Invalidate();
18608
18609 Action<int, int, int> progress = (processed, total, collisions) =>
18610 {
18611 if (total <= 0)
18612 return;
18613
18614 if (processed < total &&
18615 (DateTime.UtcNow - lastSegmentProgressUpdateUtc).TotalMilliseconds < 30)
18616 {
18617 return;
18618 }
18619
18620 lastSegmentProgressUpdateUtc = DateTime.UtcNow;
18621 int percent = (int)Math.Round((processed / (double)Math.Max(1, total)) * 100.0);
18622 int remaining = Math.Max(0, total - processed);
18623 string progressFormat = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Progress_SegmentCollisionValidation")
18624 ?? "Validating segment collisions: {0}/{1} checked, {2} left, {3} collisions";
18625 string progressMessage = string.Format(
18626 CultureInfo.CurrentCulture,
18627 progressFormat,
18628 processed,
18629 total,
18630 remaining,
18631 collisions);
18632
18633 Application.Current.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke(() =>
18634 {
18635 Machine_Status_Progress = Math.Max(0, Math.Min(100, percent));
18636 Machine_Status_ProgressText = $"{progressMessage} ({percent}%)";
18637 });
18638 };
18639
18640 var result = await _pathManager.RunGeneratedPathSegmentCollisionValidationAsync(progress, _segmentCollisionCancellationTokenSource.Token);
18641 if (!result.Completed)
18642 {
18643 System.Windows.MessageBox.Show(
18644 GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Progress_SegmentCollisionValidationSkipped") ?? "Segment collision validation skipped",
18645 GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "PathPlanning_SegmentCollisionTitle") ?? "Path Planning Collision Check",
18646 System.Windows.MessageBoxButton.OK,
18647 System.Windows.MessageBoxImage.Information);
18648 return;
18649 }
18650
18651 _pathManager.RegeneratePathVisuals();
18652 measuring_sp?.PopulatePathViewerTree();
18653
18654 string title = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "PathPlanning_SegmentCollisionTitle") ?? "Path Planning Collision Check";
18655 string message = result.Collisions == 0
18656 ? (GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "SegmentCollision_CompleteNoCollisions") ?? "No segment collisions were found.")
18657 : string.Format(
18658 CultureInfo.CurrentCulture,
18659 GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "SegmentCollision_CompleteWithCollisions") ?? "{0} segment(s) collide and were marked red.",
18660 result.Collisions);
18661
18662 EyeshotStatus_Text = message;
18663 System.Windows.MessageBox.Show(
18664 message,
18665 title,
18666 System.Windows.MessageBoxButton.OK,
18667 result.Collisions == 0 ? System.Windows.MessageBoxImage.Information : System.Windows.MessageBoxImage.Warning);
18668 }
18669 catch (Exception ex)
18670 {
18671 System.Windows.MessageBox.Show(
18672 string.Format(
18673 CultureInfo.CurrentCulture,
18674 GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "SegmentCollision_Error") ?? "Segment collision validation failed: {0}",
18675 ex.Message),
18676 GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "PathPlanning_SegmentCollisionTitle") ?? "Path Planning Collision Check",
18677 System.Windows.MessageBoxButton.OK,
18678 System.Windows.MessageBoxImage.Error);
18679 }
18680 finally
18681 {
18682 if (measuring_sp != null)
18683 {
18684 measuring_sp.IsSegmentCollisionCheckRunning = false;
18685 measuring_sp.GeneratePaths_Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
18686 }
18687
18688 Machine_Status_Progress = 0;
18689 Machine_Status_ProgressText = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Idle") ?? "Idle";
18690 Mouse.OverrideCursor = null;
18691 UpdateProbeCollisionCheckMenuVisibility();
18692 }
18693 }

18825 private async Task PreloadToolModelsAsync(bool isScanner)
18826 {
18827 if (_pathManager == null) return;
18828
18829 var modelsToLoad = new List<(string ModelName, bool IsScanner)>();
18830 var seenModelsToLoad = new HashSet<string>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
18831
18832 void AddModelToLoad(string modelName, bool isScan)
18833 {
18834 if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(modelName))
18835 return;
18836
18837 string trimmedModelName = modelName.Trim();
18838 string normalizedModelName = Path.GetFileNameWithoutExtension(trimmedModelName);
18839 if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(normalizedModelName))
18840 return;
18841
18842 string key = $"{(isScan ? "scanner" : "tool")}:{normalizedModelName}";
18843 if (seenModelsToLoad.Add(key))
18844 modelsToLoad.Add((trimmedModelName, isScan));
18845 }
18846
18847 // 1. Add tools referenced by all generated paths
18848 if (_pathManager.ColorPaths != null)
18849 {
18850 foreach (var path in _pathManager.ColorPaths.Values)
18851 {
18852 if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(path.ToolName))
18853 AddModelToLoad(path.ToolName, isScanner);
18854 }
18855 }
18856
18857 // 2. Add currently selected simulation tool
18858 if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_pathManager.CurrentSimulationToolName))
18859 {
18860 AddModelToLoad(_pathManager.CurrentSimulationToolName, isScanner);
18861 }
18862
18863 // 3. Add all available tools from disk so hot-swapping never freezes
18864 if (!isScanner)
18865 {
18866 try
18867 {
18868 var allTools = HirEV_SmartFitSystemsApp.Utilities.ToolModelLoader.GetAvailableToolNames(includeDefaultTool: false);
18869 foreach (var tool in allTools)
18870 {
18871 AddModelToLoad(tool, false);
18872 }
18873 }
18874 catch (Exception ex)
18875 {
18876 Debug.WriteLine($"WARNING: Error scanning available tool models in PreloadToolModelsAsync: {ex.Message}");
18877 }
18878 }
18879 else
18880 {
18881 try
18882 {
18883 var allScanners = HirEV_SmartFitSystemsApp.Utilities.ToolModelLoader.GetAvailableScannerNames();
18884 foreach (var scanner in allScanners)
18885 {
18886 AddModelToLoad(scanner, true);
18887 }
18888 }
18889 catch (Exception ex)
18890 {
18891 Debug.WriteLine($"WARNING: Error scanning available scanner models in PreloadToolModelsAsync: {ex.Message}");
18892 }
18893 }
18894
18895 var uncachedModelsToLoad = modelsToLoad
18896 .Where(model => !HirEV_SmartFitSystemsApp.Utilities.ToolModelLoader.IsModelCached(model.ModelName))
18897 .ToList();
18898
18899 if (uncachedModelsToLoad.Any())
18900 {
18901 _isModelLoading = true;
18902 string loadingModelText = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "LoadingModel") ?? "Loading Model";
18903 string startingText = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "StartingSimulation") ?? "Starting Simulation...";
18904
18905 // Set initial progress bar state
18906 System.Windows.Application.Current?.Dispatcher?.Invoke(() =>
18907 {
18908 StatusProgressBarColor = new SolidColorBrush(System.Windows.Media.Color.FromRgb(128, 128, 128));
18909 Machine_Status_Progress = 0;
18910 Machine_Status_ProgressText = $"{startingText} {loadingModelText} (0%)";
18911 });
18912
18913 try
18914 {
18915 for (int modelIndex = 0; modelIndex < uncachedModelsToLoad.Count; modelIndex++)
18916 {
18917 var modelToLoad = uncachedModelsToLoad[modelIndex];
18918 int currentIndex = modelIndex;
18919 await HirEV_SmartFitSystemsApp.Utilities.ToolModelLoader.LoadModelIntoCacheAsync(modelToLoad.ModelName, modelToLoad.IsScanner, (percent) =>
18920 {
18921 double overallPercent = ((currentIndex + (percent / 100.0)) / uncachedModelsToLoad.Count) * 100.0;
18922 System.Windows.Application.Current?.Dispatcher?.Invoke(() =>
18923 {
18924 Machine_Status_Progress = overallPercent;
18925 Machine_Status_ProgressText = $"{startingText} {loadingModelText} '{modelToLoad.ModelName}' ({overallPercent:F0}%)";
18926 });
18927 });
18928 }
18929 }
18930 catch (Exception ex)
18931 {
18932 Debug.WriteLine($"WARNING: Error preloading tool models: {ex.Message}");
18933 }
18934 finally
18935 {
18936 _isModelLoading = false;
18937 }
18938 }
18939 }

18945 private void RecalculatePaths()
18946 {
18947 if (_pathManager == null || !_pathManager.ColorPaths.Any()) return;
18948
18949 Mouse.OverrideCursor = Cursors.Wait;
18950 try
18951 {
18952 // Backup old state for undo
18953 var oldStates = new Dictionary<Color, ColorPath>();
18954 foreach (var kvp in _pathManager.ColorPaths)
18955 {
18956 oldStates[kvp.Key] = kvp.Value.CloneState();
18957 }
18958
18959 foreach (var kvp in _pathManager.ColorPaths)
18960 {
18961 var path = kvp.Value;
18962
18963 // 1. Gather all active waypoint markers for this path
18964 var baseWaypoints = _designControl.Entities
18965 .Where(ent => ent.EntityData is WaypointData wd && wd.Path == path)
18966 .Select(ent => (WaypointData)ent.EntityData)
18967 .OrderBy(wd => wd.PointIndex)
18968 .ToList();
18969
18970 if (baseWaypoints.Count < 2) continue;
18971
18972 // 2. Extract base waypoint info
18973 var baseInfos = baseWaypoints.Select(wd => new
18974 {
18975 Position = (Point3D)path.Points[wd.PointIndex].Clone(),
18976 Normal = (Vector3D)path.Normals[wd.PointIndex].Clone(),
18977 IsMeasure = path.IsMeasure[wd.PointIndex]
18978 }).ToList();
18979
18980 var newPoints = new List<Point3D>();
18981 var newNormals = new List<Vector3D>();
18982 var newIsMeasure = new List<bool>();
18983
18984 newPoints.Add(baseInfos[0].Position);
18985 newNormals.Add(baseInfos[0].Normal);
18986 newIsMeasure.Add(baseInfos[0].IsMeasure);
18987
18988 for (int i = 0; i < baseInfos.Count - 1; i++)
18989 {
18990 var startInfo = baseInfos[i];
18991 var endInfo = baseInfos[i + 1];
18992
18993 bool shouldRecalculate = _lastRightClickedPart == null ||
18994 IsWaypointOnPart(path, baseWaypoints[i].PointIndex, _lastRightClickedPart) ||
18995 IsWaypointOnPart(path, baseWaypoints[i + 1].PointIndex, _lastRightClickedPart);
18996
18997 if (shouldRecalculate)
18998 {
18999 bool isApproachSegment = (startInfo.IsMeasure && !endInfo.IsMeasure) || (!startInfo.IsMeasure && endInfo.IsMeasure);
19000
19001 if (isApproachSegment)
19002 {
19003 newPoints.Add(endInfo.Position);
19004 newNormals.Add(endInfo.Normal);
19005 newIsMeasure.Add(endInfo.IsMeasure);
19006 }
19007 else
19008 {
19009 List<Point3D> segment = _pathManager.PlanCollisionFreePath(startInfo.Position, endInfo.Position);
19010 if (segment != null && segment.Count >= 2)
19011 {
19012 for (int j = 1; j < segment.Count; j++)
19013 {
19014 newPoints.Add(segment[j]);
19015 if (j == segment.Count - 1)
19016 {
19017 newNormals.Add(endInfo.Normal);
19018 newIsMeasure.Add(endInfo.IsMeasure);
19019 }
19020 else
19021 {
19022 newNormals.Add(Vector3D.AxisZ);
19023 newIsMeasure.Add(false);
19024 }
19025 }
19026 }
19027 else
19028 {
19029 newPoints.Add(endInfo.Position);
19030 newNormals.Add(endInfo.Normal);
19031 newIsMeasure.Add(endInfo.IsMeasure);
19032 }
19033 }
19034 }
19035 else
19036 {
19037 // Copy existing points from path.Points[startWpIdx + 1] to path.Points[endWpIdx]
19038 int startWpIdx = baseWaypoints[i].PointIndex;
19039 int endWpIdx = baseWaypoints[i + 1].PointIndex;
19040 for (int k = startWpIdx + 1; k <= endWpIdx; k++)
19041 {
19042 newPoints.Add((Point3D)path.Points[k].Clone());
19043 newNormals.Add((Vector3D)path.Normals[k].Clone());
19044 newIsMeasure.Add(path.IsMeasure[k]);
19045 }
19046 }
19047 }
19048
19049 path.Points = newPoints;
19050 path.Normals = newNormals;
19051 path.IsMeasure = newIsMeasure;
19052
19053 // Draw the path
19054 _pathManager.DrawSinglePath(path);
19055 }
19056
19057 // Push composite undo command for all modified paths
19058 var commands = new List<IUndoCommand>();
19059 foreach (var kvp in _pathManager.ColorPaths)
19060 {
19061 commands.Add(new UpdateColorPathCommand(_pathManager, _designControl, kvp.Key, oldStates[kvp.Key], kvp.Value.CloneState()));
19062 }
19063 UndoManager.PushCommand(new CompositeCommand(commands));
19064
19065 _designControl.Invalidate();
19066 SaveCurrentSession();
19067 }
19068 catch (Exception ex)
19069 {
19070 MessageBox.Show($"Error recalculating paths: {ex.Message}", GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "MessageBox_InternalError") ?? "Error recalculating paths", MessageBoxButton.OK, MessageBoxImage.Error);
19071 }
19072 finally
19073 {
19074 Mouse.OverrideCursor = null;
19075 }
19076 }
19077 #endregion
19078 }
19079}
